commit.tip: commit to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。
commit.en: To do something illegal or seriously wrong.

community.tip: 既指同地区居民，也指有共同背景或兴趣的群体。
community.en: people living in the same area

compare.tip: 比较可用with或to；表示比喻时通常用to。
compare.en: To examine things to find similarities and differences.

compensate.tip: 赔偿某人用compensate sb for sth；弥补用for。
compensate.en: To give someone money or something else for loss or harm.

concentrate.tip: concentrate on后接名词或动名词，表示专注于。
concentrate.en: To give all your attention to a particular task.

concern.tip: concern about多指对事情的担忧；for常指关心某人。
concern.en: A feeling of worry about something important

conclude.tip: 高频搭配：conclude that / draw a conclusion；同族词：conclusion (n.)、conclusive (adj.)
conclude.en: Commonly used in expressions like "conclude that" (v.).

conduct.tip: 动词重音在后；名词重音在前，英音/ˈkɒndʌkt/。
conduct.en: to organize and carry out an activity

conflict.tip: 名词重音在首音节，动词重音在第二音节。
conflict.en: A serious disagreement or struggle between people or groups.

consequence.tip: as a consequence of后接原因，意为“由于”。
consequence.en: Something that happens because of an action or situation.

considerable.tip: considerable指数量或程度大；considerate指体贴的。
considerable.en: Large in amount, size, or degree.

constant.tip: 可指持续发生，也可指数值不变，须看语境。

contribute.tip: contribute to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。
contribute.en: To give money, time, or effort towards a shared purpose

controversial.tip: 表示引发分歧，不等于错误或不受欢迎。
controversial.en: causing strong disagreement or public debate

conventional.tip: conventional强调符合常规，不一定指历史悠久。
conventional.en: following methods or ideas that are usual and widely accepted

convince.tip: convince sb of sth表示使某人相信某事。
convince.en: to make someone believe something is true

crucial.tip: 比important语气强；常用be crucial to。
crucial.en: extremely important to the success or outcome of something

curious.en: Wanting to learn or know more about something.

debate.tip: 动词可直接接议题；debate whether to表示权衡。
debate.en: A discussion in which people express different views.

demonstrate.tip: 证明某事常用demonstrate that从句。
demonstrate.en: To show clearly that something is true or exists.

derive.tip: derive A from B指从B获得A；derive from指源于。
derive.en: to obtain something from a particular source

determine.tip: determine whether 意为查明是否；后接从句。
determine.en: To discover or establish something through examination.

devote.tip: devote…to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。
devote.en: To give time, effort, or resources to someone or something.

diminish.tip: 既可及物也可不及物：信心可diminish，也可被削弱。
diminish.en: to become smaller or weaker, or make something so

distinguish.tip: 常用distinguish A from B或between A and B。
distinguish.en: to recognize the difference between people or things

diverse.tip: diverse强调种类多或差异大，常修饰群体或范围。
diverse.en: Including many different kinds of people or things.

domestic.tip: 与international相对指国内的；与wild相对指家养的。
domestic.en: relating to activities within a particular country

emerge.tip: 不及物动词；常用emerge from或emerge as。
emerge.en: To become visible or known after being hidden.

emphasize.tip: 高频搭配：emphasize the importance of / strongly emphasize；同族词：emphasis (n.)、emphatic (adj.)
emphasize.en: Commonly used in expressions like "emphasize the importance of" (v.).

enable.tip: 高频搭配：enable somebody to do / enabled by；同族词：enabling (adj.)
enable.en: Commonly used in expressions like "enable somebody to do" (v.).

encounter.tip: 动词直接接宾语；名词常用an encounter with。
encounter.en: meet someone or experience something, especially unexpectedly

enhance.tip: 强调质量、效果或价值提升，不单指数量增加。
enhance.en: Improve the quality, value, or appeal of something

ensure.en: To make certain that something happens or is true

essential.tip: 名词常用复数 essentials，表示必需品或基本要点。
essential.en: Completely necessary for a particular purpose or situation

establish.tip: establish是及物动词，后接机构、制度或事实等。
establish.en: to start an organisation, system, or lasting arrangement

evaluate.tip: 强调依据标准作判断；不只是描述事物。
evaluate.en: Carefully judge the quality, value or effectiveness of something

evidence.tip: 作名词通常不可数：一项证据用a piece of evidence。
evidence.en: Facts or signs that help establish whether something is true.

exceed.tip: 及物动词，直接接数量或限度，不加than。
exceed.en: to be greater than a particular amount, limit, or expectation

expand.tip: “详述”用expand on/upon；扩大某物可直接接宾语。
expand.en: to become larger or make something larger

expose.tip: expose A to B表示使A接触B，B不一定有害。
expose.en: To put someone or something in contact with an influence

facilitate.tip: 后接名词或动名词，不用facilitate somebody to do。
facilitate.en: make an action or process easier

factor.tip: 动词常用factor in，表示把某因素考虑在内。
factor.en: something that influences a result or situation

feature.tip: 作动词时直接接宾语，不说feature with。
feature.en: a noticeable or important part of something

generate.tip: 及物动词，可接电力、收入、兴趣、想法等宾语。
generate.en: Cause something to exist or happen.

guarantee.tip: 可接to do或that从句；保修期内用under guarantee。
guarantee.en: to promise something firmly or make an outcome certain

highlight.tip: 作动词直接接宾语：highlight the problem。
highlight.en: Draw attention to something important or especially noticeable.

impact.tip: 名词重音在前；动词通常读/ɪmˈpækt/。
impact.en: a strong effect on someone or something

government.tip: 英国英语中，指政府群体时可接单数或复数谓语。
government.en: the group of people officially controlling a country or region

system.tip: systematic指有条理的，systemic指全系统的。
system.en: A set of connected parts that work together.

might.tip: 高频搭配：might as well (不妨，何妨) / might well (有可能)；同族词：might (v.)
might.en: Commonly used in expressions like "might as well (不妨，何妨)" (v.).

part.tip: 高频搭配：part of (部分的) / in part (部分地)；同族词：parts (复数)、parted (过去分词)、parting (现在分词)
part.en: Commonly used in expressions like "part of (部分的)" (n.).

however.tip: 表转折时不是并列连词；勿仅用逗号连接两句。
however.en: Used to introduce a contrasting statement.

area.tip: 表示面积时常用平方米等单位；也可指研究领域。
area.en: A particular part of a place or geographical region

against.tip: against是介词，后接名词、代词或动名词。
against.en: Opposing someone or something, or competing with them.

provide.tip: 用provide sb with sth或provide sth for sb。
provide.en: To give someone something they need or make it available.

point.tip: make a point是提出观点；point at是指着。
point.en: an idea or detail expressed in speech or writing

follow.en: To move behind someone or along a route.

local.tip: 名词复数locals指当地人；locally是副词。
local.en: relating to the area where someone lives or something happens

program.tip: 英式计算机程序用program；计划、节目用programme。
program.en: A set of instructions that tells a computer what to do.

although.tip: 引导让步从句；同一句通常不再用but连接主句。

fact.tip: the fact that后接完整从句，说明事实内容。
fact.en: Something known or proved to be true.

social.tip: social指社会或社交的；sociable指人爱交际。
social.en: relating to society and how people live together

business.tip: 指商业活动时不可数；指具体企业时可数。
business.en: The activity of buying and selling goods or services.

happen.tip: 不用于被动语态；happen to do表示碰巧做某事。
happen.en: to take place, often without being planned

power.tip: 表示有权做某事用have the power to do。
power.en: The ability or authority to control people, events, or decisions.

interest.tip: 兴趣用interest in；具体爱好可用复数interests。
interest.en: a desire to learn about or become involved in something

national.tip: national侧重一国整体；international指国际的。
national.en: relating to a whole country or its people

level.tip: at表示所处水平；on the same level可指同一楼层。
level.en: A particular standard, amount, or height of something.

include.tip: include常列出部分内容，不表示完整清单。
include.en: have someone or something as part of a whole

issue.tip: issue 作问题常指需讨论的议题，不一定是困难。
issue.en: An important subject or problem that needs discussion.

perhaps.tip: perhaps比maybe略正式，可放句首使建议更委婉。
perhaps.en: Used when something is possible but not certain.

policy.tip: policy是政策或保险单；politics指政治。
policy.en: an agreed plan or rule guiding decisions and actions

council.tip: council指议会或委员会；counsel指建议或劝告。
council.en: A group chosen to govern an area or manage affairs.

market.tip: a market for sth指对某物的市场需求。
market.en: a place where people buy and sell goods

court.tip: in court指在法庭上；on court指在球场上。
court.en: a place or institution where legal cases are heard

allow.tip: 用allow sb to do；无宾语时可用allow doing。

effect.tip: effect常作名词；affect常作动词，意为影响。
effect.en: A change or result caused by something.

lead.tip: 铅读/led/；动词读/liːd/，过去式和过去分词为led。
lead.en: To guide people or cause something to happen

result.tip: result in后接结果；result from后接原因。
result.en: something that happens because of an action or event

line.tip: 排队在美式英语中常用stand in line，英式常用queue。
line.en: a long, thin mark on a surface

political.tip: political是形容词；politics指政治，politician指政治家。
political.en: relating to government, public power, or political parties

law.tip: 具体一条法律可数；法学用不可数的law。
law.en: an official rule, or the system of such rules

later.tip: later表示稍后；latter表示两者中的后者。
later.en: at a time after now or another mentioned time

lose.tip: 过去式和过去分词都是lost；别与loose混淆。
lose.en: to become unable to find something you had

authority.tip: 表权力通常不可数；the authorities常指当局。
authority.en: the power or right to make decisions and enforce rules

appear.tip: 表“似乎”可接形容词或to do；不能直接接宾语。
appear.en: To become visible or come into view.

continue.tip: 可接to do或doing，通常都表示继续做某事。
continue.en: To keep doing something or keep happening.

minister.tip: 动词义较正式，常用minister to表示照料。
minister.en: A senior government official responsible for a particular area.

produce.tip: 动词重音在后，名词重音在前；农产品义不可数。
produce.en: To make, grow, or create something.

rate.tip: rate可指比率或单位费用；评价某物用rate。
rate.en: How often something happens or how quickly something changes.

general.tip: in general意为“一般来说”，常用于概括。
general.en: affecting or involving most people, things, or situations

least.tip: least是little的最高级；修饰可数名词用fewest。

president.tip: 可指总统，也可指机构负责人；具体译法看语境。
president.en: the head of state in a country without a monarch

real.tip: real修饰名词；表示“很、真正地”通常用really。
real.en: existing in fact rather than being imagined

offer.tip: 主动做某事用offer to do，不用offer doing。
offer.en: Say you are willing to give something or do something.

view.tip: 观点用view on；把某事视为用view…as…。
view.en: An opinion or belief about something.

consider.tip: “考虑做”用consider doing，不用consider to do。
consider.en: to think carefully about something before deciding

kid.tip: kid较口语；正式作文中“孩子”宜用child。
kid.en: A child or young person, in informal language.

public.tip: the public指公众；in public指在公共场合。
public.en: For everyone to use, see, or know about.

require.tip: require sb to do sth表示要求某人做某事。
require.en: To need something for a particular purpose

period.tip: 表示一段时间常用a period of；美式英语也指句号。
period.en: A length of time or a stage in history.

figure.tip: 数据常用复数figures；figure out意为弄懂。
figure.en: a number expressing an amount, especially in official information

centre.tip: centre是英式拼写，美式写center；动词常接on。
centre.en: The middle point or area of something.

police.tip: the police作主语用复数；一名警察用a police officer。
police.en: The official organisation responsible for preventing crime and maintaining order.

add.tip: add A to B表示把A加入B；add to还可表示增添。
add.en: to put something with something else or increase an amount

create.tip: create强调创造新事物，也可接problem表示造成问题。
create.en: to make something new or bring something into existence

probably.tip: 通常置于实义动词前、be动词后或第一个助动词后。
probably.en: Used when something is likely but not certain.

control.tip: 过去式controlled、现在分词controlling均双写l。
control.en: The power to direct or limit someone or something.

action.tip: take action中的action不可数；具体举动可用actions。
action.en: Something done to achieve a result or address a problem.

process.tip: in the process of后接名词或动名词。
process.en: A series of actions or changes leading to a result.

remain.tip: 表示保持某状态时，后接形容词或名词，不用副词。
remain.en: to continue to be in the same state

position.tip: 表示立场常用position on；表示职位为可数名词。
position.en: where something is or how a body is arranged

art.tip: art指艺术通常不可数；一件作品用a work of art。
art.en: creative expression through activities such as painting, sculpture, or drawing

course.tip: course 是整门课程；lesson 是其中的一节课。
course.en: A series of lessons about a particular subject.

history.tip: historical指与历史有关；historic指有历史意义。
history.en: Past events, or the study of them.

education.tip: 通常不可数；但可说a good education（良好教育）。
education.en: The process of learning or teaching knowledge and skills.

actually.en: in fact, often surprisingly or contrary to what was expected

type.tip: type of后接名词；表示多种类型用types of。
type.en: a group of things sharing particular features

subject.tip: 动词重音在后：/səbˈdʒekt/；常用subject A to B。

guy.tip: guy属口语；正式写作通常用man或person。
guy.en: An informal word for a man.

value.en: the worth, price, or importance of something

force.tip: “迫使某人做某事”用force somebody to do something。
force.en: physical power that moves something or changes its shape

act.tip: act as表示充当；act还可指戏剧的一幕。
act.en: To take action, behave in a way, or perform a role.

main.tip: 形容词通常放在名词前；主要地用mainly。
main.en: Most important or largest among others.

less.tip: 修饰不可数名词用less；可数名词复数通常用fewer。

decision.tip: 作决定用make a decision，不用do。
decision.en: a choice made after considering different possibilities

industry.en: the production of goods in factories

patient.tip: 作名词是“患者”；作形容词常接with。

major.tip: 动词主修用major in；主要用于美式英语。

church.tip: go to church指做礼拜；go to the church指去教堂。
church.en: a building where Christians gather to worship

describe.tip: 说describe something to someone，不说describe someone something。
describe.en: to explain what someone or something is like

condition.tip: 表状态通常不可数；表工作、生活环境常用复数。
condition.en: The physical state of someone or something

human.en: Relating to people rather than animals or machines.

economic.tip: economic指经济方面的；economical指节约的。
economic.en: Relating to trade, industry, money, or the study of these.

reach.tip: 表示到达时直接接地点：reach the station，不加at。
reach.en: to arrive at a place or achieve a particular level

century.tip: 世纪序数比年份前两位大一：如1901—2000为20世纪。
century.en: A period of one hundred years.

therefore.tip: 是副词，不能仅用逗号连接两个完整句子。
therefore.en: as a result of what has just been stated

section.tip: section可指文章章节，也可指商店等场所的区域。
section.en: A distinct part of something larger.

activity.tip: 具体活动可数；泛指活跃或活动量时不可数。
activity.en: Something people do for enjoyment, learning, or a particular purpose.

nation.tip: nation强调国家及人民，state常强调政权或政治实体。
nation.en: A country considered together with its people

death.tip: die是动词，dead是形容词，death是名词。
death.en: the end of a person's or animal's life

involve.tip: 表示需要做某事，用involve doing，不用to do。
involve.en: to include something as a necessary part

experience.tip: 表“经验”不可数；表具体“经历”可数。
experience.en: knowledge or skill gained by doing things

sort.tip: a sort of表示“一种”；sort of也可口语表示“有点”。
sort.en: a group of things sharing similar characteristics

likely.tip: 高频搭配：is likely to (有可能…) / most likely (最可能)；同族词：likeliest (最高级)
likely.en: Commonly used in expressions like "is likely to (有可能…)" (adj./adv.).

staff.tip: 单个员工用a member of staff，不说a staff。
staff.en: The people employed by an organisation.

kill.tip: kill强调造成死亡；die表示自身死亡，不接宾语。
kill.en: To cause a person, animal, or other organism to die

particular.tip: in particular意为尤其；be particular about表示对……讲究。
particular.en: used to refer to one specific person, thing, or situation

certain.tip: 人作主语时，certain of表确信；certain to表必然。

particularly.tip: 高频搭配：particularly — 特别；同族词：particularly (adv.)
particularly.en: Commonly used in expressions like "particularly — 特别" (adv.).

former.tip: the former 指两者中的前者，the latter 指后者。
former.en: having a particular role or condition in the past

management.tip: 指管理工作时不可数；the management可指管理层。
management.en: The work of organising and controlling activities or resources.

department.tip: 大学的系可用department；学院通常用faculty或school。
department.en: a division of an organisation responsible for a particular subject

committee.tip: 高频搭配：party committee (党委) / standing committee (常务委员会)；同族词：committees (复数)
committee.en: Commonly used in expressions like "party committee (党委)" (n.).

product.tip: product是产品或结果，production是生产过程。
product.en: something made or grown to be sold or used

effort.tip: 表示精力时不可数；表示一次尝试时可数。
effort.en: physical or mental energy used to achieve something

rather.tip: would rather后接动词原形；rather than意为“而不是”。
rather.en: To a noticeable degree, often more than expected.

drug.tip: 可指治病的药，也可指毒品，须看语境。
drug.en: A substance used to prevent or treat illness.

leader.tip: leader指领导者；leadership指领导能力或领导层。
leader.en: Someone who guides or directs a group of people.

union.tip: union以辅音/j/开头，因此说a union而非an union。
union.en: an organisation that protects workers' rights and interests

finally.tip: 表示终于常置于实义动词前；引出最后一点常置句首。
finally.en: After a long wait, delay, or effort.

event.tip: in the event of后接名词，意为“万一发生”。
event.en: Something that happens, especially an important or planned occasion.

military.tip: 作名词指整体军队时，通常用the military。
military.en: relating to armed forces or their activities

cause.tip: 名词常接of；动词可用cause sb to do sth。
cause.en: something that makes an event or situation happen

according.tip: 通常用according to，不单独作形容词。
according.en: As stated or reported by someone or something

thus.tip: thus是副词，不能仅用逗号连接两个独立句。
thus.en: As a result of what has just been stated

explain.tip: 说explain something to someone，不说explain someone。
explain.en: to make something clear or easy to understand

support.tip: support是及物动词；名词常用support for。
support.en: to help, encourage, provide for, or agree with someone

stage.tip: 表示阶段常用at a stage；表示在舞台上用on stage。
stage.en: A particular period or step in a process.

range.tip: range from A to B表示变化范围；山脉用名词。
range.en: The extent or variety of things within certain limits.

trade.tip: trade A for B指用A换B；by trade指职业上。
trade.en: the activity of buying and selling goods or services

relationship.tip: 与某人的关系用with；两者关系用between。
relationship.en: The way people know, feel about, and treat each other.

accept.tip: 接受建议用accept；接受某物不等于仅仅收到receive。
accept.en: Agree to receive something or say yes to an offer

god.tip: 指唯一的神用God，通常不加冠词；泛指神用god。
god.en: The supreme being worshipped in religions believing in one god.

club.tip: join a club表示加入社团，不用join in a club。
club.en: an organisation whose members share an interest or activity

federal.tip: 高频搭配：federal reserve (（美国）联邦储备系统) / federal government (联邦政府)；同族词：federal (adj.)
federal.en: Commonly used in expressions like "federal reserve (（美国）联邦储备系统)" (adj.).

difference.tip: 比较两者用the difference between A and B。
difference.en: A way in which people or things are not alike

account.tip: account for可表示“解释原因”或“占某比例”。
account.en: an arrangement for managing money or accessing a service

material.tip: 资料义通常不可数；多种材料可用materials。
material.en: A substance used to make things, including cloth.

situation.tip: 表示处于某种情况，用in a situation。
situation.en: The conditions and events affecting someone or something at a time.

model.tip: model还可作动词，表示建模或当模特。
model.en: a representation showing how something looks, works, or is organised

record.tip: 名词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。
record.en: Stored information about events, activities, or a person's history.

tax.tip: tax可作名词或动词；taxing常指费力的、累人的。
tax.en: Money paid to the government to fund public services.

project.tip: 名词重音在前，动词重音在后；音标按此顺序列出。
project.en: A planned piece of work with a particular purpose.

director.tip: 既可指机构主管或董事，也可指影视、戏剧导演。
director.en: Someone who manages an organisation, department, or company.

player.tip: 乐器演奏者可用“乐器名＋player”，如piano player。
player.en: someone who takes part in a sport or game

base.tip: base A on B表示“以B为依据建立A”。
base.en: The lowest supporting part or underlying foundation of something.

especially.en: more than usual, or more than other people or things

central.tip: central to表示“对……至关重要”，介词用to。
central.en: in or near the middle of a place

apply.tip: apply for接申请事项；apply to接机构或适用对象。
apply.en: To formally ask for a job, place, or permission

increase.tip: 动词重音在后，名词在前；by接增量，to接终值。
increase.en: Become greater in amount or size, or make something greater

official.tip: official强调官方认可；formal强调形式或场合正式。
official.en: approved or issued by a government or organisation

center.tip: 高频搭配：research center (研究中心) / in the center of (在中央，在中间)；同族词：centers (复数)、centered (过去分词)、centering (现在分词)
center.en: Commonly used in expressions like "research center (研究中心)" (n.).

couple.tip: a couple of后接复数名词，可指两个或少数几个。
couple.en: Two people who are married or in a romantic relationship.

site.tip: site指地点或网站；sight指视力或景象，二者同音。
site.en: A place where something is built, happens, or once existed.

claim.tip: claim强调某人的说法，不代表已得到证实。
claim.en: to say something is true, often without providing proof

hit.tip: 过去式、过去分词仍为hit；现在分词为hitting。
hit.en: Strike someone or something with force.

indeed.en: Used to confirm something or emphasize that it is true.

quality.tip: 表示质量通常不可数；表示特质时可数。
quality.en: How good or bad something is.

similar.tip: 用similar to，不用similar with；相似不等于相同。
similar.en: Almost the same, but not exactly alike.

oil.tip: 通常不可数；表示不同种类的油时可用oils。
oil.en: A thick underground liquid used to produce fuel and chemicals.

pound.tip: 英镑和重量单位磅都用pound；复数通常加s。
pound.en: the main unit of money used in the United Kingdom

data.tip: 日常常作不可数名词；学术语境也用复数谓语。
data.en: facts or information collected for analysis or computer use

nature.tip: 指大自然时通常不加the；某事的性质用the nature of。
nature.en: The physical world, including plants, animals, and landscapes.

common.tip: common指常见或共有；ordinary强调普通、不特别。
common.en: happening often or found in many places

image.tip: 既可指具体图像，也可指个人或机构的公众形象。
image.en: A picture or visual representation of someone or something.

officer.tip: officer可指警察或军官，具体含义看搭配。

structure.tip: structure既可作名词，也可作动词表示组织、安排。
structure.en: The way parts are arranged and connected within a whole.

phone.tip: 动词直接接人：phone someone，不加to。
phone.en: a device used to speak to people at a distance

contain.tip: 及物动词，直接接宾语；表示“含有”时通常不用进行时。
contain.en: to have something inside or as a part

unit.tip: 表示计量单位时常用a unit of，后接所计量的事物。
unit.en: a single part or quantity within a larger whole

method.tip: 常用a method of/for doing sth表示做事的方法。
method.en: A particular way of doing something.

movement.tip: 指具体动作或社会运动时可数；泛指移动可不可数。
movement.en: an act of changing position or moving the body

detail.tip: in detail不用复数；联系方式用contact details。
detail.en: a small fact or feature of something

recent.tip: recent是形容词；修饰动作要用recently。
recent.en: having happened or started a short time ago

reduce.tip: reduce by接减少量；reduce to接减少后的量。
reduce.en: To make something smaller or less in amount or degree.

single.tip: 单程票英式常说single ticket，美式用one-way ticket。
single.en: Only one, rather than several or many.

personal.tip: personal指个人的；personnel指全体员工，注意拼写。
personal.en: Belonging or relating to one particular person.

movie.tip: movie偏美式，英式常用film；the movies可指电影院。
movie.en: a recorded story or sequence of moving images for watching

private.tip: in private表示私下地；in public表示公开地。
private.en: For a particular person or group, not for everyone.

amount.tip: amount of接不可数名词；动词常用amount to。
amount.en: How much of something there is.

technology.tip: 泛指科技时不可数；多种具体技术可用technologies。
technology.en: Practical use of scientific knowledge, especially through tools and machines.

scheme.tip: 高频搭配：design scheme (设计方案) / scheme design ([经]初步设计)；同族词：schemes (复数)、scheming (现在分词)、schemed (过去式)
scheme.en: Commonly used in expressions like "design scheme (设计方案)" (n.).

award.tip: 高频搭配：academy award (奥斯卡金像奖) / award ceremony (颁奖仪式，颁奖典礼)；同族词：awarded (过去分词)、awards (复数)、awarding (现在分词)
award.en: Commonly used in expressions like "academy award (奥斯卡金像奖)" (v./n.).

seek.tip: 过去式和过去分词均为sought；后直接接宾语。
seek.en: To try to find or obtain something.

attention.tip: pay attention to后接名词或动名词，to是介词。
attention.en: The act of focusing your mind on someone or something.

achieve.tip: 直接接目标或成果，不说achieve to do。
achieve.en: Successfully reach a goal or result through effort.

chapter.tip: 书的“章”用chapter；章内较小部分常用section。
chapter.en: one of the main sections of a book

republican.tip: 小写指共和主义；大写常指特定共和党。
republican.en: Supporting government without a monarch, usually through elected representatives

choose.tip: 过去式chose，过去分词chosen；后接to do。
choose.en: to decide which person or thing you want

organization.tip: 指机构时可数，指组织工作时不可数；英式也写organisation。
organization.en: A group of people working together for a shared purpose.

deal.tip: deal with表示处理；a great deal of后接不可数名词。
deal.en: an agreement between people or organisations, especially in business

theory.tip: in theory意为“理论上”，常与in practice对比。
theory.en: an organized explanation of facts or how something works

property.tip: 财产义不可数；房产和性质义可数。
property.en: things that belong to a person or organisation

source.tip: 来源常用source of；作动词可用source…from…。
source.en: A place, person, or thing that something comes from.

financial.tip: financial侧重金钱与财务；economic侧重经济整体。
financial.en: relating to money or how it is managed

firm.tip: 作名词指公司；作形容词可指物体结实或态度坚定。
firm.en: a business that provides goods or professional services

application.tip: 申请某物用application for，向机构申请用to。
application.en: a formal request for a job, place, or permission

production.tip: production通常不可数；指一部演出作品时可数。
production.en: the process of making or growing things for use

board.tip: board作动词可直接接交通工具：board a train。
board.en: A flat piece of wood or other firm material.

culture.tip: 泛指文化通常不可数；不同文化可用cultures。
culture.en: the shared beliefs, customs and ways of life of a group

billion.tip: 具体数值后不加s；泛指数十亿用billions of。

king.tip: king指男性君主；queen可指女王或王后。
king.en: a male ruler who usually inherits his position

chance.tip: 机会用chance to do；可能性常用chance of doing。

energy.tip: 表示精力或能源时通常不可数，不说 an energy。
energy.en: The strength and enthusiasm needed for physical or mental activity

realize.tip: 英式也拼作realise；意识到某事可接that从句。
realize.en: To become aware of something or understand it clearly

opportunity.tip: 常用an opportunity to do，表示做某事的机会。
opportunity.en: A situation that makes it possible to do something.

operation.tip: 手术部位用on连接：an operation on the knee。
operation.en: Medical treatment involving cutting into the body.

lord.tip: 指上帝用the Lord；置于姓名前作头衔也大写。
lord.en: a man with a high noble rank or historical authority

contract.tip: 名词重音在前；动词英/kənˈtrækt/，美同。
contract.en: A legally binding agreement between people or organisations.

choice.tip: choice是名词，choose是动词；选择做某事用choose to do。
choice.en: the act or freedom of choosing between different possibilities

security.tip: security侧重防范威胁；safety更广指免受危险。
security.en: Protection against danger, crime, loss, or unwanted access

occur.tip: 不用于被动语态；过去式occurred，分词occurring。
occur.en: Happen, especially at a particular time or place.

administration.tip: 指管理工作时通常不可数；指一届政府时可数。
administration.en: The work of organising and running an institution or business.

election.tip: elect强调投票选出；select泛指挑选。
election.en: a process in which people vote to choose representatives

congress.tip: 特指美国等国家的国会时，通常大写Congress。
congress.en: A national body of representatives that makes laws.

population.tip: 人口多或少用large或small，不用many或few。
population.en: all people living in an area, or their total number

various.tip: 通常接复数可数名词，如various reasons。

economy.tip: economic指经济的；economical指节省的、划算的。
economy.en: the system of producing, trading, and using goods and services

represent.tip: represent是动词；on behalf of是“代表”的介词短语。
represent.en: To speak or act officially for someone or a group.

medical.tip: medical作名词多用于英式英语，指体检，不指医生。
medical.en: Related to medicine or the treatment of illness.

loss.tip: loss是名词，lose是动词，过去式和过去分词为lost。
loss.en: The fact of no longer having someone or something.

risk.tip: risk后接名词或动名词，不接to do。
risk.en: the possibility that something harmful or unpleasant will happen

clearly.tip: 句首Clearly常表示“显然”，而非“清晰地”。
clearly.en: In a way that is easy to see, hear, or understand.

current.tip: 形容词指当前的；名词可指水流或电流。
current.en: happening, existing, or being used now

purpose.tip: on purpose意为“故意地”，不是“有目的地”。
purpose.en: the reason for doing something or what something is intended for

benefit.tip: benefit sb指使某人受益；benefit from指得益于。
benefit.en: a helpful or positive effect of something

behavior.tip: 美式拼写；英式为behaviour。通常不可数。
behavior.en: the way a person or animal acts

anyone.tip: 作主语时谓语用单数；any one强调任意一个。

per.tip: per后通常接单数名词，不加冠词，如per day。

prove.tip: prove可接that从句，也可直接接形容词。
prove.en: Show that something is true using evidence

argue.tip: argue that常用于议论文，表示提出有理由的主张。
argue.en: To disagree with someone, often in an angry way.

charge.tip: 向某人收取某项费用：charge someone for something。
charge.en: Ask someone to pay a particular amount for something.

performance.tip: 表示整体表现通常不可数；一场演出用a performance。
performance.en: How well a person, organisation or machine does something.

fight.tip: 过去式、过去分词均为fought；fight for表示争取。
fight.en: To use physical force against another person or group.

pattern.tip: 表示规律常用a pattern of＋名词。
pattern.en: A regular or repeated way something happens or is done.

design.tip: be designed to do表示“旨在做……”。
design.en: plan how something will look or work before making it

goal.tip: 目标用set或achieve；进球用score a goal。
goal.en: Something you want to accomplish through effort.

royal.tip: royal指王室的；loyal指忠诚的，注意首字母。
royal.en: Relating to a king, queen, or their family.

author.tip: “……的作者”用the author of；也可作动词。
author.en: A person who writes books, articles, or other written works.

despite.tip: 后接名词或动名词，不加of；接从句用the fact that。
despite.en: Without being prevented or affected by something.

pressure.tip: under pressure表示承压；动词常接into doing。
pressure.en: Worry or demands that make someone feel forced to act

focus.tip: focus on后接名词或动名词；不要说focus in。
focus.en: direct attention or effort towards one particular thing

knowledge.tip: 通常不可数；可说a good knowledge of某领域。
knowledge.en: information and understanding gained through learning or experience

drop.tip: drop by表示下降了多少；drop to表示降至多少。
drop.en: to fall, let something fall, or become lower

blood.tip: blood通常不可数；一次验血用a blood test。
blood.en: the red liquid that carries oxygen around your body

agency.tip: 表示机构时可数；表示自主行动能力时通常不可数。
agency.en: A business that arranges services for people or other businesses.

basis.tip: 复数为bases；on a daily basis意为每天。
basis.en: The main facts or ideas supporting something.

further.tip: further可指程度或距离；farther主要指距离。
further.en: to a greater degree or a more distant place

color.tip: 高频搭配：color in (填色，用颜色填) / color image (彩色图像)；同族词：colors (复数)、coloring (现在分词)、colored (过去式)
color.en: Commonly used in expressions like "color in (填色，用颜色填)" (n.).

introduce.tip: 把甲介绍给乙用introduce A to B，不能用with。
introduce.en: Tell people each other's names when they first meet.

recently.tip: 可用于一般过去时或现在完成时，不只限于完成时。
recently.en: Not long ago, or during the period just before now.

series.en: several related things or events following one another

environment.tip: 泛指自然环境常用the environment。
environment.en: The natural world, including land, water, air, and living things.

enter.tip: 进入某地用enter a place，不加into。
enter.en: To go or come into a place.

analysis.en: Careful examination of something to understand its parts or meaning

natural.tip: natural指天然的；nature是名词，指自然。
natural.en: existing in nature rather than made by people

region.tip: in the region of接金额等，表示“大约”。
region.en: an area of a country or the world

list.tip: 在名单上用on the list，不用in。
list.en: Related items or names written one below another.

race.tip: race可指竞速比赛或种族；不要与民族混同。
race.en: A competition to see who finishes a course fastest.

statement.tip: 作“陈述”时是可数名词；银行对账单也用statement。
statement.en: something said or written to express information or an opinion

significant.tip: 统计上significant指达到显著性标准，不等于实际影响很大。
significant.en: large or important enough to deserve attention

relation.tip: 国家或群体间的关系常用复数relations。
relation.en: a connection between people, things, or ideas

principle.tip: 勿混principal：它可指“主要的”或“校长”。
principle.en: A belief or rule that guides decisions and behaviour.

demand.tip: 要求做某事用demand to do，不用demand sb to do。
demand.en: the desire or need for particular goods or services

labour.tip: 高频搭配：labour force (n. 劳动力) / surplus labour (【政治经济学】剩余劳动(力))；同族词：labours (复数)、labouring (现在分词)、laboured (过去式)
labour.en: Commonly used in expressions like "labour force (n. 劳动力)" (n.).

response.en: Something said or written as an answer.

refer.en: mention someone or something, or have them as the meaning

capital.tip: 表示资金时通常不可数；表示大写字母时可数。
capital.en: the city where a country or region's government is based

decade.tip: a decade是十年；decades常泛指数十年。

article.tip: 一件衣物可说an article of clothing。
article.en: A piece of writing in a newspaper, magazine, or website.

shoot.tip: 过去式和过去分词均为shot；shoot at指朝……射击。
shoot.en: Fire a gun or another weapon; hit with a bullet

save.tip: save money既可指省钱，也可指存钱。
save.en: To prevent someone or something from being harmed or lost.

artist.tip: artist指艺术家；artistic是形容词“艺术的”。
artist.en: a person who creates paintings, sculptures, or other art

individual.tip: 形容词强调单个或个人；作可数名词指一个人或个体。
individual.en: Relating to one person or thing rather than a group

attempt.tip: 动词后接to do；名词常用an attempt at doing。
attempt.en: An effort to do something, especially something difficult.

stock.tip: 库存通常不可数；表示不同公司的股票时可用stocks。
stock.en: Goods available for sale or supplies kept for future use.

career.tip: career侧重长期职业发展，job指具体工作。
career.en: a person's working life, often within a particular profession

association.tip: 高频搭配：association with (与…的交往) / trade association (贸易协会)；同族词：associations (复数)
association.en: Commonly used in expressions like "association with (与…的交往)" (n.).

income.tip: income范围比salary广，也包括租金、投资收益。
income.en: Money received regularly from work, investments, or other sources.

treatment.tip: 泛指治疗通常不可数；指具体疗法时可用a treatment。
treatment.en: medical care given to improve an illness or injury

beyond.tip: beyond不仅表位置，也可表示超出能力或限度。
beyond.en: on the farther side of something

relate.tip: relate to可指“与……有关”，也可指“产生共鸣”。
relate.en: To have or establish a connection between things.

following.tip: 高频搭配：in the following (在下面) / answer the following questions (回答下列问题)；同族词：follow (词根/原形)、followings (复数)
following.en: Commonly used in expressions like "in the following (在下面)" (adj.).

exactly.tip: not exactly常表示并非完全，也可委婉否定。
exactly.en: Precisely, with no difference or error.

protect.tip: 常用protect sb/sth from或against，表示免受伤害。
protect.en: To keep someone or something safe from harm or damage

manage.tip: manage to do表示成功做成，不只是尝试。
manage.en: To succeed in doing something, especially something difficult.

fund.tip: 专用基金可说 a fund；泛指可用资金常用 funds。
fund.en: money saved or collected for a particular purpose

identify.tip: identify with某人指产生共鸣，不是辨认对方。
identify.en: To recognize and establish who or what someone or something is.

media.tip: 统称新闻媒体常用the media；单一媒介用medium。
media.en: Organisations and channels that provide news and information publicly.

sign.tip: sign中的g不发音；a sign of后接名词或动名词。
sign.en: Something indicating that a condition exists or may develop

whatever.tip: whatever不限范围；whichever常指限定范围内任选。

difficulty.tip: 用have difficulty doing，不用difficulty to do。
difficulty.en: The state of being hard to do or understand.

degree.tip: 某专业的学位用a degree in；程度义常见to some degree。
degree.en: a qualification awarded after completing a university course

legal.tip: legal可指“法律相关的”，不一定指“合法的”。
legal.en: Relating to laws or the system that applies them

resource.tip: 资源总称常用复数resources；动词意为提供资源。
resource.en: Something useful that people or organisations can draw on.

cell.tip: 生物语境常指细胞；prison cell指牢房。
cell.en: the smallest living unit of an organism

growth.tip: 表示增长通常不可数；a growth可指一个肿块。
growth.en: An increase in size, amount, or level.

mile.tip: 英里是距离单位；mile可数，复数加s。
mile.en: A unit of distance equal to approximately 1.61 kilometres.

lady.tip: woman是中性通用词；lady常用于礼貌称呼。
lady.en: a polite word for an adult woman

prepare.tip: prepare for后接名词；prepare to后接动词原形。
prepare.en: Make someone or something ready for an activity or situation

disease.tip: 重音在第二音节；泛指疾病可不加冠词。
disease.en: An illness affecting humans, animals or plants

final.tip: finally是副词；final作名词可指决赛或期末考试。
final.en: coming last in a series or process

recognize.tip: 英式也常拼作recognise；表示“认出”时通常不用进行时。
recognize.en: Identify someone or something known or seen before.

task.tip: 作动词用task sb with doing sth，表示指派任务。
task.en: A piece of work that needs to be done.

function.tip: function as后接名词，表示起……作用。
function.en: The purpose or job of something or someone.

ability.tip: 表示“做某事的能力”用ability to do。
ability.en: the skill or power needed to do something

provision.tip: 表“提供”不可数；表“条款”可数；provisions可指粮食。
provision.en: The act of supplying something needed.

county.tip: 英国的county通常译为“郡”，美国的译为“县”。
county.en: An administrative area within a country or state.

indicate.en: to show that something exists or is likely

character.tip: 作“人物、字符”可数；作整体品质常不可数。
character.en: the qualities that make someone or something distinctive

defence.tip: 英式拼写 defence；美式拼写 defense。
defence.en: Action taken to protect someone or something from attack or harm.

attack.tip: 动词直接接宾语；名词常用an attack on。
attack.en: Try to hurt someone or criticize something strongly

obtain.tip: 比get正式；常用obtain sth from sb或某机构。
obtain.en: To get something, especially through effort or a formal process.

announce.tip: 用announce sth或announce that，不用announce sb sth。
announce.en: To make information known publicly or officially.

feeling.tip: feelings常指感情；have a feeling that表示直觉。
feeling.en: An emotional state or response to something

pretty.tip: 作副词表示“相当”时偏口语，正式写作可用fairly。
pretty.en: Attractive and pleasant to look at.

hall.tip: 英式英语中，大学宿舍常称halls或halls of residence。
hall.en: an entrance area or passage connecting rooms in a building

physical.tip: physical偏身体或物质；physiological指生理的。
physical.en: Relating to the body rather than the mind.

lay.en: to put something down carefully or arrange it flat

message.tip: message是可数名词；information通常不可数。
message.en: Information sent or left for someone to read or hear.

outside.tip: 后接地点用介词 outside；单独使用可作副词。
outside.en: In or towards a place that is not inside.

normal.tip: normal强调符合常态；ordinary强调普通、不特别。
normal.en: usual, expected, or typical in a particular situation

investment.tip: 通常搭配in；表示投资行为时常作不可数名词。
investment.en: Money put into something with the aim of future profit.

lawyer.tip: lawyer是律师的统称，区别于法官judge。
lawyer.en: Someone qualified to advise people about law and represent them.

army.tip: army主要指陆军；armed forces泛指各军种。
army.en: A country's military force trained mainly to fight on land.

suffer.tip: 疾病常用suffer from；损失、损坏常直接接在suffer后。
suffer.en: To experience physical pain or mental distress.

previous.tip: previous是形容词；表示“以前”用副词previously。
previous.en: happening or existing before the time or thing being discussed

maintain.tip: maintain后直接接宾语；表示坚持声称时可接that从句。
maintain.en: To keep something at the same level or in existence.

professor.tip: 英国通常指高级职称；美国也泛指大学教师。
professor.en: A university teacher, especially one holding a senior academic position.

crime.tip: 泛指犯罪不可数；指具体罪行可数，如commit a crime。
crime.en: illegal activities considered as a whole

publish.tip: publish强调向公众发行或公布，不等于仅仅印刷。
publish.en: to produce books or other writing for public reading

france.tip: 国名France首字母大写，通常不加the。
france.en: a country in western Europe whose capital is Paris

responsibility.tip: 泛指责任常不可数；具体职责可数；后常接for。
responsibility.en: The duty to manage something or answer for its results.

total.tip: in total表示“总共”；totally常表示“完全地”。
total.en: including everything, or complete in degree

argument.tip: 争吵常接with或about；支持某观点用argument for。

anyway.tip: anyway是副词；any way指任何方式。
anyway.en: Despite what has happened or what someone has said.

avoid.tip: 后接名词或动名词：avoid doing，不用to do。
avoid.en: to prevent something from happening or refrain from doing something

bill.tip: bill是待审议的法案；通过并生效后才成为法律。
bill.en: a written statement of money owed for goods or services

prime.tip: a prime example指典型例子，不是第一个例子。

express.tip: express作动词直接接宾语，如express your views。
express.en: Show or communicate a thought, feeling, or opinion.

suppose.tip: be supposed to表示应该或按安排做某事。
suppose.en: To think something is probably true without being certain.

gun.tip: gun也可指枪状工具，如glue gun（胶枪）。
gun.en: a weapon that fires bullets or shells

element.tip: 表示风雨等自然力量时，通常用the elements。
element.en: An important or basic part of something.

strategy.tip: 常用a strategy for doing sth表示做某事的策略。
strategy.en: a planned approach for achieving a particular goal

duty.tip: on duty指值班；具体岗位职责常用复数duties。
duty.en: something you should do because it is right or required

tend.tip: tend to do表示往往会；tend to someone表示照料。
tend.en: To usually behave in a particular way.

truth.tip: 说实话用tell the truth，通常不能省略the。
truth.en: what is real or actually happened

democratic.tip: 小写democratic泛指民主的，不特指某个政党。
democratic.en: Based on government by people or their elected representatives.

title.tip: title是标题或名称；topic是讨论的主题。
title.en: the name given to a book, film, or other work

treat.tip: treat someone to a meal表示请某人吃饭。
treat.en: Behave towards someone or consider something in a particular way.

throughout.tip: throughout强调整个范围或全程，不只是某一点。
throughout.en: In every part of a place or during an entire period.

discussion.tip: 名词可接about或of；动词discuss后直接接话题。
discussion.en: An exchange of ideas or opinions about a subject.

generally.tip: generally表示多数情况，并非毫无例外；句首可用generally speaking。
generally.en: In most cases or at most times.

aspect.tip: 高频搭配：aspect ratio (纵横比) / negative aspect (否定体)；同族词：aspects (复数)
aspect.en: Commonly used in expressions like "aspect ratio (纵横比)" (n.).

executive.tip: 名词可指高管；形容词常修饰power、board等。
executive.en: a person with important management responsibilities in an organisation

industrial.en: Relating to factories and the production of goods.

chairman.tip: 性别中性的表达可用chair或chairperson。
chairman.en: a person, usually a man, who leads a meeting or organisation

remove.tip: 常用 remove A from B，表示从B中移除A。
remove.en: to take something away from where it is

hang.tip: 悬挂的过去式、过去分词均为hung；绞死则用hanged。
hang.en: attach something above the ground, or remain suspended

entire.tip: 高频搭配：entire life (总寿命) / on entire ((邮票)附贴在信封(或明信片、邮件包装纸等)上的)；同族词：entire (adj.)
entire.en: Commonly used in expressions like "entire life (总寿命)" (adj.).

exist.tip: 是不及物动词，不用被动语态；“不存在”用does not exist。
exist.en: To be real or present in the world.

customer.tip: customer泛指顾客；client常指专业服务的客户。
customer.en: A person or organisation that buys goods or services.

institution.tip: 可指具体机构，也可指婚姻等社会制度。
institution.en: An established organisation serving an educational, financial, or public purpose.

encourage.tip: 用encourage sb to do sth表示鼓励某人做某事。
encourage.en: Give someone confidence or support to do something

network.tip: network强调多个节点之间相互连接。
network.en: A system of connected people, things or places.

specific.en: relating to one particular thing rather than things in general

profit.tip: profit是扣除成本后的利润，不等于收入revenue。
profit.en: Money earned after paying the costs of a business.

religious.tip: 高频搭配：religious belief (宗教信仰) / religious culture (宗教文化)；同族词：religious (adj.)
religious.en: Commonly used in expressions like "religious belief (宗教信仰)" (adj.).

reflect.tip: 高频搭配：reflect on (仔细考虑，思考) / reflect upon (vt. 考虑（回想)；同族词：reflects (第三人称单数)、reflected (过去分词)、reflecting (现在分词)
reflect.en: Commonly used in expressions like "reflect on (仔细考虑，思考)" (v.).

cold.tip: “觉得冷”用be cold；“感冒了”用have a cold。
cold.en: Having a low temperature or feeling a lack of warmth.

admit.tip: 用admit doing，不用admit to do；过去式双写t。
admit.en: to accept that something is true, often reluctantly

measure.tip: 采取措施用 take measures；测量某物直接接宾语。
measure.en: Find the size, amount, or degree of something.

conference.tip: 指正式会议；参加会议用attend a conference。
conference.en: a formal meeting to discuss a particular subject

division.tip: 还可指数学中的除法；divide 是对应动词。
division.en: the act of separating something into parts or shares

memory.tip: 记忆力通常不可数；一段段回忆用memories。
memory.en: the ability to store and recall information or experiences

replace.tip: replace A with B是用B换掉A，别弄反方向。
replace.en: To take something's place or put something else in its place.

procedure.tip: procedure 强调规定步骤；process 更侧重整个过程。
procedure.en: an established series of actions for completing a task

commission.tip: 作委员会是可数名词；作佣金常用不可数形式。
commission.en: An official group appointed to investigate or manage something

trial.tip: 高频搭配：on trial (在试验中) / clinical trial (临床试验)；同族词：trials (复数)、trialled (过去式)
trial.en: Commonly used in expressions like "on trial (在试验中)" (n.).

expert.tip: expert on/in表示某领域的专家。
expert.en: Someone with extensive knowledge or skill in a particular subject.

proposal.tip: proposal to do表示做某事的提议，通常为可数名词。
proposal.en: A suggested plan for others to consider.

unless.tip: 表将来条件时，unless从句通常用一般现在时。
unless.en: except if; if something does not happen or is untrue

mention.tip: 直接接所提内容：mention sth，不用 mention about。
mention.en: to refer to someone or something briefly

improve.tip: 既可及物也可不及物：improve skills；skills improve。
improve.en: To become better or make something better.

client.tip: client常购买专业服务；customer泛指购买商品或服务的人。
client.en: someone who pays for professional services

obviously.tip: 表示情况显而易见；讨论争议观点时慎用，以免武断。
obviously.en: in a way that is easy to see or understand

imagine.en: Form a picture or idea of something in your mind.

sector.tip: sector常指经济中的某个行业，不一定是公司部门。
sector.en: A particular part of an economy or area of activity.

direction.tip: 表示路线指引或操作说明时，通常用复数directions。
direction.en: the way something points, moves, or develops

basic.tip: 名词“基础知识”用复数 the basics。
basic.en: Forming the main or most necessary part of something.

huge.tip: 本身表示极大，常用absolutely huge加强语气。
huge.en: extremely large in size, amount, or degree

intend.tip: intend to do表示打算做；be intended for表示供……用。
intend.en: To have a plan or purpose in mind.

original.tip: 可指最初的，也可指原创的；看语境区分。
original.en: existing at the beginning, before any changes

attitude.tip: 对某事的态度常用attitude to或towards。
attitude.en: how you think or feel about someone or something

respond.tip: respond to后接回应对象，不能直接接宾语。
respond.en: To say or write something in reply.

aware.tip: 高频搭配：aware of (意识到，知道) / become aware of (知道)；同族词：aware (adj.)
aware.en: Commonly used in expressions like "aware of (意识到，知道)" (adj.).

discover.tip: discover发现原本存在的事物；invent创造新事物。
discover.en: to find something or learn something previously unknown

popular.tip: 表示受某群体欢迎，常用popular with或among。
popular.en: Liked or enjoyed by many people.

onto.tip: onto强调移动到表面；on常表示已在上面。
onto.en: Moving to a position on a surface.

reveal.tip: 高频搭配：reveal itself (v. 呈现，出现) / reveal all (显示全部（计算机操作命令）)；同族词：revealed (过去分词)、reveals (第三人称单数)、revealing (现在分词)
reveal.en: Commonly used in expressions like "reveal itself (v. 呈现，出现)" (v.).

weapon.tip: 可数名词；武器的总称也可用weaponry。
weapon.en: an object used for fighting or causing physical harm

germany.tip: Germany是国名；German可指德语、德国人或德国的。

employee.en: Someone paid to work for a person or organisation.

peace.tip: 通常不可数；peace of mind表示安心、心安。
peace.en: a situation without war, fighting, or serious disagreement

employment.tip: 通常不可数；一份工作用a job，不用an employment。
employment.en: paid work or the state of having a paid job

refuse.tip: 名词读/ˈrefjuːs/；动词后接to do，不接doing。
refuse.en: to say that you will not do or accept something

pain.tip: 泛指疼痛常不可数；具体一阵疼痛可用a pain。
pain.en: an unpleasant physical feeling caused by injury or illness

prevent.tip: 用prevent sb from doing，不用prevent sb to do。
prevent.en: To stop something happening or someone doing something.

affair.tip: 表公共事务常用复数affairs，如current affairs。
affair.en: a matter, event, or activity concerning someone

appeal.tip: 高频搭配：appeal for (vt. 恳求，请求) / sex appeal (性感)；同族词：appeals (复数)、appealed (过去式)、appealing (现在分词)
appeal.en: Commonly used in expressions like "appeal for (vt. 恳求，请求)" (n &v.).

interview.tip: interviewer是提问者；interviewee是接受面试或采访者。
interview.en: a meeting to assess someone's suitability for a position

regard.tip: “把A看作B”用regard A as B，不用to be。
regard.en: To think of someone or something in a particular way.

professional.tip: 与amateur对比强调职业；形容态度时强调专业得体。
professional.en: Relating to skilled work or an activity done for payment.

technique.en: A particular way of doing something, often requiring skill.

camera.tip: camera可指照相机或摄像机，具体看语境。
camera.en: A device used to take photographs or record moving images.

item.tip: item是可数名词；一件衣物可说an item of clothing。
item.en: A single object, especially one in a collection.

politics.tip: 指政治活动时通常配单数谓语；政治立场可配复数。
politics.en: activities concerning government and how a country is run

medium.en: Between small and large, or between low and high.

perform.tip: 既可指表演，也可接task、duty表示执行。
perform.en: to entertain an audience by acting, singing, or playing music

version.tip: version指同一事物的不同形式，也指个人对事件的说法。
version.en: A particular form of something that exists in different forms

candidate.tip: candidate for后接所竞聘的职位或所竞选的职务。
candidate.en: Someone competing for a job or an elected position.

okay.tip: 高频搭配：okay — 对；同族词：okaying (现在分词)、okayed (过去式)、okays (第三人称单数)
okay.en: Commonly used in expressions like "okay — 对" ((缩作ok)a&ad.).

direct.tip: direct可作形容词或动词；常见读音也有/daɪˈrekt/。
direct.en: Without anything or anyone coming between.

press.tip: 表示新闻界通常用the press；按按钮不用push down。

advice.tip: 不可数，不用an advice；动词advise末尾读/z/。
advice.en: suggestions about what someone should do in a particular situation

inside.tip: inside后接名词时是介词；单独用可作副词。
inside.en: in or into the inner part of something

adult.tip: 既可作可数名词，也可作形容词，如adult education。
adult.en: A person or animal that has finished growing.

advantage.tip: take advantage of可指利用机会，也可指占人便宜。
advantage.en: Something that makes success more likely than for others.

operate.tip: 操作机器直接接宾语；给某人做手术用operate on。
operate.en: to control equipment, or to work as a machine

immediately.tip: 作连词表示“一……就”主要见于英式英语。

variety.tip: 多样性为不可数义；表示一种品种时可数。
variety.en: the presence of different things rather than only one kind

edge.tip: 表示优势时常用an edge over，指胜过某人。
edge.en: The outer limit of an object, area, or surface.

writer.tip: writer范围较广；author常指某部作品的作者。
writer.en: someone who writes books, articles, or other texts

island.tip: s不发音；在岛上用on an island。
island.en: An area of land completely surrounded by water.

fear.tip: fear sth是害怕某事；fear for sb是为某人担忧。
fear.en: An unpleasant feeling about danger or something bad happening.

depend.tip: 常接on或upon；It depends意为“看情况”。
depend.en: to be determined or affected by something

majority.tip: the majority of接复数名词时，谓语通常用复数。
majority.en: the larger part of a group, exceeding half its members

dream.tip: dream of/about后接名词或动名词；过去式可用dreamt或dreamed。
dream.en: images, feelings, and events experienced while sleeping

extent.tip: 表示“在某种程度上”用to some extent。
extent.en: How much something happens or how far it reaches.

bar.tip: 表禁止用bar sb from doing；过去式barred。
bar.en: a place or counter where drinks, especially alcoholic drinks, are served

competition.tip: 表示竞争通常不可数；表示一场比赛时可数。
competition.en: The effort to succeed against others seeking the same goal.

parliament.tip: 特指某国议会时常大写；英国议员简称MP。
parliament.en: A country's group of representatives that debates and makes laws

instead.tip: instead可单独作副词；instead of后接名词或动名词。
instead.en: in place of someone or something else

goods.tip: goods是复数名词；一件商品可说an item。
goods.en: Things produced for sale or transported for trade.

stuff.tip: 名词stuff不可数且偏口语；正式写作宜用具体名词。
stuff.en: Things or materials referred to without naming them specifically.

complete.tip: complete a form指填写完表格，不是制作表格。
complete.en: to finish doing something or filling in information

access.tip: 名词后接to；动词直接接宾语，不加to。
access.en: The opportunity or right to enter or use something.

magazine.tip: 可数名词；英式重音通常在末音节，美式在首音节。
magazine.en: A regularly published collection of articles and pictures.

easily.tip: easily可修饰最高级：easily the best表示远胜其他。

sexual.tip: sexual指与性有关；sexy才常表示性感的。
sexual.en: Relating to sex or physical attraction between people.

effective.tip: effective强调达到效果；efficient强调省时省力。
effective.en: producing the intended or desired result

payment.tip: 支付行为通常不可数；一笔款项可用a payment。
payment.en: the act of giving money for something

heat.tip: heat作名词指热，hot作形容词指热的。

marriage.tip: marriage指婚姻关系；wedding主要指婚礼。
marriage.en: the legally or socially recognised relationship between two spouses

tough.tip: 读音与rough押韵；形容肉时指难嚼、老。
tough.en: Difficult to do, deal with, or endure

independent.tip: 常搭配of：independent of意为不依赖或不受影响。
independent.en: able to live or act without relying on others

facility.tip: 泛指配套设施常用复数facilities。
facility.en: A place or equipment provided for a particular purpose.

survey.tip: 名词重音在首音节，动词重音在末音节。
survey.en: A study that collects information by asking people questions.

reference.tip: reference to表示提及；for reference表示供参考。
reference.en: a mention of someone or something

german.tip: 首字母须大写；指德语时通常不加冠词。
german.en: relating to Germany, its people, or its language

agent.tip: agent不只指特工；cleaning agent中的agent指剂。
agent.en: A person or business acting on behalf of others

owner.tip: 表示某物的所有者，用the owner of加名词。
owner.en: A person or organisation that something belongs to.

extend.tip: extend by接增加量；extend to接新的终点或期限。
extend.en: To make something longer, larger, or wider in scope

gas.tip: 泛指气体通常不可数；多种气体用gases。
gas.en: A substance that spreads freely to fill its container.

importance.tip: importance不可数；重视某事用attach importance to。
importance.en: The quality of having great value or a strong effect.

generation.tip: 表示“一代人”时可数；表示“产生”时通常不可数。
generation.en: people born and living at roughly the same time

commercial.tip: 作名词指电视或广播广告，不泛指所有广告。
commercial.en: Related to business or intended to make money.

object.tip: 名词重音在前，动词在后；object to后接名词或动名词。
object.en: a thing that can be seen or touched

address.tip: 美音动词读/əˈdres/；address问题不等于已解决。
address.en: Details identifying where someone lives or something can be found.

cancer.tip: 高频搭配：breast cancer (乳腺癌) / lung cancer (肺癌)；同族词：cancers (复数)
cancer.en: Commonly used in expressions like "breast cancer (乳腺癌)" (n.).

possibility.tip: 常用possibility of doing或possibility that从句。
possibility.en: the chance that something might happen or be true

reality.tip: in reality意为“实际上”；a reality指已实现的事。
reality.en: The way things actually are, rather than imagined or wished.

coach.tip: 英式英语中coach也指长途客车，bus多指公交车。
coach.en: someone who trains people to improve their sporting skills

means.tip: 高频搭配：by means of (用，依靠) / means of production (生产资料)；同族词：mean (词根/原形)
means.en: Commonly used in expressions like "by means of (用，依靠)" (n.).

notice.tip: notice sb do强调全过程；notice sb doing强调正在发生。
notice.en: to become aware of something through your senses

yard.tip: 美式yard可指住宅草坪庭院；英式多用garden。
yard.en: An outdoor area beside a building, often enclosed.

violence.tip: 高频搭配：domestic violence (家庭暴力) / family violence (家庭暴力)；同族词：violence (n.)
violence.en: Commonly used in expressions like "domestic violence (家庭暴力)" (n.).

collection.tip: a collection of后接复数名词，表示一批相关物品。
collection.en: a group of objects kept or presented together

communication.tip: 表交流通常不可数；表一封正式函件可数。
communication.en: the process of sharing information, ideas, or feelings

finger.tip: 通常不包括拇指；拇指专称thumb。
finger.en: one of the long movable parts of a hand

arise.tip: 高频搭配：arise from (由…引起，起因于) / arise out of (起于……)；同族词：arising (现在分词)、arises (第三人称单数)、arose (过去式)
arise.en: Commonly used in expressions like "arise from (由…引起，起因于)" (v.).

species.en: A biological group whose members can usually breed with one another.

partner.tip: partner不表明性别；作动词常用partner with。
partner.en: Someone you work, play, or share a business with.

supply.tip: supply A with B＝supply B to A；物资常用supplies。
supply.en: to provide something that someone needs

positive.tip: 检测结果positive指阳性，不一定是好消息。
positive.en: Hopeful, confident, or producing a good effect.

civil.tip: civil law指民法；civil war则指内战。
civil.en: Relating to citizens or ordinary society rather than the military.

examine.tip: 高频搭配：examine and approve (审批) / examine and verify (审核)；同族词：examined (过去分词)、examining (现在分词)、examines (第三人称单数)
examine.en: Commonly used in expressions like "examine and approve (审批)" (v.).

consumer.tip: consumer强调消费身份；customer强调与商家的交易关系。
consumer.en: A person who buys goods or services for personal use.

document.tip: 动词末尾读/ment/，名词末尾读/mənt/。
document.en: a paper or digital record containing information

define.tip: define A as B表示“将A定义为B”。
define.en: To state exactly what a word or idea means.

shot.tip: give it a shot表示试一试；shot也是shoot的过去式。
shot.en: an act of firing a weapon or sending a ball

budget.tip: budget for后接预计开支；on a budget指经费有限。
budget.en: A plan for spending money, or the amount available.

responsible.tip: responsible for后接名词或动名词；to后接上级。
responsible.en: having a duty to manage or look after something

painting.tip: 指一幅画时可数；指绘画活动时不可数。

solution.tip: 表示“……的解决办法”用solution to，不用solution of。
solution.en: a way to solve a problem or answer a question

influence.tip: 名词后常接on；动词直接接宾语。
influence.en: the power to affect how someone thinks or behaves

victim.tip: 表示某事的受害者，用victim of。
victim.en: someone harmed by an accident, crime, or unfair treatment

software.tip: 不可数：说some software，不说a software。
software.en: programs that tell a computer how to perform tasks

threat.tip: 名词用 threat；动词用 threaten。
threat.en: Something that could cause harm or damage.

opinion.tip: 表达“在我看来”用in my opinion，不用according to me。
opinion.en: a belief or judgement about someone or something

attorney.tip: 高频搭配：power of attorney (委托书) / attorney general (司法部长)；同族词：attorneys (复数)
attorney.en: Commonly used in expressions like "power of attorney (委托书)" (n.).

score.tip: score可作名词或动词；score a goal指进球得分。
score.en: the points gained in a game, test, or competition

district.tip: 可指行政划分，也可指具有特定功能的城区。
district.en: An area defined by its features or official boundaries.

audience.tip: 观众多用large audience，不用many audiences。
audience.en: People watching or listening to a performance, speech, or programme

damage.tip: 损害用不可数damage；damages指法律赔偿金。
damage.en: Harm that makes something less useful, valuable, or healthy.

vote.tip: vote for表示支持；vote against表示反对。
vote.en: To formally express a choice in an election or decision.

requirement.en: Something that must be done, possessed, or provided

extra.tip: 形容词指额外的；pay extra中作副词。
extra.en: added to the usual or necessary amount

exchange.tip: exchange A for B表示用A换B，注意介词for。
exchange.en: to give something and receive something else in return

citizen.tip: citizen强调公民身份；resident强调居住。
citizen.en: A legal member of a country with rights and responsibilities.

option.tip: option指可选方案；have no option but to后接动词原形。
option.en: Something you can choose from a range of possibilities.

born.tip: 出生用be born；过去出生说was/were born。
born.en: Brought into the world as a baby

eventually.tip: 强调经过时间或困难后的结果，不表示可能。
eventually.en: in the end, especially after a long time or difficulty

occasion.tip: 表示“在某次场合”用on，不用in。
occasion.en: a particular time when something happens

senior.tip: 比较级别用senior to，不用senior than。
senior.en: Having a higher rank or more experience within an organisation.

highly.tip: 高频搭配：highly appreciated (高度支持) / highly sensitive (高灵敏度的)；同族词：highly (adv.)
highly.en: Commonly used in expressions like "highly appreciated (高度支持)" (adv.).

arrangement.tip: 表示具体筹备常用复数：make arrangements for。
arrangement.en: A plan or preparation for something that will happen.

mission.tip: 高频搭配：mission statement (宗旨) / space mission (太空任务)；同族词：missions (复数)
mission.en: Commonly used in expressions like "mission statement (宗旨)" (n.).

target.tip: 表示达成目标用meet或reach a target。
target.en: A result or level that someone aims to achieve.

aid.tip: 援助义通常不可数；辅助工具义可数，如a hearing aid。
aid.en: Help provided through money, supplies, services, or practical support.

alone.tip: alone指独自，不一定孤独；lonely强调孤独感。

railway.tip: railway常用于英式英语，美式常用railroad。
railway.en: Tracks and services used by trains to transport people or goods.

attend.tip: 参加活动直接接宾语；处理、照料用attend to。
attend.en: to go to an event or regularly visit an institution

concept.tip: 可数名词；常用the concept of引出具体概念。
concept.en: an idea or principle used to understand or plan something

lack.tip: 名词用a lack of；动词直接接宾语，不加of。
lack.en: The absence of something or not having enough of it

fresh.tip: fresh water指淡水；fresh air指新鲜空气。
fresh.en: Recently produced or picked, and not preserved or stale.

forest.tip: forest通常指大片森林；wood也可指较小树林。
forest.en: a large area of land covered mainly with trees

video.tip: 一段视频用a video；泛指视频媒介时可不可数。
video.en: A recording of moving images, usually with sound.

global.tip: global强调全球范围；international强调国家之间。
global.en: Involving or affecting the whole world.

slightly.tip: 可修饰形容词、比较级或动词，如slightly higher。
slightly.en: by a small amount or to a small degree

senate.tip: 指特定国家的参议院时，通常写作the Senate。
senate.en: The upper chamber of parliament in some countries

reform.tip: reform重在改进现有制度，不一定彻底推翻。
reform.en: to improve a system by changing how it works

gain.tip: gain常接经验、信心等；赢比赛通常用win。
gain.en: To obtain something useful or increase in amount.

scale.tip: 表示规模用on a large scale；表示秤通常用复数scales。
scale.en: The size or extent of something

judge.tip: judge A by B表示依据B判断A。
judge.en: To form an opinion after considering someone or something.

equipment.tip: 不可数；一件设备说a piece of equipment。
equipment.en: the tools and other items needed for a particular activity

release.tip: release可指释放，也可指公开发布报告或产品。
release.en: To let someone or something go free or escape.

credit.tip: on credit表示赊购；学分义可数，常用复数。
credit.en: An arrangement allowing payment later or borrowing money.

critical.tip: critical of表示批评；critical to表示对……至关重要。
critical.en: extremely important to the success or outcome of something

male.tip: male可作形容词或名词；日常指男人通常用man。
male.en: Relating to men or boys, or the sex that produces sperm.

review.tip: 复习在美式英语中常用review，英式常用revise。
review.en: An account giving an opinion of a book, product, or performance.

recall.tip: 表示记得做过某事用 recall doing，不用 to do。
recall.en: to remember something from the past

stare.tip: stare at强调长时间盯看；glance at指瞥一眼。
stare.en: to look at someone or something steadily for a while

otherwise.tip: 表示“否则”时，书面语常在前面用分号。
otherwise.en: If this does not happen or is not done.

neighborhood.tip: 高频搭配：in the neighborhood of (在…附近) / neighborhood committee (居委会)；同族词：neighborhoods (复数)
neighborhood.en: Commonly used in expressions like "in the neighborhood of (在…附近)" (n.).

hardly.tip: hardly意为几乎不，并非hard的副词形式。
hardly.en: almost not, or only to a very small degree

status.tip: 既可指社会地位，也可指当前状况，注意语境。
status.en: A person's social position or standing within a group.

troop.tip: 表示士兵常用复数troops；演员团用troupe。
troop.en: soldiers collectively, or an organized military unit

expression.tip: 表示“表情、说法”时可数；表示“表达”时常不可数。
expression.en: The act of showing thoughts or feelings through words or actions.

directly.tip: directly可指直接，也可指正好在某位置。
directly.en: Without anyone or anything coming between

hurt.tip: 过去式和过去分词均为 hurt；疼痛部位可作主语。
hurt.en: To feel pain or cause physical injury.

christmas.tip: 首字母大写；节日期间用at，当天用on Christmas Day。
christmas.en: the Christian festival celebrating Jesus's birth, or the surrounding period

track.tip: keep track of指持续掌握；lose track of指失去线索。
track.en: A path or course for walking, running, or trains.

band.tip: IELTS中的band指成绩等级，不是乐队。
band.en: A group of musicians who perform together.

failure.tip: 泛指失败通常不可数；a failure可指失败的事物。
failure.en: a lack of success, or something that does not succeed

freedom.tip: freedom to do表示做某事的自由；from表示免受。
freedom.en: The right or ability to act without unnecessary restrictions.

reader.tip: reader既可指人，也可指设备或供学习的读物。
reader.en: A person who reads, especially books, newspapers, or magazines

absolutely.tip: 常修饰essential等极限形容词，不常说absolutely good。

fair.tip: fair指待遇公平；fairly还可表示“相当”。

confirm.tip: 可接名词或that从句；不要用confirm to do。
confirm.en: To establish that something is true or correct.

adopt.tip: adopt是采用或收养；adapt是适应或改编。
adopt.en: To start using a method, idea, or approach.

powerful.tip: 通常作形容词；副词用powerfully，不用powerful。
powerful.en: Having great physical strength or producing a strong effect.

trust.tip: trust sb to do sth表示相信某人能可靠地做某事。
trust.en: Belief that someone or something is honest, reliable, or safe.

completely.tip: 表示程度达到全部，常修饰形容词或动词。
completely.en: In every way or to the fullest possible degree.

touch.tip: 保持联系用keep in touch with someone。
touch.en: to put your hand or another body part against something

sentence.tip: 判某人某种刑罚用sentence sb to sth。
sentence.en: a group of words expressing a complete statement, question, or command

file.tip: file a complaint 指正式投诉，不是把投诉归档。
file.en: Stored information on a computer, or an organized collection of papers.

obvious.tip: 常用It is obvious that…表示“显然……”。

length.tip: at length常指“详细地”，不是“在长度上”。
length.en: The distance from one end of something to the other.

investigation.tip: 调查某事用investigation into；under investigation指正被调查。
investigation.en: a careful effort to discover facts about an event or problem

balance.tip: 兼顾两者用balance A with B；均衡饮食用balanced。
balance.en: A steady position or a suitable mixture of different things

nuclear.tip: nuclear可指原子核或细胞核，依语境判断。
nuclear.en: Relating to atomic nuclei or the energy they release.

branch.tip: branch既指树枝，也指机构或学科的分支。
branch.en: a woody part growing from a tree's trunk

doubt.tip: b不发音；I doubt that常表示认为某事不大可能。
doubt.en: A feeling of uncertainty about whether something is true or possible.

accident.tip: by accident表示无意中，反义短语是on purpose。
accident.en: An unexpected event that causes injury or damage.

camp.tip: go camping表示去露营；camp也可指观点相同的阵营。
camp.en: A place where people stay temporarily, often in tents.

brain.tip: 表示智力时常用复数brains；器官用brain。
brain.en: The organ inside your head controlling thought and bodily activity.

studio.tip: 英式studio flat、美式studio apartment均指单间公寓。
studio.en: A room where art, music, or broadcasts are produced

dozen.tip: two dozen不加s；dozens of表示许多。

normally.tip: 既可表频率“通常”，也可表状态“正常地”。

contact.tip: 动词contact直接接人，不加with；名词后可加with。
contact.en: Communication with someone, or physical touching between things.

insurance.tip: 通常不可数；保险费用premium，保单用policy。
insurance.en: An arrangement providing financial protection against specified risks.

battle.tip: battle可指具体战斗，也常比喻与疾病或困难抗争。

beginning.tip: at the beginning of后接名词；in the beginning表示起初。
beginning.en: The first part or starting point of something.

contribution.tip: 常用make a contribution to；to后接名词或动名词。
contribution.en: Something done or provided to help achieve a shared result.

transport.tip: 上列为名词音标；动词重音后移，英/t/前为/n/。
transport.en: Vehicles or systems used to move people and goods.

african.tip: 首字母须大写；表示来自非洲，不限定肤色。
african.en: relating to Africa or its people

cash.tip: cash作现金讲不可数；用现金付款是pay in cash。
cash.en: Money in the form of coins and banknotes

crisis.en: a serious situation requiring urgent decisions or action

fan.tip: 表示“……的爱好者”用a fan of。
fan.en: someone who greatly enjoys or admires a person or thing

museum.tip: museum是可数名词；参观博物馆说visit a museum。
museum.en: a building displaying objects of historical, scientific, or artistic interest

hole.tip: hole指洞；whole指完整的，两词同音。
hole.en: An opening through something or a hollow space in the ground.

associate.tip: 动词尾音/eɪt/；名词、形容词尾音/ət/。
associate.en: to connect people or things in your mind

vision.tip: 表示视力通常不可数；具体愿景可用a vision。

marry.tip: 说marry someone或get married to，不说marry with。
marry.en: To become someone's husband or wife.

presence.tip: in someone's presence指当着某人的面。
presence.en: The state of being in a particular place.

protection.tip: 通常不可数；protection from/against表示免受伤害。
protection.en: the act of keeping someone or something safe from harm

collect.tip: 英式英语collect someone可指去接某人。
collect.en: To gather things together or keep objects as a hobby

queen.tip: queen 可指统治国家的女王，也可指国王的妻子。
queen.en: A female monarch, or the wife of a king.

master.tip: 动词直接接宾语；硕士学位写作master's degree。
master.en: To learn to do something very well.

meaning.tip: 问词义用the meaning of；不要与opinion混淆。
meaning.en: The idea that a word, action, or message communicates.

spot.tip: on the spot可指“当场”或“在现场”，依语境判断。

employ.tip: employ既可指雇人，也可正式地表示采用方法。
employ.en: Pay someone to work for you.

distance.tip: in the distance指在远处；at a distance指隔一段距离。
distance.en: The amount of space between two places or things

handle.tip: handle作处理讲直接接宾语，不加with。
handle.en: To deal with a situation, task, or person.

relevant.tip: 表示“与……相关”用relevant to，不用with。
relevant.en: closely connected with the subject or situation being considered

tradition.tip: 具体习俗可数；泛指传统时可不可数，如break with tradition。
tradition.en: A belief or custom passed down through generations.

route.tip: 美式也读 /raʊt/；route 强调行进路线。
route.en: a way taken to get from one place to another

proportion.tip: a proportion of后谓语单复数取决于所指名词。
proportion.en: a part or share of a whole

consideration.tip: 表考虑或体谅通常不可数；表考虑因素时可数。
consideration.en: Careful thought about something before making a decision.

roll.tip: roll强调翻转滚动；卷起常用roll up。
roll.en: To move or make something move by turning over repeatedly

africa.tip: 洲名首字母大写，通常不加冠词；非洲不是国家。
africa.en: The continent south of Europe, between the Atlantic and Indian oceans.

latter.tip: the latter指两者中的后者，不等于later。
latter.en: the second of two people or things already mentioned

screen.tip: screen A for B表示检查A是否存在B问题。
screen.en: A surface on which electronic images or films appear.

resident.tip: resident指人；residential形容住宅或居住区。
resident.en: Someone who lives in a particular place.

mark.tip: 表示考试分数常用复数marks，尤其在英式英语中。
mark.en: a visible spot, line, or symbol on a surface

hide.tip: 过去式hid，过去分词hidden；hide from意为躲避。
hide.en: To put or stay somewhere out of sight.

gold.tip: gold作材料名通常不可数；a gold可指一枚金牌。
gold.en: A valuable yellow metal used for jewellery and money

separate.tip: 形容词词尾读/ət/，动词词尾读/eɪt/。
separate.en: not joined, shared, or considered together

deny.tip: 否认做某事用 deny doing，不用 deny to do。
deny.en: Say that something is not true or did not happen.

practical.tip: practical可强调亲手实践，也可表示实用、可行。
practical.en: involving real activities and experience rather than only ideas

potential.tip: 高频搭配：market potential ([经]市场潜力) / potential energy (势能)；同族词：potentials (复数)
potential.en: Commonly used in expressions like "market potential ([经]市场潜力)" (n./adj.).

understanding.en: Knowledge of something, or sympathy for someone's feelings and situation.

aim.tip: aim to do表打算做；aim at doing表力求实现。
aim.en: something you want or plan to achieve

danger.tip: in danger指处于危险中；dangerous指会带来危险。
danger.en: The possibility that someone or something will be harmed.

progress.tip: 名词不可数；动词重音后移，英音/prəˈɡres/。
progress.en: improvement or movement towards a goal

path.tip: 表示实现目标的途径，用a path to，to后接名词。
path.en: A narrow track for people to walk along.

reaction.tip: 高频搭配：reaction time (反应时间) / reaction temperature (反应温度)；同族词：reactions (复数)
reaction.en: Commonly used in expressions like "reaction time (反应时间)" (n.).

crowd.tip: a crowd of后接复数名词；crowded表示拥挤的。
crowd.en: A large group of people gathered in one place.

christian.tip: 无论作名词还是形容词，首字母都要大写。
christian.en: relating to Christianity or its followers

appoint.tip: 任命某人可用appoint sb as或appoint sb to职位。
appoint.en: to officially choose someone for a job or responsibility

apartment.tip: 美式常用apartment，英式日常多用flat。
apartment.en: A set of rooms forming one home within a building.

merely.tip: 语气比only正式；通常置于实义动词前、be动词后。
merely.en: only, and nothing more or more important

willing.tip: 常用be willing to do，表示愿意，不等于将要。
willing.en: ready and happy to do something

regular.tip: regular侧重规律或经常，不等于持续不停的continuous。
regular.en: Happening repeatedly, often with similar gaps between events.

link.tip: 常用a link between A and B；动词用link A to/with B。
link.en: a connection between people, things, or ideas

comment.tip: 动词comment后接on再接评论对象，不直接接宾语。
comment.en: something said or written to express an opinion or observation

due.tip: be due to do表示预计做；due to＋名词表示由于。
due.en: Required to be paid or submitted by a particular time.

content.tip: 名词重音在前，形容词和动词在后；目录用contents。
content.en: Information in something, or the amount of a substance it contains

conclusion.tip: “得出结论”用reach或draw a conclusion，不用make。
conclusion.en: a judgement formed after considering facts or evidence

prison.tip: in prison指服刑；in the prison强调在监狱内。
prison.en: A place where people are kept as punishment for crimes.

chief.tip: chief可作形容词或名词；副词用chiefly。

guard.tip: guard against表示防范某种风险或错误。
guard.en: a person whose job is to protect people or places

reporter.tip: reporter侧重新闻采访报道；journalist涵盖范围更广。
reporter.en: Someone who gathers and presents news for the public.

reply.tip: reply to后接人或消息，不直接接宾语。
reply.en: to answer someone or respond to a message

justice.tip: 高频搭配：social justice ([法]社会主义) / justice department (司法部门)；同族词：justices (复数)
justice.en: Commonly used in expressions like "social justice ([法]社会主义)" (n.).

deliver.tip: 递送用deliver sth to sb；兑现承诺可用deliver on。
deliver.en: to take goods or messages to their intended destination

observe.tip: observe sb doing sth 表示观察到某人正在做某事。
observe.en: to watch carefully or notice something

belief.tip: belief in表示信任或信仰；belief that后接具体看法。
belief.en: Confidence that something is true or someone is capable.

vehicle.tip: 指交通工具时是可数名词，不仅指汽车。
vehicle.en: A machine used to transport people or goods.

settle.tip: 高频搭配：settle down (定居) / settle in (v. 迁入)；同族词：settled (过去分词)、settling (现在分词)、settles (第三人称单数)
settle.en: Commonly used in expressions like "settle down (定居)" (v.).

ignore.tip: 直接接宾语；不表示法律上的“驳回诉讼”。
ignore.en: Pay no attention to someone or something

average.tip: on average表示“平均而言”，不用in average。
average.en: Representing a calculated middle value, or typical rather than exceptional.

estate.tip: real estate指房地产；housing estate指住宅区。
estate.en: A large area of owned land, often with a large house.

leadership.tip: 通常不可数；可指领导能力，也可指领导层。
leadership.en: the ability or activity of guiding people towards shared goals

earn.tip: earn强调劳动或表现所得；win多指比赛获胜。
earn.en: To receive money in return for work.

propose.tip: propose doing是提议；propose to do通常是打算。
propose.en: Suggest an idea or plan for others to consider.

additional.tip: 通常放在名词前；additional costs指额外费用。
additional.en: Added to what already exists or is available.

sample.tip: sample强调从整体取出的一部分；example常用于举例。
sample.en: A small amount or group examined to understand a larger whole.

possibly.tip: can't possibly表示“绝不可能”，语气很强。
possibly.en: Used when something may happen or may be true.

tiny.tip: 比small语气更强，强调小得惊人。
tiny.en: Extremely small in size or amount.

active.tip: active指积极活动或参与；不等于表示乐观的positive。
active.en: regularly moving, doing things, or taking part

feed.tip: 过去式和过去分词均为fed；feed on表示以……为食。
feed.en: Give food to someone or an animal, or eat food.

employer.en: A person or organisation that pays people to work.

debt.en: Money owed to a person, bank, or other organisation.

identity.tip: identity指身份；identify是识别、确认身份的动词。

objective.tip: 名词指目标；形容词指客观的，反义词为subjective。

largely.tip: 表示主要或大体上，不表示物体体积很大。
largely.en: mostly or to a great extent

arrange.tip: 安排某人做某事用arrange for sb to do。
arrange.en: Make plans or preparations for something to happen.

mostly.tip: mostly指大部分情况；almost指差一点或几乎。
mostly.en: mainly, or for the largest part

survive.tip: 表示从事故中幸存，直接说survive an accident。
survive.en: stay alive despite danger, illness, or hardship

faith.tip: 表示对某人或某事有信心，用have faith in。
faith.en: Strong trust or confidence in someone or something.

promote.tip: 晋升到某职位用be promoted to＋职位。
promote.en: to encourage something to develop or become more widely accepted

living.tip: living可放名词前；alive通常作表语或后置修饰。
living.en: Alive now, rather than dead or without life.

count.tip: count on意为依靠；count作“重要”时不及物。
count.en: to find how many things there are

farmer.tip: farmer指人，farm指农场，farming指农业生产。
farmer.en: someone who grows crops or raises animals on a farm

injury.tip: 具体伤处可数；泛指身体伤害时常不可数。
injury.en: Physical harm to someone's body, often caused by an accident

package.tip: 指邮寄的包裹时，英式英语也常用parcel。
package.en: An object or collection of objects wrapped or boxed together.

nevertheless.tip: 是副词，不是连词；连接独立句时可用分号。
nevertheless.en: Despite what has just been mentioned.

colleague.tip: colleague指同事，不一定是朋友或同级员工。
colleague.en: Someone you work with, especially in a professional job.

complex.tip: 作形容词指复杂；作名词可指综合建筑群。
complex.en: Having many connected parts and being difficult to understand.

folk.tip: 指人们时用复数动词；my folks口语指父母。
folk.en: People, especially those belonging to a particular group.

impossible.tip: 常用it is impossible to do，表示不可能做某事。
impossible.en: unable to happen, exist, or be done

confidence.tip: 对某人或某事有信心用confidence in。
confidence.en: Belief in your abilities or in a successful outcome.

lift.en: To move someone or something to a higher position.

mainly.tip: 表示“主要而非全部”；常放在实义动词前。
mainly.en: mostly, or more than anything else

border.tip: border作动词直接接地点；border on还可表示近乎。
border.en: the dividing line between countries or regions

gather.tip: I gather that...表示“我听说或推断……”。
gather.en: to collect things from different places or sources

limit.tip: limit A to B意为将A限制在B范围内。
limit.en: the greatest amount or level that is allowed or possible

cross.en: to go from one side to another, or intersect

critic.en: Someone who judges and discusses artistic works professionally.

commitment.tip: commitment to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。
commitment.en: A strong willingness to give time and effort to something.

plus.tip: plus作名词表示优点时可数，如a big plus。
plus.en: With something added to an amount or group.

volume.tip: volume可指体积、总量或音量；面积用area。
volume.en: The space something occupies, or the total amount of something.

insist.tip: 用insist on doing，不用insist to do。
insist.en: to demand something firmly despite disagreement

legislation.tip: 高频搭配：environmental legislation (环境立法) / subsidiary legislation (附属法例)；同族词：legislations (复数)
legislation.en: Commonly used in expressions like "environmental legislation (环境立法)" (n.).

manner.en: The way something is done or happens.

background.tip: 经历领域用background in；背景中用in the background。
background.en: The family, education, and experience that shape someone's life

spread.tip: 过去式和过去分词均为spread。
spread.en: To reach, or make something reach, more people or places

entry.tip: 进入某处常用entry to；具体入口通常用entrance。
entry.en: The act of entering, or permission to enter a place.

baseball.tip: 运动名称不可数；表示一个棒球时用a baseball。
baseball.en: A team sport involving hitting a ball and running between bases

engine.tip: engine多指燃料发动机；电动机通常用motor。
engine.en: a machine that produces power to make something move

cabinet.tip: 可指家具或内阁；内阁由政府高级部长组成。
cabinet.en: a cupboard with shelves or drawers for storing things

introduction.tip: 入门介绍常用introduction to；引进某物用of。
introduction.en: An explanation or meeting that first presents someone or something.

previously.tip: previously意为先前；表示提前准备通常用in advance。
previously.en: At a time before now or before another event.

murder.tip: murder强调非法且故意杀人；kill含义更广。
murder.en: the crime of deliberately and unlawfully killing someone

religion.tip: 泛指宗教时不可数；指某一种宗教时可数。
religion.en: belief in gods or spiritual powers, with related practices

editor.tip: editor可指编辑人员，也可指编辑软件。
editor.en: someone who prepares written material or manages a publication

prefer.tip: 用prefer A to B；过去式preferred双写r。
prefer.en: To like or choose something more than another option.

engage.tip: 参与活动用engage in；与人互动用engage with。
engage.en: To attract someone's attention and keep them interested or involved.

ordinary.tip: ordinary强调不特别；不等于表示平均水平的average。
ordinary.en: Normal or usual, without special or unusual features.

extremely.tip: 修饰可分程度的形容词或副词，语气强于very。

threaten.tip: threaten to do指威胁要做；threaten sth可指危及某物。
threaten.en: Say you will cause harm or trouble unless demands are met

relief.tip: relief是名词，relieve是动词；疼痛缓解用pain relief。
relief.en: Comfort felt when worry or fear ends

technical.tip: technical强调技术或专业知识，不等于高科技。
technical.en: relating to practical skills, machinery, or scientific methods

grant.tip: grant sb sth可改为grant sth to sb。
grant.en: money given by an organisation for a particular purpose

female.tip: 指成年女性通常用women；female作定语较自然。
female.en: Relating to women, girls, or animals that typically produce eggs.

actual.tip: actual指实际的，不等于表示目前的current。
actual.en: real, rather than imagined, estimated, or claimed

youth.tip: 表示青春通常不可数；a youth指一名年轻男子。
youth.en: the period of life when someone is young

repeat.tip: repeat已含“再次”之意，通常不必再加again。
repeat.en: To say or do something again.

wave.tip: 向某人挥手用wave at或wave to someone。
wave.en: A moving ridge of water or a travelling energy disturbance.

regulation.tip: 具体条例可数；表示监管这一过程时通常不可数。
