regulation.en: An official rule controlling how something must be done.

native.tip: a native of指某地出生者；the natives可能带贬义。
native.en: connected with the place or language of someone's early life

broad.tip: 高频搭配：broad market (广阔的市场) / broad spectrum ([医]广谱)；同族词：broader (比较级)、broadest (最高级)、broads (复数)
broad.en: Commonly used in expressions like "broad market (广阔的市场)" (adj.).

wage.tip: wage常按小时或周计算；salary通常指固定薪金。
wage.en: money earned for work, often calculated by the hour or week

row.en: people or things arranged in a straight line

suit.tip: suit强调合适或好看；fit强调尺寸合身。
suit.en: to be convenient or right for someone

perspective.tip: 从某一视角用from a perspective，不用in。
perspective.en: A particular way of considering a situation or issue.

fairly.tip: 表程度时弱于very；fairly good是还不错，并非极好。
fairly.en: to a moderate degree, but not very

construction.tip: 表示建造过程时不可数；under construction指在建。
construction.en: the process of building something, especially roads or buildings

excellent.tip: 已含“极好”之意，通常不用very修饰。
excellent.en: Extremely good or of very high quality.

intelligence.tip: 通常不可数；intelligence agency指情报机构。
intelligence.en: The ability to learn, understand, and solve problems.

destroy.tip: destroy比damage程度重，通常指彻底毁坏。
destroy.en: To damage something so badly that it cannot be used.

internal.tip: 高频搭配：internal control (内部控制) / internal force (内力)；同族词：internals (复数)
internal.en: Commonly used in expressions like "internal control (内部控制)" (adj.).

category.tip: 常用fall into a category表示“归入某类别”。
category.en: a group of things sharing particular features

tour.tip: tour强调参观或多站行程；trip泛指一次出行。
tour.en: A journey visiting several places, or a guided visit somewhere.

connection.tip: 表示两者的联系用connection between A and B。
connection.en: a relationship between people, things, or ideas

burn.tip: 过去式和过去分词可用burnt或burned。
burn.en: To produce flames, or destroy something with fire.

traffic.tip: 表示交通或车流时不可数，不说a traffic。
traffic.en: Vehicles moving along roads in a particular area

exhibition.tip: exhibition指整场展览；exhibit可指一件展品。
exhibition.en: A public display of art, objects, or products.

launch.tip: 推出产品、发起活动和发射卫星都可用launch。
launch.en: To introduce a product or start an organised activity.

sheet.tip: sheet是可数名词；一张纸说a sheet of paper。
sheet.en: A large piece of cloth used to cover a bed.

location.tip: on location指在摄影棚外实地拍摄。
location.en: The place where something is or where something happens.

appearance.tip: 外貌与露面都可用appearance；露面常用make an appearance。
appearance.en: the way someone or something looks

indian.tip: 首字母大写；指美洲原住民时宜用其自称。
indian.en: relating to India or its people

promise.en: to say firmly that you will do something

improvement.tip: 某方面的改善用 in；比原来更好用 an improvement on。
improvement.en: The process or result of becoming better.

description.tip: 表示对某物的描述，用a description of，不用about。
description.en: an account explaining what someone or something is like

session.tip: session强调一段活动时间；semester才通常指学期。
session.en: a period spent doing a particular activity

bone.tip: bone作动词指去骨；boneless表示无骨的。
bone.en: One of the hard parts forming a body's supporting frame.

northern.tip: northern是形容词，常置于region、coast等名词前。
northern.en: In, from, or relating to the north.

housing.tip: 高频搭配：housing market (住宅区市场) / housing construction (住宅建筑，住房建设)；同族词：house (词根/原形)、housings (复数)
housing.en: Commonly used in expressions like "housing market (住宅区市场)" (n.).

flat.tip: “公寓”英式常用 flat，美式常用 apartment。
flat.en: a set of rooms forming a home within a building

discipline.tip: 表示纪律通常不可数；表示学科时可数。
discipline.en: Controlled behaviour achieved by following rules or managing yourself.

contrast.tip: 高频搭配：in contrast (与此相反) / by contrast (相比之下)；同族词：contrasts (复数)、contrasted (过去分词)、contrasting (现在分词)
contrast.en: Commonly used in expressions like "in contrast (与此相反)" (n./v.).

lip.tip: 上下嘴唇合称lips；lip也可指容器等的边沿。
lip.en: Either fleshy edge of the opening of the mouth.

increasingly.tip: 直接修饰原级形容词：increasingly popular。
increasingly.en: More and more as time passes

existence.tip: 表示“存在”通常不可数；a quiet existence指平静生活。
existence.en: the state of being real or present

gentleman.tip: 复数为gentlemen；正式称呼男性时未必强调品行。
gentleman.en: A man who behaves politely and considers other people.

learning.tip: 通常不可数；强调学习过程，knowledge强调所掌握的知识。
learning.en: The process of gaining knowledge or skills through study or experience.

distribution.tip: 既指分发过程，也指人口等的分布状态。
distribution.en: the process of giving or delivering things to different people

hell.tip: 比喻义语气强烈；作咒骂或强调语时可能冒犯他人。
hell.en: A place of punishment after death in some religious beliefs.

dangerous.tip: dangerous是形容词；修饰动作要用dangerously。
dangerous.en: Likely to cause harm, injury, or serious problems.

proper.tip: 表示“本身的”时放名词后，如the city proper。
proper.en: Suitable or correct for a particular purpose or situation.

remind.tip: 提醒去做用remind sb to do；使想起用of。
remind.en: Help someone remember something they need to do or know

moral.tip: moral指道德；morale指士气，注意拼写区别。
moral.en: concerning right and wrong, or following accepted standards of goodness

academic.tip: 作名词指大学教师或研究者，通常不指大学生。
academic.en: related to education, study, or research

prince.tip: prince不一定是王子，也可指亲王或公国君主。
prince.en: A male royal family member, often a monarch's son.

loan.tip: loan作动词意为借出，不是借入。
loan.en: money borrowed and expected to be paid back

code.tip: 程序代码通常不可数；一组密码可说a code。
code.en: Symbols or instructions representing information, including instructions for computers

representative.tip: 形容词常接of：representative of某群体。
representative.en: someone chosen to speak or act for other people

negative.tip: 检测结果为negative指未检出，并非结果不好。
negative.en: expressing pessimism or having a harmful effect

historical.tip: historical指与历史有关；historic强调具有历史意义。
historical.en: connected with history or events in the past

belong.tip: belong to表示属于，不用被动语态或进行时。

respect.tip: 名词常接for；动词直接接宾语，不加for。
respect.en: Admiration for someone or consideration for their rights and feelings.

finding.tip: 表示研究或调查结果时，常用复数findings。
finding.en: Information discovered through research or an investigation.

attract.tip: attract是及物动词，直接接人或事物作宾语。
attract.en: Make someone interested in or drawn towards something

grab.en: to take hold of something suddenly or firmly

limited.tip: be limited to表示“仅限于”，to后接名词或动名词。
limited.en: Small in amount or restricted in range

photograph.en: a picture made using a camera

formal.tip: formal不等于former：前者“正式的”，后者“以前的”。
formal.en: Following established rules or officially recognised procedures.

participate.tip: 高频搭配：participate in (参加) / participate in social activities (参与社会活动)；同族词：participating (现在分词)、participated (过去式)、participates (第三人称单数)
participate.en: Commonly used in expressions like "participate in (参加)" (v.).

daily.tip: 高频搭配：daily life (日常生活) / daily necessities (日用品)；同族词：dailies (复数)
daily.en: Commonly used in expressions like "daily life (日常生活)" (adj./n.).

writing.tip: writing通常不可数；也是write的现在分词，需去e。
writing.en: The activity or skill of producing words on a surface.

reject.tip: 动词重音在后；名词重音在前，读/ˈriːdʒekt/。
reject.en: To refuse to accept, approve, or believe something.

knee.en: The joint where your leg bends in the middle.

joint.tip: joint作形容词指共同参与；作名词可指关节。
joint.en: Shared, owned, or done by two or more people or groups.

pension.tip: 高频搭配：pension fund (养老基金) / pension insurance (养老保险)；同族词：pensions (复数)、pensioned (过去分词)、pensioning (现在分词)
pension.en: Commonly used in expressions like "pension fund (养老基金)" (n.).

hire.tip: 租车英式常用hire，美式常用rent。
hire.en: To pay someone to do a job.

explanation.tip: explanation of多说明内容，for多解释原因。
explanation.en: information that makes something easier to understand

familiar.tip: 人熟悉事物用with；事物为人熟悉用to。
familiar.en: easy to recognise because you have encountered it before

consist.tip: consist of表组成，不用被动；consist in表在于。
consist.en: to be formed from particular parts or members

conservative.tip: 小写通常指保守；大写可表示保守党的。
conservative.en: preferring traditional ideas and avoiding major changes

actor.tip: actor可指任何性别的演员；actress专指女演员。
actor.en: Someone who performs characters in plays, films, or television

asset.tip: 高频搭配：asset management (资产管理) / fixed asset ([经]固定资产)；同族词：assets (复数)
asset.en: Commonly used in expressions like "asset management (资产管理)" (n.).

birth.tip: give birth to表示生下；be born表示出生。
birth.en: The event or process of a baby being born.

democracy.tip: 指制度通常不可数；指民主国家可数。
democracy.en: A system of government in which people choose their leaders.

invite.tip: invite sb to＋活动；invite sb to do＋动作。
invite.en: to ask someone to attend something or do something

eastern.tip: eastern通常只作形容词，不表示“东方人”。
eastern.en: In or relating to the east of an area.

circle.tip: circle是圆或圆圈；cycle才常指循环或周期。
circle.en: A round shape whose edge is equally distant from its centre.

device.tip: device是名词；devise是动词，意为设计或想出。
device.en: an object or machine designed for a particular purpose

vary.tip: vary from A to B表示范围；vary in表示某方面不同。
vary.en: To differ or change depending on circumstances.

bottom.tip: 在某物底部用at the bottom of。

selection.tip: 表示挑选过程时通常不可数；一组选项可数。
selection.en: The process of choosing someone or something

finance.tip: finance可指资金或金融；个人财务常用finances。
finance.en: the management of money by people, businesses, or governments

impose.tip: 常用 impose A on B，表示把A强加于B。
impose.en: Officially introduce a rule, tax, punishment, or restriction

rural.tip: rural修饰乡村事物，urban修饰城市事物。
rural.en: Relating to the countryside rather than towns or cities.

lean.tip: lean against指倚靠；lean towards可指倾向于。
lean.en: Bend or rest against something in a sloping position.

neck.en: the body part connecting the head to the shoulders

intention.tip: 用intention to do或intention of doing。
intention.en: Something that you plan or mean to do.

plastic.tip: 表示塑料材料时通常不可数；a plastic指一种塑料。
plastic.en: a lightweight manufactured material that can form many different shapes

whereas.tip: 高频搭配：whereas — 然而；同族词：whereas (conj.)
whereas.en: Commonly used in expressions like "whereas — 然而" (conj.).

initial.tip: 形容词通常放在名词前；姓名首字母常用initials。
initial.en: Happening or existing at the beginning

hate.tip: hate后可接动名词或不定式，语气比dislike强。
hate.en: To dislike someone or something very strongly.

examination.tip: 考试义口语常简称exam；检查义常接of。
examination.en: a formal test of knowledge or ability

alive.tip: 通常放在系动词后；“活鱼”说a live fish。

definition.tip: definition of引出被定义的概念；高清常缩写为HD。
definition.en: A statement explaining exactly what a word or concept means

declare.tip: declare强调公开或正式宣布；海关申报也用此词。
declare.en: to announce something publicly or officially

substantial.tip: 高频搭配：substantial evidence (确实证据) / substantial savings (巨额储蓄)；同族词：substantial (adj.)
substantial.en: Commonly used in expressions like "substantial evidence (确实证据)" (adj.).

aircraft.en: a vehicle that flies, such as a plane or helicopter

chicken.tip: 指活鸡时可数，指鸡肉时不可数；小鸡常用chick。
chicken.en: A bird kept for its eggs or meat.

abuse.tip: 高频搭配：drug abuse (药物滥用) / child abuse (虐待儿童，摧残儿童)；同族词：abused (过去分词)、abuses (复数)、abusing (现在分词)
abuse.en: Commonly used in expressions like "drug abuse (药物滥用)" (v.).

output.tip: 高频搭配：output power ([化]输出功率) / output voltage (输出电压)；同族词：outputs (复数)、outputting (现在分词)
output.en: Commonly used in expressions like "output power ([化]输出功率)" (n.).

immediate.en: Happening or needed now, without any delay.

divide.tip: divide into表示分成；divide by表示除以。
divide.en: to separate something into parts or share it among people

ought.tip: ought是情态动词，后接to do；否定为ought not to。
ought.en: Used with to for advice, duty, or the right action.

equal.tip: 形容词常接to；动词equal直接接宾语，不加to。
equal.en: The same in amount, value, status, or opportunity.

literature.tip: 通常不可数；表示多篇文献时也不用加s。
literature.en: Written works valued for their artistic qualities.

reasonable.tip: 形容价格时指公道、不贵，不一定是非常便宜。
reasonable.en: Fair and sensible, showing good judgement.

desire.tip: 高频搭配：desire for (渴望) / sexual desire (性欲)；同族词：desires (复数)、desired (过去分词)、desiring (现在分词)
desire.en: Commonly used in expressions like "desire for (渴望)" (n.).

leading.tip: 高频搭配：leading position (基础地位) / leading role (主导作用)；同族词：lead (词根/原形)
leading.en: Commonly used in expressions like "leading position (基础地位)" (adj.).

reduction.tip: reduction in接减少的项目，of可接减少的幅度。
reduction.en: a decrease in the amount, size, or level of something

paint.tip: paint多指用颜料画；draw多指用铅笔等画线条。
paint.en: a coloured substance spread on surfaces for protection or decoration

nod.tip: 过去式nodded；现在分词nodding，均双写d。
nod.en: to move your head down and up to communicate

fuel.tip: fuel作动词还可表示助长情绪或推动变化。
fuel.en: material burned or used to produce heat or power

appointment.tip: 与某人预约用appointment with；任命某人用appointment of。
appointment.en: An arrangement to meet someone at a particular time.

leaf.tip: 高频搭配：leaf blade (叶片) / in leaf (有叶子的)；同族词：leaves (复数)、leafing (现在分词)、leafed (过去式)
leaf.en: Commonly used in expressions like "leaf blade (叶片)" (n.).

instruction.tip: 操作说明常用复数instructions；表示教学时不可数。
instruction.en: Information explaining what to do or how to do something

concentration.tip: 专注通常不可数；某物的浓度用concentration of。
concentration.en: The ability to keep your attention on one activity.

overall.tip: 形容词放名词前；副词可放句首概括整体情况。
overall.en: considering or including every part of something

pool.tip: pool resources指集中资源；play pool则指打美式台球。
pool.en: An artificial swimming basin or a small area of still water

climb.tip: 词尾b不发音；climb a mountain不加介词。
climb.en: to move upwards using your feet and often your hands

metal.tip: 泛指材料时不可数；指金属种类时可数。
metal.en: a usually hard, shiny material that conducts heat and electricity

recommend.en: To suggest someone or something as a good choice.

disappear.tip: 通常是不及物动词，不说 be disappeared。
disappear.en: To become impossible to see or find.

correct.tip: 既是形容词也是动词；correctly才是副词。
correct.en: free from mistakes and matching the facts

reading.tip: 表示阅读活动通常不可数；表示读数或朗诵会可数。
reading.en: The activity of understanding written words.

sufficient.tip: 常用sufficient for或sufficient to do，语气较正式。
sufficient.en: enough to meet a need or achieve a purpose

urban.en: Relating to cities or towns rather than the countryside.

mental.tip: mental侧重心理或脑力；口语中形容人疯狂可能冒犯。
mental.en: Relating to the mind and emotional wellbeing.

absence.tip: 缺席某活动用absence from；缺乏某物用absence of。
absence.en: a situation in which someone is not present

criticism.tip: 高频搭配：literary criticism (n. 文艺评论) / textual criticism (校勘)；同族词：criticisms (复数)
criticism.en: Commonly used in expressions like "literary criticism (n. 文艺评论)" (n.).

planet.tip: planet是行星，star是恒星；the planet常指地球。
planet.en: A large round object that travels around a star.

transfer.tip: 名词重音在首音节；过去式transferred双写r。
transfer.en: To move someone or something from one place to another.

explore.tip: 作及物动词时直接接地点或问题，不加about。
explore.en: Travel around a place to discover what it is like

error.tip: error比mistake正式，常用于技术、计算或判断。
error.en: something incorrect in an action, calculation, or judgement

assembly.tip: 集会义通常可数；组装义通常不可数。
assembly.en: A gathering of people for a shared purpose.

enemy.tip: enemy指敌人；比赛对手通常用opponent。
enemy.en: A person or group that opposes or wants to harm another.

acid.tip: acid可作名词或形容词；acidic常指呈酸性的。
acid.en: A chemical substance with a pH below seven.

surround.tip: 常用be surrounded by；surroundings指周围环境。
surround.en: be or move into positions on every side of something

settlement.tip: 可指争议的解决协议，也可指人们居住的定居点。
settlement.en: An agreement that ends a dispute.

athlete.tip: athlete常泛指运动员，不只指田径选手。
athlete.en: A person trained to compete in sports requiring physical skill.

scientific.tip: scientific强调科学依据，不等于仅仅有条理。
scientific.en: relating to science or using methods based on evidence

undertake.en: Accept responsibility for a task and begin doing it

panel.tip: 专家组用a panel of experts；成员称panellist。
panel.en: a group chosen to discuss, judge, or advise

married.tip: 与某人结婚用 be/get married to，不用 with。

instrument.tip: 乐器和精密仪器均可用instrument；普通工具常用tool。
instrument.en: an object played to produce musical sounds

whilst.tip: 高频搭配：whilst — 当…的时候；同族词：whilst (conj&n.)
whilst.en: Commonly used in expressions like "whilst — 当…的时候" (conj&n.).

predict.tip: 可接that从句；不要与表示预防的prevent混淆。
predict.en: To say what will happen, often using evidence.

select.tip: select 比 choose 正式，常强调仔细挑选。
select.en: Choose someone or something carefully from available options.

channel.tip: 动词常用channel sth into sth，表示将资源投入某处。
channel.en: A television service or route for communicating and distributing things

emotional.tip: emotional不一定指悲伤，也可指喜悦等强烈情绪。
emotional.en: Related to feelings rather than thoughts or physical needs.

fee.tip: fee指服务或入场等费用；小费通常用tip。
fee.en: Money charged for a service, course, or professional advice.

supreme.tip: 本身含“最高”之意，通常不用比较级或最高级。
supreme.en: highest in rank, authority, or importance

pocket.tip: pocket money指零花钱，英式英语中常用。
pocket.en: A small bag sewn into clothing for carrying things.

poll.tip: 民调常用opinion poll；the polls指选举投票。
poll.en: A survey asking people about their opinions or preferences

solicitor.tip: 高频搭配：solicitor — 律师；同族词：solicitors (复数)
solicitor.en: Commonly used in expressions like "solicitor — 律师" (n.).

frequently.tip: 通常放实义动词前、be动词后，与often近义。

implication.tip: 表示潜在影响常用复数 implications，后接 for。
implication.en: a possible effect or consequence of an action or decision

recognition.tip: 通常不可数；in recognition of常用于表彰贡献。
recognition.en: The act of identifying someone or something encountered before.

breath.en: air moving into or out of your lungs

institute.tip: 高频搭配：research institute (研究机构，研究所) / institute of technology (理工学院)；同族词：institutes (复数)、instituted (过去分词)、instituting (现在分词)
institute.en: Commonly used in expressions like "research institute (研究机构，研究所)" (n & v.).

component.tip: a component of表示“……的组成部分”。
component.en: One of the parts that together form a whole.

republic.tip: 共和国没有君主，但并不必然实行民主制度。
republic.en: A country whose head of state is not a monarch.

minority.tip: 高频搭配：ethnic minority (少数民族) / minority nationality (少数民族)；同族词：minorities (复数)
minority.en: Commonly used in expressions like "ethnic minority (少数民族)" (n.).

unlikely.tip: 常用be unlikely to do或It is unlikely that。
unlikely.en: Not expected to happen or be true.

connect.tip: 连接设备常用connect A to B。
connect.en: to join things together or link them electronically

partly.tip: 表示部分而非全部；常用partly because说明原因。
partly.en: To some extent, but not completely.

elsewhere.tip: 本身是副词，通常不说in elsewhere或to elsewhere。

necessarily.tip: not necessarily 意为“不一定”，不是“一定不”。
necessarily.en: As an unavoidable result or something that must be true

organize.tip: 英式也常拼作organise；organize是规范拼写。
organize.en: To plan and arrange an event or activity

household.tip: household强调同住一户，不一定有亲属关系。
household.en: all the people who live together in one home

guide.tip: 指南用a guide to；指导某人完成用guide someone through。
guide.en: someone who leads people and explains places they visit

trail.tip: trail作名词可指小径或痕迹；trail behind指落在后面。
trail.en: A path through countryside, forests, or mountains.

novel.tip: 作名词指长篇小说；作形容词指新颖的。
novel.en: A long written story about imaginary people and events.

somehow.tip: 高频搭配：somehow or other (设法，想办法) / somehow you will (不知道什么原因你就会做到（歌词）)；同族词：somehow (adv.)
somehow.en: Commonly used in expressions like "somehow or other (设法，想办法)" (adv.).

jury.tip: jury指整个陪审团；单个陪审员叫juror。
jury.en: a group that decides facts in a court case

experiment.tip: 动词接with表示尝试；名词重音在第二音节。
experiment.en: a test designed to discover something or check an idea

breast.tip: 高频搭配：breast cancer (乳腺癌) / breast milk (母乳)；同族词：breasts (复数)、breasted (过去式)、breasting (现在分词)
breast.en: Commonly used in expressions like "breast cancer (乳腺癌)" (n.).

silence.tip: in silence意为默默地；silent是形容词。
silence.en: a lack of sound or speech

secure.tip: secure可作形容词，也可作及物动词表示争取到。
secure.en: Protected from danger, or firmly fixed in place.

theme.tip: theme侧重贯穿作品的思想；topic多指讨论话题。
theme.en: the main subject or idea in a work or discussion

publication.tip: 指出版行为时不可数；指具体出版物时可数。
publication.en: The process of making written material available to the public.

treaty.tip: 通常指国家间正式协议，不表示谈判过程。

journey.tip: journey侧重路途；trip常指包含往返的出行。
journey.en: an occasion of travelling from one place to another

struggle.tip: struggle to do表示做某事很吃力，不保证成功。
struggle.en: To try very hard to do something difficult.

sum.tip: sum up表示总结；一笔钱用a sum of money。

imply.tip: imply是说话者暗示；infer是听者推断。
imply.en: To suggest something without stating it directly.

being.tip: 指生物时可数；表示“存在”时通常不可数。
being.en: a living creature, especially a person

illustrate.tip: illustrate可用例子说明，不一定涉及图片。
illustrate.en: To make something clear through examples or evidence.

captain.tip: 军衔含义随军种变化；海军中通常指上校。
captain.en: The leader of a team or person commanding a vessel.

shift.tip: shift作名词可指变化，也可指工作班次。
shift.en: To move or change position, direction, or focus.

revenue.tip: 高频搭配：tax revenue (税收) / sales revenue (产品销售收入)；同族词：revenues (复数)
revenue.en: Commonly used in expressions like "tax revenue (税收)" (n.).

phase.tip: phase in指逐步引入，phase out指逐步淘汰。
phase.en: A distinct period in a process of change or development.

locate.tip: 表示“位于”常用be located in/near，不直接用locate。
locate.en: To find the exact position of someone or something.

display.tip: on display意为“在展出”，中间不加冠词。
display.en: Put something where people can see it

initiative.tip: 高频搭配：take the initiative (采取主动) / on one's own initiative (主动地)；同族词：initiatives (复数)
initiative.en: Commonly used in expressions like "take the initiative (采取主动)" (n.).

basically.tip: 用于概括核心情况；不等于“几乎不”的barely。
basically.en: considering only the main facts or most important features

sequence.tip: a sequence of后接复数名词，表示一连串事物。
sequence.en: An ordered series of things, actions, or events.

assumption.tip: 常用assumption that从句，表示未经证实的看法。
assumption.en: Something accepted as true without definite proof.

curriculum.tip: 复数为curricula或curriculums；不等于单门课。
curriculum.en: the subjects and content included in a programme of study

thinking.tip: 高频搭配：thinking of (想起) / way of thinking (思维方式)；同族词：think (词根/原形)
thinking.en: Commonly used in expressions like "thinking of (想起)" (adj./n.).

escape.tip: 逃离某处用escape from；免遭某事可直接接名词。
escape.en: to get away from confinement or a dangerous situation

trend.tip: 朝向某种趋势常用a trend towards后接名词。
trend.en: a general direction of change or development

comfortable.en: physically pleasant and free from discomfort

crew.tip: crew是集体名词；单个成员说a crew member。
crew.en: The people who work together on a ship or aircraft

investigate.tip: 直接接调查对象：investigate the problem，不加into。
investigate.en: To examine facts carefully to discover what happened or why.

hearing.tip: 指听力时不可数；指听证会时可数。
hearing.en: The ability to notice sounds through your ears.

muscle.tip: muscle中的c不发音；pull a muscle指拉伤肌肉。
muscle.en: body tissue that tightens and relaxes to produce movement

gallery.tip: gallery主要展示艺术品；museum涵盖的展品范围更广。
gallery.en: A room or building where artworks are displayed or sold.

notion.tip: 高频搭配：notion — 概念；同族词：notions (复数)
notion.en: Commonly used in expressions like "notion — 概念" (n.).

capture.tip: 拍摄影像、捕捉气氛也可用capture。
capture.en: to catch someone or something and prevent escape

closely.tip: look closely指仔细看；stand close指站得近。
closely.en: with careful attention to details or changes

ministry.tip: 政府部门名称常用Ministry of加领域名词。
ministry.en: a government department responsible for a particular area

chest.tip: chest指胸部或大箱子；chest of drawers才是抽屉柜。
chest.en: The upper front part of the body, enclosing heart and lungs.

emphasis.tip: 高频搭配：emphasis on (着重于) / put emphasis on (重视，强调)；同族词：emphasis (n.)
emphasis.en: Commonly used in expressions like "emphasis on (着重于)" (n.).

truly.en: Really or genuinely, rather than only apparently

thick.tip: 形容液体时指黏稠，不一定表示味道浓。
thick.en: having a large distance between opposite surfaces

prospect.tip: 前景常用复数prospects；of后可接动名词。
prospect.en: The possibility or expectation that something will happen.

beauty.tip: 表示“美”通常不可数；the beauty of也指妙处。
beauty.en: The quality of being pleasing to see, hear, or experience.

emergency.tip: 是可数名词；emergency exit中的名词作定语。
emergency.en: A serious, unexpected situation requiring immediate action.

narrow.tip: narrow down表示缩小选择范围，不指道路变窄。
narrow.en: having little distance from one side to the other

inform.tip: 告知某人某事用inform sb of/about sth。
inform.en: To give someone facts or tell them about something.

unique.tip: unique to表示某处特有；严格指唯一时不用very修饰。
unique.en: Unlike anything else, or the only one of its kind

advise.tip: advise是动词；advice是不可数名词，词尾发/s/。
advise.en: Tell someone what you think they should do

priority.tip: give priority to后接优先考虑的事物。
priority.en: something considered more important than other things

opening.tip: 高频搭配：opening up (开放，扩大开放) / opening ceremony (开学典礼)；同族词：open (词根/原形)、openings (复数)
opening.en: Commonly used in expressions like "opening up (开放，扩大开放)" (adj./n.).

stress.tip: 人感到压力用stressed；事情令人紧张用stressful。
stress.en: Mental strain caused by difficult situations or too many demands

combination.tip: 常用a combination of A and B表示两者结合。
combination.en: two or more things joined or used together

rely.tip: 不直接接宾语：用rely on或rely upon。
rely.en: to need someone's help or depend on something

liberal.tip: 政治含义随国家而异；也可表示开明或用量充足。
liberal.en: Accepting different opinions and supporting people's freedom to choose.

appreciate.tip: 可接名词或动名词，不接to do；感谢帮助用appreciate your help。
appreciate.en: Feel grateful for something someone has done.

setting.tip: 环境义常用in a setting；设备设置常用复数settings。
setting.en: The place and conditions in which something happens.

upper.tip: 通常放在名词前，如upper floor；反义词是lower。
upper.en: Located above another part or nearer the top.

interpretation.tip: 高频搭配：simultaneous interpretation (同声传译) / judicial interpretation (司法解释)；同族词：interpretations (复数)
interpretation.en: Commonly used in expressions like "simultaneous interpretation (同声传译)" (n.).

outcome.tip: 可数名词，常用the outcome of表示某事的结果。
outcome.en: The final result of an action, event, or process.

ad.tip: ad是advertisement的非正式缩写，是可数名词。
ad.en: a public message promoting a product, service, or opportunity

defend.en: to protect someone or something from attack or harm

wing.tip: 鸟的翅膀和飞机机翼都用wing，通常成对用复数。
wing.en: A body part or aircraft structure that enables flight.

lane.tip: lane指一条车道；整条道路通常用road。
lane.en: a strip of road for one line of vehicles

flow.tip: 过去式和过去分词均为flowed，不是flew。
flow.en: To move continuously, like water through a channel.

mix.tip: mix A with B指混合；mix A up with B指混淆。
mix.en: To combine different substances or things.

crown.tip: be crowned champion意为“被授予冠军称号”。
crown.en: a ceremonial headpiece worn by a king or queen

coal.tip: coal指煤，charcoal指木炭；煤通常用作不可数名词。
coal.en: A hard black or brown material burned to produce heat.

approve.tip: 批准某事用approve；赞成某事用approve of。
approve.en: To officially accept or allow something.

zone.tip: zone强调特定用途或特征的区域；area含义更宽泛。
zone.en: An area with a particular purpose, feature, or condition.

bloody.tip: 高频搭配：bloody nose (出血的鼻子) / bloody mary (血玛丽（一种通常用伏特加、蕃茄汁和调味料制成的鸡尾酒）)；同族词：bloodiest (最高级)、bloodied (过去分词)、bloodying (现在分词)
bloody.en: Commonly used in expressions like "bloody nose (出血的鼻子)" (adv./adj.).

variation.tip: variation in指某方面的差异；variation on指变体。
variation.en: A difference or change in amount, level, form, or quality.

airport.tip: 在机场通常用at the airport；航站楼是terminal。
airport.en: A place where planes take off, land, and collect passengers

castle.en: A large fortified building with thick walls and towers.

motion.tip: 动议可用pass或reject；in motion表示在运动中。
motion.en: the act or process of moving

membership.tip: 表示加入某组织的资格，常用membership of。
membership.en: the status of belonging to a club or organisation

pilot.tip: pilot作定语常表示试点，如pilot project。
pilot.en: a person who flies an aircraft

ultimately.tip: 强调最终结果或根本因素，不用于列举中的最后一项。
ultimately.en: in the end, after a series of events

suggestion.tip: suggestion是可数名词；advice通常不可数。
suggestion.en: an idea offered for someone to consider

persuade.tip: persuade sb to do强调劝服成功，不只是提出建议。
persuade.en: To get someone to do something by giving reasons

cope.tip: cope是不及物动词，接困难或压力时用with。
cope.en: To manage a difficult situation successfully.

attractive.tip: 既可形容外表好看，也可形容方案、薪资诱人。

politician.tip: politician指从政者，本身不一定含贬义。
politician.en: Someone whose work involves politics, especially an elected government member.

steal.tip: 过去式stole，过去分词stolen；宾语通常是物。
steal.en: to take something without permission and keep or use it

incident.en: An event, especially one that is unusual or unpleasant.

pursue.tip: 高频搭配：pursue after (v. 追赶)；同族词：pursued (过去分词)、pursuing (现在分词)、pursues (第三人称单数)
pursue.en: Commonly used in expressions like "pursue after (v. 追赶)" (v.).

slip.tip: 过去式和过去分词均为slipped，双写p。
slip.en: To slide accidentally, losing balance or leaving a position.

percentage.en: an amount expressed as a fraction of one hundred

funny.tip: funny侧重好笑或奇怪；fun侧重令人愉快、有趣。

soil.tip: 土壤一般不可数；不同土质可用复数soils。
soil.en: The earth in which plants grow.

index.tip: 高频搭配：index system ([计]索引系统) / refractive index (折射率，折光率)；同族词：indices (复数)、indexed (过去分词)、indexing (现在分词)
index.en: Commonly used in expressions like "index system ([计]索引系统)" (n.).

surgery.tip: 手术义通常不可数；英式英语中诊所义可数。
surgery.en: Medical treatment involving cutting into the body to repair damage.

elect.tip: elect sb chair 中职务前常不加冠词。
elect.en: to choose someone for a position by voting

jewish.tip: 高频搭配：jewish — 犹太人的；同族词：jewish (adj.)
jewish.en: Commonly used in expressions like "jewish — 犹太人的" (adj.).

blame.tip: 人作宾语用blame sb for；事作宾语用blame sth on。
blame.en: To consider someone or something responsible for a problem.

estimate.tip: 动词末尾读/eɪt/；名词末尾读/ət/。
estimate.en: To judge an approximate amount, value, or size.

golf.tip: 球类运动前通常不加冠词：play golf。
golf.en: A sport hitting a small ball into holes with clubs

square.tip: 面积用square metres；长度用metres，勿混淆。
square.en: a shape with four equal sides and four right angles

vital.tip: 常用be vital for/to，表示对……至关重要。

crazy.tip: 偏口语；crazy about表示着迷，不宜用来称呼精神疾病患者。

recover.tip: 从疾病或挫折中恢复用recover from。
recover.en: return to health or a normal condition after difficulty

chain.tip: a chain of后接复数名词，表示相连的一系列事物。
chain.en: a series of connected metal rings

specialist.tip: 名词后接in表示专长领域；形容词常修饰knowledge。
specialist.en: Someone with detailed knowledge or training in a particular field.

governor.tip: 具体职位看搭配：school governor指学校董事。
governor.en: the official leader of a state or territory

characteristic.tip: 形容词常用be characteristic of，表示是……的典型特征。
characteristic.en: A quality that is typical of a person or thing.

tone.tip: 高频搭配：skin tone (肤色) / tone of voice (语调)；同族词：tones (复数)、toned (过去分词)、toning (现在分词)
tone.en: Commonly used in expressions like "skin tone (肤色)" (n.).

engineering.tip: 表示学科或技术领域时不可数；engineer可指工程师。
engineering.en: using science to design and build machines, structures, or systems

kick.tip: kick用脚踢；hit泛指击打，不限定用什么。
kick.en: to hit something with your foot

ancient.tip: ancient强调年代久远，不宜代替一般的old。
ancient.en: belonging to a period thousands of years in the past

request.tip: 名词接for；动词直接接宾语：request information。
request.en: an act of asking politely or formally for something

golden.tip: golden多形容颜色；表示金制的通常用gold。
golden.en: Having the warm yellow colour of gold.

foundation.tip: 高频搭配：on the foundation ([英国英语]领取基金会提供奖学金(或津贴)的) / theoretical foundation (理论基础)；同族词：foundations (复数)
foundation.en: Commonly used in expressions like "on the foundation ([英国英语]领取基金会提供奖学金(或津贴)的)" (n.).

solve.en: Find an answer to a problem or mystery

deputy.tip: 常置于职务前，如deputy director；不泛指所有代表。
deputy.en: someone authorised to assist or act for a more senior person

landscape.tip: landscape可数，指一片景观；scenery通常不可数。
landscape.en: The visible features of an area of land.

bowl.tip: a bowl of表示“一碗”；bowling指保龄球运动。
bowl.en: a round, deep container used for food or liquids

rare.tip: rare形容肉时指内部仍红，熟度低于medium。
rare.en: not common or not happening often

frame.tip: frame既可指实体框架，也可指组织表达的方式。
frame.en: a structure that surrounds or supports something

forth.tip: 常见于固定搭配；勿与表示“第四”的fourth混淆。
forth.en: Forward or out from a place.

typical.tip: 用typical of表示具有某人或某物的典型特征。
typical.en: having the usual features of a particular group or situation

elderly.tip: 指人年老，不指中年；older people通常更中性。

eliminate.tip: 比reduce更彻底，强调完全去除或排除。
eliminate.en: To remove or get rid of something completely.

host.tip: a host of后接复数名词，表示“大量”。
host.en: someone who welcomes guests or presents a programme or event

observation.tip: 观察活动通常不可数；一条观察意见可数。
observation.en: The act of watching carefully to learn or check something.

ocean.tip: ocean通常比sea范围大；专名常加the。
ocean.en: The vast salt water covering much of Earth's surface.

impression.tip: under the impression that表示“以为”，常暗示误解。
impression.en: An idea or feeling formed about someone or something.

meanwhile.tip: 连接两个完整句子时，前面用句号或分号。
meanwhile.en: During the same time or while something else is happening.

neighbour.en: someone living nearby, or something located next to another

capable.tip: 用capable of doing，不用capable to do。
capable.en: Having the ability or qualities needed to do something.

attach.tip: 常用attach A to B；邮件附件用attachment。
attach.en: Join or fasten something to something else

fix.tip: fix既可修理物品，也可解决问题或确定日期。
fix.en: Make something work properly or solve a problem.

grand.tip: grand total指全部加起来的总数。
grand.en: Large, impressive, or splendid in appearance

fashion.tip: 表方式时常用in a ... fashion，语气较正式。
fashion.en: A style of clothing or behaviour popular at a particular time

mirror.tip: 照镜子用look in the mirror，不用look the mirror。
mirror.en: A smooth surface, usually glass, that shows a reflected image.

coast.tip: on the coast指在海边；off the coast指在近海。
coast.en: the land along the edge of the sea

atmosphere.tip: 表示某种氛围常用an atmosphere；地球大气用the atmosphere。
atmosphere.en: the feeling or mood of a place or situation

smart.tip: 英式常指衣着整洁时髦；美式常指聪明。

mass.tip: 物理学中mass指质量，weight指重量，二者不同。
mass.en: a large amount of something gathered together

revolution.tip: revolution强调根本变革；reform通常指渐进改革。
revolution.en: a major change in government, often achieved by force

complain.tip: 向某人投诉某事：complain to sb about sth。
complain.en: To say that something is wrong or unsatisfactory

topic.tip: topic指讨论或写作的主题；title指文章等的标题。
topic.en: a subject that people discuss, write about, or study

variable.tip: 作形容词指可变的；作可数名词指变量。
variable.en: Likely or able to change rather than remain the same.

brief.tip: brief指时间短或内容简洁，本身不表示草率。
brief.en: Lasting a short time or using few words.

distinction.tip: 表示两者区别，常用distinction between A and B。
distinction.en: A difference that separates one thing or group from another

perception.tip: 高频搭配：visual perception (视觉感知) / aesthetic perception (美感，审美观念)；同族词：perceptions (复数)
perception.en: Commonly used in expressions like "visual perception (视觉感知)" (n.).

mechanism.tip: mechanism for doing表示“做某事的机制或办法”。
mechanism.en: a process or system through which something works or happens

external.tip: external与internal相对；药品上指外用的。
external.en: Located on the outside of something.

clause.tip: 语法中clause含主语和谓语；phrase通常不含。
clause.en: A separate condition or requirement in a legal document.

tank.tip: fish tank是水族箱；汽车的油箱用fuel tank。
tank.en: A large container for holding liquids or gases.

iron.tip: 铁是不可数名词；熨斗可数，用an iron。
iron.en: A strong metal used in construction and needed by the body.

aside.tip: aside通常是副词；“除……以外”用aside from。
aside.en: to or at one side, away from the main position

anywhere.tip: 不定副词，通常不直接作名词；anywhere else指别处。

bond.tip: bond with sb指增进感情；issue bonds指发行债券。
bond.en: a close connection between people or groups

advance.tip: in advance表示提前；advanced表示先进的或高级的。
advance.en: An improvement or development in a particular field

welfare.tip: 不可数名词；作前置修饰语时也仍是名词。
welfare.en: The health, happiness, and good living conditions of people.

era.tip: era强调具有共同特征的时代，不指固定年数。
era.en: A period distinguished by particular events, developments, or ways of life.

bind.tip: 高频搭配：bind up (包扎) / in a bind (adv. 处于困境)；同族词：bound (过去分词)、binding (现在分词)、binds (第三人称单数)
bind.en: Commonly used in expressions like "bind up (包扎)" (v.).

engineer.tip: engineer也可作动词，表示设计或策划促成。
engineer.en: Someone who designs or builds machines, structures, or technical systems.

beneath.tip: 比under更正式；beneath也可表示有失身份。
beneath.en: In or to a position directly below something.

expectation.tip: 表示对表现的期望时常用复数expectations。
expectation.en: A belief that something will happen.

drawing.tip: 指一幅画时可数；指绘画活动时通常不可数。
drawing.en: A picture made with a pencil, pen, or similar tool.

accuse.tip: 高频搭配：accuse of (谴责，控告)；同族词：accused (过去分词)、accusing (现在分词)、accuses (第三人称单数)
accuse.en: Commonly used in expressions like "accuse of (谴责，控告)" (v.).

motor.tip: motor skills指身体动作技能，与汽车无关。
motor.en: A machine that supplies power to move or operate something.

somewhat.tip: 比a bit正式，常用于缓和判断或语气。
somewhat.en: To a limited degree; rather, but not very.

origin.tip: 高频搭配：country of origin (原产地) / certificate of origin ([商]原产地证书)；同族词：origins (复数)
origin.en: Commonly used in expressions like "country of origin (原产地)" (n.).

pour.tip: 倒入用pour into；倒出用pour out of。
pour.en: To make liquid flow from a container.

grey.tip: grey为英式拼写，gray为美式拼写。
grey.en: Having a colour between black and white.

stir.tip: 过去式stirred、现在分词stirring均双写r。
stir.en: To mix something by moving a spoon or similar object around.

beach.tip: 在海滩上用on the beach；shore泛指岸边。
beach.en: an area of sand or small stones beside water

accompany.tip: 直接接人作宾语，不说accompany with someone。

establishment.tip: 表示建立时不可数；表示机构时可数。
establishment.en: the process of starting an organisation or system

hence.tip: 正式用语；表示“因此”时，后面也可直接接名词短语。
hence.en: For this reason; as a result

nineteen.tip: 高频搭配：nineteen — 十九；同族词：nineteen (num.)
nineteen.en: Commonly used in expressions like "nineteen — 十九" (num.).

unfortunately.tip: 常置于句首并加逗号，对整件事表示遗憾。
unfortunately.en: used to say that something is disappointing or unlucky

minor.tip: minor injury指轻伤；名词a minor指未成年人。
minor.en: Not very serious, important, or large.

hero.tip: 复数为heroes；故事中的hero不一定品德高尚。
hero.en: someone admired for courage, achievements, or good actions

height.tip: height 是名词；形容人高用 tall，物体高可用 high。
height.en: the measurement of how tall someone or something is

stretch.tip: 高频搭配：stretch oneself (伸懒腰) / stretch out (伸手)；同族词：stretched (过去式)、stretching (现在分词)、stretches (复数)
stretch.en: Commonly used in expressions like "stretch oneself (伸懒腰)" (v./n.).

ideal.tip: ideal for后接名词或动名词，表示最适合某用途。
ideal.en: perfect or the best possible for a particular purpose

expense.tip: 日常各项开支常用复数expenses；expensive是形容词。
expense.en: money spent or needed for a particular purpose

seed.tip: sow seeds指播种；seedling指已经发芽的幼苗。
seed.en: A small part of a plant that can grow into another.

withdraw.tip: 过去式withdrew，过去分词withdrawn；退出用from。
withdraw.en: To take money out of a bank account

significance.tip: be of great significance相当于be very significant。
significance.en: the importance of something, especially its effects

severe.tip: 可修饰疼痛、天气、短缺或惩罚，表示程度重。

pepper.tip: 胡椒粉不可数；指一个甜椒时可说a pepper。
pepper.en: A spice used to give food a hot flavour.

terrible.tip: terrible是形容词；表示“非常”通常用terribly。

tip.tip: tip作“建议”可数，advice不可数：a tip。

india.tip: 高频搭配：east india (东印度（指印度，印度支那半岛，马来半岛和马来群岛等）) / east india company (东印度公司)；同族词：india (n.)
india.en: Commonly used in expressions like "east india (东印度（指印度，印度支那半岛，马来半岛和马来群岛等）)" (n.).

prisoner.tip: prisoner 不一定已被定罪，也可指被俘或被拘禁者。
prisoner.en: A person kept in prison or prevented from leaving.

cite.tip: cite是引用；site是地点；sight是视力，三者同音。
cite.en: To mention a source or example supporting a statement.

vast.tip: the vast majority of表示……中的绝大多数。
vast.en: Extremely large in area, size, amount, or degree.

champion.tip: 作动词直接接宾语：champion a cause。
champion.en: a person or team that wins a competition

gray.tip: gray为美式拼写，英式通常写grey。
gray.en: having a colour between black and white

exclude.tip: 高频搭配：exclude — 排除；同族词：excluded (过去分词)、excluding (现在分词)、excludes (第三人称单数)
exclude.en: Commonly used in expressions like "exclude — 排除" (v.).

eighty.tip: 高频搭配：eighty — 八十；同族词：eighty (num.)
eighty.en: Commonly used in expressions like "eighty — 八十" (num.).

oppose.tip: oppose 后直接接名词或动名词，不加 to。
oppose.en: Disagree with something and try to prevent or change it.

christ.tip: 高频搭配：jesus christ (耶稣基督) / body of christ (基督的身体)；同族词：christ (n.)
christ.en: Commonly used in expressions like "jesus christ (耶稣基督)" (n.).

contemporary.tip: 当代艺术中指“当代”；历史语境也可指“当时的”。

convention.tip: 惯例与大会通常可数；by convention意为按惯例。
convention.en: An accepted way of behaving or doing something.

multiple.tip: 表示“多个的”时通常修饰复数名词。
multiple.en: Involving or consisting of more than one person or thing.

switch.tip: switch on/off表示开关设备；switch to表示改用。
switch.en: A device used to turn equipment on or off.

criminal.tip: criminal 可作形容词或名词；crime 是“罪行”。
criminal.en: relating to crime or the legal treatment of crime

core.tip: 果核指苹果等的中央硬部；桃核通常用stone。
core.en: the central or most important part of something

rush.tip: rush to do表示赶紧做；rush into表示仓促行动。
rush.en: to move or do something very quickly, often without care

specifically.tip: specifically for强调专门用途；更具体地说用more specifically。
specifically.en: for one particular purpose, person, or group

justify.tip: justify后接名词或动名词，不接不定式。
justify.en: Give good reasons for an action, decision, or belief.

signal.tip: 过去式英式常写signalled，美式常写signaled。
signal.en: A sound, movement, or light that communicates a message.

rail.tip: by rail表示乘火车，不加冠词；动词常接against。
rail.en: a steel track for trains, or transport by train

resolution.tip: 高频搭配：high resolution (高分辨) / spatial resolution (空间分辨率)；同族词：resolutions (复数)
resolution.en: Commonly used in expressions like "high resolution (高分辨)" (n.).

comparison.tip: 两者之间的比较用comparison between A and B。
comparison.en: Examining things to see how they are similar or different.

witness.tip: 高频搭配：bear witness (证明，作证) / as witness (以…为证明)；同族词：witnesses (复数)、witnessed (过去分词)、witnessing (现在分词)
witness.en: Commonly used in expressions like "bear witness (证明，作证)" (n.).

apart.tip: apart from可指“除外”或“除……还”，需看语境。
apart.en: separated by distance or time; not together

barely.tip: 本身含否定意义，通常不再与not连用。

plenty.tip: plenty of后接复数可数名词或不可数名词，无须加a。
plenty.en: Enough or more than enough of something.

achievement.tip: 具体成就可数；表示目标的实现时通常不可数。
achievement.en: Something valuable accomplished through effort or skill.

proud.tip: be proud of后接名词或动名词，表示为……自豪。
proud.en: Feeling pleased about achievements or people you care about.

faculty.tip: 英式常指大学院系，美式常指全体教员。
faculty.en: A university division covering a particular group of subjects.

gap.tip: 两者间的差距用 gap between A and B。
gap.en: An empty space between things or within something.

occupy.tip: 忙于某事可用be occupied with或in doing。
occupy.en: to fill or use a space, place, or period

definitely.en: certainly, with no doubt about something

bomb.tip: 词尾b不发音；bombing指轰炸或炸弹袭击。
bomb.en: A weapon designed to explode and cause damage.

permanent.tip: permanent job指无固定结束日期的工作，不保证终身任职。
permanent.en: Lasting indefinitely rather than for a limited time.

enormous.tip: 既可形容体积，也可形容压力、数量或影响很大。
enormous.en: extremely large in size, amount, or degree

complaint.tip: complaint是名词，complain是动词；投诉某事用about。
complaint.en: a statement that something is wrong or unsatisfactory

massive.tip: 既可形容体积巨大，也可形容投入或变化程度极大。

amongst.tip: 高频搭配：amongst — 在…之中(=among)；同族词：amongst (prep.)
amongst.en: Commonly used in expressions like "amongst — 在…之中(=among)" (prep.).

shock.tip: 人感到震惊用shocked；事物令人震惊用shocking。
shock.en: a strong feeling of surprise caused by something unexpected

wheel.tip: at或behind the wheel常表示正在开车。
wheel.en: A round object that turns to move a vehicle.

invest.tip: 常用invest in；投入时间做事可用invest time in doing。
invest.en: To put money into something hoping to gain financial returns.

passenger.tip: 指乘坐交通工具的人，不包括驾驶员或机组人员。
passenger.en: Someone travelling in a vehicle without driving or operating it

odd.tip: the odd加单数名词常表示偶尔的某事。
odd.en: Strange or different from what is expected.

cable.tip: 既可传电或信号，也可指承重用的钢缆。
cable.en: covered wires carrying electricity or electronic signals

via.tip: via后直接接地点或方式，如via email。
via.en: travelling through a particular place on the way somewhere

column.tip: column 是竖列，row 是横行；词尾 n 不发音。
column.en: a vertical arrangement of items or a printed page section

charity.tip: 指机构时可数；指慈善事业或救济时不可数。
charity.en: an organisation that helps people or causes in need

cream.tip: cream是奶油或乳霜；cheese才是奶酪。
cream.en: The thick, fatty part of milk, used in food.

territory.tip: 领土义可不可数；一块辖区可用a territory。
territory.en: land controlled by a particular country or authority

independence.tip: 通常不可数；independence from表示不依赖或不受控制。
independence.en: The ability to live or act without relying on others.

solid.tip: solid作名词指固体；solid evidence表示可靠证据。
solid.en: having a firm shape rather than being liquid or gas

inner.tip: 高频搭配：inner mongolia (n. 中国内蒙古) / inner surface (内表面)；同族词：inner (adj.)
inner.en: Commonly used in expressions like "inner mongolia (n. 中国内蒙古)" (adj.).

manufacturer.tip: 高频搭配：automobile manufacturer (汽车制造厂) / parts manufacturer (零件制造者)；同族词：manufacturers (复数)
manufacturer.en: Commonly used in expressions like "automobile manufacturer (汽车制造厂)" (n.).

celebrate.tip: 庆祝某事用celebrate；祝贺某人用congratulate。
celebrate.en: To mark a special occasion by doing something enjoyable.

permit.tip: 动词重音在后，名词在前；permit sb to do。
permit.en: to officially allow someone to do something

similarly.tip: 句首Similarly常接逗号，用于引出相似情况。
similarly.en: In a similar way; also true of another person or thing

corporation.tip: 常指大型公司；勿与cooperation（合作）混淆。
corporation.en: A legally established company, especially a large one.

talent.tip: 表示某方面的天赋，用a talent for加名词或动名词。
talent.en: A natural ability to do something well.

inflation.tip: 经济语境指物价普遍上涨，不只某件商品涨价。
inflation.en: A general rise in prices that reduces money's purchasing power.

fundamental.tip: 名词通常用复数 fundamentals，表示基本原理。
fundamental.en: Forming the essential basis of something.

taste.tip: taste表示“尝起来”时接形容词，不接副词。
taste.en: A food's flavour, or the sense that detects it.

virtually.tip: 常指“几乎”，不等于表示真实情况的actually。
virtually.en: Almost completely, or in every important practical way.

cast.tip: 过去式、过去分词均为cast；全体演员用单数形式。
cast.en: All the actors appearing in a film or play.

unusual.tip: It is unusual for sb to do表示某人很少这样做。
unusual.en: Different from what is common, normal, or expected.

quote.tip: quote引用原话；paraphrase用自己的话转述。
quote.en: To repeat someone's exact words in speech or writing.

dominate.tip: 高频搭配：dominate the market (欺行霸市)；同族词：dominated (过去分词)、dominates (第三人称单数)、dominating (现在分词)
dominate.en: Commonly used in expressions like "dominate the market (欺行霸市)" (v.).

physician.tip: 美式常泛指医生；英式常指内科医生。
physician.en: A medical doctor, especially one treating illness without surgery.

exception.tip: 规则的例外用exception to，不用exception of。
exception.en: someone or something not included in a general rule or pattern

addition.tip: in addition作连接语；in addition to后接名词或动名词。
addition.en: the act of putting something extra into something

accommodation.tip: 英式英语中表住宿通常不可数；注意双c、双m。
accommodation.en: a place where someone can live or stay

creative.tip: 形容人有创意或方法新颖；名词形式是creativity。
creative.en: Able to produce original ideas, or involving imagination.

boundary.tip: boundary 强调分界；border 常用于国家或地区边界。
boundary.en: A line marking where one area ends and another begins

lower.tip: lower作动词通常接宾语；表示物价下降也可不及物。
lower.en: below something else in position, level, or amount

gay.tip: 通常作形容词；“快乐的”义现已少用。
gay.en: Romantically or sexually attracted to people of the same sex.

construct.tip: 动词重音在后；名词construct重音在前。
construct.en: to build something by putting parts or materials together

campus.tip: 表示“在校园内”通常用on campus，不加冠词。
campus.en: the grounds and buildings belonging to a university or college

guilty.tip: guilty of接罪行；feel guilty about接内疚的事。
guilty.en: Responsible for breaking a law or doing something wrong.

formation.tip: formation可指形成过程，也可指形成的结构或队形。
formation.en: The process of developing or bringing something into existence.

compete.en: Try to win or succeed against others.

transaction.tip: 通常可数：一笔交易是a transaction。
transaction.en: an act of buying, selling, or exchanging money

dispute.tip: dispute a claim是质疑说法，不是讨论说法。
dispute.en: a serious disagreement between people or groups

inquiry.tip: 调查某事用inquiry into；英式enquiry也常指咨询。
inquiry.en: a process of investigating facts or seeking knowledge

immigrant.tip: 高频搭配：illegal immigrant (非法移民) / immigrant visa (移民签证)；同族词：immigrants (复数)
immigrant.en: Commonly used in expressions like "illegal immigrant (非法移民)" (n./adj.).

kingdom.tip: 政治语境指王国；animal kingdom指动物界。
kingdom.en: a country ruled by a king or queen

illegal.tip: 常用句型：It is illegal to do sth.。

interaction.tip: 高频搭配：interaction with (交往) / interaction design (交互设计)；同族词：interactions (复数)
interaction.en: Commonly used in expressions like "interaction with (交往)" (n.).

personality.tip: 指性格时可数；have personality指有个人魅力。
personality.en: the qualities that shape how someone thinks, feels, and behaves

fault.tip: It's my fault表示“是我的错”，不用mistake替换。
fault.en: Something wrong with an object, system, or person's character

badly.tip: 比较级worse，最高级worst；不是bad的形容词用法。
badly.en: In a way that is poor, unsuccessful, or unacceptable

assistance.tip: 不可数名词；表示帮助时比help更正式。
assistance.en: Help given to someone who needs it.

phrase.tip: phrase是短语，不一定构成完整句子。
phrase.en: a group of words expressing an idea or forming a unit

quantity.tip: quantity指数量，quality指质量；a quantity of可接两类名词。
quantity.en: the amount or number of something

forever.tip: be forever doing常表示不满：老是做某事。

unknown.tip: the unknown泛指“未知事物或未知领域”。

naturally.tip: 句首Naturally常表示“当然”，不一定指天然。
naturally.en: Through natural processes rather than human action

proceed.tip: proceed是动词；表示收入的名词是proceeds。
proceed.en: Continue an activity or move to its next stage.

lab.tip: lab是laboratory的常用缩写，二者均为可数名词。
lab.en: A room or building equipped for scientific experiments and tests

wrap.tip: 用wrap A in B表示用材料B包住A。
wrap.en: to cover something by folding material around it

preparation.tip: 泛指准备时不可数；具体筹备工作常用复数preparations。
preparation.en: The work done to get ready for something.

tension.tip: 关系紧张常用tension between；多方矛盾可用复数。
tension.en: Strained relations between people or groups that may cause conflict

interpret.en: To explain or understand the meaning of something

depression.tip: 抑郁症不等于短暂心情低落；经济萧条常用a depression。
depression.en: a condition involving persistent sadness and loss of interest

spiritual.tip: 可指心灵层面，不一定涉及宗教。
spiritual.en: Connected with inner feelings and meaning rather than material things.

musical.tip: 作形容词指“音乐的”；作可数名词指音乐剧等。
musical.en: Relating to music, or showing skill and interest in it.

prayer.tip: 表示祈祷活动常不可数；一段祷词可数。
prayer.en: the act of speaking to God or a god

secondary.tip: 表示“次于”用secondary to，不用secondary than。
secondary.en: Relating to education after primary school and before higher education.

journalist.tip: journalist泛指新闻工作者，reporter更侧重采访报道。
journalist.en: Someone who gathers and reports news for the media.

metre.tip: 长度单位英式写metre，美式写meter；复数metres。
metre.en: A unit of length equal to one hundred centimetres.

dismiss.tip: dismiss A as B：认为A是B而不予考虑。
dismiss.en: to decide something is not worth considering

suspect.tip: 动词重音在后；名词、形容词读/ˈsʌspekt/。
suspect.en: To think something is likely true without being certain.

scholar.tip: scholar通常指学者，不是普通学生。
scholar.en: A person with deep knowledge of an academic subject.

climate.tip: climate指长期气候，weather指具体天气。
climate.en: The typical weather conditions of a place over many years.

cheese.tip: 通常不可数；一块奶酪用a piece of cheese。
cheese.en: A food made by pressing or ripening the solids of milk.

childhood.tip: during childhood泛指童年；in my childhood指我的童年。
childhood.en: the period of life when someone is a child

cigarette.tip: 可数名词；一包香烟可说a packet of cigarettes。
cigarette.en: A thin paper tube filled with tobacco for smoking.

moreover.tip: 正式递进副词；连接独立句时，前用句号或分号。
moreover.en: Used to add another fact supporting what was just said.

subsequent.tip: 高频搭配：subsequent events (财务报表编制后发生的事项) / subsequent handling (后续工序)；同族词：subsequent (adj.)
subsequent.en: Commonly used in expressions like "subsequent events (财务报表编制后发生的事项)" (adj.).

currency.tip: 货币种类可数；泛指货币通常不可数。
currency.en: The money used in a particular country.

graduate.tip: 名词尾音/ət/，动词/eɪt/；毕业于用graduate from。
graduate.en: someone who has successfully completed a university degree

emotion.tip: 泛指情感时可不可数；具体的各种情绪常用emotions。
emotion.en: a strong feeling such as joy, fear, or sadness

scream.tip: scream强调声音尖厉；shout只强调喊得响。
scream.en: To give a loud, high cry from strong emotion.

dramatic.tip: 高频搭配：dramatic — 引人注目的；同族词：dramatics (复数)
dramatic.en: Commonly used in expressions like "dramatic — 引人注目的" (adj.).

universe.tip: 指宇宙通常用the universe；开头是辅音音素/j/。
universe.en: All space and everything that exists within it

alter.tip: 可及物也可不及物；altar是“祭坛”，勿混。
alter.en: To change, or make something different.

rarely.tip: 通常放实义动词前、be动词后；本身有否定意味。
rarely.en: Not often; on very few occasions.

extension.tip: 高频搭配：brand extension (品牌延伸) / by extension (相关地)；同族词：extensions (复数)
extension.en: Commonly used in expressions like "brand extension (品牌延伸)" (n.).

prize.tip: prize可作动词表珍视，常见be highly prized。
prize.en: something given for winning a competition or achieving something

lucky.tip: “有幸做某事”用be lucky to do something。
lucky.en: Having good things happen by chance.

drag.tip: drag过去式为dragged；drag on指拖延下去。
drag.en: To pull something along a surface, often with effort.

airline.tip: airline指航空公司；具体航班用flight。
airline.en: A company that transports passengers or goods by aircraft

mill.tip: mill多指加工原料的工厂；普通工厂常用factory。
mill.en: a building or machine where grain is ground into flour

possess.tip: 比have正式；通常不用进行时。注意拼写有四个s。

agenda.tip: 高频搭配：item on the agenda (议程项目) / hidden agenda (隐秘的议程)；同族词：agendas (复数)
agenda.en: Commonly used in expressions like "item on the agenda (议程项目)" (n.).

tower.tip: 作动词常接over或above，表示远高于周围事物。
tower.en: a tall, narrow structure, standing alone or on a building

arrest.tip: 因某事被捕用be arrested for；under arrest表示被捕状态。
arrest.en: to take someone into police custody under legal authority

primarily.tip: 通常表示“主要”，不是表示先后顺序的“首先”。
primarily.en: Mainly, or more than anything else

coat.tip: 动词常用coat A with B，意为给A涂上B。
coat.en: an outer garment worn for warmth or protection

involvement.tip: 高频搭配：involvement in (介入) / job involvement (工作投入)；同族词：involvements (复数)
involvement.en: Commonly used in expressions like "involvement in (介入)" (n.).

analyse.en: to examine something carefully to understand its parts or causes

therapy.tip: 泛指治疗通常不可数；具体疗法可用复数。
therapy.en: Treatment intended to improve physical or mental health.

schedule.tip: 英音开头通常为/ʃ/，美音为/sk/；on schedule指准时。
schedule.en: a plan showing when activities or events will happen

spokesman.tip: 特指男性；不强调性别时用spokesperson。
spokesman.en: A man who speaks officially for a group or organisation

communist.tip: 高频搭配：communist party (共产党) / chinese communist (n. 中国共产党)；同族词：communists (复数)
communist.en: Commonly used in expressions like "communist party (共产党)" (n.).

pollution.en: damage to the environment caused by harmful substances or energy

constitution.tip: 高频搭配：chemical constitution (化学结构) / physical constitution (n. 体格)；同族词：constitutions (复数)
constitution.en: Commonly used in expressions like "chemical constitution (化学结构)" (n.).

purchase.tip: purchase比buy正式；名词可指购买行为或买到的东西。
purchase.en: to obtain something by paying money for it

gene.en: A unit of inherited information that influences an organism's characteristics

steel.tip: steel是钢，steal是偷；二者读音相同。
steel.en: A strong metal made mainly from iron and some carbon

regarding.tip: regarding直接接名词，不加to；比about正式。
regarding.en: On the subject of someone or something.

heavily.tip: 表示下大雨用rain heavily，不用rain strongly。
heavily.en: To a great degree or in large amounts.

visual.tip: visual表示与视觉有关；“栩栩如生”通常用vivid。
visual.en: Relating to sight or things that can be seen.

violent.tip: 既可指行为有暴力，也可形容风暴、震动猛烈。
violent.en: Using physical force to hurt people or damage things.

inch.tip: 英寸符号为″；作动词表示一点点移动。
inch.en: a unit of length equal to 2.54 centimetres

chip.tip: 食物中的chips：英式指薯条，美式通常指薯片。
chip.en: a tiny electronic component containing many connected circuits

depth.tip: in depth表示“深入地”，不是“在深处”。
depth.en: The distance from a surface to the bottom.

silent.tip: silent强调不出声；quiet也可表示声音很小。
silent.en: Not speaking or choosing not to speak.

assist.tip: 比help正式；常用assist someone with something。

saving.tip: 表示积蓄通常用复数savings；节省可用单数。
saving.en: a reduction in the money, time, or resources used

perceive.tip: 高频搭配：perceive as (视为)；同族词：perceived (过去分词)、perceives (第三人称单数)、perceiving (现在分词)
perceive.en: Commonly used in expressions like "perceive as (视为)" (v.).

port.tip: port指左舷时，反义词是starboard（右舷）。
port.en: A place where ships load, unload, or shelter.

command.tip: 高频搭配：command line (命令行) / command system (命令系统)；同族词：commands (复数)、commanded (过去式)、commanding (现在分词)
command.en: Commonly used in expressions like "command line (命令行)" (v.).

layer.tip: “一层某物”用a layer of；layer也可作动词。
layer.en: an amount of material covering a surface or another amount

calculate.tip: 高频搭配：calculate on (指望) / be calculated for (适合于……)；同族词：calculated (过去分词)、calculating (现在分词)、calculates (第三人称单数)
calculate.en: Commonly used in expressions like "calculate on (指望)" (v.).

delivery.tip: delivery指递送服务或过程；deliver是动词。
delivery.en: the act of taking goods or messages to someone

string.tip: 绳线通常不可数；琴弦及a string of中的string可数。
string.en: Thin cord used for tying or fastening things.

resolve.tip: resolve a problem是解决；resolve to do是决心做。
resolve.en: To find a satisfactory solution to a problem or disagreement.

slide.tip: 动词过去式和过去分词均为slid。
slide.en: to move smoothly across a surface without lifting

boot.tip: 汽车后备箱英式说boot，美式说trunk。
boot.en: footwear that covers the foot and part of the leg

wedding.en: A ceremony in which two people get married.

framework.tip: 常用a framework for sth，表示某事的基本框架。
framework.en: A basic structure of ideas or rules supporting something

portion.tip: portion可指整体的一部分，也常指一人份食物。
portion.en: A part or share of something larger.

opponent.tip: 高频搭配：opponent — 对手；同族词：opponents (复数)
opponent.en: Commonly used in expressions like "opponent — 对手" (n.).

poem.tip: poem可数，指一首诗；poetry不可数，统称诗歌。
poem.en: A literary work using carefully arranged language, often in lines.

obligation.tip: 常用have an obligation to do，表示有义务做。
obligation.en: Something you must do for legal or moral reasons

extensive.tip: 强调范围广或数量多；intensive强调集中、强度高。
extensive.en: covering many subjects or involving a large amount

transform.tip: 高频搭配：fourier transform (傅里叶变换) / fast fourier transform (快速傅里叶变换)；同族词：transformed (过去分词)、transforming (现在分词)、transforms (第三人称单数)
transform.en: Commonly used in expressions like "fourier transform (傅里叶变换)" (v.).

net.tip: net指扣除成本或税款后的净额；gross指扣除前的总额。
net.en: material made of crossing threads with spaces between them

alcohol.tip: 泛指酒或酒精时通常不可数；a drink可指一杯酒。
alcohol.en: drinks containing a substance that can make people drunk

glance.tip: glance at是短暂一瞥；stare at是盯着看。
glance.en: To look at someone or something very briefly.

protein.tip: 作营养物质通常不可数；指不同种类时可数。
protein.en: A nutrient needed for growth and repair of body tissues.

unlike.tip: unlike后接名词或代词；不要直接接完整句子。

bend.tip: 过去式和过去分词均为bent；bend down表示弯下腰。
bend.en: To become curved or make something curved.

desert.en: a very dry area with little rain and few plants

maintenance.en: work needed to keep something in good condition

cop.tip: 高频搭配：no cop (没价值，不值钱) / traffic cop (n. [口]交通警察)；同族词：cops (复数)、copped (过去式)、copping (现在分词)
cop.en: Commonly used in expressions like "no cop (没价值，不值钱)" (n.).

cycle.tip: cycle作动词表示骑车；骑车上班用cycle to work。
cycle.en: a series of events or stages that repeats

italian.tip: 国籍和语言名称首字母大写；意大利人复数为Italians。
italian.en: Relating to Italy, its people, culture, or language

reckon.tip: 高频搭配：reckon with (处理) / reckon on (指望)；同族词：reckons (第三人称单数)、reckoned (过去式)、reckoning (现在分词)
reckon.en: Commonly used in expressions like "reckon with (处理)" (v.).

occasionally.tip: 常放实义动词前、be动词后，也可放句首。
occasionally.en: sometimes, but not often or regularly

print.tip: print out指打印出来；out of print则指书已绝版。
print.en: To produce words or images on paper using a machine

restrict.tip: restrict A to B表示“把A限定在B范围内”。
restrict.en: to limit what someone can do or how much is allowed

recommendation.tip: recommendation后的that从句常用should或动词原形。
recommendation.en: advice about the best thing to do

preserve.tip: preserve强调保持原状；保藏食物也用它。
preserve.en: Keep something safe, unchanged, or in good condition

profession.tip: profession通常指需专门训练的职业，比job范围窄。
profession.en: A job requiring specialist knowledge and usually advanced training.

load.tip: load A with B指把B装进A；卸货用unload。
load.en: something carried, or the amount a vehicle or person carries

restore.tip: restore A to B：使A恢复到B状态或归还给B。
restore.en: To bring back a previous condition, ability, or situation.

mode.tip: 方式常用mode of；设备处于某模式用in ... mode。
mode.en: A particular way of doing something.

gently.en: In a soft, careful, or kind way.

lock.tip: lock是锁上，unlock是解锁；两者不可混用。
lock.en: to secure something so it cannot open, move, or be accessed

opposite.tip: 介词opposite后直接接地点；名词常用the opposite of。
opposite.en: completely different, or on the other side

approval.tip: approval of常指赞同；approval for常指项目许可。
approval.en: official permission for something to happen

deserve.tip: 接名词或to do；不用deserve doing表示主动。
deserve.en: To have earned something because of your actions or qualities.

cottage.tip: 通常指乡间小住宅，不等同于豪华的villa。
cottage.en: A small house, usually in the countryside.

principal.tip: principal指“主要的”或“校长”；principle指“原则”。

resistance.tip: 高频搭配：corrosion resistance (耐蚀性) / wear resistance ([机]耐磨性，耐磨度)；同族词：resistances (复数)
resistance.en: Commonly used in expressions like "corrosion resistance (耐蚀性)" (n.).

restriction.tip: 对某事的限制用restriction on；具体规定常用复数。
restriction.en: a rule or condition that limits what is allowed

boss.tip: boss较口语；作动词常用boss someone around。
boss.en: A person who manages workers or runs a business.

discovery.tip: discovery是发现原已存在的事物，不同于invention。
discovery.en: finding something previously unknown, or the thing that is found

protest.tip: 所列为名词音；动词英音/prəˈtest/，常接against。
protest.en: An expression or action showing strong disagreement or opposition.

exposure.tip: 高频搭配：exposure time (曝光时间) / sun exposure (日照)；同族词：exposures (复数)
exposure.en: Commonly used in expressions like "exposure time (曝光时间)" (n.).

pose.tip: 高频搭配：pose a threat (构成威胁)；同族词：posed (过去分词)、poses (第三人称单数)、posing (现在分词)
pose.en: Commonly used in expressions like "pose a threat (构成威胁)" (v./n.).

specify.tip: 可接名词、that从句或疑问词引导的从句。
specify.en: To state exactly what is required or meant.

export.tip: 动词重音在后；名词重音在前。
export.en: to send goods to another country for sale

stream.tip: a stream of可指接连不断的人或事物。

reputation.tip: 用reputation for接特点；名声可好可坏。
reputation.en: The general opinion people have about someone or something.

pot.tip: 锅、盆、罐都可用pot；平底煎锅常用pan。
pot.en: A deep container used for cooking food.

slight.tip: slight是形容词；修饰动词或比较级用slightly。
slight.en: small in amount, degree, or importance

regularly.tip: 可表示经常，也可表示固定间隔；不一定指每天。

habit.tip: 表示做某事的习惯，用habit of doing。
habit.en: something you do regularly, often without thinking

tale.tip: tale指故事；tail指尾巴，两者同音。
tale.en: a story, especially one involving imaginary or exciting events

racial.tip: 高频搭配：racial discrimination (种族歧视) / racial prejudice (种族偏见)；同族词：racial (adj.)
racial.en: Commonly used in expressions like "racial discrimination (种族歧视)" (adj.).

abroad.tip: abroad是副词：说go abroad，不说go to abroad。
abroad.en: in or to a foreign country

silver.tip: 表示金属银时不可数；a silver可指一枚银牌。
silver.en: A shiny greyish-white precious metal used for jewellery and coins.

convert.tip: 动词重音在后；名词重音在前。
convert.en: to change something into a different form, purpose, or system

joke.tip: 讲笑话用tell a joke，不用say a joke。
joke.en: Something said or done to make people laugh.

symptom.tip: 常用a symptom of；症状缓解用relieve symptoms。
symptom.en: a physical or mental change that suggests an illness

empire.tip: 高频搭配：roman empire (罗马帝国（指公元前27年到公元476年的罗马奴隶制国家）) / british empire (大英帝国)；同族词：empires (复数)
empire.en: Commonly used in expressions like "roman empire (罗马帝国（指公元前27年到公元476年的罗马奴隶制国家）)" (n.).

philosophy.tip: 指学科通常不可数；指某套理念可用a philosophy。
philosophy.en: The study of knowledge, existence, reality, and moral values

relative.tip: 作名词指亲属；作形容词常与to连用表示比较。
relative.en: A person connected to you by blood or marriage.

recovery.tip: 康复常用make a recovery；recover是动词。
recovery.en: A return to health or a normal condition.

submit.tip: 过去式 submitted；submit sth to sb 表示向某人提交。
submit.en: To send a document or application for consideration

urge.tip: 动词用urge sb to do；名词用an urge to do。
urge.en: To strongly encourage someone to do something.

voluntary.en: done by choice rather than because it is required

dust.tip: dust作动词既可指除尘，也可指撒粉，看宾语判断。
dust.en: Fine, dry particles that settle on surfaces or float.

breathe.tip: breathe是动词，末音/ð/；breath是名词，末音/θ/。
breathe.en: take air into your lungs and let it out

jacket.tip: jacket通常是短外套，不专指羽绒服。
jacket.en: A short coat covering the upper body and arms.

creature.tip: creature常指动物，也可指想象中的生物。
creature.en: a living being, especially an animal

constitute.tip: 表组成时通常以部分作主语，整体作宾语。
constitute.en: To be the parts that form a whole

pack.tip: 高频搭配：a pack of (一包) / pack up (整理)；同族词：packed (过去分词)、packs (复数)、packing (现在分词)
pack.en: Commonly used in expressions like "a pack of (一包)" (v./n.).

recession.tip: 通常指整体经济衰退，不等于单纯价格下跌。
recession.en: A period when economic activity falls and many businesses struggle.

agriculture.en: The activity of growing crops and raising animals for food.

suicide.tip: 中性表达常用die by suicide，避免污名化。
suicide.en: The act of intentionally causing one's own death.

numerous.tip: 修饰可数名词复数，不能直接修饰不可数名词。

input.tip: 作动词时，过去式可用 input 或 inputted。
input.en: information or resources supplied to a system or process

substance.tip: 表示物质种类时可数；表示实质或根据时通常不可数。
substance.en: A particular type of material with specific physical properties.

shortly.tip: 表示“简要地”通常用briefly，不用shortly。
shortly.en: After a short amount of time.

keen.tip: keen on后接名词或动名词；keen to后接动词原形。
keen.en: very interested in something or eager to do it

arrival.tip: on arrival意为一到达，相当于upon arrival。
arrival.en: The act of reaching a place.

passion.tip: 表达对某事的热爱，用a passion for。
passion.en: a very strong enthusiasm for an activity or subject

volunteer.tip: 自愿做某事用volunteer to do；voluntary是常用形容词。
volunteer.en: someone who freely offers to help, usually without payment

sauce.tip: sauce泛指酱汁；酱油应说soy sauce。
sauce.en: A liquid or thick mixture added to food for flavour.

illness.tip: 泛指生病时不可数；指具体疾病时可数。
illness.en: a disease, or the state of being unwell

priest.tip: 并非所有宗教人士都称priest；僧侣通常称monk。
priest.en: a person authorised to perform religious ceremonies

intense.tip: intense 强调程度强烈；intensive 强调密集投入。
intense.en: very strong or extreme in degree

electricity.tip: electricity不可数；electric多指用电的，electrical指电相关的。
electricity.en: Energy carried by charged particles, used to power devices

penalty.tip: 高频搭配：death penalty (死刑) / penalty function (罚函数)；同族词：penalties (复数)
penalty.en: Commonly used in expressions like "death penalty (死刑)" (n.).

inspire.tip: 常用 inspire sb to do sth，表示激励某人做某事。
inspire.en: to make someone feel eager and able to do something

retire.tip: retire是动词；“退休”这一名词用retirement。
retire.en: To stop working permanently, usually because of age.

temporary.tip: 强调持续时间有限，反义词为permanent。
temporary.en: Lasting for only a limited period of time.

kiss.tip: 吻某人的脸颊用 kiss someone on the cheek。
kiss.en: to touch someone or something with your lips affectionately

visible.tip: visible to表示对谁可见；别与visual（视觉的）混淆。

cap.tip: cap作动词指设上限；a cap on后接受限项目。
cap.en: a soft hat, often with a stiff front part

efficiency.tip: efficiency强调少浪费；effectiveness强调达到效果。
efficiency.en: The ability to achieve results without wasting time, energy, or resources

competitive.tip: 形容人常指好胜；形容价格指有竞争力。
competitive.en: Involving people or organisations trying to outperform each other.

frank.tip: 高频搭配：frank lampard (弗兰克·兰帕德（英国足球明星）) / to be frank (说实话)；同族词：franked (过去分词)、frankest (最高级)、franker (比较级)
frank.en: Commonly used in expressions like "frank lampard (弗兰克·兰帕德（英国足球明星）)" (adj.).

drama.tip: 戏剧艺术用不可数drama；一部戏剧用a drama。
drama.en: Plays and the art of writing or performing them.

cake.tip: 整个蛋糕可数；泛指蛋糕这种食物时常不可数。
cake.en: A sweet food baked from flour, eggs, sugar, and fat.

wealth.tip: wealth通常不可数；a wealth of表示大量有价值的事物。
wealth.en: a large amount of money and valuable possessions

peak.tip: peak at后接峰值；peak season表示旺季。
peak.en: A mountain's top or the highest level of something.

presentation.tip: 作报告用give a presentation；注意present作动词的重音。
presentation.en: a talk that explains something to an audience

pale.tip: pale可指脸色苍白或颜色浅，不等于白色。
pale.en: Having little colour, or less colour than usual.

laboratory.tip: 常缩写为lab；英美发音的重音位置不同。
laboratory.en: a room or building equipped for scientific work

disaster.tip: 也可夸张形容失败：The party was a disaster。
disaster.en: An event causing great damage, suffering, or loss.

owe.tip: owe A to B可指欠B东西A，也可指把A归功于B。
owe.en: To have to pay money back to someone.

mood.tip: in the mood for后接名词；接动词用to do。
mood.en: the way someone feels at a particular time

gradually.tip: 强调变化缓慢发生，不只是动作速度慢。
gradually.en: slowly over time, rather than all at once

bay.tip: bay主要指海湾；停车或装卸语境中指专用区域。
bay.en: An area of sea partly enclosed by land.

mystery.tip: 表示一个谜用a mystery；表示神秘感通常不可数。
mystery.en: Something that is unknown or cannot be explained

poverty.tip: 不可数名词；“生活贫困”用live in poverty。
poverty.en: The condition of lacking money for basic needs.

possession.tip: 高频搭配：in possession of something (拥有(或占有)某物) / in possession (占有，持有)；同族词：possessions (复数)
possession.en: Commonly used in expressions like "in possession of something (拥有(或占有)某物)" (n.).

symbol.tip: “……的象征”用 a symbol of，不用 symbol for。
symbol.en: Something that represents an idea, quality, or group.

certificate.tip: certificate泛指证明或资格证书，不一定是学位。
certificate.en: An official document proving a fact or qualification.

custom.tip: custom指风俗或惯例；customs还可指海关。
custom.en: a traditional or usual way of behaving

accomplish.tip: 及物动词，直接接任务或目标，不接不定式。
accomplish.en: to successfully finish something or achieve a goal

angle.tip: angle 是角度；angel 才是天使，注意字母顺序。
angle.en: The space between two lines or surfaces that meet.

monitor.tip: 作动词可直接接宾语：monitor changes监测变化。
monitor.en: To regularly check something for changes, progress, or problems.

entertainment.tip: 通常不可数：提供娱乐用provide entertainment。
entertainment.en: Performances or activities that people enjoy watching or doing.

bean.tip: 可数名词；泛指食用豆类时通常用beans。
bean.en: An edible seed, or the plant that produces it.

alliance.tip: 常用form an alliance with，表示“与……结盟”。
alliance.en: A partnership between groups or countries pursuing shared goals.

evaluation.tip: 常接of；强调质量或效果，价格估值常用valuation。
evaluation.en: the process of judging something's quality, value, or effectiveness

commander.tip: 泛指指挥官；作具体军衔时，级别因国家而异。
commander.en: an officer responsible for directing a military unit or operation

digital.tip: digital侧重数字技术；表示“数字上的”常用numerical。
digital.en: using electronic systems that store and process information as digits

dependent.tip: 常接on；英式名词“受抚养者”通常拼作dependant。
dependent.en: Needing someone or something for support or survival.

bid.tip: 表示出价时，过去式和过去分词均为bid。
bid.en: To offer a price or compete formally for a contract.

expansion.en: An increase in size, amount, or area

radical.tip: radical change指根本性改变，不一定涉及政治。
radical.en: Involving major changes to the basic nature of something.

psychological.tip: 高频搭配：psychological quality (心理素质) / psychological characteristics (心理特点)；同族词：psychological (adj.)
psychological.en: Commonly used in expressions like "psychological quality (心理素质)" (adj.).

anger.tip: anger作名词通常不可数；形容词是angry。
anger.en: a strong feeling of displeasure about something wrong or unfair

ratio.tip: A与B之比用the ratio of A to B，注意顺序。
ratio.en: A comparison showing the relative sizes of two quantities.

approximately.tip: 多放在数量前，语气比about更正式。
approximately.en: Close to a particular amount, but not exactly.

missile.tip: 高频搭配：ballistic missile (n. 弹道飞弹，弹道导弹) / cruise missile (n. 巡航导弹)；同族词：missiles (复数)
missile.en: Commonly used in expressions like "ballistic missile (n. 弹道飞弹，弹道导弹)" (n.).

disorder.tip: 疾病义可数；杂乱或骚乱义通常不可数。
disorder.en: a condition that disrupts normal physical or mental functioning

false.tip: false指不真实；fake更强调刻意仿冒。通常写作小写。
false.en: not true or based on facts

wire.tip: wire可指单根金属丝；cable通常更粗或由多股组成。
wire.en: Thin metal drawn into strands, often used to carry electricity.

sensitive.tip: sensitive指敏感的；sensible指明智的，勿混淆。
sensitive.en: Easily affected by emotions, substances, or changes

transportation.en: Moving people or goods, or the systems used for this.

holy.tip: holy强调宗教上的神圣，与wholly发音相同。
holy.en: Connected with a religion and treated with deep respect

twin.tip: a twin指双胞胎中的一人；twins指两人。
twin.en: One of two children born to the same mother together.

tendency.tip: 高频搭配：development tendency (发展趋势) / tendency to sth (趋向)；同族词：tendencies (复数)
tendency.en: Commonly used in expressions like "development tendency (发展趋势)" (n.).

chamber.tip: chamber多指专用房间或封闭腔室，不是普通卧室。
chamber.en: A room used for a particular, often official, purpose.

honour.en: Great respect, or something that brings pride and privilege.

deposit.tip: 订金是预付款；押金作担保；银行存款也用deposit。
deposit.en: money paid in advance, held as security, or banked

luck.tip: 高频搭配：good luck (好运) / bad luck (运气不好，坏运气)；同族词：luck (n.)
luck.en: Commonly used in expressions like "good luck (好运)" (n.).

rent.tip: rent可指租入或出租；rent out明确表示出租。
rent.en: money paid regularly to use someone else's property

pure.tip: pure既可指无杂质，也可加强语气，如pure luck。

acceptable.tip: acceptable表示达到要求，不等于优秀。
acceptable.en: good enough or suitable to be allowed or approved

veteran.tip: a veteran of后接领域或经历；也可前置修饰职业名词。
veteran.en: Someone with extensive experience in a particular activity or profession.

phenomenon.tip: 高频搭配：social phenomenon (社会现象) / natural phenomenon (自然现象)；同族词：phenomena (复数)
phenomenon.en: Commonly used in expressions like "social phenomenon (社会现象)" (n.).

nervous.tip: nervous about后接名词或动名词，表示对某事紧张。
nervous.en: worried or uneasy about what might happen

festival.tip: festival强调庆祝或系列活动，不一定是放假的holiday。
festival.en: A special occasion when people celebrate a tradition or event

qualification.tip: 谈学历或资历常用复数qualifications。
qualification.en: An official award showing successful completion of education or training.

bury.en: to put something in the ground and cover it

pray.tip: pray to 接祈祷对象，pray for 接所求之事。
pray.en: To speak to a god to ask, thank, or worship.

rapid.tip: rapid常修饰变化或增长；急流通常用rapids。

butter.tip: butter是黄油，cream是奶油；作食品名通常不可数。
butter.en: a pale yellow fat made from cream, used in food

bathroom.tip: 美式英语中bathroom也可指没有浴缸的厕所。
bathroom.en: A room with a bath or shower, often including a toilet.

frequency.tip: 频率高低用high或low；发生得多不等于速度快。
frequency.en: how often something happens within a particular period

electronic.tip: electronic强调电子电路；electric泛指用电的。
electronic.en: using circuits to control electrical signals

ally.tip: 名词重音通常在前；动词通常读/əˈlaɪ/。
ally.en: A person or country that supports another.

mixture.tip: a mixture of 后可接物质，也可接情感等抽象事物。
mixture.en: Something made by combining two or more different things.

resist.tip: 表示忍住做某事，用resist doing，不用to do。
resist.en: Oppose something or try to prevent it from happening

confront.tip: 直接接问题；be confronted with表示面临。
confront.en: To face and deal with a difficult situation or problem.

absolute.tip: 常表示程度已达极限，通常不用 very 修饰。

dimension.tip: 表示长宽高等具体尺寸时，通常用复数dimensions。
dimension.en: A particular aspect of a situation, problem, or experience.

fellow.tip: 形容词只放名词前，如my fellow students。
fellow.en: Sharing a situation, activity, or status with someone

routine.tip: 名词指固定安排；形容词指按惯例进行的。
routine.en: A regular way of doing things in a particular order.

rough.tip: rough estimate是粗略估计；rough中的gh发/f/。
rough.en: Having an uneven surface that is not smooth.

smooth.tip: 末尾th读浊音/ð/；smoothly常形容事情进展顺利。
smooth.en: having an even surface without rough areas or bumps

nearby.tip: nearby不用作介词：说near the school，不说nearby the school。

remarkable.tip: 表示值得注意，常含赞赏，但不一定只描述好事。
remarkable.en: unusual or impressive enough to deserve special attention

peer.tip: 名词常用复数peers；动词常接through、at或into。
peer.en: Someone of similar age, status, or ability

personnel.tip: 高频搭配：technical personnel (技术人员) / personnel training (人员培训)；同族词：personnel (n.)
personnel.en: Commonly used in expressions like "technical personnel (技术人员)" (n.).

maximum.tip: a maximum of表示“最多”；反义词是minimum。
maximum.en: being the greatest amount or level possible or allowed

furniture.tip: 不可数：一件家具说a piece of furniture。
furniture.en: Movable objects such as chairs, tables, and beds in buildings.

brilliant.tip: 英式口语中常用 brilliant 表示“太棒了”。

register.tip: 报名课程用register for；登记做某事用register to do。
register.en: To put information on an official list

belt.tip: belt除腰带外也指带状区域，如green belt。
belt.en: a strip worn around the waist to hold clothes

pipe.tip: pipe可作动词：pipe water to把水输送到某处。
pipe.en: A hollow tube that carries liquid or gas.

mere.tip: 高频搭配：mere trifle (小意思) / a mere nobody (微不足道的人)；同族词：merest (最高级)、meres (复数)
mere.en: Commonly used in expressions like "mere trifle (小意思)" (adj.).

teenager.tip: 特指13至19岁的人，不泛指所有未成年人。
teenager.en: A person aged thirteen to nineteen.

instance.tip: for instance意为“例如”，作用类似for example。
instance.en: A particular example or occurrence of something.

comprehensive.tip: 强调涵盖范围全面，不是指容易理解。
comprehensive.en: Covering all or nearly all important parts of something.

flag.tip: 动词过去式flagged，进行式flagging，双写g。
flag.en: a cloth symbol representing a country, group, or organisation

whisper.tip: 对某人低语用whisper to someone；低声说用in a whisper。
whisper.en: To speak very quietly without using your full voice

landlord.tip: 房东是landlord，租客是tenant；第二义常见于英国。
landlord.en: someone who rents out property or land to others

corn.tip: 美式corn通常指玉米；英式也可泛指谷物。
corn.en: a tall crop with large heads of yellow edible seeds

throat.tip: 喉咙痛用have a sore throat，注意冠词a。
throat.en: the passage inside the neck through which air and food pass

junior.tip: 职位或年龄比较用junior to，不用junior than。
junior.en: Having a lower rank or less experience in an organisation

wooden.tip: wooden指木制；woody多指木质或像木头的。

swing.tip: 过去式和过去分词均为swung；不是swinged。
swing.en: To move backwards and forwards or in a curved path.

salary.tip: salary指固定薪金；wages常指按时或按周计算的工资。
salary.en: A fixed regular payment for work, often expressed yearly

lad.tip: 偏英式口语；正式写作宜用boy或young man。
lad.en: A boy or young man, especially in informal British English.

observer.tip: 高频搭配：observer pattern (观察者模式) / observer status (n. 观察员身份)；同族词：observers (复数)
observer.en: Commonly used in expressions like "observer pattern (观察者模式)" (n.).

cheek.tip: 脸颊义可数；无礼义通常不可数，多用于英式口语。
cheek.en: either side of the face below the eyes

equation.tip: 高频搭配：differential equation (微分方程) / wave equation (波动方程)；同族词：equations (复数)
equation.en: Commonly used in expressions like "differential equation (微分方程)" (n.).

pace.tip: 按某种速度用at a ... pace；keep pace with指跟上。
pace.en: The speed at which someone moves or something happens

crop.tip: crop既指庄稼也指收成；动词可指裁剪照片。
crop.en: a plant grown in large quantities for food or other uses

overcome.tip: 高频搭配：overcome difficulties (克服困难)；同族词：overcoming (现在分词)、overcame (过去式)、overcomes (第三人称单数)
overcome.en: Commonly used in expressions like "overcome difficulties (克服困难)" (v.).

behave.tip: behave yourself意为守规矩，不是“表现自己”。
behave.en: to act in a particular way

rank.tip: rank可作名词或动词；ranking常指排名或榜单。
rank.en: A position within an ordered system of importance or authority

entrance.tip: 某处的入口用entrance to，不用entrance of。
entrance.en: An opening or place through which people enter.

anxiety.tip: anxiety about后接担忧的事情；形容词是anxious。
anxiety.en: Worry or nervousness about something uncertain or threatening.

permission.tip: 通常不可数；说give permission，不加a。
permission.en: agreement allowing someone to do something

electric.tip: 电动设备多用electric；电气系统多用electrical。
electric.en: Using, producing, or relating to electricity.

enquiry.tip: 可数名词，复数enquiries；美式通常写inquiry。
enquiry.en: A question or request for information.

embrace.tip: 表示接受时，常接change、idea等抽象名词。
embrace.en: to willingly accept an idea, change, or opportunity

reserve.tip: 动词常用 reserve sth for sb；储量常用 reserves。
reserve.en: Arrange to keep something for a particular person or purpose.
