pan.tip: 作动词时过去式为panned，现在分词为panning。
pan.en: a metal container used for cooking or baking food

consultant.tip: 医疗语境中，英国的consultant指高级专科医生。
consultant.en: An expert paid to provide specialist advice.

allowance.tip: 零用钱义常见于美式英语；英式常用pocket money。
allowance.en: Money given regularly to cover particular needs

carpet.tip: carpet常指大面积地毯；rug多指可移动的小块地毯。
carpet.en: A thick woven covering for a floor.

mayor.tip: mayor是市长，别与major（主要的）混淆。
mayor.en: The official who leads or represents a city or town

judgement.tip: 英式可写judgement或judgment；美式通常用后者。
judgement.en: the ability to make sensible decisions after considering information

scope.tip: 范围用scope of；做某事的余地用scope for。
scope.en: The range of subjects or activities that something covers.

pink.tip: pink既可作形容词，也可作名词表示粉红色。

platform.tip: 在站台上用on the platform，不用in。
platform.en: The area beside railway tracks where passengers board trains.

curtain.tip: draw the curtains可指拉开或拉上，需看语境。
curtain.en: hanging fabric used to cover a window or divide space

historic.tip: historic强调历史意义；historical泛指与历史有关。
historic.en: Important in history or likely to be remembered in history.

paragraph.tip: 可数名词；写作中通常一段围绕一个中心意思。
paragraph.en: A section of writing dealing with one main idea.

grandmother.tip: 可指祖母或外祖母；口语常用grandma。
grandmother.en: The mother of your father or mother.

cricket.tip: 指板球运动时不可数；指蟋蟀时可数。
cricket.en: A team sport using a bat, ball, and wickets.

journal.tip: journal常指专业期刊；表示私人记录时近似diary。
journal.en: a publication containing articles about a particular subject

favor.tip: favor是美式拼写，英式为favour；帮忙用do a favor。
favor.en: something helpful you do for someone

detect.tip: 高频搭配：detect — 觉察；同族词：detected (过去分词)、detecting (现在分词)、detects (第三人称单数)
detect.en: Commonly used in expressions like "detect — 觉察" (v.).

consent.tip: 高频搭配：informed consent (知情同意，知会同意) / written consent (书面同意)；同族词：consented (过去分词)、consents (复数)、consenting (现在分词)
consent.en: Commonly used in expressions like "informed consent (知情同意，知会同意)" (v./n.).

comprise.tip: 最稳妥结构：整体comprises部分，不加of。
comprise.en: to have particular people or things as parts

install.tip: 下载是download；下载后安装才是install。
install.en: to put equipment or software in place for use

curve.tip: curve可作名词或动词；“弯曲的”用curved。
curve.en: a line or shape that bends smoothly

elementary.tip: elementary school主要用于美式英语，英式常用primary school。
elementary.en: Related to the simplest or first stages of learning.

literary.en: Relating to literature or the study of it.

aggressive.tip: 形容行为常含贬义；商业语境可指强势进取。
aggressive.en: Ready to argue, threaten, or attack.

concert.tip: 去听音乐会用 go to a concert。
concert.en: a live musical performance given before an audience

guitar.tip: 表示弹吉他，通常说play the guitar。
guitar.en: A stringed musical instrument played by plucking or strumming.

disk.tip: 计算机磁盘用disk；英式圆盘、光盘通常写disc。
disk.en: a device that stores computer data on a circular surface

extreme.tip: 副词用extremely；名词常见go to extremes。
extreme.en: very great in degree or far beyond what is usual

tube.tip: the tube特指伦敦地铁；一管牙膏用a tube of。
tube.en: a long, hollow object that carries liquids or gases

presumably.tip: 表示有依据的推测，不等于certainly的确定语气。
presumably.en: Probably true, based on what is known or reasonably expected.

quit.tip: 高频搭配：quit smoking (戒烟)；同族词：quitting (现在分词)、quits (第三人称单数)
quit.en: Commonly used in expressions like "quit smoking (戒烟)" (v.).

genuine.tip: 高频搭配：genuine leather (真皮) / genuine gold (纯金，赤金)；同族词：genuine (adj.)
genuine.en: Commonly used in expressions like "genuine leather (真皮)" (adj.).

greatly.tip: 常修饰动词，如greatly improve；不说greatly good。
greatly.en: To a large degree or by a large amount.

latin.tip: 首字母大写；Latin America指拉丁美洲。

favourite.tip: 英式拼写favourite，美式favorite；一般不用most修饰。
favourite.en: liked more than any other of the same kind

jail.tip: in jail指在押，不加冠词；英式旧拼法为gaol。
jail.en: A place where people are kept as punishment or awaiting trial.

delay.tip: 动词后接动名词：delay doing，不用to do。
delay.en: To make something happen later than expected or planned.

honest.tip: h不发音，因此说an honest person。
honest.en: Telling the truth and not cheating or stealing.

diversity.tip: 通常为不可数名词；a diversity of表示多种多样的。
diversity.en: The presence of many different types of people or things.

sake.tip: 常用于for the sake of或for someone's sake。
sake.en: Someone's benefit or the purpose behind an action.

relax.tip: 人感到放松用relaxed；事物令人放松用relaxing。
relax.en: To become calm and comfortable, or make someone feel this way.

essay.tip: 可数名词；一篇关于某主题的文章用an essay on。
essay.en: A short piece of writing exploring a particular subject.

edition.tip: edition指版本或期次；一本实体书通常叫a copy。
edition.en: A particular version of a book or other published work.

respondent.tip: 高频搭配：respondent — 回答者；同族词：respondents (复数)
respondent.en: Commonly used in expressions like "respondent — 回答者" (n.).

circuit.tip: 电路和环形路线都可用circuit；short circuit指短路。
circuit.en: A connected path through which an electric current can flow

giant.tip: 作形容词通常放名词前；作名词可指行业巨头。

exciting.tip: exciting形容令人兴奋的事物；excited形容人的感受。
exciting.en: Making someone feel eager, enthusiastic, or thrilled.

negotiate.tip: 与某人谈判用with；也可直接接agreement。
negotiate.en: Discuss terms with others to reach an agreement.

clock.tip: clock通常指钟；戴在手腕上的表叫watch。
clock.en: a device that shows the time

pop.tip: 表示短暂去或顺手放时属非正式用法。
pop.en: popular music with catchy tunes and usually simple structures

chemical.tip: chemical作名词可数；化学物质不一定有害。
chemical.en: A substance produced or used in a chemical process.

resign.tip: resign oneself to后接名词或动名词，表示无奈接受。
resign.en: To officially leave a job or position.

criticize.tip: criticize sb for sth；英式也常拼作criticise。
criticize.en: express disapproval of someone or something

bath.tip: 英式常说have a bath；美式常说take a bath。
bath.en: Washing your body while sitting or lying in water.

differ.tip: from引出比较对象，in引出差异方面。
differ.en: To be unlike something else in one or more ways.

advanced.tip: advanced表示先进或高级；预先通知用advance notice。
advanced.en: using highly developed technology or methods

defeat.tip: defeat后接对手；win后接比赛、奖项等。
defeat.en: to win against someone in a competition or conflict

shell.tip: shell作动词可指剥壳；shell peas是剥豌豆。
shell.en: A hard outer covering protecting an animal, egg, or nut.

consumption.tip: 通常不可数；消费的人是consumer，不是consumption。
consumption.en: the use of resources, energy, goods, or services

classical.tip: 古典音乐用classical；经典作品常用classic。
classical.en: relating to formal Western music, such as symphonies and operas

peasant.tip: 多用于历史或传统农业语境；称呼他人可能带贬义。
peasant.en: a poor farmer working a small plot of land

province.tip: 表示“职责领域”时常用the province of。
province.en: A major administrative area within a country

pause.tip: pause指暂时停下，通常暗示还会继续。

acquisition.tip: 习得过程通常不可数；收购交易或购得物可数。
acquisition.en: the process of obtaining something or developing knowledge and skills

onion.tip: 开头是元音音素，单数前用an：an onion。
onion.en: a round vegetable with layers and a strong smell

socialist.tip: socialist指社会主义的；social仅指社会的或社交的。
socialist.en: relating to collective ownership and more equal distribution of wealth

brand.tip: brand指品牌；trademark强调受法律保护的商标。
brand.en: A product name identifying the company that makes it

assure.tip: 高频搭配：assure oneself (弄清楚，查明) / assure of (vt. 向...保证）)；同族词：assured (过去式)、assures (第三人称单数)、assuring (现在分词)
assure.en: Commonly used in expressions like "assure oneself (弄清楚，查明)" (v.).

mad.tip: mad at表示生气；mad about可表示痴迷。

split.tip: 过去式和过去分词均为split；现在分词为splitting。
split.en: To divide something into parts, or separate into groups

altogether.tip: altogether是完全或总共；all together是全在一起。

utility.tip: “效用”通常不可数；水电燃气等服务常用utilities。
utility.en: the usefulness of something for a particular purpose

confident.en: believing in your own ability to succeed

remark.tip: 高频搭配：remark on (评论)；同族词：remarks (复数)、remarked (过去式)、remarking (现在分词)
remark.en: Commonly used in expressions like "remark on (评论)" (vt&vi&n.).

helpful.tip: helpful可形容事物有用，也可形容人乐于助人。
helpful.en: Making something easier to do or understand.

highway.tip: 常见于美式英语；不一定是封闭式高速公路。
highway.en: a main public road connecting towns or cities

survival.en: the state of remaining alive or continuing to exist

workshop.tip: 表示学习活动时，通常强调参与和实践，而非只听讲。
workshop.en: A session where people learn by discussing and practising together.

lecture.tip: lecture on讲授某主题；lecture someone可指训斥。
lecture.en: an educational talk given to an audience, especially university students

ingredient.tip: 是可数名词；既指烹饪配料，也可比喻必要因素。
ingredient.en: one of the foods used to prepare a dish

stake.tip: have a stake in指有利益关系；at stake指面临风险。
stake.en: a financial share or personal interest in something

occupation.tip: 表示职业时较正式，常见于表格；不要与职位混同。
occupation.en: the type of work someone does to earn money

mount.tip: mount可指压力等上升；mount a campaign指发起运动。
mount.en: To increase gradually in amount, strength, or seriousness.

snap.tip: snap at someone常指厉声说话，也可指猛咬某人。
snap.en: To break suddenly with a short, sharp sound.

refugee.tip: 高频搭配：refugee camp (难民营)；同族词：refugees (复数)
refugee.en: Commonly used in expressions like "refugee camp (难民营)" (n.).

formula.en: a mathematical rule expressed using symbols

ultimate.tip: ultimate强调最终目标或极致，不指最近一次。
ultimate.en: Being the final or most important aim or result.

guidance.tip: 不可数名词；说some guidance，不说a guidance。
guidance.en: help or advice about what to do or how to proceed

statistics.tip: 指数据时谓语用复数；指统计学时谓语用单数。
statistics.en: numerical facts collected and organised to describe something

hip.tip: 高频搭配：hip joint (髋关节) / shoot from the hip (鲁莽地做事)；同族词：hips (复数)、hippest (最高级)、hipper (比较级)
hip.en: Commonly used in expressions like "hip joint (髋关节)" (n.).

gear.tip: 表示装备时不可数；表示挡位或单个齿轮时可数。
gear.en: equipment or clothing needed for a particular activity

found.tip: “创立”的过去式是founded；“找到”的原形是find。
found.en: to establish an organization, institution, or settlement

barrier.tip: 高频搭配：trade barrier (贸易壁垒) / language barrier (n. 语言障碍)；同族词：barriers (复数)
barrier.en: Commonly used in expressions like "trade barrier (贸易壁垒)" (n.).

distinct.tip: distinct from表示“与……不同”；勿混淆为distant。
distinct.en: clearly different or separate from something else

assign.tip: 常用assign sth to sb，也可用assign sb sth。
assign.en: To give someone a task, role, or resource

compensation.tip: 高频搭配：compensation system (补偿制度) / error compensation (误差补偿，平差)；同族词：compensations (复数)
compensation.en: Commonly used in expressions like "compensation system (补偿制度)" (n.).

poet.tip: poet指诗人，poem指一首诗，poetry统称诗歌。

gang.tip: 指朋友群体时较口语化；正式语境常指犯罪团伙。
gang.en: A group of people involved in crime or violence.

classic.tip: classic指经典或典型；古典音乐用classical。
classic.en: Widely admired for lasting quality and value.

label.en: a small attached piece giving information about something

widespread.tip: 高频搭配：widespread — 普遍的；同族词：widespread (adj.)
widespread.en: Commonly used in expressions like "widespread — 普遍的" (adj.).

respectively.tip: 高频搭配：respectively — 各自地；同族词：respectively (adv.)
respectively.en: Commonly used in expressions like "respectively — 各自地" (adv.).

vacation.tip: 主要用于美式英语；英式英语一般用holiday。
vacation.en: time away from work or study for rest or travel

draft.tip: 表“草稿”英美均用draft；穿堂风英式用draught。
draft.en: an early version of writing that may be changed

extraordinary.tip: 比very good更强调超出寻常，也可指奇特。
extraordinary.en: Much better or more impressive than usual.

fortune.tip: 表示大笔财富时用a fortune；表示运气时通常不可数。
fortune.en: A very large amount of money

heaven.tip: 高频搭配：in heaven (究竟) / heaven and earth (天地，宇宙万物)；同族词：heavens (复数)
heaven.en: Commonly used in expressions like "in heaven (究竟)" (n.).

pregnant.tip: 表示怀孕多久可说six months pregnant。
pregnant.en: having a baby developing inside the body

anxious.tip: anxious about表担忧；anxious to do常表急切。
anxious.en: Worried or nervous about something uncertain.

distant.tip: 高频搭配：distant view (远景) / distant place (远方)；同族词：distant (adj.)
distant.en: Commonly used in expressions like "distant view (远景)" (adj.).

satellite.tip: 可指人造或天然卫星；月球是地球的天然卫星。
satellite.en: A device orbiting Earth or another body, collecting or transmitting information.

conscious.tip: 意识到某事用be conscious of，勿与conscience混淆。
conscious.en: aware of something or noticing that it exists

tackle.tip: tackle直接接问题，不加with；强调着手应对。
tackle.en: Make a determined effort to deal with a difficult problem.

chocolate.tip: 食材巧克力不可数；单颗巧克力糖可数。
chocolate.en: A sweet food made from cocoa, often with milk and sugar.

sweep.tip: 过去式、过去分词均为 swept。
sweep.en: to clean a surface using a brush or broom

stable.tip: 作形容词指稳定；作可数名词指马厩。
stable.en: unlikely to change suddenly, fall, or become worse

ceiling.tip: ceiling是室内天花板；roof是建筑外部的屋顶。
ceiling.en: the inside surface at the top of a room

preference.tip: 对某物的偏好用preference for，不用to。
preference.en: a greater liking for one thing than for another

universal.tip: 指全体适用或普遍存在，语气通常强于common。
universal.en: Existing everywhere or applying to everyone in a group.

spin.tip: 过去式、过去分词均为 spun；现在分词为 spinning。
spin.en: turn quickly around a central point

button.tip: button up指扣好纽扣；拉链用zip，不用button。
button.en: A small control you press to operate something

clothing.tip: clothing不可数；一件衣服用an item of clothing。
clothing.en: Things people wear to cover or protect their bodies.

pitch.tip: 球场义常见于英式英语；pitch a tent意为搭帐篷。
pitch.en: An area of ground used for outdoor team sports.

fence.tip: sit on the fence比喻保持中立、不表态。
fence.en: A barrier enclosing land or separating areas.

given.tip: 高频搭配：given up (已放弃) / given time (给定时间)；同族词：give (词根/原形)、givens (复数)
given.en: Commonly used in expressions like "given up (已放弃)" (adj./prep.).

portrait.tip: portrait以人物为主体；landscape多指风景画或照片。
portrait.en: a painting, drawing, or photograph of a person

indication.tip: 常用 indication of sth 或 indication that 从句。
indication.en: a sign suggesting that something exists or may happen

bunch.tip: a bunch of可指一束或一串；指人时较口语化。
bunch.en: a group of similar things held or growing together

concerning.tip: 高频搭配：concern oneself (◎从事,忙于(常与with, about, in, over连用)) / of concern (重要的)；同族词：concern (词根/原形)
concerning.en: Commonly used in expressions like "concern oneself (◎从事,忙于(常与with, about, in, over连用))" (prep.).

awful.tip: feel awful可指身体难受，也可指内疚或心情差。

distribute.tip: distribute A to B 表示“把A分发给B”。
distribute.en: to give or deliver something to several people or places

burden.tip: 负担落在某人身上用a burden on someone。
burden.en: a heavy load, difficult duty, or source of worry

react.tip: 对某事反应用react to；与物质反应用react with。
react.en: Behave or feel in response to something that happens.

measurement.tip: 指测量过程常不可数；指具体尺寸时可数。
measurement.en: The process of finding the size, amount, or degree of something.

ceremony.tip: 指具体典礼时可数；without ceremony意为不拘礼节。
ceremony.en: A formal event marking an important occasion.

communicate.tip: 与某人交流用with；向某人传达某事用某事＋to。
communicate.en: to share information, thoughts, or feelings with others

ownership.tip: 不可数名词；take ownership of也可指主动担责。
ownership.en: The legal right to possess something.

profile.tip: in profile指呈侧面；a high profile指高关注度。
profile.en: The outline of a face or object seen from the side.

enthusiasm.tip: 对某事的热情用enthusiasm for，通常不可数。
enthusiasm.en: Strong interest and excitement about something you enjoy or value.

cease.tip: 较正式；后可接动名词或to do，均表示停止。
cease.en: to stop happening or doing something

disagree.tip: 不同意某人用disagree with；争议话题用on或about。
disagree.en: To have a different opinion from someone else.

impressive.tip: 事物令人赞叹用impressive；人感到佩服用impressed。
impressive.en: Causing admiration because of exceptional quality, size, or skill.

remote.tip: remote还可作名词，口语中指遥控器。
remote.en: Far away from towns, cities, or other people.

resort.tip: resort to中to是介词，后接名词或动名词。
resort.en: a place people visit for holidays and leisure

qualify.tip: qualify for接机会或待遇；qualify as接职业。
qualify.en: To meet requirements, or make someone suitable for something.

destruction.tip: 通常不可数；动词是destroy，不是destruct。
destruction.en: Damage so severe that something no longer exists or works.

tissue.tip: 纸巾是可数名词；生物组织通常不可数。
tissue.en: A small piece of soft paper used for wiping.

interval.tip: at intervals表示每隔一段时间或距离。
interval.en: A period or distance between events or objects.

eighteen.tip: eighteen是十八，eighty是八十；注意词尾发音。
eighteen.en: The number after seventeen and before nineteen.

princess.tip: 可指君主的女儿，也可指王子的妻子。
princess.en: A king's or queen's daughter, or a prince's wife.

stranger.tip: stranger是陌生人，不等于foreigner外国人。

confusion.tip: 人感到困惑用confused；事物令人困惑用confusing。
confusion.en: A state of not understanding something clearly

broken.tip: 也是break的过去分词；过去式为broke。
broken.en: Damaged by being split or separated into pieces.

provided.en: Only if a particular condition is met.

bet.tip: 过去式和过去分词通常仍是bet；I bet常表确信。
bet.en: to risk money on the result of an uncertain event

operator.tip: 既指操作设备的人，也指经营服务的公司。
operator.en: a person who controls a machine or piece of equipment

virus.tip: virus是病毒，bacterium是细菌；两者不能混用。
virus.en: A tiny infectious agent that reproduces inside living cells

strategic.tip: strategic重整体长远规划，tactical重具体战术。
strategic.en: relating to plans for achieving important long-term goals

storage.tip: storage通常不可数；一间储藏室用a storeroom。
storage.en: The act of keeping things somewhere until they are needed.

assistant.tip: assistant指人，assistance指帮助，通常不可数。
assistant.en: A person who helps someone with their work.

strengthen.tip: 高频搭配：strengthen environmental protection (加强环境保护) / strengthen the awareness (提高意识)；同族词：strengthened (过去分词)、strengthening (现在分词)、strengthens (第三人称单数)
strengthen.en: Commonly used in expressions like "strengthen environmental protection (加强环境保护)" (v.).

summary.tip: a summary of后接概括对象；in summary用于总结。
summary.en: a short account giving the main points of something

catalogue.en: An organised list of items, often with descriptions or pictures

architecture.en: The art and practice of designing buildings.

cousin.tip: 不区分堂表、性别或长幼；需要时另加说明。
cousin.en: A child of your aunt or uncle

outstanding.tip: outstanding debt指未偿债务，不是“出色的债务”。
outstanding.en: Extremely good and much better than average.

minimum.tip: a minimum of 后接数量，表示“至少”。
minimum.en: The smallest amount or level possible or allowed.

blind.tip: blind to表示未察觉或无视；窗帘义是可数名词。

dominant.en: More powerful, influential, or noticeable than others.

slave.tip: 历史语境可用enslaved person，强调其人的身份。
slave.en: a person owned by another and forced to work

accurate.tip: accurate强调准确无误；precise更强调细节精确。

theoretical.tip: 高频搭配：theoretical basis (理论基础) / theoretical foundation (理论基础)；同族词：theoretical (adj.)
theoretical.en: Commonly used in expressions like "theoretical basis (理论基础)" (adj.).

terror.tip: 表示强烈恐惧，程度比fear深；通常不可数。
terror.en: An extremely strong feeling of fear.

complicated.tip: 强调复杂难懂；complex也可仅指结构复杂。
complicated.en: Having many connected parts and therefore difficult to understand or manage.

alongside.tip: 作介词后接名词；也可表示两件事同时进行。
alongside.en: Beside someone or something, or together with them.

dirt.tip: 通常不可数；表示“泥土”时多见于美式英语。
dirt.en: Unwanted material that makes something unclean

bullet.tip: bullet指弹头或子弹；bullet point指列表中的项目。
bullet.en: A small metal projectile fired from a gun.

bible.tip: 指《圣经》时首字母大写，通常用the Bible。
bible.en: the collection of sacred writings used in Christianity

replacement.tip: 替换物常可数；替换这一过程通常不可数。
replacement.en: A person or thing that takes another's place.

chart.tip: 图表用chart；普通地图用map，海图可用chart。
chart.en: a visual display of information, often showing comparisons or changes

proof.tip: 表示证据时通常不可数；数学证明可用a proof。
proof.en: Facts or information showing that something is true.

solar.tip: solar是形容词，常用于太阳或太阳能相关搭配。

practise.tip: 英式动词用practise、名词用practice；美式均用practice。
practise.en: Do something repeatedly to improve your skill

strain.tip: strain可指拉伤；sprain主要指关节扭伤。
strain.en: pressure or difficulty that tests someone's strength or resources

leisure.tip: leisure通常不可数；leisure time指闲暇时间。
leisure.en: Time when you are free from work or other duties.

cheque.tip: 高频搭配：crossed cheque (划线支票) / cheque book ([经]支票簿)；同族词：cheques (复数)
cheque.en: Commonly used in expressions like "crossed cheque (划线支票)" (n.).

strip.tip: strip的过去式为stripped；剥夺用strip sb of sth。
strip.en: A long, narrow piece or area of something.

merchant.tip: 高频搭配：merchant ship (商船) / merchant marine (（一个国家的）商船，商船队)；同族词：merchants (复数)、merchanting (现在分词)
merchant.en: Commonly used in expressions like "merchant ship (商船)" (n.).

steam.tip: steam作名词通常不可数；作动词可表示蒸食物。
steam.en: The gas water becomes when heated, often seen as white mist.

import.tip: 高频搭配：import and export (进出口) / import and export corporation ([经]进出口公司)；同族词：imports (复数)、imported (过去分词)、importing (现在分词)
import.en: Commonly used in expressions like "import and export (进出口)" (n & v.).

reflection.tip: on reflection表示仔细考虑后；a reflection of表示……的体现。
reflection.en: an image seen in a mirror or shiny surface

telescope.tip: 观星常用telescope；双筒望远镜通常叫binoculars。
telescope.en: An instrument that makes distant objects appear closer and clearer

precise.tip: 高频搭配：to be precise (确切地讲) / to be more precise (更确切地说)；同族词：precise (adj.)
precise.en: Commonly used in expressions like "to be precise (确切地讲)" (adj.).

fiction.tip: 统称小说时不可数；一部小说可说a work of fiction。
fiction.en: Stories about imagined people and events.

plain.tip: plain可指无花纹；平原用名词plain。
plain.en: simple, without decoration or a pattern

lover.tip: 表爱好者常用名词＋lover；单用可能指情人。
lover.en: Someone in a romantic or sexual relationship with another person.

lifetime.tip: 高频搭配：of a lifetime (一生最…的) / once in a lifetime (一生一次)；同族词：lifetimes (复数)
lifetime.en: Commonly used in expressions like "of a lifetime (一生最…的)" (n.).

tremendous.tip: 常强调程度或数量极大，不只指体积大。
tremendous.en: Very great in amount, strength, or degree.

admission.tip: 进入某处用admission to；承认某事用admission of。
admission.en: Permission to enter a place or join an institution

senator.en: A member of a senate, a lawmaking body

tunnel.tip: 介词 through 常表示从隧道内部穿过。
tunnel.en: A passage built underground or through a hill.

poetry.tip: poetry不可数；一首诗用a poem，不用a poetry。
poetry.en: Literature using carefully arranged language, rhythm, and imagery.

fabric.tip: 泛指布料常不可数；不同种类可用fabrics。
fabric.en: material made by weaving or knitting fibres

salad.tip: 可指一份沙拉，也可不可数地指沙拉这种食物。
salad.en: a cold dish of vegetables or other mixed ingredients

sustain.tip: 高频搭配：sustain losses (蒙受损失)；同族词：sustained (过去分词)、sustaining (现在分词)、sustains (第三人称单数)
sustain.en: Commonly used in expressions like "sustain losses (蒙受损失)" (n.).

innocent.tip: 表示未犯某罪用innocent of，不用innocent from。
innocent.en: Not responsible for a crime or wrongdoing.

gentle.tip: 对人温柔用be gentle with sb。
gentle.en: Kind and careful, without roughness or force.

vessel.tip: vessel较正式；blood vessel是“血管”，不是船。

favour.tip: 英式拼写为favour，美式为favor；帮忙用do。
favour.en: Something helpful you do for someone.

bench.tip: 长凳常无靠背，但并非一定如此；工作台也可用bench。
bench.en: A long seat designed for several people.

raw.tip: raw强调未烹煮或未加工，不等于“新鲜的”fresh。

deck.tip: 一副纸牌美式常用deck，英式也常用pack。
deck.en: a floor on a ship or a level of a bus

determination.tip: 表决心常接to do；表确定常接of。
determination.en: the firm intention to continue despite difficulties

pole.tip: pole与poll同音；地理名称the North Pole需大写。
pole.en: A long, narrow stick or post, often used for support.

silly.tip: 语气通常比stupid轻，也可表示逗趣、不正经。
silly.en: Showing poor judgment or a lack of sensible thought

newly.tip: 常放在过去分词前，如newly built，表示新近完成。
newly.en: Recently, especially when describing something just done or begun.

unity.tip: 高频搭配：national unity (国家统一，民族团结) / unity is strength (团结就是力量)；同族词：unities (复数)
unity.en: Commonly used in expressions like "national unity (国家统一，民族团结)" (n.).

mutual.tip: mutual friend是共同朋友，不是彼此的朋友。
mutual.en: Felt or done by each person towards the other.

furthermore.tip: 正式递进副词；连接完整句时，前面用句号或分号。
furthermore.en: In addition, introducing another point supporting what was said

pride.tip: 动词用pride oneself on；形容词用proud of。
pride.en: Pleasure and satisfaction in achievements, qualities, or people you value.

bush.tip: 灌木是可数名词；the bush可指澳洲等地的荒野。
bush.en: A woody plant with several branches growing near the ground.

percent.tip: 英式也写per cent；具体比例用percent。
percent.en: For every hundred, used when expressing a proportion.

freeze.en: To become ice or make something extremely cold and solid.

sensible.en: Showing good judgement and practical understanding.

bake.tip: bake常用于面包、蛋糕；烤肉通常用roast。
bake.en: To cook food in an oven using dry heat.

brick.tip: 单块砖可数；作建筑材料统称时可不可数。
brick.en: A hard rectangular block used for building walls and houses.

joy.tip: 表喜悦通常不可数；表乐事可数，如a joy。

headquarters.tip: 单复数同形，词尾始终保留s。
headquarters.en: The main place from which an organisation is directed.

reward.tip: reward强调付出后的回报；award常指正式授奖。
reward.en: Something received for good work, helpful behaviour, or achievement.

conservation.tip: 通常不可数；可指保护自然，也可指节约能源。
conservation.en: the protection of wildlife and natural environments

evolve.tip: 高频搭配：evolve into (vt. 发展成，进化成) / evolve from (v. 由…进化)；同族词：evolved (过去分词)、evolving (现在分词)、evolves (第三人称单数)
evolve.en: Commonly used in expressions like "evolve into (vt. 发展成，进化成)" (v.).

corridor.tip: 既指建筑内走廊，也指连接地区的狭长地带。
corridor.en: a long passage connecting rooms inside a building

ban.tip: ban doing；ban sb from doing；过去式banned。
ban.en: To officially forbid an activity or the use of something

consult.tip: 高频搭配：consult with (商量，协商)；同族词：consulted (过去分词)、consulting (现在分词)、consults (第三人称单数)
consult.en: Commonly used in expressions like "consult with (商量，协商)" (v.).

comfort.tip: 表示舒适或慰藉时通常不可数；作动词直接接人。
comfort.en: A pleasant state of physical ease and relaxation.

imagination.tip: imaginative指有想象力的；imaginary指想象中的。
imagination.en: The ability to form mental pictures or invent new ideas.

offense.tip: 高频搭配：no offense (无意冒犯) / criminal offense (犯罪行为，犯罪)；同族词：offenses (复数)
offense.en: Commonly used in expressions like "no offense (无意冒犯)" (n.).

counter.tip: 动词可直接接宾语；run counter to表示与……相悖。
counter.en: A raised flat surface for serving customers or preparing food

crash.tip: crash into后接撞上的物体；电脑崩溃也可用crash。
crash.en: an accident in which a vehicle hits something or falls

inevitable.tip: 常用it is inevitable that…表示“……不可避免”。
inevitable.en: Certain to happen and impossible to prevent

outline.tip: 表示概要时强调主要内容，不包含详细论述。
outline.en: a short description covering the main points

craft.tip: 表示船或飞行器时，craft的单复数形式相同。
craft.en: An activity involving skill in making things by hand

reinforce.tip: 高频搭配：reinforce the management (加强管理)；同族词：reinforced (过去分词)、reinforces (第三人称单数)、reinforcing (现在分词)
reinforce.en: Commonly used in expressions like "reinforce the management (加强管理)" (v.).

conviction.tip: 高频搭配：conviction — 确信；同族词：convictions (复数)
conviction.en: Commonly used in expressions like "conviction — 确信" (n.).

insight.tip: 常用insight into；泛指理解力时通常不可数。
insight.en: a clear, deep understanding of a person or situation

tap.tip: 水龙头在美式英语中常称faucet。
tap.en: a device that controls water flowing from a pipe

mouse.tip: 老鼠的复数是mice；鼠标的复数可用mice或mouses。
mouse.en: A small rodent with a pointed nose and long thin tail.

episode.tip: episode指一集；series指整部系列或连续剧。
episode.en: one part of a television or radio series

readily.tip: readily available指容易获得，不是“乐意提供”。
readily.en: Easily and without difficulty or delay.

tire.tip: 动词英美均用tire；轮胎的英式拼写为tyre。
tire.en: To become tired or make someone feel tired

loose.tip: loose是形容词，尾音/s/；lose是动词，尾音/z/。
loose.en: not firmly attached or held in place

prior.tip: prior常放名词前；prior to相当于before。
prior.en: existing or happening before something else

intellectual.tip: intellectual强调思维活动；intelligent强调聪明。
intellectual.en: Relating to thinking, reasoning, and understanding complex ideas

characterize.en: To be a typical or distinguishing feature of something.

adventure.tip: adventure指具体经历时可数，指冒险精神时不可数。
adventure.en: An exciting experience involving uncertainty or possible danger

stair.tip: 高频搭配：below stairs (在地下室) / stair railing (楼梯栏杆)；同族词：stair (n.)
stair.en: Commonly used in expressions like "below stairs (在地下室)" (n.).

shrug.tip: 过去式shrugged；shrug off表示不予理会。
shrug.en: To raise your shoulders to show uncertainty or indifference

weakness.tip: 弱点通常可数；虚弱不可数；偏爱用a weakness for。
weakness.en: a feature that makes someone or something less effective

trace.tip: trace A back to B表示“追溯A至B”。
trace.en: find something's origin or location by following evidence

rid.tip: 牢记get rid of；rid A of B表示清除A中的B。
rid.en: free someone or something from an unwanted thing

license.tip: 英式名词写 licence、动词写 license；美式均用 license。
license.en: to give official permission for an activity

shelter.tip: 表示庇护通常不可数；指具体避难所时可数。
shelter.en: Protection from danger or bad weather.

rub.tip: 过去式rubbed、现在分词rubbing均双写b。
rub.en: Move against a surface with pressure, often repeatedly.

controversy.tip: 多指公众对某议题的争议，不是普通口角。
controversy.en: Strong public disagreement about a particular issue.

sail.tip: 作动词不限于帆船，也可指轮船航行。
sail.en: Travel across water in a boat or ship.

absorb.tip: 高频搭配：absorb in (集中精力做某事)；同族词：absorbed (过去分词)、absorbs (第三人称单数)、absorbing (现在分词)
absorb.en: Commonly used in expressions like "absorb in (集中精力做某事)" (v.).

pleasant.tip: pleasant形容事物令人愉快；pleased形容人感到高兴。

fade.tip: 强调逐渐变化；fade away指慢慢减弱或消失。
fade.en: to lose colour or make something lose colour gradually

pit.tip: 维修区常用the pits；果核义主要用于美式英语。
pit.en: A large hole in the ground

gesture.tip: 高频搭配：gesture recognition (手势识别) / make a gesture (做手势，表示)；同族词：gestures (复数)、gestured (过去式)、gesturing (现在分词)
gesture.en: Commonly used in expressions like "gesture recognition (手势识别)" (n.).

tragedy.tip: 既指现实中的惨事，也指文学悲剧；后者与comedy相对。
tragedy.en: An event causing great suffering, sadness, or loss.

funeral.tip: 通常是可数名词：attend a funeral参加葬礼。
funeral.en: a ceremony held to remember and honour someone who has died

pretend.tip: 常用pretend to do或pretend that，不用pretend doing。
pretend.en: to act as though something untrue is true

entitle.tip: entitle sb to sth或to do sth；常用于被动语态。
entitle.en: To give someone the right to have or do something.

grateful.tip: be grateful to某人 for某事；注意不是greatful。
grateful.en: Feeling thankful for kindness, help, or something good.

venture.tip: venture本身不等于风险投资；风险资本是venture capital。
venture.en: a new activity or business involving risk

squeeze.tip: 高频搭配：squeeze casting (模压铸造，压挤铸造) / squeeze out (挤出)；同族词：squeezed (过去式)、squeezing (现在分词)、squeezes (第三人称单数)
squeeze.en: Commonly used in expressions like "squeeze casting (模压铸造，压挤铸造)" (v.).

architect.tip: architect指人，architecture指建筑学或建筑风格。
architect.en: Someone whose job is to design buildings

mask.tip: mask 作动词直接接宾语，表示掩盖问题或感受。
mask.en: A covering worn over part or all of the face.

excitement.tip: 表示兴奋情绪通常不可数：with excitement。
excitement.en: a feeling of great enthusiasm and eager anticipation

cathedral.tip: 严格指主教驻地的教堂，并非所有大型教堂。
cathedral.en: The main church of a district led by a bishop.

prominent.tip: 既可指人物重要知名，也可指位置或外形显眼。

deaf.tip: 读音同def；大写Deaf可强调聋人文化身份。
deaf.en: Unable to hear, or able to hear very little.

confine.tip: 常用confine A to B，表示将A限制在B内。
confine.en: To keep something within particular limits

acceptance.tip: 通常不可数；acceptance of后接接受的事物。
acceptance.en: The act of agreeing to receive or do something offered.

regardless.tip: regardless是副词；接名词时用regardless of。
regardless.en: Despite difficulties, objections, or other circumstances.

limitation.tip: “局限性”常用复数；对……的限制用limitation on。
limitation.en: a weakness that prevents someone or something from being fully effective

departure.tip: departure from可指“从……出发”或“背离……”。
departure.en: The act of leaving a place.

detective.en: Someone whose job is to investigate crimes or discover facts

summit.tip: 山顶常用the summit of；峰会可用a summit。
summit.en: The highest point of a mountain.

violate.tip: 及物动词，直接接法律、协议、权利等宾语。
violate.en: To act against a law, rule, or agreement.

thereby.tip: 常用逗号加thereby doing，说明前述行为的结果。
thereby.en: as a result of the action just mentioned

deer.en: a hoofed wild animal whose males usually have branching antlers

composition.tip: 指构成或创作过程通常不可数；指作品可数。
composition.en: The parts or substances that something consists of

pacific.tip: 小写pacific是正式形容词；the Pacific指太平洋。
pacific.en: Peaceful in nature or intended to avoid conflict

steady.tip: steady作形容词；修饰动词通常用steadily。

structural.tip: 既可指建筑结构，也可指经济、制度等的结构。
structural.en: Relating to how something is built or its parts are arranged.

fate.tip: 表示天意时通常不可数；a terrible fate指悲惨结局。
fate.en: a power believed to control what happens in people's lives

oven.tip: oven指封闭烤箱；炉顶灶具通常叫hob或stove。
oven.en: an enclosed appliance used to bake or roast food

segment.en: one part of something divided into separate sections

nowhere.tip: 本身含否定意义：I have nowhere to go。
nowhere.en: not in or to any place

occasional.en: happening sometimes, but not often or regularly

reception.tip: 英式英语常说at reception，表示在接待处。
reception.en: the area where visitors are welcomed and given information

shelf.en: A flat board used to support or store things.

objection.tip: objection to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。
objection.en: An expression of opposition, or a reason for opposing something.

honey.tip: 表示蜂蜜时不可数；一罐蜂蜜说a jar of honey。
honey.en: a sweet, sticky food made by bees

correspondent.tip: 记者义常指驻某地或负责某领域的记者。
correspondent.en: A journalist reporting from a particular place or on a subject.

diary.tip: diary是日记，dairy是乳制品；注意字母顺序。
diary.en: A book containing personal accounts of daily events and feelings.

desperate.tip: 渴望某物用desperate for；急切做某事用to do。
desperate.en: Feeling nearly hopeless and ready to try anything.

musician.tip: musician指音乐人；作曲家更具体地用composer。
musician.en: someone who plays music, especially professionally

continuous.tip: continuous强调不中断；continual常指反复发生。
continuous.en: Continuing without a break or interruption.

horror.tip: 情绪义通常不可数；in horror表示惊恐地。
horror.en: a strong feeling of fear, shock, or disgust

repair.tip: 具体维修常用复数repairs；beyond repair表示无法修复。
repair.en: To make something damaged or broken work properly again

flee.tip: 过去式和过去分词均为fled；可直接接逃离的地点。
flee.en: To leave quickly to escape danger or an unpleasant situation.

leather.tip: 通常不可数；leather jacket中名词作定语。
leather.en: animal skin treated for making clothes, bags, and other goods

cow.tip: cow指成年母牛；cattle统称牛，不能说a cattle。
cow.en: an adult female bovine, often kept for milk

evolution.tip: evolution指进化；进化论用the theory of evolution。
evolution.en: Gradual changes in living things over many generations.

infant.tip: 比baby正式；infant mortality专指婴儿死亡率。
infant.en: a baby or very young child

grandfather.tip: 不区分父系母系；外祖父可说maternal grandfather。
grandfather.en: The father of your mother or father.

lawn.tip: 高频搭配：lawn mower (割草机) / lawn tennis (草地网球)；同族词：lawns (复数)
lawn.en: Commonly used in expressions like "lawn mower (割草机)" (n.).

wisdom.tip: 不可数；knowledge重知识，wisdom重判断与运用。
wisdom.en: The ability to judge well using knowledge and experience

garlic.tip: 通常不可数；一瓣大蒜用a clove of garlic。
garlic.en: A plant whose strong-smelling bulbs are used to flavour food.

tin.tip: 罐子义可数，英式常用tin，美式常用can；锡不可数。
tin.en: A metal container, especially for food, or its contents.

clerk.tip: 英式读音中元音为/ɑː/；美式常指店员。
clerk.en: someone whose job involves records, documents, or routine office tasks

virtue.tip: by virtue of意为由于或凭借，并非凭美德。
virtue.en: A morally good quality or morally good behaviour.

margin.tip: by a narrow margin表示以微小差距获胜等。
margin.en: the blank space around a page or an area's edge

stability.tip: 通常不可数；形容词为stable，反义词为instability。
stability.en: The ability to remain steady and resist unwanted change

canal.tip: canal通常为人工水道；river指天然河流。
canal.en: an artificial waterway for boats or carrying water

fantasy.tip: 具体幻想可数；表示奇幻文学类型时通常不可数。
fantasy.en: An imagined situation that is unlikely to happen

coin.tip: coin作动词常指创造词语，如coin a term。
coin.en: a small, flat piece of metal used as money

fulfil.en: to do what a duty, promise, or agreement requires

plot.tip: plot指情节；作动词还可表示标绘数据。
plot.en: the connected events that make up a story

timber.tip: 指木材时通常不可数；美式英语常用lumber指加工木料。
timber.en: wood prepared for building or making things

cattle.tip: cattle是复数集合名词，用are；单头牛不用a cattle。
cattle.en: Farm animals kept for their milk or meat.

seize.tip: 高频搭配：seize the opportunity (抓住机遇，抓住机会) / seize opportunities (抓住机遇)；同族词：seized (过去分词)、seizing (现在分词)、seizes (第三人称单数)
seize.en: Commonly used in expressions like "seize the opportunity (抓住机遇，抓住机会)" (v.).

evident.tip: 常用It is evident that...表示显然……。
evident.en: Easy to see, understand, or recognize.

divorce.tip: divorce sb表示与某人离婚，不加with。
divorce.en: the legal ending of a marriage

grammar.tip: 表示语法知识时不可数；一个语法错误用a grammar mistake。
grammar.en: The rules for combining words and changing their forms.

commonly.tip: 常置于实义动词前、be动词后，如is commonly used。
commonly.en: often or among many people or in many places

opera.tip: 泛指歌剧艺术时不可数；一部歌剧用an opera。
opera.en: a musical drama in which performers sing most words

shade.tip: shade常指阴凉区域；shadow指物体投下的影子。
shade.en: an area protected from direct sunlight

consciousness.en: The state of being awake and aware of your surroundings

overseas.tip: 作副词前不加to：go overseas；也可修饰名词。
overseas.en: in or to a foreign country

palm.tip: 高频搭配：palm oil (n. 棕榈油) / bear the palm (获奖)；同族词：palms (复数)、palmed (过去式)、palming (现在分词)
palm.en: Commonly used in expressions like "palm oil (n. 棕榈油)" (n.).

guideline.tip: 常用复数guidelines；通常指指导而非强制法规。
guideline.en: Advice or a principle explaining how something should be done.

pile.tip: a pile of后接所堆之物；pile up表示积聚。
pile.en: Objects placed together, often one on top of another.

publicity.tip: 不可数；不同于advertising，不一定是付费广告。
publicity.en: Attention given to someone or something by the media.

alarm.tip: 警报响起用go off，不是go on。
alarm.en: A warning signal or device, or something that wakes you.

carbon.tip: carbon是碳元素；carbon dioxide才是二氧化碳。
carbon.en: A chemical element present in all living things.

nerve.tip: nerve指勇气常不可数；nerves可指紧张情绪。
nerve.en: A fibre carrying signals between the brain and body.

crack.tip: crack常指裂而未碎；shatter强调碎成许多片。
crack.en: A narrow break in a surface or solid object

burst.tip: 高频搭配：burst into (闯入) / rock burst (岩层突裂)；同族词：bursting (现在分词)、bursts (复数)
burst.en: Commonly used in expressions like "burst into (闯入)" (v./vi&n.).

survivor.en: Someone who remains alive after danger, illness, or disaster.

besides.tip: besides表示额外包括；beside表示在旁边。
besides.en: In addition to someone or something.

pig.tip: pig指动物；作为食物的猪肉通常用pork。
pig.en: A farm animal with a broad snout and short legs.

wealthy.tip: the wealthy指富人群体；wealthy本身是形容词。
wealthy.en: Having a large amount of money or valuable possessions.

privilege.tip: 表示荣幸常用have the privilege of doing。
privilege.en: A special right or advantage available only to certain people.

sophisticated.tip: 形容设备指精密先进；形容人可指见多识广。
sophisticated.en: highly developed and involving complex methods or technology

explosion.tip: 表示数量激增时，常用an explosion in加名词。
explosion.en: a sudden violent release of energy, usually with a bang

consequently.tip: 是副词而非连词；连接独立句可在前面用分号。
consequently.en: as a result of something mentioned earlier

companion.tip: companion强调陪伴，不一定是好友，也可指动物。
companion.en: a person or animal that spends time with someone

clever.en: Quick to learn, understand, or find solutions.

incredible.tip: incredible可表难以置信，也可口语赞叹“极好”。
incredible.en: So surprising that it is difficult to believe

wander.tip: wander指漫游；wonder指想知道，注意拼写。
wander.en: to move around without a fixed route or purpose

van.tip: 常指载货的封闭式车辆；不要与敞篷货车混淆。
van.en: A covered vehicle used to carry goods or people.

injure.tip: injure通常指身体受伤；损坏物品常用damage。
injure.en: to cause physical harm to a person or animal

educate.tip: educate强调教育培养；teach也可直接接学科。
educate.en: To teach someone and develop their knowledge or skills.

exploit.tip: 高频搭配：exploit — 开采；同族词：exploited (过去分词)、exploiting (现在分词)、exploits (复数)
exploit.en: Commonly used in expressions like "exploit — 开采" (v.).

painful.tip: painful可指身体疼痛，也可指情感痛苦或难堪。

flesh.tip: 一般不可数；食用的肉通常用meat，不用flesh。
flesh.en: The soft tissue between the skin and bones.

rabbit.tip: rabbit泛指兔；hare通常指腿耳更长的野兔。
rabbit.en: a small animal with long ears, soft fur, and strong back legs

patch.tip: 高频搭配：patch clamp (膜片箝) / patch up (修补)；同族词：patches (复数)、patched (过去分词)、patching (现在分词)
patch.en: Commonly used in expressions like "patch clamp (膜片箝)" (n./v.).

uniform.tip: 开头是辅音/j/，所以说a uniform，不用an。
uniform.en: Special clothing worn by members of a particular group.

asleep.tip: asleep通常作表语；“熟睡的婴儿”用a sleeping baby。

scholarship.tip: 指奖学金时可数；指学问或学术研究时不可数。
scholarship.en: Money awarded to help someone pay for their studies.

reservation.tip: 表示疑虑常用复数：have reservations about。
reservation.en: An arrangement to keep a room, seat, or table available.

lease.tip: lease from指租入；lease to指租给别人。
lease.en: a legal agreement to use property for payment

govern.tip: 高频搭配：govern — 管理；同族词：governed (过去分词)、governing (现在分词)、governs (第三人称单数)
govern.en: Commonly used in expressions like "govern — 管理" (v.).

equivalent.tip: 常用equivalent to；相当不代表完全相同。
equivalent.en: Equal in value, amount, meaning, or function.

scandal.tip: 高频搭配：sex scandal (性丑闻) / watergate scandal (水门事件)；同族词：scandals (复数)
scandal.en: Commonly used in expressions like "sex scandal (性丑闻)" (n.).

impress.tip: impressed形容人的感受；impressive形容事物令人赞叹。
impress.en: to make someone admire or respect someone or something

heel.tip: heel是脚后跟或鞋跟；heal意为愈合，二者同音。
heel.en: The rounded back part of the foot below the ankle.

rival.tip: rival作动词直接接宾语，无需加with。
rival.en: Someone competing with another for the same goal or advantage.

resemble.tip: 直接接宾语：resemble someone，不加to或with。
resemble.en: To look like or be similar to someone or something

undergo.tip: 过去式underwent，过去分词undergone；直接接宾语。
undergo.en: to experience a process, change, or treatment

mate.tip: 表示朋友时属英式非正式用语，正式写作宜用friend。
mate.en: A friend or someone you share an activity with

contest.tip: 名词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。
contest.en: an event or struggle in which people compete to win

charter.tip: 高频搭配：charter party (佣船契约) / olympic charter (奥林匹克宪章)；同族词：charters (复数)、chartered (过去分词)、chartering (现在分词)
charter.en: Commonly used in expressions like "charter party (佣船契约)" (adj./n.).

rifle.tip: 作动词时常用rifle through，表示匆忙翻找。
rifle.en: A long gun held against the shoulder when fired.

trick.tip: trick sb into doing sth表示“骗某人做某事”。
trick.en: an action intended to deceive someone or make them look foolish

organic.tip: 食品语境指有机生产；化学语境通常指含碳化合物。
organic.en: produced without artificial fertilizers or most synthetic pesticides

tent.en: a portable fabric shelter supported by poles and ropes

specimen.tip: specimen多指供研究或检验的样本，不泛指任何例子。
specimen.en: An individual animal, plant, or object collected for scientific study.

myth.tip: 高频搭配：myth — 神话；同族词：myths (复数)
myth.en: Commonly used in expressions like "myth — 神话" (n.).

format.en: the way information or an event is arranged or presented

barrel.tip: 复数barrels；一桶石油用a barrel of oil。
barrel.en: A large round container with flat ends, or its contents.

sigh.tip: gh不发音；叹气也可表示放松，不一定是悲伤。
sigh.en: To breathe out slowly and audibly, expressing feelings

menu.tip: 说菜品在菜单上，用on the menu，不用in。
menu.en: A list of food and drinks available to order

wise.tip: wise强调判断明智；clever更强调聪明、学得快。
wise.en: Showing good judgment based on knowledge and experience.

sympathy.tip: 高频搭配：sympathy for (对…表示同情) / sympathy with (赞同)；同族词：sympathies (复数)
sympathy.en: Commonly used in expressions like "sympathy for (对…表示同情)" (n.).

strict.tip: 对人严格用with；对事情要求严格用about。
strict.en: requiring rules to be obeyed and standards to be met

ease.tip: with ease指毫不费力；at ease指自在放松。
ease.en: To make pain, difficulty, or worry less severe.

collapse.tip: 表示倒塌或崩溃时通常是不及物动词，不用被动。
collapse.en: To fall down suddenly or stop functioning completely.

loud.tip: read out loud指读出声；loudly也可表示大声地。
loud.en: Making or having a strong sound that is easily heard.

bitter.tip: 味觉上的bitter是苦，sour是酸，别混淆。
bitter.en: having a sharp taste like strong unsweetened coffee

glove.tip: 一副手套用 a pair of gloves，注意 gloves 用复数。
glove.en: A hand covering with separate sections for fingers and thumb.

outer.tip: 高频搭配：outer space (n. 太空) / outer ring (外环)；同族词：outers (复数)
outer.en: Commonly used in expressions like "outer space (n. 太空)" (adj.).

machinery.tip: 高频搭配：machinery and equipment (机器及设备) / construction machinery (建筑机械)；同族词：machineries (复数)
machinery.en: Commonly used in expressions like "machinery and equipment (机器及设备)" (n.).

helicopter.tip: 乘直升机用by helicopter，中间不加冠词。
helicopter.en: An aircraft with rotating blades that can rise straight upwards.

petrol.tip: 不可数名词；英式用petrol，美式用gasoline或gas。
petrol.en: a liquid fuel used in cars and other engines

modest.tip: 形容人常指谦虚；形容数量常指不大。
modest.en: not boasting about your abilities or achievements

organ.tip: organ指器官；organism指完整的生物体。
organ.en: A body part that performs a particular function.

carriage.tip: 火车车厢英式常用 carriage，美式常用 car。
carriage.en: A railway vehicle in which passengers travel.

explode.tip: 爆炸物作主语常用主动形式，不必用被动。
explode.en: To burst violently, or cause something to burst violently.

stroke.tip: 中风用have a stroke，勿与心脏病发作混淆。
stroke.en: Sudden brain damage caused by interrupted blood flow or bleeding.

attraction.tip: 指景点时可数；指吸引力时通常不可数。
attraction.en: A place or feature that people want to visit or experience.

frequent.tip: 形容词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。
frequent.en: Happening often or at short intervals

handful.tip: a handful of可接不可数名词或复数名词。
handful.en: An amount that can be held in one hand.

horizon.tip: 表示眼界通常用复数：broaden your horizons。
horizon.en: The line where the sky seems to meet land or sea.

garage.tip: 英式英语也常用 garage 指汽车修理厂。
garage.en: A building or part of a building for keeping vehicles.

prompt.tip: 高频搭配：prompt delivery (限时专送) / command prompt (命令提示符)；同族词：prompted (过去式)、prompting (现在分词)、prompts (第三人称单数)
prompt.en: Commonly used in expressions like "prompt delivery (限时专送)" (adj.).

suspend.tip: 高频搭配：suspend production (停产) / suspend payment (v. 宣告破产)；同族词：suspended (过去分词)、suspending (现在分词)、suspends (第三人称单数)
suspend.en: Commonly used in expressions like "suspend production (停产)" (v.).

undoubtedly.tip: 语气很肯定；证据不足时宜用probably等弱化表达。
undoubtedly.en: Certainly true, with no reasonable doubt.

slope.tip: 高频搭配：slope stability (坡面稳定性) / rock slope (岩石边坡)；同族词：slopes (复数)、sloped (过去式)、sloping (现在分词)
slope.en: Commonly used in expressions like "slope stability (坡面稳定性)" (n./v.).

eager.tip: 常用eager to do或eager for＋名词。
eager.en: very interested and excited about doing or having something

compose.en: To create music or carefully write a piece of writing

assignment.tip: 指具体作业时可数；homework通常不可数。
assignment.en: A piece of work someone is required to complete.

conversion.tip: 高频搭配：frequency conversion (频率变换) / conversion rate (汇率)；同族词：conversions (复数)
conversion.en: Commonly used in expressions like "frequency conversion (频率变换)" (n.).

collective.tip: 高频搭配：collective economy (集体经济) / collective action (集体行动)；同族词：collectives (复数)
collective.en: Commonly used in expressions like "collective economy (集体经济)" (adj.).

auto.tip: 主要用于美式英语，常作定语，如auto industry。
auto.en: A car, especially in American English

romantic.tip: 除爱情义外，也可指把现实想得过于美好。
romantic.en: connected with love or expressing loving feelings

cotton.tip: 通常不可数；cotton shirt中cotton作名词定语。
cotton.en: Soft white plant fibres used to make thread and fabric.

overlook.tip: overlook可指忽略或俯瞰；不要与监督的oversee混淆。
overlook.en: To fail to notice or consider something.

rat.tip: rat通常指大鼠，mouse通常指体型较小的小鼠。
rat.en: a rodent with a long tail, larger than a mouse

float.tip: float an idea是提出想法供讨论，并非实施。
float.en: To stay on a liquid's surface or move gently through air.

discount.tip: 名词重音在首音节；动词通常读/dɪsˈkaʊnt/。
discount.en: a reduction in the usual price

jet.tip: a jet of water指一股喷射的水流。
jet.en: An aircraft powered by jet engines.

blade.tip: blade指刀的切割部分，knife指整把刀。
blade.en: The flat cutting part of a knife or tool.

experimental.tip: experimental指实验的或试验性的，不是“有经验的”。
experimental.en: Relating to scientific tests or based on their results

medication.tip: 泛指药物多不可数；具体多种药可用medications。
medication.en: Medicine used to treat illness, or treatment using medicine.

cabin.tip: 既指陆地上的小屋，也指船舱或飞机客舱。
cabin.en: A small, simple house, often built from wood.

bite.tip: 过去式bit，过去分词bitten；一口用a bite。
bite.en: To cut or grip with teeth, or wound with mouthparts

revolutionary.tip: 高频搭配：revolutionary war (n. 美国之革命战争) / revolutionary committee (革命委员会)；同族词：revolutionaries (复数)
revolutionary.en: Commonly used in expressions like "revolutionary war (n. 美国之革命战争)" (adj./n.).

particle.tip: 高频搭配：particle size (粒度) / particle size distribution (粒度分布)；同族词：particles (复数)
particle.en: Commonly used in expressions like "particle size (粒度)" (n.).

remedy.tip: 名词常接for；动词直接接问题，不加for。
remedy.en: A treatment or medicine used to relieve an illness.

pine.tip: pine for表示渴望或思念；pine away指日渐憔悴。
pine.en: An evergreen tree with needles, or the wood it produces.

applicant.tip: 申请某职位的人用 applicant for a position。
applicant.en: Someone who formally requests a job, place, or permission.

emperor.en: A male ruler of an empire.

gulf.tip: gulf可指海湾，也常用gulf between表示巨大差距。
gulf.en: A large area of sea partly surrounded by land.

discrimination.tip: 歧视某群体用 discrimination against；通常不可数。
discrimination.en: unfair treatment based on someone's identity or personal characteristics

offensive.tip: 表示觉得被冒犯用offended，不用offensive。
offensive.en: Causing people to feel insulted, upset, or disgusted.

integration.tip: 高频搭配：economic integration (经济一体化) / system integration (系统综合)；同族词：integrations (复数)
integration.en: Commonly used in expressions like "economic integration (经济一体化)" (n.).

boom.tip: 表示某领域的迅速增长，常用a boom in。
boom.en: a period of rapid growth or economic success

bound.tip: bound to后接动词；bound for后接目的地。
bound.en: Certain or very likely to happen

reverse.tip: 倒车用reverse；撤销决定可说reverse a decision。
reverse.en: to change something to its opposite, or move backwards

invitation.tip: 参加活动用invitation to；邀请做事用to do。
invitation.en: a request for someone to attend or join something

generous.tip: be generous with sth表示在某方面慷慨。
generous.en: willing to give money, time, or help freely

lemon.tip: 整个柠檬可数；lemon juice中的juice不可数。
lemon.en: a yellow citrus fruit with sour juice

cancel.tip: 英式过去式cancelled，美式常用canceled；抵消用out。
cancel.en: To decide that something planned will not happen.

automatic.tip: 可指机器自动运作，也可指人未经思考的反应。
automatic.en: Working by itself without direct human control.

ambition.tip: 具体志向可数，进取心不可数；常接to do。
ambition.en: A strong desire to achieve a particular goal.

naked.tip: 高频搭配：naked eye (n. 肉眼) / naked light (明火)；同族词：naked (adj.)
naked.en: Commonly used in expressions like "naked eye (n. 肉眼)" (adj.).

weekly.tip: 既可作形容词也可作副词：a weekly meeting；meet weekly。
weekly.en: Happening once a week or relating to one week

logical.tip: logical强调推理合理，不表示事实一定正确。
logical.en: Based on clear reasoning, with ideas that fit together sensibly.

nut.tip: 食物和五金中的nut都是可数名词。
nut.en: A hard-shelled fruit with an edible seed inside.

harm.tip: 名词不可数；用do harm to，动词harm直接接宾语。
harm.en: Physical injury or damage to someone's wellbeing or something's condition.

electrical.tip: electrical常指电气领域；electric常指电驱动的。
electrical.en: Related to electricity or equipment that uses it.

battery.tip: 复数为batteries；a battery of可指一系列测试。
battery.en: A device that stores energy and supplies electricity.

logic.tip: 通常不可数；the logic behind表示背后的道理。
logic.en: Reasoning that connects ideas in a clear, consistent way.

inspection.tip: inspection指检查过程；检查某物用of连接。
inspection.en: A careful examination to check condition, quality, or safety.

flame.tip: 高频搭配：flame retardant ([化]阻燃剂) / olympic flame (奥林匹克圣火)；同族词：flames (复数)、flamed (过去式)、flaming (现在分词)
flame.en: Commonly used in expressions like "flame retardant ([化]阻燃剂)" (n.).

bare.tip: 高频搭配：bare of (vt. 几乎没有，缺乏) / lay bare (揭发，暴露)；同族词：bared (过去式)、barest (最高级)、baring (现在分词)
bare.en: Commonly used in expressions like "bare of (vt. 几乎没有，缺乏)" (adj.).

gross.tip: 财务中gross为扣除前总额，net为净额。
gross.en: Calculated before taxes, costs, or other amounts are taken away.

accordingly.tip: 表“相应地”常放句末；表“因此”较正式。
accordingly.en: in a way that suits the particular situation

wound.en: An injury involving damage to skin or other body tissue.

shower.tip: 洗淋浴可用take或have a shower；阵雨也叫shower。
shower.en: Washing under falling water, or the equipment used for this

disposal.tip: at someone's disposal 表示供某人使用或支配。
disposal.en: The process of getting rid of unwanted things

calculation.tip: 一次具体计算可数；指计算过程时可不可数。
calculation.en: the process or result of working something out using numbers

dare.tip: 敢做用dare to do；激将用dare sb to do。
dare.en: to have enough courage to do something

valid.tip: valid for可接有效时长；valid until接到期时间。
valid.en: officially acceptable and able to be used

mineral.tip: 营养语境中minerals指矿物质，不等于维生素。
mineral.en: a natural substance found in rocks, soil, food, or water

fibre.tip: 美式拼写为 fiber；膳食纤维义通常不可数。
fibre.en: a thin thread forming part of a material or tissue

comedy.tip: 指喜剧类型时通常不可数；一部喜剧用a comedy。
comedy.en: Entertainment intended to make people laugh.

suspicion.en: a belief that something is wrong without definite proof

sanction.tip: 可指“制裁”或“批准”，含义相反，须看语境。
sanction.en: An official penalty intended to enforce rules or change behaviour.

civilian.tip: civilian指非军人；公务员通常是civil servant。
civilian.en: A person who is not a member of the armed forces

humour.tip: 英式拼写humour，美式humor；作动词表示迁就。
humour.en: The quality of being funny or the ability to appreciate funniness.

devise.tip: 高频搭配：devise — 设计；同族词：devised (过去分词)、devising (现在分词)、devises (第三人称单数)
devise.en: Commonly used in expressions like "devise — 设计" (v.).

grain.tip: grain指粮食通常不可数；指单颗谷粒或细粒可数。
grain.en: seeds of crops such as wheat, used as food

condemn.tip: 词尾n不发音；别与表示“冷凝”的condense混淆。
condemn.en: To express strong disapproval of someone or something.

swear.tip: 过去式swore，过去分词sworn；swear at指咒骂。
swear.en: to use rude or offensive words

declaration.tip: declare是动词；海关申报用customs declaration。
declaration.en: An official or public statement expressing a decision, belief, or intention.

identification.tip: 表示身份证明时通常不可数，可简称 ID。
identification.en: the process of establishing who or what someone or something is

correspond.tip: 对应常用correspond to；与人通信接with。
correspond.en: To match something or have an equivalent role or position.

actress.tip: actor也可指女性；actress明确指女演员。
actress.en: a woman who performs characters in plays or films

needle.tip: 高频搭配：pins and needles (如坐针毡) / needle valve (针阀)；同族词：needles (复数)、needling (现在分词)、needled (过去式)
needle.en: Commonly used in expressions like "pins and needles (如坐针毡)" (n.).

modify.tip: 通常指局部调整，不一定是彻底改变。
modify.en: To change something slightly to improve it or suit a purpose.

youngster.tip: 男女皆可指，语气较随意；正式写作可用young people。

rational.tip: 高频搭配：rational design (合理的设计) / rational choice (理性选择)；同族词：rational (adj.)
rational.en: Commonly used in expressions like "rational design (合理的设计)" (adj.).

shore.tip: shore多指海、湖岸；河岸通常用bank。
shore.en: the land along the edge of a sea or lake

repeatedly.tip: 强调次数多；不一定像regularly那样有规律。
repeatedly.en: Many times, often with little time between occasions.

lung.tip: 单个肺用lung；谈双肺或肺部通常用lungs。
lung.en: Either of the two chest organs used for breathing.

artistic.tip: artistic指艺术或艺术天赋；artificial指人造的。
artistic.en: Related to art or the creation of art

dose.tip: 高频搭配：radiation dose (辐射剂量) / a dose of (一剂（药）)；同族词：doses (复数)、dosed (过去分词)、dosing (现在分词)
dose.en: Commonly used in expressions like "radiation dose (辐射剂量)" (n.).

gaze.tip: 动词常接at；比glance看得久，通常比stare柔和。
gaze.en: To look steadily at something for a long time.

powder.tip: powder通常不可数；一勺粉用a spoonful of powder。
powder.en: A dry substance consisting of very small loose particles.

ugly.tip: 比较级uglier，最高级ugliest；形容人外貌不礼貌。

moderate.tip: 形容词末尾读/ət/，动词末尾读/eɪt/。
moderate.en: Neither very large nor very small in amount or degree

darling.tip: 高频搭配：little darling (小宝贝)；同族词：darlings (复数)
darling.en: Commonly used in expressions like "little darling (小宝贝)" (n.).

molecule.tip: 高频搭配：small molecule (小分子) / water molecule (水分子)；同族词：molecules (复数)
molecule.en: Commonly used in expressions like "small molecule (小分子)" (n.).

ghost.tip: a ghost of a smile指一丝若有若无的笑。
ghost.en: The spirit of a dead person, imagined as appearing alive.

urgent.tip: urgent强调必须立即处理，不仅是重要。

exact.tip: exact强调分毫不差；副词形式为exactly。
exact.en: Correct in every detail, without any difference or error.

carrier.tip: 医学中carrier可能没有症状，但仍携带病原体。
carrier.en: a company or person that transports people or goods

reliable.tip: reliable可形容人、信息或机器，强调值得信赖。
reliable.en: Able to be trusted to work well or behave consistently

disturb.tip: disturb强调打扰或使不安；interrupt强调中断。
disturb.en: to interrupt someone's activity, rest, or peace

identical.tip: 常用 identical to；比 similar 的相似程度更强。
identical.en: exactly the same in every relevant detail

sole.tip: 表示“唯一的”时通常放名词前；与 soul 同音。
sole.en: Being the only one, with nobody or nothing else involved.

admire.tip: admire sb for sth：因某事钦佩某人。
admire.en: To respect someone for their qualities or achievements

advertisement.tip: 广告内容用 for 引出；advertising 泛指广告活动。
advertisement.en: A public message promoting a product, service, event, or opportunity.

pet.tip: 动词过去式为petted；英式英语中抚摸也常用stroke。
pet.en: An animal kept at home for company and pleasure.

hesitate.tip: 高频搭配：don't hesitate (别再犹豫了) / hesitate in (吞吞吐吐)；同族词：hesitated (过去式)、hesitating (现在分词)、hesitates (第三人称单数)
hesitate.en: Commonly used in expressions like "don't hesitate (别再犹豫了)" (v.).

miracle.tip: work miracles指创造奇迹，也可夸张表示效果惊人。
miracle.en: An extraordinary event that seems impossible or beyond natural explanation.

rhythm.tip: 高频搭配：circadian rhythm (生理节律) / sense of rhythm (节奏感)；同族词：rhythms (复数)
rhythm.en: Commonly used in expressions like "circadian rhythm (生理节律)" (n.).

accountant.tip: accountant指人；accounting指会计工作或学科。
accountant.en: Someone whose job is to prepare and check financial records

satisfactory.tip: 强调达到要求，不一定出色；人的满意感用satisfied。
satisfactory.en: Good enough to meet a particular need or standard

tide.tip: tide是海水的周期性涨落，wave是单个波浪。
tide.en: the regular rise and fall of the sea

sin.tip: 侧重宗教或道德上的罪，不等于法律上的crime。
sin.en: an action that breaks a religious or moral rule

acre.tip: 面积单位：1英亩约4047平方米，不等于一公顷。
acre.en: A unit of land area equal to about 4,047 square metres

script.tip: 高频搭配：regular script (楷书) / cursive script (草书)；同族词：scripts (复数)、scripted (过去分词)、scripting (现在分词)
script.en: Commonly used in expressions like "regular script (楷书)" (n.).

atlantic.tip: 首字母大写；作名词通常用the Atlantic。
atlantic.en: The ocean between the Americas and Europe and Africa.

swallow.tip: swallow your pride指放下自尊，接受不情愿的事。
swallow.en: make food or liquid pass from your mouth into your stomach

transformation.tip: 常用transformation from A into B表示由A变成B。
transformation.en: a complete change in the appearance or nature of something

everyday.tip: 高频搭配：everyday life (日常生活) / happy everyday (快乐每一天（祝福语）)；同族词：everyday (adj.)
everyday.en: Commonly used in expressions like "everyday life (日常生活)" (adj.).

headline.tip: make headlines指成为新闻焦点，不是制作标题。
headline.en: the title of a news report

invasion.tip: 高频搭配：water invasion (水侵) / invasion of privacy (侵犯个人隐私)；同族词：invasions (复数)
invasion.en: Commonly used in expressions like "water invasion (水侵)" (n.).

angel.tip: 称某人为an angel，可表示对方善良或帮了大忙。
angel.en: A spiritual being believed to carry messages from God

liable.tip: liable to后接动词表可能；liable for表责任。
liable.en: Likely to experience something, especially something unpleasant.

intensity.tip: 高频搭配：high intensity (adj. 高强度的) / labor intensity (劳动强度，劳力投入密集度)；同族词：intensities (复数)
intensity.en: Commonly used in expressions like "high intensity (adj. 高强度的)" (n.).

grocery.tip: 食品杂货用复数groceries；作定语用grocery。
grocery.en: Food and household supplies bought at a shop; usually plural.

exhibit.tip: 英式英语中，exhibit 通常指单件展品，展览用 exhibition。
exhibit.en: to display objects or artworks for people to see

greet.tip: greet直接接人；表示向某人问好不加to。
greet.en: to welcome someone or say hello

removal.tip: 搬家义主要用于英式英语；搬家公司为removal company。
removal.en: The act of taking something away from a place.

blanket.tip: blanket作形容词指全面适用，如blanket ban。
blanket.en: A thick bed covering, or a layer covering something.

cloth.tip: 布料义不可数；抹布可数，复数cloths；勿混clothes。
cloth.en: Material made by weaving or knitting fibres.

interior.tip: 高频搭配：interior design (室内设计) / interior decoration (室内装饰)；同族词：interiors (复数)
interior.en: Commonly used in expressions like "interior design (室内设计)" (adj.).

rope.tip: 材料泛指用rope；一根绳可说a rope。
rope.en: a thick, strong cord made from twisted fibres

concrete.tip: cement是水泥，是制作concrete（混凝土）的原料之一。
concrete.en: A building material made from cement, water, sand, and stones.

chase.tip: chase可直接接追赶对象，也可用chase after。
chase.en: to run or move after someone to catch them

recruit.tip: recruit可作动词或可数名词；招聘活动用recruitment。
recruit.en: to find and employ workers or attract new members

wholly.tip: 高频搭配：wholly owned subsidiary (全资子公司)；同族词：wholly (adv.)
wholly.en: Commonly used in expressions like "wholly owned subsidiary (全资子公司)" (adv.).

render.tip: 表“使……”时常用render＋宾语＋形容词，语气正式。
render.en: to cause someone or something to enter a particular state

laughter.tip: laughter不可数；表示“一阵笑声”用a burst of laughter。
laughter.en: The sound or action of laughing

painter.tip: 既可指艺术画家，也可指刷墙的油漆工。
painter.en: Someone who creates pictures using paint.

pie.en: Food with a pastry base or covering and a filling.

courage.tip: 通常不可数；做某事的勇气用courage to do。
courage.en: Ability to face danger or difficulty despite feeling afraid.

clue.tip: a clue to中的to是介词，后接名词等。
clue.en: Information that helps you solve a problem or understand something.

slice.tip: slice强调切出的片；piece泛指一块或一件。
slice.en: a thin, flat piece cut from something larger

miner.tip: 高频搭配：continuous miner (连续采煤机) / coal miner (煤矿工人)；同族词：miners (复数)
miner.en: Commonly used in expressions like "continuous miner (连续采煤机)" (n.).

lamp.tip: lamp指灯具；light也可指光或光线。
lamp.en: A device that produces light, often on a table.

pond.tip: pond通常比lake小；可指天然或人工池塘。
pond.en: a small area of still water surrounded by land

namely.tip: 高频搭配：namely — 即；同族词：namely (adv.)
namely.en: Commonly used in expressions like "namely — 即" (adv.).

knit.tip: k不发音；过去式和过去分词可用knitted或knit。
knit.en: to make clothing or fabric by looping yarn with needles

integrate.tip: 常用integrate A into B，也可用integrate A with B。
integrate.en: To combine separate parts so they work together effectively.

fragment.tip: 名词重音在前；动词读/fræɡˈment/，重音在后。
fragment.en: A small piece broken off or separated from something larger.

grave.tip: 作形容词比serious更正式，常修饰威胁或后果。
grave.en: A place in the ground where a dead person is buried.

lap.tip: 高频搭配：last lap (最后一圈) / chek lap kok (赤鱲角（俗称赤腊角，香港西部海域的一个岛屿）)；同族词：laps (复数)、lapped (过去分词)、lapping (现在分词)
lap.en: Commonly used in expressions like "last lap (最后一圈)" (n.).

toe.tip: 手指是finger，脚趾是toe；大脚趾用big toe。
toe.en: One of the five separate parts at the foot's end

container.tip: 泛指盛装东西的容器；运输语境常指集装箱。
container.en: an object used to hold or store things

unexpected.tip: unexpected强调未料到，不一定表示突然发生。
unexpected.en: Happening without being expected or predicted.

sheer.tip: 高频搭配：sheer nonsense (一派胡言)；同族词：sheers (复数)、sheered (过去式)、sheering (现在分词)
sheer.en: Commonly used in expressions like "sheer nonsense (一派胡言)" (adv./v.).

bulk.tip: the bulk of指大部分；in bulk指大批量。

decrease.tip: 动词重音在后，名词/ˈdiːkriːs/重音在前。
decrease.en: To become smaller or make something smaller in amount.

trap.tip: 动词过去式trapped、现在分词trapping都双写p。
trap.en: A device or concealed danger designed to catch someone or something

anniversary.tip: 指重要事件每年对应的纪念日，不只用于婚礼。
anniversary.en: A date marking another year since an important event.

necessity.tip: 表必要性常不可数；表必需品可数，常用复数。
necessity.en: the need for something or for something to happen

navy.tip: navy指海军整体；具体的一艘军舰用warship。
navy.en: the armed force that operates mainly at sea

grip.tip: 过去式gripped、现在分词gripping均双写p。

exclusive.tip: exclusive to表示“为……独有”；exclusive of指不含。
exclusive.en: Available only to a particular person or group.

mess.tip: 常说make a mess；mess up可指弄乱或搞砸。
mess.en: A dirty or untidy state or collection of things.

nursery.tip: 英式英语中at nursery常指在托儿所。
nursery.en: a place where young children are cared for

legend.tip: legend可能有历史原型，不等于已证实的历史。
legend.en: an old popular story that may not be historically true

regulate.tip: 及物动词，直接接宾语；regulate temperature指调温。
regulate.en: control an activity through rules or laws

illustration.tip: 插图或例证可数；表示举例说明这一行为时常不可数。
illustration.en: A picture that accompanies or explains something.

superb.tip: 本身已含程度很高之意，通常不说very superb。
superb.en: Extremely good in quality or performance.

interrupt.tip: interrupt指中途打断；disrupt侧重扰乱正常进程。
interrupt.en: to stop someone speaking or working by doing something

await.tip: 较正式，直接接宾语；不要写await for。
await.en: To wait for someone or something

upset.tip: 动词过去式、过去分词仍是upset；名词重音在前。
upset.en: Unhappy, worried, or disappointed about something.

delight.tip: delighted形容人感到高兴；delightful形容事物令人愉快。
delight.en: a feeling of great pleasure or happiness

forgive.tip: 用forgive sb for doing sth；过去式forgave，过去分词forgiven。
forgive.en: Stop blaming someone or feeling angry about what they did.

lightly.tip: take something lightly意为不认真对待某事。
lightly.en: With little force, pressure, or weight.

lion.tip: 狮群用a pride of lions；母狮称lioness。
lion.en: A large wild cat, whose males usually have thick neck hair.

invent.tip: invent是创造新事物；discover是发现已有事物。
invent.en: To design or make something that did not exist before.

receiver.tip: receiver可指设备或人；收件人通常用recipient。
receiver.en: A device that receives radio, television, or other electronic signals.

northwest.tip: 西北风从西北吹来；向西北走用head northwest。
northwest.en: The direction between north and west, or an area's northwestern part.

shortage.tip: 常用a shortage of；“缺少”也可说be short of。
shortage.en: a situation in which there is not enough of something

insect.tip: 可数名词；蜘蛛有八条腿，不属于昆虫。
insect.en: A small animal with six legs and three main body sections.

motive.tip: motive强调行动背后的原因，常接for。

desirable.en: Worth having or doing because it offers benefits.

superior.tip: 比较时用superior to，不用superior than。
superior.en: Better in quality or performance than another

magic.tip: magic 多指魔法或魔术；magical 也可形容美妙体验。
magic.en: An imaginary supernatural power, or tricks that seem to use it.

combat.tip: 作动词直接接问题或危害，不必加against。

stem.en: the main plant part supporting leaves, flowers, or fruit

fleet.tip: 集合名词；a fleet of可接船、车辆或飞机。
fleet.en: a group of ships controlled or operated together

physics.tip: 虽以s结尾，仍作不可数名词，谓语用单数。
physics.en: the science of matter, energy, forces, and their interactions

counsel.tip: counsel指忠告或律师；council指委员会。
counsel.en: advice, especially from someone experienced or knowledgeable

crystal.tip: crystal clear既可形容水清澈，也可表示意思十分清楚。
crystal.en: A solid whose particles form a regular, repeating pattern.

hunt.tip: 猎捕动物可直接接宾语；寻找物品常用hunt for。
hunt.en: to chase wild animals to catch or kill them

jeans.tip: jeans用复数；一条用a pair of jeans。
jeans.en: Trousers made from strong cotton cloth, usually denim.

log.tip: 动词过去式为logged；log in表示登录。
log.en: a thick piece of wood cut from a tree

echo.tip: 高频搭配：radar echo (雷达回波) / echo cancellation (回波消除)；同族词：echoed (过去式)、echoes (复数)、echoing (现在分词)
echo.en: Commonly used in expressions like "radar echo (雷达回波)" (n./v.).

leap.tip: 高频搭配：by leaps and bounds (adv. 飞跃地，突飞猛进地) / leap forward (跃进)；同族词：leapt (过去式)、leaping (现在分词)、leaps (复数)
leap.en: Commonly used in expressions like "by leaps and bounds (adv. 飞跃地，突飞猛进地)" (v./n.).

pill.tip: take a pill指服药；the pill常特指口服避孕药。
pill.en: a small solid piece of medicine that you swallow

raid.tip: 高频搭配：air raid (空袭)；同族词：raids (复数)、raided (过去式)、raiding (现在分词)
raid.en: Commonly used in expressions like "air raid (空袭)" (n&vt.).

compound.tip: 名词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。
compound.en: A substance formed from chemically joined elements.

flour.en: powder made by grinding grain, used especially in baking

hardware.tip: 不可数名词；hardware指硬件，software指软件。
hardware.en: the physical parts of a computer or electronic system

colony.tip: 既可指殖民地，也可指蚁群、鸟群或菌落。
colony.en: a territory governed by another country

pump.tip: pump up a tyre表示给轮胎打气；抽水用pump water。
pump.en: a device that moves liquid or gas

candy.tip: 美式常用candy，英式常用sweets；一块用a piece of。
candy.en: a sweet food made mainly from sugar

evil.tip: 比bad语气强得多，通常涉及严重的道德恶行。
evil.en: morally very bad and deliberately causing harm

temple.tip: 表示太阳穴时，常用复数temples指两侧。
temple.en: a building used for worship in certain religions

medal.tip: medal是奖牌；metal是金属，注意拼写区别。
medal.en: A metal award given for achievement, service, or bravery.

beg.tip: 高频搭配：beg for (乞求) / beg your pardon (对不起，请原谅)；同族词：begging (现在分词)、begged (过去式)、begs (第三人称单数)
beg.en: Commonly used in expressions like "beg for (乞求)" (vt&vi.).

sponsor.tip: sponsor可作名词或动词；赞助行为用sponsorship。
sponsor.en: A person or organisation providing support, often in return for publicity.

rebel.tip: 高频搭配：rebel against (v. 反抗)；同族词：rebels (复数)、rebelled (过去式)、rebelling (现在分词)
rebel.en: Commonly used in expressions like "rebel against (v. 反抗)" (v./n.).

slam.en: to shut or put something down with force and noise

civilization.tip: 英式也拼作 civilisation；某个文明可用 a civilization。
civilization.en: an organized society with developed institutions, culture, and technology

melt.tip: melt指受热融化；dissolve指溶于液体。
melt.en: To become liquid through heat, or make something become liquid

midnight.tip: 在午夜用at midnight，不用in midnight。
midnight.en: Twelve o'clock at night, when one day ends and another begins.

oral.tip: oral既指口头的，也指口腔的；oral medication是口服药。

harsh.tip: 比strict更强调严厉得令人不快或难以承受。
harsh.en: unkind or excessively severe in judging or treating others

retail.tip: retail面向消费者零售；wholesale指批发。
retail.en: the sale of goods directly to consumers

statistical.tip: statistical指与统计有关，不等于“显著的”。
statistical.en: relating to collecting, studying, or interpreting numerical data

mutter.tip: 高频搭配：mutter — 轻声低语；同族词：muttered (过去式)、muttering (现在分词)、mutters (第三人称单数)
mutter.en: Commonly used in expressions like "mutter — 轻声低语" (v.).

hint.tip: 动词常用hint at sth或hint that从句。
hint.en: An indirect suggestion or clue that helps someone understand

fold.tip: fold强调折叠；bend只表示弯曲，不一定叠合。
fold.en: to bend something so one part lies over another

convenient.tip: 说 It is convenient for me，不说 I am convenient。
convenient.en: Easy to use or suitable for your needs and plans.

rumour.tip: 高频搭配：rumour — 谣传；同族词：rumours (复数)、rumoured (过去分词)、rumouring (现在分词)
rumour.en: Commonly used in expressions like "rumour — 谣传" (n.).

missing.tip: missing作形容词表不见或缺失；be missing from表缺少。
missing.en: lost or absent, with whereabouts unknown

artificial.en: Made by people rather than occurring naturally

flash.tip: 高频搭配：in a flash (瞬间) / flash memory (闪速存储器)；同族词：flashed (过去式)、flashing (现在分词)、flashes (复数)
flash.en: Commonly used in expressions like "in a flash (瞬间)" (n./v.).

widow.tip: widow指丧偶女性；丧偶男性用widower。
widow.en: a woman whose spouse has died and who has not remarried

heating.tip: 指供暖时通常不可数：turn on the heating。
heating.en: The system or process that keeps a building warm.

roman.tip: 高频搭配：roman empire (罗马帝国（指公元前27年到公元476年的罗马奴隶制国家）) / roman catholic (罗马天主教的)；同族词：romans (复数)
roman.en: Commonly used in expressions like "roman empire (罗马帝国（指公元前27年到公元476年的罗马奴隶制国家）)" (n./adj.).

fraction.tip: a fraction of常强调占比极小，不只是一般部分。
fraction.en: a small part or amount of something

reluctant.tip: 常用be reluctant to do，表示不愿做某事。
reluctant.en: Unwilling or hesitant to do something.

elbow.tip: elbow作动词时常指用肘推挤着前进。
elbow.en: the joint where your arm bends

deadly.tip: 虽以-ly结尾，deadly也常作形容词，意为致命的。
deadly.en: Causing death or likely to cause death.

confuse.tip: confused形容人感到困惑；confusing形容事物令人困惑。
confuse.en: To make someone unable to understand or think clearly.

disadvantage.tip: 表示处于不利地位用at a disadvantage。
disadvantage.en: something that makes success harder or reduces something's value

airplane.tip: airplane常用于美式英语，英式通常用aeroplane。
airplane.en: A powered flying vehicle with fixed wings.

monthly.tip: monthly既可作形容词，也可作副词。
monthly.en: Happening, produced, or paid once every month.

mud.tip: mud通常不可数；形容泥泞用muddy。
mud.en: Soft, wet earth made when soil mixes with water.

mechanical.tip: mechanical指机器相关；mechanic指机械修理工。
mechanical.en: relating to machines or their moving parts

duck.tip: 指鸭子时可数，指鸭肉时不可数。
duck.en: A waterbird with a broad bill, or its meat

drift.tip: drift强调随水、风移动，或缺乏明确方向。
drift.en: To move slowly, carried by water or air.

lorry.tip: lorry主要用于英式英语，美式英语通常用truck。
lorry.en: A large road vehicle used for carrying goods.

harbour.en: A sheltered area of water where boats can stay safely.

warmth.tip: 通常不可数；既指温度舒适，也指待人亲切。

dock.tip: 高频搭配：dock in (进坞) / loading dock (n. 码头)；同族词：docks (复数)、docked (过去分词)、docking (现在分词)
dock.en: Commonly used in expressions like "dock in (进坞)" (n.).

suburb.tip: 常用in the suburbs；suburb不等于乡村。
suburb.en: A mainly residential area outside a city's central part.

uncertain.tip: 人没把握用uncertain about；事情未定用remain uncertain。

magnificent.tip: 多形容景色、建筑或成就，不表示品德高尚。

trunk.tip: 汽车后备箱美式用trunk，英式用boot。
trunk.en: The thick main stem of a tree.

motivate.tip: 常用motivate sb to do；by后可接动机。
motivate.en: to make someone eager to do something

landing.tip: 除“着陆”外，也指楼梯顶部或中间的平台。
landing.en: The act of reaching the ground or shore.

devil.tip: 高频搭配：like the devil (猛烈地) / a devil of a (讨厌…的，异常的…，非常恼人(或糟糕)的)；同族词：devils (复数)、devilled (过去式)、devilling (现在分词)
devil.en: Commonly used in expressions like "like the devil (猛烈地)" (n.).

lens.tip: 复数为lenses；隐形眼镜常用contact lenses。
lens.en: A curved transparent piece that focuses or spreads light.

enforce.tip: enforce后接法律或规定；迫使某人做事用force。
enforce.en: Make sure that people obey a law or rule.

triumph.tip: 作动词时常用triumph over，表示战胜。
triumph.en: An important victory or impressive achievement.

toilet.tip: 美式toilet通常指马桶；问公共洗手间常用restroom。
toilet.en: a bowl-shaped fixture used for getting rid of bodily waste

cliff.tip: cliff强调陡峭岩壁，不泛指山坡。
cliff.en: A high, very steep rock face, often beside the sea.

chemistry.tip: 学科名通常不可数：study chemistry，不加a。
chemistry.en: the science of substances and how they react

nail.tip: 既指指甲也指钉子；作动词表示用钉子固定。
nail.en: The hard covering at the end of a finger or toe.

assemble.tip: 组装物品时及物；表示人集合时也可不及物。
assemble.en: to join separate parts together to make something

provoke.tip: provoke不只指激怒，也常指引发讨论或反应。
provoke.en: To cause a reaction, feeling, or event.

loyalty.tip: 高频搭配：customer loyalty (客户忠诚度) / brand loyalty (品牌忠诚度)；同族词：loyalties (复数)
loyalty.en: Commonly used in expressions like "customer loyalty (客户忠诚度)" (n.).

stimulate.tip: 直接接宾语：stimulate interest表示激发兴趣。
stimulate.en: to encourage something to develop or become more active

cave.tip: cave指洞穴；动词短语cave in表示坍塌或屈服。
cave.en: A large natural hollow inside rock or under the ground.

refusal.tip: 表示拒绝做某事，用refusal to do，不用of doing。
refusal.en: an act of saying you will not do or accept something

chap.tip: 高频搭配：old chap ([主英国口语][用作招呼语]老兄，老伙计，老弟[亦称作 old boy， old fellow])；同族词：chaps (复数)、chapping (现在分词)、chapped (过去式)
chap.en: Commonly used in expressions like "old chap ([主英国口语][用作招呼语]老兄，老伙计，老弟[亦称作 old boy， old fellow])" (n.).

colonel.tip: 发音与kernel相同，字母l在此不发/l/音。
colonel.en: a senior army or air force officer

diplomatic.tip: 既可指国家间外交，也可形容说话处事得体。
diplomatic.en: relating to official relations between countries

obstacle.tip: 高频搭配：obstacle course (n. 超越障碍训练场)；同族词：obstacles (复数)
obstacle.en: Commonly used in expressions like "obstacle course (n. 超越障碍训练场)" (n.).

filter.tip: filter out后接被滤除的东西，不是保留下来的。
filter.en: a device that removes unwanted substances from liquid or air

marine.tip: marine侧重海洋；海军的通常用naval。
marine.en: Relating to the sea or organisms living in it

flood.tip: 读音与 blood 的元音相同，不与 food 押韵。
flood.en: Water covering land that is normally dry.

nightmare.tip: 通常作可数名词；形容词形式为nightmarish。
nightmare.en: a frightening or deeply unpleasant dream

mathematics.tip: 虽以s结尾，作学科名用单数谓语；英式简称maths。
mathematics.en: The study of quantities, shapes, patterns, and their relationships.

flexibility.tip: 既可指安排可变通，也可指身体或材料的柔韧性。
flexibility.en: the ability to change or adapt to different needs

drain.tip: 高频搭配：down the drain (浪费掉) / brain drain (人才外流)；同族词：drains (复数)、drained (过去分词)、draining (现在分词)
drain.en: Commonly used in expressions like "down the drain (浪费掉)" (v./n.).

bacteria.tip: 高频搭配：lactic acid bacteria (乳酸菌) / pathogenic bacteria (致病菌)；同族词：bacterium (词根/原形)
bacteria.en: Commonly used in expressions like "lactic acid bacteria (乳酸菌)" (n.).

sociology.tip: 高频搭配：sociology of law (法律社会学) / economic sociology (经济社会学)；同族词：sociologies (复数)
sociology.en: Commonly used in expressions like "sociology of law (法律社会学)" (n.).

outdoor.tip: outdoor是形容词；表示在户外用副词outdoors。
outdoor.en: happening, used, or located outside a building

broadcast.tip: 过去式和过去分词通常都为broadcast。
broadcast.en: To transmit programmes through radio, television, or the internet.

suck.tip: 表示“很糟糕”时属非正式用语，不宜用于学术写作。
suck.en: To draw liquid or air in using the mouth

realistic.tip: realistic强调符合现实或逼真，real强调真实存在。
realistic.en: Based on what is actually possible or likely

intelligent.en: Able to learn, understand, and think well.

wrist.tip: 开头的w不发音；手腕是wrist，脚踝是ankle。
wrist.en: The joint connecting your hand to your arm.

continent.en: one of the Earth's main large areas of land

unite.tip: unite可及物也可不及物，强调为共同目标联合。
unite.en: To join together or bring people together for a shared purpose.

liberty.tip: 高频搭配：at liberty (自由) / statue of liberty (n. 自由女神)；同族词：liberties (复数)
liberty.en: Commonly used in expressions like "at liberty (自由)" (n.).

ridiculous.tip: 语气较强，强调荒唐不合理，不只是有趣。
ridiculous.en: Extremely silly or unreasonable and deserving to be laughed at.

receipt.tip: p不发音；表示收入时通常用复数receipts。
receipt.en: a document showing that something has been paid for

avenue.tip: 比喻义常见avenue for/of，表示途径。
avenue.en: a wide street, often lined with trees

dump.tip: 高频搭配：dump truck (自动倾卸卡车) / waste dump (废石堆，废料堆)；同族词：dumped (过去分词)、dumping (现在分词)、dumps (复数)
dump.en: Commonly used in expressions like "dump truck (自动倾卸卡车)" (v.).

merit.tip: 高频搭配：on its merits (根据事物本身的优缺点) / merit and demerit (优缺点)；同族词：merits (复数)、merited (过去式)、meriting (现在分词)
merit.en: Commonly used in expressions like "on its merits (根据事物本身的优缺点)" (n./v.).

execute.tip: 高频搭配：execute plan (执行计划)；同族词：executed (过去分词)、executing (现在分词)、executes (第三人称单数)
execute.en: Commonly used in expressions like "execute plan (执行计划)" (v.).

equip.tip: 常用equip A with B；过去式equipped双写p。
equip.en: To provide someone or something with necessary tools or equipment

limb.tip: 高频搭配：lower limb ([医]下肢) / out on a limb (孤立无援)；同族词：limbs (复数)、limbed (过去式)
limb.en: Commonly used in expressions like "lower limb ([医]下肢)" (n.).

spectacular.tip: 既可形容壮观景象，也可修饰growth等抽象名词。
spectacular.en: extremely impressive to see or experience

tune.tip: in tune指音调准确；out of tune指走调。
tune.en: a series of musical notes forming a recognizable pattern

nasty.tip: 比bad更带厌恶感；形容人时通常指刻薄、不友善。
nasty.en: Very unpleasant to experience, taste, smell, or see.

railroad.tip: 高频搭配：railroad car (有轨电车) / railroad industry (铁路工业)；同族词：railroads (复数)、railroaded (过去分词)、railroading (现在分词)
railroad.en: Commonly used in expressions like "railroad car (有轨电车)" (n./v.).

endure.tip: 表“忍受”直接接宾语；表“持续”可不接宾语。
endure.en: To suffer something difficult or unpleasant without giving up.

radiation.tip: 通常不可数；辐射不只指核辐射，也包括阳光。
radiation.en: Energy travelling through space or matter as waves or particles.

horn.tip: 动物的角和车辆喇叭都用horn，均为可数名词。
horn.en: A hard pointed growth on the head of some animals.

peaceful.tip: 可形容环境安静，也可指行动不使用暴力。
peaceful.en: quiet and calm, without disturbance or worry

copper.tip: 表示金属铜时不可数；表示铜币时可数。
copper.en: a reddish-brown metal used for wires, pipes, and coins

residence.tip: residence较正式；居民是resident，住宅区用residential。
residence.en: A house or other place where someone lives.

fool.tip: fool作名词称呼别人有贬义；动词可接into doing。
fool.en: someone who behaves without good sense or judgment

heading.tip: heading常指章节标题；headline多指新闻标题。
heading.en: words introducing the subject of a document or section

bureau.tip: 复数可用bureaux或bureaus；家具义有英美差异。
bureau.en: an office or organisation providing information or managing particular activities

pad.tip: 高频搭配：brake pad (刹车片) / pad printing (移印)；同族词：pads (复数)、padded (过去式)、padding (现在分词)
pad.en: Commonly used in expressions like "brake pad (刹车片)" (n./v.).

transmission.tip: 动词是 transmit；过去式 transmitted 双写 t。
transmission.en: The process of passing something from one place to another.

spill.tip: 过去式和过去分词可用spilled或spilt。
spill.en: To accidentally let liquid or loose material escape its container.

envelope.en: A flat paper container used for sending a letter.

twist.tip: twist既可指实际扭转，也可指歪曲事实。
twist.en: turn something so its parts rotate in different directions
