umbrella.en: a folding cover on a stick protecting against rain or sun

underneath.tip: 后接名词时是介词；单独使用时是副词。
underneath.en: Directly below something, often covered or hidden by it.

spider.tip: 蜘蛛有八条腿，不属于六条腿的昆虫。
spider.en: a small creature with eight legs, often making webs

vigorous.tip: 高频搭配：vigorous — 朝气蓬勃的；同族词：vigorous (adj.)
vigorous.en: Commonly used in expressions like "vigorous — 朝气蓬勃的" (adj.).

pillar.tip: pillar of可比喻某体系的支柱或群体的中坚。
pillar.en: A strong upright structure that supports part of a building.

restrain.tip: 常用restrain sb from doing，表示阻止某人做某事。
restrain.en: to prevent someone or something from moving or acting freely

physicist.en: A scientist who studies matter, energy, and their interactions.

salesman.tip: salesman明确指男性；不强调性别时用salesperson。
salesman.en: A man whose job is to sell goods or services.

cultivate.tip: 既可指种植作物，也可指有意识地培养兴趣或关系。
cultivate.en: To prepare land for crops or grow plants

agony.tip: 高频搭配：agony of ((感情上的)突然而强烈的爆发，任何精神上的激动) / in agony (痛苦不堪)；同族词：agonies (复数)
agony.en: Commonly used in expressions like "agony of ((感情上的)突然而强烈的爆发，任何精神上的激动)" (n.).

microphone.en: A device that captures sound for recording or making it louder.

bracket.tip: 高频搭配：mounting bracket (安装支架) / support bracket (支架)；同族词：brackets (复数)、bracketed (过去分词)、bracketing (现在分词)
bracket.en: Commonly used in expressions like "mounting bracket (安装支架)" (n./v.).

aluminium.en: A light, silver-coloured metal used in cans and aircraft.

meadow.tip: meadow多指乡间草地，不是修剪整齐的lawn。
meadow.en: a field of grass, often containing wildflowers

cherry.en: A small round fruit with a stone and usually red skin

unwilling.tip: 常用be unwilling to do；不愿做不等于unable不能做。
unwilling.en: not wanting or agreeing to do something

plug.tip: 插头是plug，插座是socket；plug in表示插电。
plug.en: A device connecting electrical equipment to a power socket.

uneasy.tip: uneasy意为不安，不是“不容易”；常接about。
uneasy.en: Feeling worried or uncomfortable about a situation.

accord.tip: of your own accord意为自愿地，无需别人要求。
accord.en: A formal agreement between countries, groups, or organisations.

heap.tip: a heap of 指一堆；heaps of 口语中表示大量。
heap.en: A pile of things placed together without careful arrangement.

bundle.tip: a bundle of后接复数名词；bundle up也指穿暖。
bundle.en: A group of things tied or wrapped together.

axis.tip: 复数是 axes /ˈæksiːz/，注意与 axe 的复数区分。
axis.en: a real or imaginary line around which something turns

applause.tip: 不可数；“一阵掌声”用 a round of applause。
applause.en: the sound of people clapping to show approval

spontaneous.tip: 强调非预先安排，不等于“无意识的”。
spontaneous.en: Happening naturally without being planned or deliberately caused

presently.tip: 高频搭配：presently — 一会儿；同族词：presently (adv.)
presently.en: Commonly used in expressions like "presently — 一会儿" (adv.).

simplicity.tip: simplicity通常不可数；simple的名词形式。
simplicity.en: The quality of being easy to understand or use.

picnic.tip: 动词过去式为picnicked，进行形式为picnicking。
picnic.en: a meal eaten outdoors, usually with food brought from home

feast.tip: 动词常用feast on，表示尽情享用某种食物。
feast.en: A large, special meal with plenty of food.

mould.tip: 高频搭配：injection mould (注塑模具) / mould design (模具设计)；同族词：moulds (复数)、moulded (过去分词)、moulding (现在分词)
mould.en: Commonly used in expressions like "injection mould (注塑模具)" (n./v.).

dairy.tip: 高频搭配：dairy industry (乳品业，乳品加工业) / dairy product (乳制品)；同族词：dairies (复数)、dairying (现在分词)
dairy.en: Commonly used in expressions like "dairy industry (乳品业，乳品加工业)" (n.).

interpreter.tip: interpreter 通常做口译；translator 通常做笔译。
interpreter.en: Someone who translates spoken or signed communication between languages.

collision.tip: 高频搭配：collision detection ([计]碰撞检测) / collision avoidance (碰撞避免，冲突避免)；同族词：collisions (复数)
collision.en: Commonly used in expressions like "collision detection ([计]碰撞检测)" (n.).

dash.tip: 高频搭配：dash forward (插上) / a dash of (少许)；同族词：dashed (过去式)、dashing (现在分词)、dashes (复数)
dash.en: Commonly used in expressions like "dash forward (插上)" (v./n.).

verify.tip: verify强调核实真伪或准确性，后接名词或从句。
verify.en: to check that something is true, accurate, or genuine

rude.tip: 对某人无礼用 rude to someone，不用 rude with。
rude.en: speaking or behaving without respect for others

mat.tip: mat通常是小块功能性垫子，不等同于carpet。
mat.en: A piece of material covering or protecting a surface.

fairy.tip: 高频搭配：fairy tale (神话故事，童话) / fairy story (神话)；同族词：fairies (复数)
fairy.en: Commonly used in expressions like "fairy tale (神话故事，童话)" (n.).

astronaut.en: a person trained to travel and work in space

outset.tip: 常用于at/from the outset，不用于set outset。
outset.en: The beginning of an activity, process, or period.

crust.tip: 地壳用the Earth's crust；面包皮也用crust。
crust.en: The firm outer layer of bread or pastry.

flu.tip: flu通常不可数；英式常说have flu，美式常加the。
flu.en: an infectious illness causing fever, aches, and tiredness

sausage.tip: 单根香肠可数；sausage meat指香肠肉馅，不可数。
sausage.en: finely chopped meat enclosed in a thin, tube-shaped skin

notify.tip: 高频搭配：notify party (到货受通知人) / also notify (另请通知)；同族词：notified (过去分词)、notifying (现在分词)、notifies (第三人称单数)
notify.en: Commonly used in expressions like "notify party (到货受通知人)" (v.).

lieutenant.tip: 英式开头读/lef/，美式读/luː/；军衔译名因军种而异。
lieutenant.en: An officer holding a junior rank in the armed forces

mosquito.en: A small flying insect whose females bite and suck blood.

nationality.tip: nationality指国籍，不等同于出生地或族裔。
nationality.en: the legal status of belonging to a particular country

thoughtful.tip: 体贴用thoughtful of someone；thoughtful不一定表示忧虑。
thoughtful.en: showing care for other people's needs and feelings

linen.tip: 通常不可数；bed linen不一定由亚麻制成。
linen.en: strong cloth made from fibres of the flax plant

optional.tip: optional表示不强制，不是“随便的”或“随机的”。
optional.en: available to choose but not required

aloud.tip: aloud强调发出声音，不一定像loudly那样响亮。
aloud.en: With an audible voice rather than silently.

jealous.tip: 常用be jealous of；既可指嫉妒，也可指吃醋。
jealous.en: unhappy because someone has something you want

cigar.tip: cigar是雪茄；cigarette是通常用纸卷制的香烟。
cigar.en: a thick roll of dried tobacco leaves made for smoking

rainbow.tip: 通常是可数名词；a rainbow of表示色彩缤纷的一系列。
rainbow.en: a curved band of colours appearing in the sky after rain

recreation.tip: 表示休闲娱乐通常不可数；别与re-creation重新创造混淆。
recreation.en: Activities done for enjoyment and relaxation when not working.

liquor.tip: 通常指烈酒；liqueur则指利口酒，注意拼写。
liquor.en: Strong alcoholic drink made by distillation.

span.tip: span作动词直接接时间或范围，无需加介词。
span.en: The period during which something lasts or happens

chimney.en: a structure that carries smoke from a fire outside

cube.tip: 高频搭配：water cube (水立方（北京奥运会主游泳馆）) / rubik's cube (魔术方块)；同族词：cubes (复数)、cubed (过去分词)、cubing (现在分词)
cube.en: Commonly used in expressions like "water cube (水立方（北京奥运会主游泳馆）)" (n.).

dim.en: not bright or providing little light

footstep.tip: 常用复数；footprint指留下的脚印。
footstep.en: a step taken when walking, or the sound it makes

plantation.tip: 通常指大面积种植单类作物的农场，不是普通花园。
plantation.en: A large farm growing crops such as tea, coffee, or cotton.

predictable.tip: 既可表示结果可预料，也可贬指情节老套。
predictable.en: Happening or behaving in a way that can be expected.

sunset.tip: 表示在日落时用at sunset，通常不加冠词。
sunset.en: the time when the sun disappears below the horizon

housewife.en: A married woman managing her home rather than doing paid work.

antique.tip: antique强调古老且有收藏价值，不只是旧。
antique.en: An old object valued for its age, beauty, or rarity

toast.tip: 表示烤面包时不可数；表示一次祝酒时可数。
toast.en: Sliced bread browned and made crisp by heat.

courtyard.tip: 强调由建筑或墙围合的露天空间，不等同于花园。
courtyard.en: an outdoor area partly or completely enclosed by walls or buildings

cough.tip: gh在此发/f/；have a cough表示有咳嗽症状。
cough.en: Force air suddenly from your throat with a rough sound.

communism.tip: 高频搭配：communism — 共产主义；同族词：communism (n.)
communism.en: Commonly used in expressions like "communism — 共产主义" (n.).

curse.tip: curse可指咒骂或诅咒；swear也可指发誓。
curse.en: to use rude words because you are angry

freight.tip: 名词通常不可数；cargo主要指货物，不指货运服务。
freight.en: goods transported in bulk, or the transport of such goods

mug.tip: mug通常有柄、较大；作动词可指拦路抢劫。
mug.en: a large cup with a handle, usually for hot drinks

maths.tip: 英式用 maths，美式用 math；作主语用单数动词。
maths.en: The study of quantities, shapes, and relationships using logical rules

stain.tip: 污渍用stain；普通颜色不叫stain，染色剂则可以。
stain.en: a dirty or coloured mark that is difficult to remove

shave.en: To remove hair from skin using a razor.

spelling.tip: 指拼写能力通常不可数；指具体拼法可数。
spelling.en: forming words correctly using their written characters

kettle.tip: kettle 用来烧水，teapot 用来泡茶。
kettle.en: A container with a handle and spout for boiling water.

playground.tip: 主要指儿童玩耍场所，不泛指专业体育场。
playground.en: An outdoor area where children play, often with special equipment.

delete.tip: 常用delete something from...表示从某处删除。
delete.en: To remove written material or stored information.

brandy.tip: 通常不可数；a brandy可指一杯白兰地。
brandy.en: A strong alcoholic drink distilled from wine or fermented fruit juice.

harmful.tip: 表示对……有害用harmful to，不用harmful for。
harmful.en: causing or likely to cause damage or injury

ant.tip: ant是可数名词；一只蚂蚁用an ant。
ant.en: A small insect that lives in organised groups.

tuition.tip: 不可数；英式谈学费常用tuition fees。
tuition.en: money paid for teaching at a school or university

inexpensive.tip: 比cheap更中性，通常不暗示质量差。

bark.tip: 狗叫声可数；树皮通常不可数。
bark.en: to make the short, loud sound of a dog

fascinate.tip: 事物令人着迷用fascinating；人感到着迷用fascinated。
fascinate.en: to attract and hold someone's attention very strongly

generator.tip: 由generate加-or构成，既指机器也可指程序。
generator.en: A machine that converts other forms of energy into electricity.

cafe.tip: 也写作café；通常提供饮料和简餐。
cafe.en: A small place serving drinks and light meals.

adjective.tip: 形容词常放在名词前或系动词后，如a cold day。
adjective.en: a word that describes a person, thing, or state

nucleus.tip: 复数为nuclei；可指细胞核或原子核。
nucleus.en: The part of a cell containing most of its genetic material.

kite.tip: “放风筝”用 fly a kite，不用 play a kite。
kite.en: A lightweight frame flown in the wind on a string

nitrogen.tip: nitrogen是不可数名词，化学符号为N。
nitrogen.en: A chemical element forming most of the gas in Earth's air.

transparent.tip: 透明强调看得清；translucent指透光但看不清。
transparent.en: Allowing light through so objects behind can be seen clearly.

velocity.tip: 物理中velocity含方向，speed只表示快慢。
velocity.en: Speed of movement, including direction in physics.

aviation.tip: 不可数名词，常指飞行活动或整个航空业。
aviation.en: The activity or industry of flying and operating aircraft.

voltage.tip: 高频搭配：low voltage (低电压) / output voltage (输出电压)；同族词：voltages (复数)
voltage.en: Commonly used in expressions like "low voltage (低电压)" (n.).

grammatical.tip: 可指“语法方面的”，也可指句子“符合语法的”。
grammatical.en: relating to the rules for forming words and sentences

strap.tip: strap作动词时，过去式为strapped，现在分词为strapping。
strap.en: a narrow strip used to carry, hold, or fasten something

conductor.tip: 导体常搭配of heat或of electricity。
conductor.en: Someone who directs an orchestra or choir

sway.tip: sway既可指身体摇摆，也可指影响观点或决定。
sway.en: To move slowly from side to side, or cause this movement.

whichever.tip: 高频搭配：whichever — 无论哪个；同族词：whichever (pron&adj.)
whichever.en: Commonly used in expressions like "whichever — 无论哪个" (pron&adj.).

exaggerate.tip: 高频搭配：exaggerate — 夸张；同族词：exaggerated (过去分词)、exaggerating (现在分词)、exaggerates (第三人称单数)
exaggerate.en: Commonly used in expressions like "exaggerate — 夸张" (v.).

overtake.tip: 过去式 overtook，过去分词 overtaken。
overtake.en: To catch up with and move ahead of someone.

recreational.tip: 常修饰activities或facilities，强调休闲而非工作。
recreational.en: Done for enjoyment and relaxation rather than work.

lick.tip: lick指用舌头舔；咬用bite，吸吮用suck。
lick.en: Move your tongue across something, often to taste it.

precaution.tip: 常用 take precautions；as a precaution 表示以防万一。
precaution.en: an action taken to prevent danger, damage, or problems

tense.tip: 作名词指语法“时态”；作形容词指紧张或绷紧。
tense.en: Nervous and unable to relax, or stretched tightly.

inferior.tip: 比较用inferior to，不用than；feel inferior指自卑。
inferior.en: Lower in quality, value, or ability than something else.

correction.tip: 具体一处修改可数；泛指纠正过程时常不可数。
correction.en: A change that fixes an error, or the act of fixing it.

acquaintance.tip: 指熟人时可数；表示了解时常接with。
acquaintance.en: Someone you know, but who is not a close friend.

humble.tip: 谦逊是humble；不要与“羞辱”humiliate混淆。
humble.en: Not believing or acting as though you are better than others.

gum.tip: 口香糖不可数；牙龈通常用复数gums。
gum.en: A sweet substance chewed but not swallowed

audio.tip: 高频搭配：digital audio (数字音频) / audio signal (声频信号)；同族词：audios (复数)
audio.en: Commonly used in expressions like "digital audio (数字音频)" (adj.).

swift.en: Moving quickly or happening after very little delay.

handy.tip: 高频搭配：come in handy (迟早有用)；同族词：handier (比较级)、handies (复数)
handy.en: Commonly used in expressions like "come in handy (迟早有用)" (adj.).

complicate.tip: 及物动词，后接被弄复杂的事物。
complicate.en: to make something harder to understand or deal with

rag.tip: 单数常指一块破布；in rags表示衣衫褴褛。
rag.en: A piece of old cloth, often used for cleaning.

chalk.tip: 高频搭配：chalk it up (v. 记帐) / french chalk (n. 滑石粉)；同族词：chalked (过去式)、chalks (复数)、chalking (现在分词)
chalk.en: Commonly used in expressions like "chalk it up (v. 记帐)" (n.).

hobby.tip: 可数名词，复数为hobbies；开始一种爱好用take up。
hobby.en: An activity you regularly do for pleasure in your free time

decay.tip: 名词通常不可数；tooth decay指龋齿，不是掉牙。
decay.en: to gradually break down through natural processes

gallon.tip: 英制约4.55升，美制约3.79升，注意区分。
gallon.en: A liquid measure, about 4.55 litres British or 3.79 litres American

congratulate.tip: 用congratulate sb on sth，介词不是for。
congratulate.en: Tell someone you are pleased about their success or good fortune.

drip.tip: 英式英语用 on a drip 表示正在输液。
drip.en: To fall or let liquid fall in separate drops.

doubtless.tip: 常表示有把握的推测，不一定是绝对确定。
doubtless.en: Almost certainly, or as one confidently expects.

loosen.tip: loosen是动词；loose是形容词，勿混淆lose。
loosen.en: to make or become less tight or firmly attached

cellar.tip: 高频搭配：wine cellar (酒窖) / cellar door (地窖的门)；同族词：cellars (复数)
cellar.en: Commonly used in expressions like "wine cellar (酒窖)" (n.).

procession.tip: 高频搭配：funeral procession (送葬)；同族词：processions (复数)
procession.en: Commonly used in expressions like "funeral procession (送葬)" (n.).

honourable.tip: 高频搭配：honourable — 诚实的；同族词：honourables (复数)
honourable.en: Commonly used in expressions like "honourable — 诚实的" (adj.).

sticky.tip: sticky weather指湿热天气；sticky situation指困境。
sticky.en: able to stick to things, often because of a substance

appliance.tip: 高频搭配：home appliance (家电产品) / electric appliance (家用电器)；同族词：appliances (复数)
appliance.en: Commonly used in expressions like "home appliance (家电产品)" (n.).

infinite.tip: 通常作形容词；表示“无穷”常用名词infinity。

gauge.tip: 读音同gage；既可用仪器测量，也可凭信息判断。
gauge.en: To judge or measure the amount, level, or nature of something

inhabit.tip: 及物动词，直接接地点，不加in。
inhabit.en: To live in a particular place or environment

pigeon.tip: 注意拼写pigeon；同音词pidgin指洋泾浜语。
pigeon.en: A plump bird with short legs, commonly seen in cities

ripe.tip: 水果成熟用ripe；人心智成熟通常用mature。
ripe.en: Fully grown and ready to eat or harvest

coordination.tip: 通常不可数；between引出需要协调的双方或多方。
coordination.en: Organising people or activities so they work effectively together

jewel.tip: jewel可数；jewellery指珠宝总称，不可数。
jewel.en: A valuable stone, often used in decorative personal objects.

hen.tip: 高频搭配：hen — 母鸡；同族词：hens (复数)
hen.en: Commonly used in expressions like "hen — 母鸡" (n.).

mold.tip: 美式拼写mold，英式通常写mould；也指霉菌。
mold.en: a shaped container in which a material sets into shape

cushion.tip: 动词常搭配impact或blow，表示减轻冲击。
cushion.en: A soft filled bag used for comfort or support.

dial.tip: 过去式英式常用dialled，美式常用dialed。
dial.en: A marked face or rotating control on an instrument

bacon.tip: 通常不可数；一片培根用a slice of bacon。
bacon.en: salted or smoked pork, usually served in thin slices

berry.tip: 复数为berries；日常用法与植物学定义有差异。
berry.en: a small, usually round fruit, often growing in clusters

indoor.en: Located, used, or happening inside a building.

kindergarten.tip: 美式常指小学前的一年；英式幼儿园常用nursery。
kindergarten.en: A school or class for children beginning their education

utter.tip: 形容词utter只放名词前；副词用utterly。
utter.en: Complete or total, used to emphasise something

detection.tip: 通常不可数；detection of后接被发现或检测的对象。
detection.en: The act of discovering or noticing something difficult to find.

upward.tip: 高频搭配：upward pressure (上压力) / upward tendency (上涨的趋势)；同族词：upward (adj.)
upward.en: Commonly used in expressions like "upward pressure (上压力)" (adj.).

imitate.tip: 直接接模仿的对象，不加介词：imitate someone。
imitate.en: To copy someone's actions, speech, or way of doing something

roller.tip: 高频搭配：roller bearing (滚柱轴承) / roller coaster (过山车)；同族词：rollers (复数)、rollered (过去式)、rollering (现在分词)
roller.en: Commonly used in expressions like "roller bearing (滚柱轴承)" (n.).

heroic.tip: heroic effort强调付出极大努力，不一定涉及危险。
heroic.en: Showing great courage, especially when helping others

honesty.tip: 高频搭配：honesty — 诚实；同族词：honesty (n.)
honesty.en: Commonly used in expressions like "honesty — 诚实" (n.).

fearful.tip: 高频搭配：fearful of (惧怕)；同族词：fearful (adj.)
fearful.en: Commonly used in expressions like "fearful of (惧怕)" (adj.).

consultancy.tip: 高频搭配：consultancy service (咨询服务) / consultancy company (点子公司)；同族词：consultancies (复数)
consultancy.en: Commonly used in expressions like "consultancy service (咨询服务)" (n.).

standpoint.tip: 常用from a ... standpoint表示“从……角度看”。
standpoint.en: a position from which someone considers or judges something

empower.tip: 常用empower sb to do sth，表示赋能或授权。
empower.en: Give someone confidence or control over their own life.

groan.tip: 高频搭配：groan — 哼；同族词：groaned (过去式)、groaning (现在分词)、groans (复数)
groan.en: Commonly used in expressions like "groan — 哼" (v./n.).

saddle.tip: saddle someone with指使某人承担不想要的负担。
saddle.en: a seat on a horse or bicycle

preceding.tip: preceding指所谈时间或事物之前的，不等于现在之前。
preceding.en: Happening or appearing before the thing being discussed.

abundant.tip: abundant强调数量充足；名词搭配an abundance of。
abundant.en: Available in large amounts, often more than needed.

lazy.tip: lazy afternoon指悠闲的午后，不一定含贬义。
lazy.en: unwilling to work or make an effort

proportional.tip: 常与to搭配；成正比用directly proportional to。
proportional.en: changing in a constant ratio to another quantity

odour.tip: 英式拼写odour，美式odor；常指难闻气味。
odour.en: A noticeable smell, especially an unpleasant one.

magnet.tip: 比喻吸引某类人时常用a magnet for。
magnet.en: an object that attracts iron and certain other metals

emit.tip: 过去式 emitted，进行式 emitting，均双写 t。
emit.en: to release gas, heat, light, or sound

noun.tip: 名词不只指实物，也可指advice等抽象概念。
noun.en: a word naming a person, place, thing, quality, or idea

stripe.tip: 高频搭配：magnetic stripe (磁条，磁片)；同族词：stripes (复数)、striped (过去分词)、striping (现在分词)
stripe.en: Commonly used in expressions like "magnetic stripe (磁条，磁片)" (n.).

foremost.tip: 高频搭配：first and foremost (首先)；同族词：foremost (adj.)
foremost.en: Commonly used in expressions like "first and foremost (首先)" (adj.).

sorrow.tip: 表示悲伤情绪通常不可数；具体伤心事可数。
sorrow.en: deep sadness caused by loss or disappointment

volcano.en: A mountain with an opening that releases lava, ash, and gases

greeting.tip: 表示节日祝福常用复数greetings，如birthday greetings。
greeting.en: Words or actions used when meeting or welcoming someone.

oblige.tip: be obliged to do表示被迫或有义务做某事。
oblige.en: Require someone to act because of rules or circumstances

noticeable.tip: noticeable指容易察觉；notable侧重值得关注。

enlarge.tip: enlarge指扩大；enlarge on指进一步详述。
enlarge.en: To become bigger or make something bigger.

sore.tip: sore常修饰身体部位，如a sore throat。
sore.en: painful, especially when touched or moved

nephew.tip: nephew 指男性晚辈；女性对应词是 niece。
nephew.en: A son of your sibling or your spouse's sibling.

vacant.tip: 高频搭配：vacant space (空舱位) / vacant room (空房)；同族词：vacant (adj.)
vacant.en: Commonly used in expressions like "vacant space (空舱位)" (adj.).

fertilizer.tip: 英式也拼作fertiliser；泛指肥料时常不可数。
fertilizer.en: a substance added to soil to help plants grow

gratitude.tip: 对人感激用to，对某事感激用for；通常不可数。
gratitude.en: A feeling of thankfulness for help or kindness received.

altitude.tip: altitude指高度；attitude指态度，注意拼写区别。
altitude.en: Height above sea level or above the ground.

tidy.tip: tidy强调摆放整齐；clean强调没有污垢。
tidy.en: Neatly arranged, with everything in its proper place.

hardship.tip: 泛指困苦通常不可数；具体磨难可用 hardships。
hardship.en: severe difficulty or suffering, especially from lacking basic necessities

hopeless.en: Having no hope, or offering no chance of success.

aeroplane.tip: 英式用aeroplane，美式用airplane；口语常用plane。
aeroplane.en: A powered flying vehicle with fixed wings.

cement.tip: cement是水泥；concrete是含水泥、砂石的混凝土。
cement.en: Powder mixed with water to bind building materials together.

undo.tip: 高频搭配：undo — 解开；同族词：undone (过去分词)、undid (过去式)、undoing (现在分词)
undo.en: Commonly used in expressions like "undo — 解开" (v.).

collaborative.tip: 高频搭配：collaborative learning (协作学习) / collaborative filtering (协同过滤)；同族词：collaborative (adj.)
collaborative.en: Commonly used in expressions like "collaborative learning (协作学习)" (adj.).

feasible.tip: 指条件允许、实际可行，不等于“可信”。
feasible.en: possible and practical to achieve with available resources

fuss.tip: make a fuss指大惊小怪；fuss over指过分操心。
fuss.en: unnecessary excitement, worry, or activity about something

accustomed.tip: 高频搭配：become accustomed to (习惯于) / get accustomed to (变得习惯于，习惯于)；同族词：accustomed (adj.)
accustomed.en: Commonly used in expressions like "become accustomed to (习惯于)" (adj.).

rotten.tip: 高频搭配：rotten apple ([美俚]坏家伙) / feel rotten (觉得不舒服)；同族词：rotten (adj.)
rotten.en: Commonly used in expressions like "rotten apple ([美俚]坏家伙)" (adj.).

blossom.tip: 多指树木的花；blossom into可比喻成长为。
blossom.en: a flower or mass of flowers on a tree or bush

spacecraft.en: A vehicle designed to travel or operate in space.

imprison.tip: be imprisoned for后可接罪名，也可接监禁时长。
imprison.en: To put someone in prison or keep them confined.

generic.tip: generic强调非特定；generic medicine通常指仿制药。
generic.en: Relating to a whole group rather than one particular example.

sew.tip: 过去式sewed；过去分词sewn或sewed；与so同音。
sew.en: to join or repair fabric using a needle and thread

ditch.tip: 作动词表示抛弃或放弃时偏口语。
ditch.en: A long narrow channel dug in the ground, often for drainage.

whistle.tip: whistle中的t不发音；吹哨子用blow a whistle。
whistle.en: to make a high sound with lips or escaping air

porter.tip: 不是泛指服务员；通常指搬行李者或门房。
porter.en: Someone employed to carry luggage at hotels or stations.

bud.tip: 动词过去式budded，现在分词budding，双写d。
bud.en: a small growth that develops into a leaf or flower

devotion.tip: 高频搭配：devotion to duty (忠于职守(常用于正式嘉奖大会上)) / devotion aura (虔诚光环)；同族词：devotions (复数)
devotion.en: Commonly used in expressions like "devotion to duty (忠于职守(常用于正式嘉奖大会上))" (n.).

superficial.tip: 高频搭配：superficial velocity (空塔速度) / superficial layer (浅层)；同族词：superficial (adj.)
superficial.en: Commonly used in expressions like "superficial velocity (空塔速度)" (adj.).

scenery.tip: scenery是不可数名词，不说a scenery或sceneries。
scenery.en: The natural features of a place considered for their beauty.

mankind.tip: 指全人类，不指男性；包容性表达可用humankind。
mankind.en: all human beings considered as one group

muddy.tip: 高频搭配：muddy water (浑水)；同族词：muddied (过去分词)、muddies (复数)、muddying (现在分词)
muddy.en: Commonly used in expressions like "muddy water (浑水)" (adj.).

thickness.tip: 表示厚度时常用a thickness of＋具体尺寸。
thickness.en: The distance between two opposite surfaces of something.

hillside.tip: 指山的斜坡部分；在山坡上用 on the hillside。
hillside.en: The sloping surface of a hill.

voyage.tip: 高频搭配：maiden voyage (n. 初航，首航，处女航) / sea voyage (远航，航海)；同族词：voyages (复数)、voyaging (现在分词)、voyaged (过去式)
voyage.en: Commonly used in expressions like "maiden voyage (n. 初航，首航，处女航)" (n&vi./n.).

stocking.tip: 高频搭配：stock market (股票市场) / in stock (有存货)；同族词：stock (词根/原形)、stockings (复数)
stocking.en: Commonly used in expressions like "stock market (股票市场)" (n.).

helpless.tip: helpless是无助的；unhelpful是不肯帮忙或无用的。
helpless.en: Unable to protect yourself or change a difficult situation

conquest.tip: 表示征服行为可不可数；指征服的领土时可数。
conquest.en: the act of taking control of a country by force

slender.tip: 形容身材常含赞美；也可形容机会、优势很小。
slender.en: Thin in an attractive or delicate way.

imaginary.tip: imaginary指想象中的；imaginative指富有想象力的。
imaginary.en: existing only in the mind, not in reality

interruption.tip: 一次打断可数；without interruption表示不间断。
interruption.en: Something that briefly stops an activity, conversation, or continuous process.

hay.tip: 高频搭配：make hay (利用机会去赚钱) / hay fever ([医]枯草热)；同族词：hays (复数)、haying (现在分词)、hayed (过去式)
hay.en: Commonly used in expressions like "make hay (利用机会去赚钱)" (n.).

moan.tip: 表示抱怨时较口语化，常用moan about。
moan.en: To make a low sound expressing pain or unhappiness.

messenger.tip: message 是信息；messenger 是传递信息的人。
messenger.en: a person who carries a message to someone

thunder.tip: thunder指雷声，通常不可数；lightning指闪电。
thunder.en: The loud sound in the sky caused by lightning

moist.tip: moist常指适度湿润；damp常带潮湿、不舒服之意。
moist.en: Slightly wet, rather than dry or soaked.

comrade.tip: 高频搭配：comrade — 同志；同族词：comrades (复数)
comrade.en: Commonly used in expressions like "comrade — 同志" (n.).

tractor.tip: tractor是拖拉机；truck是卡车，注意区别。
tractor.en: A powerful farm vehicle used to pull equipment or loads

abnormal.tip: 常用于医学或异常现象，不宜随意用来评价人。
abnormal.en: Different from what is usual or expected, often causing concern.

revolt.tip: 高频搭配：in revolt (反抗) / revolt against (反感)；同族词：revolts (复数)、revolted (过去式)、revolting (现在分词)
revolt.en: Commonly used in expressions like "in revolt (反抗)" (vi&n.).

excursion.tip: 常指集体休闲短途旅行，搭配go on。
excursion.en: A short journey made for pleasure, often with a group.

cloak.tip: 高频搭配：under the cloak of (◎在…的掩护下)；同族词：cloaks (复数)、cloaked (过去分词)、cloaking (现在分词)
cloak.en: Commonly used in expressions like "under the cloak of (◎在…的掩护下)" (n.).

insult.tip: 动词重音在后；名词读/ˈɪnsʌlt/，重音在前。
insult.en: Say or do something that treats someone with disrespect.

upright.tip: 高频搭配：upright position (正浮位置) / upright post (立柱)；同族词：uprights (复数)、uprighted (过去分词)
upright.en: Commonly used in expressions like "upright position (正浮位置)" (adj.).

submarine.tip: 高频搭配：submarine pipeline (海底管道) / nuclear submarine (核潜艇)；同族词：submarines (复数)、submarining (现在分词)、submarined (过去式)
submarine.en: Commonly used in expressions like "submarine pipeline (海底管道)" (adj./n.).

sideways.tip: 既可作副词也可作形容词；无需再加 -ly。
sideways.en: with one side facing forward, or towards one side

bloom.tip: bloom可作动词；表示正在开花用in bloom。

necklace.tip: 结尾-lace读/ləs/，不是单词lace的读音。
necklace.en: a piece of jewellery worn around the neck

refine.tip: 既可指完善方法，也可指提纯原材料。
refine.en: Improve something by making small, careful changes

oval.tip: oval可作形容词或名词；an oval指一个椭圆形。
oval.en: Having a rounded shape that is longer than it is wide.

synthetic.tip: 高频搭配：synthetic method (综合法) / synthetic aperture (合成孔径)；同族词：synthetics (复数)
synthetic.en: Commonly used in expressions like "synthetic method (综合法)" (adj.).

canoe.tip: 虽译作独木舟，现代canoe不一定由木头制成。
canoe.en: a narrow, light boat moved using paddles

grandson.tip: 不区分父系与母系，既指孙子也指外孙。
grandson.en: the son of your son or daughter

coupon.tip: coupon多指折扣券；voucher也常指预付代金券。
coupon.en: A ticket or code giving a discount or free item.

fireman.tip: 复数为firemen；现代通用表达多用中性的firefighter。
fireman.en: A man whose job is to put out fires.

resistant.en: Not easily damaged or affected by something.

violin.tip: 小提琴手是violinist；拉小提琴常说play the violin。
violin.en: A four-stringed instrument held under the chin and usually bowed.

learned.tip: 意为“博学的”读两音节；作 learn 过去式读一音节。
learned.en: having or showing knowledge gained through extensive study

conversely.tip: 用于引出相反情况，不是一般性的补充转折。
conversely.en: used to introduce an opposite situation or relationship

liar.tip: 高频搭配：liar — 说谎的人；同族词：liars (复数)
liar.en: Commonly used in expressions like "liar — 说谎的人" (n.).

madam.tip: 正式称呼女性时使用；日常熟人交谈中通常不用。
madam.en: A formal, polite way of addressing a woman.

inquire.tip: 高频搭配：inquire into (调查，探究) / inquire about (询问，查问)；同族词：inquired (过去式)、inquiring (现在分词)、inquires (第三人称单数)
inquire.en: Commonly used in expressions like "inquire into (调查，探究)" (v.).

inference.tip: 常用draw an inference from，指根据证据推断。
inference.en: A conclusion reached from evidence rather than direct statements.

sulphur.tip: sulphur是传统英式拼写；科学文献常用sulfur。
sulphur.en: a yellow chemical element used in industry and agriculture

handkerchief.tip: 指擦脸、擦鼻子的手帕，一般不指头巾。
handkerchief.en: A small cloth used for wiping your nose or face.

heave.tip: 高频搭配：frost heave (冻胀) / heave a sigh (叹了口气)；同族词：heaved (过去式)、heaving (现在分词)、heaves (第三人称单数)
heave.en: Commonly used in expressions like "frost heave (冻胀)" (v./n.).

accountancy.tip: 高频搭配：accountancy profession (会计专业)；同族词：accountancy (n.)
accountancy.en: Commonly used in expressions like "accountancy profession (会计专业)" (n.).

clap.en: To strike your hands together, often to show approval.

deepen.tip: 既可及物也可不及物：deepen trust；a crisis deepens。
deepen.en: To become stronger or more complete, or make something so

radioactive.tip: 高频搭配：radioactive waste (放射性废弃物) / radioactive isotope (放射性同位素)；同族词：radioactive (adj.)
radioactive.en: Commonly used in expressions like "radioactive waste (放射性废弃物)" (adj.).

conquer.tip: 及物动词，直接接宾语：conquer a fear。
conquer.en: Take control of a country or place by force.

mourn.tip: 可直接接逝者或损失，也可用mourn for sb。
mourn.en: To feel or express deep sadness after a death or loss.

scarce.tip: scarce指供应不足；rare强调少见，不一定短缺。
scarce.en: not available in large enough amounts to meet demand

multicultural.tip: 高频搭配：multicultural education (多元文化教育)；同族词：multicultural (adj.)
multicultural.en: Commonly used in expressions like "multicultural education (多元文化教育)" (adj.).

pierce.tip: 打耳洞常说have/get your ears pierced。
pierce.en: to make a hole through something with a sharp object

atmospheric.tip: 修饰pressure指大气的；修饰场所常指富有氛围的。
atmospheric.en: Relating to the gases surrounding Earth or another planet.

pear.en: A sweet, juicy fruit, often narrower at the top

sincere.tip: sincere强调不虚假；sincerely常用于信件结尾。
sincere.en: Honestly expressing what you really feel or believe

loaf.tip: 高频搭配：loaf of bread (长面包，面包片) / meat loaf (肉糜卷)；同族词：loaves (复数)、loafing (现在分词)、loafed (过去式)
loaf.en: Commonly used in expressions like "loaf of bread (长面包，面包片)" (n.).

scout.tip: scout for后接寻找的对象；童子军成员常写作Scout。
scout.en: Someone sent to gather information or discover talented people.

sow.en: To put seeds in soil so they can grow.

prosperous.tip: 常修饰国家、地区或经济，强调经济上的兴旺。
prosperous.en: Financially successful and enjoying wealth or economic growth

preferable.tip: 用A is preferable to B，不用than；通常不加more。
preferable.en: Better or more suitable than another option.

plough.tip: 美式拼作plow；两种拼写都读/plaʊ/。
plough.en: A farm tool that turns soil before crops are planted

responsive.tip: 高频搭配：responsive — 响应的；同族词：responsive (adj.)
responsive.en: Commonly used in expressions like "responsive — 响应的" (adj.).

deceive.tip: deceive sb into doing sth表示骗某人做某事。
deceive.en: to deliberately make someone believe something that is not true

accidental.tip: 高频搭配：accidental death (意外死亡) / accidental damage (意外损坏)；同族词：accidentals (复数)
accidental.en: Commonly used in expressions like "accidental death (意外死亡)" (adj.).

wreck.tip: wreck可指一艘失事船；wreckage泛指残骸。
wreck.en: A ship or vehicle that has been badly damaged.

lever.tip: 英式首音节读/liː/，美式通常读/lev/。
lever.en: A bar used to move something or control a machine

famine.tip: famine指大范围粮食匮乏；个人饥饿用hunger。
famine.en: a severe shortage of food affecting many people

ignorant.tip: 常用be ignorant of；直接形容人可能带贬义。
ignorant.en: not knowing about a particular fact or subject

claw.tip: claw是尖爪；paw指猫狗等动物的整个脚掌。
claw.en: a sharp, curved nail on an animal's foot

frost.tip: frost是霜，不是雪；涂糖霜这一动词义多见于美语。
frost.en: Thin ice crystals on surfaces, or weather that forms them.

marvelous.tip: marvelous为美式拼写；英式通常写marvellous。

mercury.tip: mercury指汞，不可数；大写Mercury可指水星。
mercury.en: A poisonous, silver-coloured metal that is liquid at room temperature.

saw.tip: 表“锯”的过去式为sawed；表“看见”则是see的过去式。
saw.en: a tool with a toothed blade for cutting hard materials

chess.en: a two-player board game involving pieces with different permitted moves

camel.tip: 高频搭配：camel hair (驼绒) / bactrian camel (双峰驼)；同族词：camels (复数)
camel.en: Commonly used in expressions like "camel hair (驼绒)" (n.).

farewell.tip: 比goodbye正式，常用于长久分别或郑重告别。
farewell.en: An act of saying goodbye, especially before a long separation.

withstand.tip: 过去式和过去分词均为withstood；后直接接宾语。
withstand.en: To resist damage or remain strong under pressure

cabbage.tip: 整颗可数：a cabbage；作为食材通常不可数。
cabbage.en: a vegetable with large leaves forming a firm round head

lumber.tip: 木材义多用于美式英语，英式通常用timber。
lumber.en: Wood cut into pieces for building, especially in American English.

gloomy.tip: 高频搭配：gloomy — 阴沉的；同族词：gloomier (比较级)、gloomiest (最高级)、gloomies (复数)
gloomy.en: Commonly used in expressions like "gloomy — 阴沉的" (adj.).

selfish.tip: 评价某人的行为用It is selfish of sb to do。
selfish.en: Caring about your own needs without considering other people

harden.tip: 高频搭配：harden — 使变硬；同族词：hardened (过去分词)、hardening (现在分词)、hardens (第三人称单数)
harden.en: Commonly used in expressions like "harden — 使变硬" (v.).

earnest.tip: 高频搭配：in earnest (认真的) / in real earnest (adv. 认真地)；同族词：earnests (复数)
earnest.en: Commonly used in expressions like "in earnest (认真的)" (adj.).

kindness.tip: 指善良品质时不可数；指具体善举时可数。
kindness.en: the quality of caring about others and helping them

irregular.tip: 既可形容形状，也可形容时间；不规则动词也用它。
irregular.en: Not having an even shape or a regular pattern.

hollow.tip: hollow指内部中空；empty指里面没有东西。

lavatory.tip: 较正式，常见于英式英语；日常多用toilet。
lavatory.en: A toilet or a room containing one.

coarse.tip: 与course同音；coarse形容质地粗或言语粗俗。
coarse.en: Having a rough texture or consisting of large particles

hare.tip: 高频搭配：run after two hares (做徒劳无益之事) / hare krishna (印度教克利须那派教徒)；同族词：hares (复数)、haring (现在分词)、hared (过去式)
hare.en: Commonly used in expressions like "run after two hares (做徒劳无益之事)" (n.).

donkey.tip: 指动物时donkey最常用；用来称呼人有贬义。
donkey.en: an animal like a small horse with long ears

impatient.tip: 高频搭配：impatient — 不耐烦的；同族词：impatient (adj.)
impatient.en: Commonly used in expressions like "impatient — 不耐烦的" (adj.).

oriental.tip: 高频搭配：oriental pearl (东方明珠) / new oriental (新东方（专业的培训机构）)；同族词：orientals (复数)
oriental.en: Commonly used in expressions like "oriental pearl (东方明珠)" (adj.).

deception.tip: deception强调故意使人信以为真，不是普通错误。
deception.en: the act of deliberately making someone believe something false

workman.tip: 高频搭配：workman — 工人；同族词：workmen (复数)
workman.en: Commonly used in expressions like "workman — 工人" (n.).

incorrect.tip: incorrect比wrong正式，常用于答案、信息或数据。

compass.tip: 高频搭配：within the compass of (在…的范围内) / magnetic compass (磁罗盘，磁罗经)；同族词：compasses (复数)、compassed (过去式)、compassing (现在分词)
compass.en: Commonly used in expressions like "within the compass of (在…的范围内)" (n.).

beginner.tip: beginner是可数名词，单数前通常要有限定词。
beginner.en: someone who has just started learning or doing something

canteen.tip: 英式英语中常指食堂；美式英语常用cafeteria。
canteen.en: a place serving meals in a school or workplace

acceleration.tip: 物理中指速度变化率，方向改变也可产生加速度。
acceleration.en: the process of moving faster or happening more quickly

simplify.tip: simplify强调减少复杂性；simple是形容词。
simplify.en: To make something less complicated or easier to understand.

cafeteria.tip: 强调自行取餐，不一定是不限量的自助餐。
cafeteria.en: A restaurant where customers collect food and carry it to tables.

restless.tip: restless指难以安静；restful指令人放松的。
restless.en: Unable to relax, stay still, or sleep peacefully.

fry.tip: 高频搭配：stir fry (用大火炒) / deep fry (油炸)；同族词：fries (复数)、frying (现在分词)、fried (过去分词)
fry.en: Commonly used in expressions like "stir fry (用大火炒)" (v.).

glide.tip: 强调移动平稳轻盈；空中滑翔也用glide。
glide.en: To move smoothly and easily, often without much noise.

radius.tip: 高频搭配：curvature radius (曲率半径) / radius compensation (半径补偿)；同族词：radii (复数)
radius.en: Commonly used in expressions like "curvature radius (曲率半径)" (n.).

blaze.tip: blaze常指猛烈的大火；flame指火焰。

nylon.tip: 高频搭配：nylon bag (尼龙袋) / nylon fiber (尼龙纤维)；同族词：nylons (复数)
nylon.en: Commonly used in expressions like "nylon bag (尼龙袋)" (n.).

cannon.en: a large heavy gun that fires powerful projectiles

embarrass.tip: 人感到尴尬用embarrassed；事情令人尴尬用embarrassing。
embarrass.en: To make someone feel awkward, ashamed, or uncomfortable.

oneself.tip: 高频搭配：of oneself (自动地，自发地) / by oneself (独自地，单独)；同族词：oneself (pron.)
oneself.en: Commonly used in expressions like "of oneself (自动地，自发地)" (pron.).

fasten.tip: t不发音；反义词unfasten表示解开。
fasten.en: to close or attach something securely

navigation.tip: 不仅指航海，也用于道路导航和网页浏览。
navigation.en: Finding and following a route to a destination.

luggage.tip: 不可数；一件行李用a piece of luggage。
luggage.en: bags and cases that hold your belongings when travelling

unload.tip: 高频搭配：unload — 卸(货)；同族词：unloaded (过去分词)、unloading (现在分词)、unloads (第三人称单数)
unload.en: Commonly used in expressions like "unload — 卸(货)" (v.).

dental.en: Relating to teeth or their care and treatment

naughty.tip: 常用于小孩或宠物，通常不表示严重的恶行。
naughty.en: Behaving badly, especially by disobeying adults

dialect.tip: dialect涉及词汇和语法，accent主要指口音。
dialect.en: A language variety used in a particular region or community.

infer.tip: infer是听者推断，imply是说者暗示。
infer.en: to reach a conclusion using evidence rather than direct statements

vice.tip: 台钳在美式英语中拼作vise；副主席中的vice-是前缀。
vice.en: a bad habit or morally wrong behaviour

dusk.tip: 在黄昏用at dusk；dawn表示黎明。
dusk.en: The time when daylight fades before night.

wax.tip: wax作蜡时通常不可数；月亮渐盈与wane相反。
wax.en: A substance that melts easily, used for candles and protective coatings.

graceful.tip: graceful多形容姿态优美；gracious多指亲切有礼。
graceful.en: Moving or shaped in a smooth, attractive way.

handbag.tip: 美式常用purse指女式手袋；英式purse通常指零钱包。
handbag.en: A small bag for carrying personal items, typically used by women.

glue.tip: 作名词通常不可数；be glued to可指目不转睛地看。
glue.en: a sticky substance used to join things together

visibility.tip: 高频搭配：low visibility (低能见度) / poor visibility (不良能见度)；同族词：visibility (n.)
visibility.en: Commonly used in expressions like "low visibility (低能见度)" (n.).

microscope.tip: microscope看微小物体；telescope看远处物体。
microscope.en: An instrument that makes very small objects appear much larger.

turbine.tip: 重音在首音节；wind turbine指风力涡轮机。
turbine.en: A machine whose blades turn when pushed by moving fluid.

baggage.tip: 不可数；一件行李说a piece of baggage。
baggage.en: the bags and suitcases you take when travelling

sunrise.tip: 在日出时用at sunrise；日落是sunset。
sunrise.en: The appearance of the sun above the horizon each morning.

comb.tip: 词尾b不发音；comb through表示仔细搜查。
comb.en: A toothed tool used to arrange or tidy hair.

elimination.tip: 动词是eliminate；by elimination表示“用排除法”。
elimination.en: the complete removal of something unwanted or unnecessary

friction.tip: 物理摩擦与人际不和两义均通常不可数。
friction.en: Resistance when one surface moves or rubs against another.

hatch.tip: 表示孵化用动词；名词常指舱口或小开口。
hatch.en: to emerge from an egg, or cause this to happen

merry.tip: 常形容欢庆气氛；make merry意为欢庆作乐。

clasp.tip: clasp作动词强调握紧；作名词也可指首饰搭扣。
clasp.en: To hold someone or something firmly.

nap.en: a short sleep, usually during the day

starve.tip: 日常说I'm starving表示饿极了，并非濒临饿死。
starve.en: To suffer or die from insufficient food

fertile.tip: 高频搭配：fertile soil (沃土，肥沃的土壤) / fertile land (肥沃的土地)；同族词：fertile (adj.)
fertile.en: Commonly used in expressions like "fertile soil (沃土，肥沃的土壤)" (adj.).

disgust.tip: disgusted形容人的感受；disgusting形容令人厌恶的事物。
disgust.en: a strong feeling of dislike caused by something unpleasant

niece.tip: niece指女性晚辈，nephew指男性晚辈。
niece.en: A daughter of your sibling or your spouse's sibling.

rainy.tip: rainy是形容词；正在下雨用It is raining。
rainy.en: Having rain, either now or frequently.

microcomputer.tip: 高频搭配：microcomputer — 微型计算机；同族词：microcomputers (复数)
microcomputer.en: Commonly used in expressions like "microcomputer — 微型计算机" (n.).

hamburger.tip: 高频搭配：hamburger — 汉堡包；同族词：hamburgers (复数)
hamburger.en: Commonly used in expressions like "hamburger — 汉堡包" (n.).

liberate.tip: 及物动词；liberate A from B表示使A摆脱B。
liberate.en: To free people or places from control or imprisonment.

liner.tip: 高频搭配：cylinder liner (汽缸衬垫) / inner liner (内衬)；同族词：liners (复数)
liner.en: Commonly used in expressions like "cylinder liner (汽缸衬垫)" (n.).

announcer.tip: announcer负责播报；journalist侧重新闻采访。
announcer.en: Someone who presents information on broadcasts or at public events

orphan.tip: 常用be orphaned表示因双亲去世而成为孤儿。
orphan.en: a child whose parents have both died

needless.tip: needless to say意为“不用说”，常作插入语。
needless.en: not necessary and therefore best avoided

idle.tip: idle可指人闲着、设备闲置，也可指发动机空转。
idle.en: Not being used or doing any work.

indifferent.tip: 常用be indifferent to；这里的to是介词。

bathe.tip: bathe读/beɪð/，勿与bath混淆；英式还可指海泳。
bathe.en: To wash yourself or another person in a bath

conjunction.tip: in conjunction with常表示“与……共同或结合”。
conjunction.en: a word that connects words, phrases, or clauses

outdoors.tip: outdoors是副词；修饰名词用outdoor，如outdoor activities。
outdoors.en: outside a building, in the open air

continual.tip: continual常指反复发生；continuous强调不中断。
continual.en: Happening repeatedly, often with short breaks.

digest.en: Break down food inside the body so it can be used.

breadth.tip: breadth强调广度；depth强调深度，二者常并列。
breadth.en: The wide range of things something includes.

accustom.tip: accustom oneself to中to是介词，后接名词或动名词。
accustom.en: To make someone familiar or comfortable with something through experience.

preventive.tip: 高频搭配：preventive maintenance (预防性维修) / preventive medicine ([医]预防医学)；同族词：preventives (复数)
preventive.en: Commonly used in expressions like "preventive maintenance (预防性维修)" (adj.).

paste.tip: 糊状物通常不可数；电脑操作中指“粘贴”。
paste.en: A thick, soft mixture, sometimes used for sticking things together.

midday.tip: 时间前用at；也可置于名词前，如midday sun。
midday.en: the middle of the day, around twelve o'clock

bruise.tip: bruise通常不破皮；cut指割破皮肤的伤口。
bruise.en: A dark mark caused by bleeding under the skin.

mediterranean.tip: 作海域名称时通常用the Mediterranean，首字母大写。
mediterranean.en: The sea between southern Europe, northern Africa, and western Asia.

bankrupt.en: legally unable to pay the debts you owe

ornament.tip: 名词重音在首音节；动词末音节读/ment/。
ornament.en: An object used to make something look more attractive.

lessen.tip: 高频搭配：lessen — 减少；同族词：lessened (过去分词)、lessening (现在分词)、lessens (第三人称单数)
lessen.en: Commonly used in expressions like "lessen — 减少" (v.).

typewriter.en: A machine with keys that print characters directly onto paper.

roast.tip: roast多用于肉和蔬菜；烤面包、蛋糕通常用bake。
roast.en: To cook food using dry heat, especially in an oven.

careless.tip: careless是粗心的；carefree才是无忧无虑的。
careless.en: Not giving enough attention to avoid mistakes or damage.

masterpiece.tip: 通常指作品，不用来指才华出众的人。
masterpiece.en: an exceptionally fine work of art, literature, or skill

slippery.tip: 高频搭配：slippery slope (n. 灾难性的急剧下滑) / slippery road (滑路)；同族词：slippery (adj.)
slippery.en: Commonly used in expressions like "slippery slope (n. 灾难性的急剧下滑)" (adj.).

ache.tip: ache多指持续钝痛；pain可泛指各种疼痛。
ache.en: to feel a steady pain that is usually not sharp

pinch.tip: a pinch of表少量；feel the pinch指手头紧。
pinch.en: to squeeze something tightly, often between a finger and thumb

annoy.tip: 人感到烦用annoyed；事物令人烦用annoying。
annoy.en: To make someone feel slightly angry or irritated.

deduce.tip: 高频搭配：deduce from (推断)；同族词：deduced (过去分词)、deducing (现在分词)、deduces (第三人称单数)
deduce.en: Commonly used in expressions like "deduce from (推断)" (v.).

indoors.tip: indoors是副词；修饰名词用indoor，如indoor sports。
indoors.en: Inside a building, or into a building.

orderly.tip: 虽以-ly结尾，常作形容词；名词可指医院护工。
orderly.en: well arranged or behaving in a controlled, organised way

quarrel.tip: 高频搭配：quarrel with (v. 抱怨) / quarrel about (争论)；同族词：quarrels (复数)、quarrelled (过去式)、quarrelling (现在分词)
quarrel.en: Commonly used in expressions like "quarrel with (v. 抱怨)" (n.).

pants.tip: 美式指裤子，英式常指内裤；用 a pair of 计数。
pants.en: Clothing covering the legs separately, from the waist down.

cubic.tip: cubic用于体积单位；square用于面积单位。
cubic.en: relating to volume measured in cubes, or shaped like a cube

inefficient.tip: 高频搭配：inefficient — 效率低的；同族词：inefficient (adj.)
inefficient.en: Commonly used in expressions like "inefficient — 效率低的" (adj.).

tailor.tip: tailor A to B表示“根据B调整或定制A”。
tailor.en: someone who makes or alters clothes, especially suits

brighten.tip: 可及物也可不及物；brighten up也指心情好转。
brighten.en: To become lighter or make something lighter or more colourful.

compute.tip: 比calculate更正式，常用于计算机或数学语境。
compute.en: To calculate an amount or result, often using a computer.

handwriting.tip: 通常不可数；优美书法这门艺术用calligraphy。
handwriting.en: The particular way someone forms words when writing by hand.

flare.tip: flare up可指火势突然变旺，也指矛盾或病症发作。
flare.en: To burn suddenly brighter or become suddenly stronger.

dye.tip: 高频搭配：reactive dye (活性染料) / hair dye (n. 染发剂)；同族词：dyes (复数)、dyed (过去分词)、dyeing (现在分词)
dye.en: Commonly used in expressions like "reactive dye (活性染料)" (v./n.).

geometry.tip: 学科名，不可数；通常不加冠词。
geometry.en: The study of shapes, angles, sizes, and spatial relationships.

knob.tip: 高频搭配：with knobs on ([俚语]尤其突出地，更加) / door knob (门把手)；同族词：knobs (复数)、knobbed (过去式)、knobbing (现在分词)
knob.en: Commonly used in expressions like "with knobs on ([俚语]尤其突出地，更加)" (n.).

evaporate.tip: 蒸发不一定要沸腾；evaporate也可比喻希望等消失。
evaporate.en: to change from liquid into gas, or cause this change

doctoral.tip: 高频搭配：doctoral student (博士生) / doctoral degree (博士学位)；同族词：doctoral (adj.)
doctoral.en: Commonly used in expressions like "doctoral student (博士生)" (adj.).

honeymoon.tip: 英式常说on honeymoon，美式常说on a honeymoon。
honeymoon.en: A holiday taken by a couple just after their wedding.

hawk.tip: 鹰派hawk与主张和平的鸽派dove相对。
hawk.en: a hunting bird with sharp claws and a curved beak

inward.tip: 形容词用inward；副词英式英语也常用inwards。
inward.en: moving or directed towards the inside or centre

durable.tip: 耐用品通常用复数名词durables或durable goods。
durable.en: Able to last a long time without breaking or wearing out.

vapour.en: A gas formed when a liquid or solid changes state.

despise.tip: 高频搭配：despise — 鄙视；同族词：despised (过去式)、despises (第三人称单数)、despising (现在分词)
despise.en: Commonly used in expressions like "despise — 鄙视" (v.).

cock.tip: 指公鸡可用rooster；cock另有粗俗的性含义。
cock.en: An adult male chicken or another male bird.

coil.tip: 作动词可及物或不及物，强调绕成圈或螺旋。
coil.en: to wind into a series of circles or rings

paw.tip: paw指整个脚掌；claw指尖锐的爪或爪甲。
paw.en: the foot of an animal such as a cat or dog

carpenter.tip: 高频搭配：carpenter — 木匠；同族词：carpenters (复数)、carpentering (现在分词)、carpentered (过去式)
carpenter.en: Commonly used in expressions like "carpenter — 木匠" (n.).

accordance.tip: 高频搭配：in accordance (按照) / in accordance with (依照)；同族词：accordance (n.)
accordance.en: Commonly used in expressions like "in accordance (按照)" (n.).

petroleum.tip: 高频搭配：petroleum industry (石油工业) / petroleum gas (石油气)；同族词：petroleum (n.)
petroleum.en: Commonly used in expressions like "petroleum industry (石油工业)" (n.).

sting.tip: 过去式、过去分词均为stung；蜇用sting，咬用bite。
sting.en: Cause sharp pain with a pointed body part or irritating substance

shortcoming.tip: 高频搭配：shortcoming — 短处；同族词：shortcomings (复数)
shortcoming.en: Commonly used in expressions like "shortcoming — 短处" (n.).

pronunciation.en: the way a word or language is spoken

inventor.tip: inventor创造新事物；discoverer发现已有事物。
inventor.en: someone who creates a device or process not previously existing

ore.tip: ore是含有可提取物质的矿石，不等于metal。
ore.en: rock containing metal or other valuable substances that can be extracted

disappoint.tip: 人感到失望用disappointed；事物令人失望用disappointing。
disappoint.en: To make someone unhappy by failing to meet their expectations.

downward.tip: downward可作形容词和副词；downwards只作副词。
downward.en: Moving or pointing towards a lower place, level, or amount.

misunderstand.tip: 过去式和过去分词均为misunderstood。
misunderstand.en: to understand someone's words, actions, or intentions incorrectly

cucumber.tip: 通常可数：a cucumber；表示食材时也可不可数。
cucumber.en: A long vegetable with green skin and crisp, watery flesh.

mister.tip: 通常写作Mr（美式Mr.），读Mister，后接姓氏。
mister.en: A title used before a man's surname or full name

dorm.tip: dorm是dormitory的非正式简称，多见于美式英语。
dorm.en: a building or shared room where students sleep

overtime.tip: 加班用work overtime；over time意为随着时间推移。
overtime.en: Extra working hours, or the money paid for them.

awfully.tip: 高频搭配：awfully — 令人畏惧的；同族词：awfully (adv.)
awfully.en: Commonly used in expressions like "awfully — 令人畏惧的" (adv.).

lantern.tip: 指有外罩的灯，常可提携；不等同于手电筒。
lantern.en: a light inside a protective container, often with a handle

heroine.tip: 与heroin（海洛因）同音，注意末尾的e。
heroine.en: the main female character in a story

respectful.tip: respectful尊重他人的；respectable值得尊敬的。
respectful.en: showing politeness and consideration towards someone or something

modernization.tip: 高频搭配：level of modernization (现代化水平)；同族词：modernizations (复数)
modernization.en: Commonly used in expressions like "level of modernization (现代化水平)" (n.).

crane.tip: 动词常用crane your neck，表示伸长脖子看。
crane.en: A machine for lifting and moving heavy objects.

crow.tip: 名词指乌鸦，动词却可指公鸡打鸣。
crow.en: A large black bird with a loud, rough call.

faulty.tip: 既可形容设备故障，也可形容推理有误。
faulty.en: not working correctly because something is wrong

butcher.tip: 肉店常说the butcher's；动词也可指把表演等搞砸。
butcher.en: someone who prepares and sells meat

tedious.tip: 常形容因耗时长或反复重复而乏味的任务。
tedious.en: boring because it continues too long or involves repeated actions

lag.tip: 常用lag behind表示落后；过去式为lagged。
lag.en: Move or develop more slowly than others

prolong.tip: 高频搭配：prolong — 拉长；同族词：prolonging (现在分词)、prolonged (过去分词)、prolongs (第三人称单数)
prolong.en: Commonly used in expressions like "prolong — 拉长" (v.).

persuasive.tip: 通常形容论点或表达有说服力，不作名词。
persuasive.en: Able to make people believe something or agree with you

mislead.tip: 过去式和过去分词均为misled；常接into doing。
mislead.en: to cause someone to believe something incorrect

envy.tip: 动词直接接宾语：envy someone，不加of。
envy.en: a feeling of wanting something that someone else has

haircut.tip: 说get或have a haircut，不说cut a haircut。
haircut.en: An act of cutting hair, or the resulting hairstyle.

harness.tip: 高频搭配：in harness (一起合作) / wiring harness (线束)；同族词：harnessed (过去分词)、harnessing (现在分词)、harnesses (复数)
harness.en: Commonly used in expressions like "in harness (一起合作)" (v./n.).

economical.tip: 高频搭配：economical efficiency (经济效率，经济效果) / economical and practical (经济实用)；同族词：economical (adj.)
economical.en: Commonly used in expressions like "economical efficiency (经济效率，经济效果)" (adj.).

hasten.tip: t不发音；hasten to do表示赶紧做某事。
hasten.en: To make something happen sooner or develop more quickly.

skim.tip: 高频搭配：skim milk (脱脂牛奶) / skim through (v. 浏览)；同族词：skimming (现在分词)、skimmed (过去式)、skims (第三人称单数)
skim.en: Commonly used in expressions like "skim milk (脱脂牛奶)" (v.).

granddaughter.tip: 既指孙女也指外孙女，英语不区分父系与母系。
granddaughter.en: The daughter of someone's son or daughter

gracious.tip: gracious重待人有礼；graceful重动作优美。
gracious.en: kind and polite, especially when treating others generously

indispensable.tip: 常接to或for；语气比useful强，表示少不了。
indispensable.en: So important or useful that it cannot be done without

outwards.tip: outwards 是副词；作定语需用 outward。
outwards.en: Towards the outside or away from the centre

lighten.tip: lighten可指减负或变亮；lighten up常指放轻松。
lighten.en: to make something less heavy or less demanding

greedy.tip: 常含贬义；greedy for后接金钱、权力等所贪之物。
greedy.en: wanting more money or possessions than one needs

solemn.tip: 高频搭配：solemn promise (庄严承诺) / solemn ceremony (隆重的典礼)；同族词：solemn (adj.)
solemn.en: Commonly used in expressions like "solemn promise (庄严承诺)" (adj.).

outward.tip: 作副词时英式英语更常用outwards。
outward.en: visible on the outside rather than reflecting inner feelings

amaze.tip: 人感到惊奇用amazed；事物令人惊奇用amazing。

brisk.tip: brisk walk指轻快有力的快走，不是跑步。

advisable.tip: 高频搭配：advisable — 明智的；同族词：advisable (n.)
advisable.en: Commonly used in expressions like "advisable — 明智的" (n.).

clumsy.tip: 主要指动作或处理方式笨拙，不等于智力低下。
clumsy.en: moving awkwardly and often dropping or breaking things

cherish.tip: 高频搭配：cherish time (珍惜时间)；同族词：cherished (过去分词)、cherishes (第三人称单数)、cherishing (现在分词)
cherish.en: Commonly used in expressions like "cherish time (珍惜时间)" (v.).

ounce.tip: 重量盎司约28.35克；fluid ounce是容量单位。
ounce.en: A unit of weight equal to approximately 28.35 grams.

jolly.tip: 高频搭配：a jolly dog ([俚语]快乐的家伙) / jolly roger (海盗旗（饰有白色骷髅的黑旗）)；同族词：jollies (第三人称单数)、jollier (比较级)、jolliest (最高级)
jolly.en: Commonly used in expressions like "a jolly dog ([俚语]快乐的家伙)" (adj.).

spade.tip: 高频搭配：in spades ([美俚]坦率地)；同族词：spades (复数)、spading (现在分词)、spaded (过去式)
spade.en: Commonly used in expressions like "in spades ([美俚]坦率地)" (n.).

scissors.tip: 通常用复数；一把剪刀说a pair of scissors。
scissors.en: A tool with two blades for cutting things.

exterior.en: The outside surface or appearance of something.

dread.tip: 表示害怕做某事通常用 dread doing。
dread.en: Feel very worried about something unpleasant that may happen.

childish.tip: childish 常含贬义；childlike 多指天真无邪。
childish.en: Behaving immaturely in a way unsuitable for an adult.

amuse.tip: amused形容人的感受；amusing形容有趣的事物。
amuse.en: To make someone smile or laugh.

semiconductor.tip: semi-表示半；半导体导电性介于导体与绝缘体之间。
semiconductor.en: A material that conducts electricity less easily than most metals.

brittle.tip: 高频搭配：brittle — 脆的；同族词：brittling (现在分词)
brittle.en: Commonly used in expressions like "brittle — 脆的" (adj.).

intentional.tip: 高频搭配：intentional crime (故意犯罪) / intentional injury (故意伤害)；同族词：intentional (adj.)
intentional.en: Commonly used in expressions like "intentional crime (故意犯罪)" (adj.).

draught.tip: 高频搭配：draught fan (通风风扇) / draught animals (挽畜)；同族词：draughts (复数)、draughting (现在分词)、draughted (过去分词)
draught.en: Commonly used in expressions like "draught fan (通风风扇)" (n./adj.).

pollute.tip: 及物动词，直接接被污染的对象，不加介词。
pollute.en: to make air, water, or land dirty or harmful

quiz.en: A short test or game involving questions.

arithmetic.tip: 作名词通常不可数；范围比mathematics窄。
arithmetic.en: mathematics involving addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division

lest.tip: 较正式；从句常用动词原形或should加原形。
lest.en: To prevent something unwanted, or because of fearing it

calculator.tip: calculator指工具；calculation指计算过程或结果。
calculator.en: A device or application used for mathematical calculations

worthless.tip: worthless指无价值；priceless反而指极珍贵。
worthless.en: having no value or practical use

trumpet.tip: 乐器义是“小号”；动词可指大肆宣扬。
trumpet.en: A brass musical instrument with three valves and a bright sound.

centimetre.en: A unit of length equal to one hundredth of a metre.

yearly.tip: 高频搭配：yearly output (年产量) / yearly income (岁入， 年度收入)；同族词：yearly (adj./adv.)
yearly.en: Commonly used in expressions like "yearly output (年产量)" (adj./adv.).

stoop.tip: stoop to doing表示不惜做卑劣之事，to为介词。
stoop.en: to bend your upper body forward and downward

sportsman.tip: 特指男性；不强调性别时可用athlete。
sportsman.en: a man who plays sports, especially with skill

mouthful.tip: 高频搭配：mouthful — 满口；同族词：mouthfuls (复数)
mouthful.en: Commonly used in expressions like "mouthful — 满口" (n.).

anyhow.tip: 表示“反正”较口语化；勿与somehow混淆。
anyhow.en: Despite what has happened or been said.

gram.tip: 符号为g；复数为grams；一千克等于一千克中的一千克？
gram.en: A unit of mass equal to one thousandth of a kilogram.

furnace.tip: 工业语境指熔炉；美式家居语境常指暖气炉。
furnace.en: An enclosed structure producing intense heat for industrial processes.

preface.tip: 书的preface通常由作者写；foreword常由他人撰写。
preface.en: An introductory section explaining a book's purpose or background.

saucer.tip: saucer是杯子下的小碟；flying saucer指飞碟。
saucer.en: a small shallow dish placed underneath a cup

barber.tip: barber主要为男士理发修面；barber's可指理发店。
barber.en: Someone who cuts men's hair and trims or shaves beards.

alphabet.tip: alphabet指整套字母；单个字母用letter。
alphabet.en: the complete set of letters used in a language

homogeneous.tip: 强调组成部分相似或一致，反义词为heterogeneous。
homogeneous.en: Consisting of parts or people that are all similar

singular.tip: 高频搭配：singular value (n. 奇异值) / singular value decomposition (奇异值分解)；同族词：singulars (复数)
singular.en: Commonly used in expressions like "singular value (n. 奇异值)" (adj.).

captive.tip: captive audience指无法随意离开的听众，非着迷者。
captive.en: kept somewhere and not allowed to leave

germ.tip: 高频搭配：in germ ([比喻]处于初级阶段，处于萌芽阶段) / wheat germ (小麦的胚芽，麦芽)；同族词：germs (复数)
germ.en: Commonly used in expressions like "in germ ([比喻]处于初级阶段，处于萌芽阶段)" (n.).

daring.tip: 作形容词强调敢冒险；作名词时通常不可数。
daring.en: Willing to take risks or try unusually bold things.

shriek.tip: shriek强调声音尖而高，既可因恐惧也可因兴奋。
shriek.en: To make a sudden, loud, high sound with your voice.

pluralism.tip: 高频搭配：cultural pluralism (文化多元主义)；同族词：pluralisms (复数)
pluralism.en: Commonly used in expressions like "cultural pluralism (文化多元主义)" (n.).

pronoun.tip: 高频搭配：personal pronoun (n. 人称代名词) / demonstrative pronoun (n. 指示代词)；同族词：pronouns (复数)
pronoun.en: Commonly used in expressions like "personal pronoun (n. 人称代名词)" (n.).

cripple.tip: 名词指人有冒犯性；动词常指经济或系统受重创。
cripple.en: To severely damage something's ability to function

broom.tip: 高频搭配：new broom (新上任者) / broom corn millet (黍， 稷)；同族词：brooms (复数)
broom.en: Commonly used in expressions like "new broom (新上任者)" (n.).

misconception.tip: 高频搭配：misconception — 误解；同族词：misconceptions (复数)
misconception.en: Commonly used in expressions like "misconception — 误解" (n.).

hesitant.tip: 常用 hesitant to do 或 hesitant about sth。
hesitant.en: slow to act or speak because you feel uncertain

utmost.tip: do one's utmost意为尽最大努力，常接to do。
utmost.en: greatest in degree, amount, or intensity

depress.tip: depressed形容人感到沮丧，depressing形容事物令人沮丧。
depress.en: To make someone feel unhappy and without hope.

attentive.tip: attentive to后接关注的对象；也可形容服务周到。

humorous.tip: 高频搭配：humorous story (幽默小说)；同族词：humorous (adj.)
humorous.en: Commonly used in expressions like "humorous story (幽默小说)" (adj.).

haste.tip: 通常为不可数名词；in haste意为匆忙地。
haste.en: Speed in acting, often without enough care or thought.

limp.tip: 作动词指跛行；作形容词指无力或软塌塌。
limp.en: To walk unevenly because one leg or foot is hurt

biotechnology.tip: 高频搭配：biotechnology — 生物工艺学；同族词：biotechnologies (复数)
biotechnology.en: Commonly used in expressions like "biotechnology — 生物工艺学" (n.).

compress.tip: 动词重音在后；名词“敷布”重音在前。
compress.en: Press something into a smaller space or reduce its size

exceedingly.tip: 比 very 更正式，常修饰形容词或副词。

poisonous.en: Containing a substance that can cause illness or death.

acquaint.tip: 较正式，常用acquaint sb/oneself with sth。
acquaint.en: Give someone knowledge of or familiarity with something.

pessimistic.tip: 常用be pessimistic about；反义词是optimistic。
pessimistic.en: Expecting bad results or focusing on possible problems.

plentiful.tip: 表示物资或机会充足，不表示一个人富有。
plentiful.en: Available in large amounts or numbers.

shear.tip: 高频搭配：shear stress ([物]剪应力) / shear strength (切变强度)；同族词：shears (复数)、shorn (过去分词)、shearing (现在分词)
shear.en: Commonly used in expressions like "shear stress ([物]剪应力)" (v.).

amplify.tip: 既可放大实际声音，也可增强影响或情绪。
amplify.en: to make a sound or electrical signal stronger

troublesome.tip: troublesome指造成麻烦；troubled指自身遇到困扰。

feeble.tip: 可形容身体、声音，也可批评借口或努力无力。
feeble.en: Lacking physical strength, energy, or intensity.

statistic.tip: statistics表数据用复数谓语，表统计学用单数谓语。
statistic.en: A numerical fact obtained by collecting and examining information.

thermometer.tip: 重音在第二音节；测体温常用take someone's temperature。
thermometer.en: An instrument used to measure temperature.

fluent.tip: 说某种语言流利用be fluent in；流利不等于零错误。
fluent.en: Able to speak or write a language easily and smoothly.

vibrate.tip: 指快速、小幅度振动，不等于大幅摇摆。
vibrate.en: To shake rapidly with small movements, or cause this movement.

fruitful.tip: 高频搭配：fruitful — 多产的；同族词：fruitful (adj.)
fruitful.en: Commonly used in expressions like "fruitful — 多产的" (adj.).

cunning.tip: 形容人时通常含贬义，不等于单纯的聪明。
cunning.en: Clever at getting what you want by deceiving others.

vain.tip: in vain作状语，表示“徒劳地”；vain也可指虚荣。
vain.en: failing to achieve the intended result

grieve.tip: grieve for常接逝者；grieve over常接损失或不幸。
grieve.en: To feel deep sadness, especially after someone's death

postage.tip: 高频搭配：postage stamp (n. 邮票)；同族词：postages (复数)
postage.en: Commonly used in expressions like "postage stamp (n. 邮票)" (n.).

unbearable.tip: 这里的bear指忍受；unbearable语气很强。
unbearable.en: Too unpleasant, painful, or intense to tolerate

beggar.tip: 高频搭配：beggar — 乞丐；同族词：beggars (复数)、beggaring (现在分词)、beggared (过去式)
beggar.en: Commonly used in expressions like "beggar — 乞丐" (n.).

millimetre.tip: 缩写为mm；美式拼写为millimeter；一厘米等于十毫米。
millimetre.en: A unit of length equal to one thousandth of a metre

clothe.tip: 较正式；过去式和过去分词通常为clothed。
clothe.en: To dress someone or provide them with clothes

melon.en: A large round fruit with thick skin and sweet, juicy flesh.

approximate.tip: 形容词词尾读/mət/，动词词尾读/meɪt/。
approximate.en: Close to the actual amount or value, but not exact

stale.tip: stale指失去新鲜感；rotten指已腐烂。
stale.en: No longer fresh, especially when describing bread or air.

waterproof.tip: water-resistant仅指有一定抗水能力，防水程度较弱。
waterproof.en: not allowing water to pass through

hostess.tip: hostess特指女性；host如今也可用于任何性别。
hostess.en: A woman who welcomes and entertains guests.

elastic.tip: 作材料名词通常不可数；elastic band指橡皮筋。
elastic.en: able to stretch and return to its original shape

telegram.tip: telegram是电报消息；telegraph指电报通信系统。
telegram.en: a message sent by telegraph and delivered in written form

lame.tip: 高频搭配：lame duck (n. 投机者)；同族词：lames (第三人称单数)、lamed (过去分词)、laming (现在分词)
lame.en: Commonly used in expressions like "lame duck (n. 投机者)" (adj.).

provocation.tip: 常指引起愤怒的挑衅，不宜泛译为普通刺激。
provocation.en: behaviour intended or likely to cause anger or a reaction

farther.tip: farther多指实际距离；进一步讨论用further。
farther.en: At or to a greater distance.

hospitalize.tip: 高频搭配：hospitalize — 就医；同族词：hospitalized (过去分词)、hospitalizes (第三人称单数)、hospitalizing (现在分词)
hospitalize.en: Commonly used in expressions like "hospitalize — 就医" (v.).

rouse.tip: rouse sb from sleep表唤醒；rouse interest表激起。
rouse.en: Wake someone or make them more alert.

cent.tip: cent是可数名词；金额超过一分通常用cents。
cent.en: a monetary unit worth one hundredth of a dollar or euro

metric.tip: 形容词指公制的；名词指指标，常用复数。
metric.en: Using measurement units such as metres, litres, and grams.

landlady.en: a woman who rents property or rooms to other people

subtract.tip: subtract A from B 表示用B减去A。
subtract.en: to take one number or amount away from another

nourish.tip: 既可指提供营养，也可比喻培养希望、好奇心等。
nourish.en: to provide what a living thing needs to grow healthily

scold.tip: 用 scold someone for doing，表示因某行为责骂某人。
scold.en: To speak angrily to someone because they did something wrong.

brook.tip: 高频搭配：stony brook (斯托尼布鲁克分校)；同族词：brooks (复数)、brooked (过去式)、brooking (现在分词)
brook.en: Commonly used in expressions like "stony brook (斯托尼布鲁克分校)" (n.).

rust.tip: 技能生疏常用rusty：My French is rusty。
rust.en: A reddish-brown substance that forms on iron exposed to moisture.

thirsty.tip: 表示渴望某物用thirsty for，不用thirsty of。
thirsty.en: feeling that you need or want a drink

idiom.tip: 高频搭配：idiom — 习语；同族词：idioms (复数)
idiom.en: Commonly used in expressions like "idiom — 习语" (n.).

slit.tip: 动词过去式、过去分词均为slit；现在分词为slitting。
slit.en: a long, narrow cut or opening

internship.tip: intern指实习生；internship指实习岗位或实习期。
internship.en: A temporary job providing practical experience in a particular field.

alloy.tip: 名词重音在前；动词常读/əˈlɔɪ/。
alloy.en: A metal made by combining metals or adding other elements.

yawn.tip: 打哈欠可说yawn或give a yawn。
yawn.en: Open your mouth widely and breathe deeply from tiredness or boredom.

overcoat.tip: overcoat通常指套在其他衣服外的御寒长大衣。
overcoat.en: a long warm coat worn over other clothes

victimize.tip: 高频搭配：victimize — 使受害；同族词：victimized (过去分词)、victimizing (现在分词)、victimizes (第三人称单数)
victimize.en: Commonly used in expressions like "victimize — 使受害" (v.).

humid.tip: humid主要形容空气或气候潮湿，不用于湿衣服。
humid.en: containing a lot of moisture in the air

automation.tip: 高频搭配：industrial automation (工业自动化) / office automation (办公自动化)；同族词：automations (复数)
automation.en: Commonly used in expressions like "industrial automation (工业自动化)" (n.).

transistor.tip: 指电子元件；transistor radio才是晶体管收音机。
transistor.en: An electronic component that amplifies signals or switches electrical current.

glitter.tip: 作动词表示闪耀；作闪光装饰粉讲时通常不可数。
glitter.en: To shine with many small flashes of reflected light.

adoptive.tip: 高频搭配：adoptive father (养父)；同族词：adoptive (adj.)
adoptive.en: Commonly used in expressions like "adoptive father (养父)" (adj.).

tame.tip: tame指不怕人或被驯服，不等于天生无害。
tame.en: Used to people and not wild or dangerous.

mute.tip: 高频搭配：deaf mute (聋哑人)；同族词：mutes (复数)、muting (现在分词)、muted (过去分词)
mute.en: Commonly used in expressions like "deaf mute (聋哑人)" (adj./n.).

dormitory.tip: 美式常指学生宿舍楼；英式也常指多人寝室。
dormitory.en: A large room where several people sleep.

disable.tip: 技术语境常指“禁用”，不表示删除或损坏。
disable.en: to prevent a device or feature from working

bristle.tip: 高频搭配：bristle with (充满) / bristle brush (鬃毛画笔)；同族词：bristles (复数)、bristling (现在分词)、bristled (过去式)
bristle.en: Commonly used in expressions like "bristle with (充满)" (n.).

providing.tip: 高频搭配：provide oneself (自备) / provide for (供养，供给)；同族词：provide (词根/原形)
providing.en: Commonly used in expressions like "provide oneself (自备)" (conj.).

sympathize.tip: 不直接接宾语：用 sympathize with；英式也拼 sympathise。
sympathize.en: To understand and care about someone's suffering or difficulties.

submerge.tip: 可及物或不及物；强调进入水面或液面以下。
submerge.en: To go below a liquid's surface or put something there

arabian.tip: Arabian多指半岛或马种；语言用Arabic，人常用Arab。
arabian.en: Relating to Arabia, especially its geography, culture, or wildlife.

cashier.tip: cashier负责收款，accountant负责会计核算。
cashier.en: Someone who receives customers' payments in a shop or bank

habitual.tip: 形容反复发生的行为，也可修饰经常做某事的人。
habitual.en: done regularly or repeatedly as a habit

refresh.tip: 人感觉精神恢复用refreshed；令人清爽用refreshing。
refresh.en: To make someone feel less tired or more comfortable.

ax.tip: 高频搭配：ax — 斧子；同族词：axing (现在分词)、axes (复数)、axed (过去式)
ax.en: Commonly used in expressions like "ax — 斧子" (n.).

measurable.tip: 高频搭配：measurable set ([数]可测集)；同族词：measurable (adj.)
measurable.en: Commonly used in expressions like "measurable set ([数]可测集)" (adj.).

liter.tip: liter是美式拼写，英式为litre；一升等于一千毫升。
liter.en: A unit of volume equal to one thousand milliliters.

vitally.tip: 高频搭配：vitally important (极其重要的)；同族词：vitally (adv.)
vitally.en: Commonly used in expressions like "vitally important (极其重要的)" (adv.).

joyful.tip: 比happy更强调强烈喜悦，也可形容场合。
joyful.en: Feeling, expressing, or causing great happiness.

coward.tip: coward是名词，形容词用cowardly；称人时含贬义。
coward.en: Someone who avoids danger or difficulty because of fear

hasty.tip: 高频搭配：hasty — 急速的；同族词：hastiest (最高级)、hastier (比较级)
hasty.en: Commonly used in expressions like "hasty — 急速的" (adj.).

relativity.tip: 高频搭配：theory of relativity ([物]相对论) / general relativity (广义相对论)；同族词：relativities (复数)
relativity.en: Commonly used in expressions like "theory of relativity ([物]相对论)" (n.).

postman.tip: 英式常用；美式常用mail carrier，且不限定性别。
postman.en: a man whose job is to deliver letters and parcels

brute.tip: 高频搭配：brute force (强力)；同族词：brutes (复数)
brute.en: Commonly used in expressions like "brute force (强力)" (n.).

weld.tip: weld A to B表示把A焊接到B上。
weld.en: To join metal parts by heating their edges until they fuse.

indignant.tip: 强调因不公或受辱而生气，不泛指愤怒。
indignant.en: Angry because something seems unfair or insulting.

mechanically.tip: 既可指通过机械，也可指做事不动脑筋。
mechanically.en: Using machinery, or relating to how a machine works

succeeding.tip: 高频搭配：succeed in (成功) / succeed someone as (接任某人的职务)；同族词：succeed (词根/原形)
succeeding.en: Commonly used in expressions like "succeed in (成功)" (adj.).

ox.tip: 复数是oxen；多指役牛，不等同于未阉割公牛bull。
ox.en: a large bovine, often a castrated male, used for work

grocer.tip: 高频搭配：grocer — 食品商；同族词：grocers (复数)
grocer.en: Commonly used in expressions like "grocer — 食品商" (n.).

elective.tip: 高频搭配：elective course (选修课) / an elective course (选修科目)；同族词：electives (复数)
elective.en: Commonly used in expressions like "elective course (选修课)" (adj./n.).

indefinite.tip: 高频搭配：indefinite integral (不定积分) / indefinite equation (不定方程式)；同族词：indefinite (adj.)
indefinite.en: Commonly used in expressions like "indefinite integral (不定积分)" (adj.).

steamer.tip: 既可指蒸食物的器具，也可指蒸汽动力船。
steamer.en: A container or appliance that cooks food using steam.

sexism.tip: 高频搭配：sexism — 性别偏见；同族词：sexism (n.)
sexism.en: Commonly used in expressions like "sexism — 性别偏见" (n.).

incline.en: To tend towards a particular opinion or course of action

rotary.tip: 常形容旋转式机械；不等同于表示轮流的rotating。
rotary.en: Moving in circles, or operating through circular movement.

gaol.tip: gaol是jail的旧式英式拼法，读音相同。
gaol.en: An older British spelling of jail, a place holding prisoners.

owing.tip: 高频搭配：owing — 应付的；同族词：owe (词根/原形)、owings (复数)
owing.en: Commonly used in expressions like "owing — 应付的" (adj.).

skillful.tip: 高频搭配：be skillful in (精于)；同族词：skillful (adj.)
skillful.en: Commonly used in expressions like "be skillful in (精于)" (adj.).

brim.tip: 满到杯沿用to the brim；充满用brim with。
brim.en: the upper edge of a cup, bowl, or other container

horsepower.tip: 数量后horsepower不加s；它衡量功率而非速度。
horsepower.en: A unit used to measure the power of an engine.

volt.tip: 伏特衡量电压；瓦特 watt 衡量功率。
volt.en: A unit used to measure electrical potential difference

astonish.tip: 人感到惊讶用astonished；事物令人惊讶用astonishing。

erroneous.tip: 高频搭配：erroneous — 错误的；同族词：erroneous (adj.)
erroneous.en: Commonly used in expressions like "erroneous — 错误的" (adj.).

bosom.tip: 较文学化或旧式；bosom friend指知心朋友。
bosom.en: The chest, especially a woman's, or the embrace it provides.

materialism.tip: 消费话题常指物质至上；哲学语境指唯物主义。
materialism.en: The belief that money and possessions matter most

soluble.tip: 常用be soluble in；水溶性可写water-soluble。
soluble.en: Able to dissolve in a liquid.

loudspeaker.en: A device that makes recorded or transmitted sound audible

oppress.tip: 高频搭配：oppress — 压迫；同族词：oppressed (过去分词)、oppressing (现在分词)、oppresses (第三人称单数)
oppress.en: Commonly used in expressions like "oppress — 压迫" (v.).

violet.tip: 高频搭配：crystal violet (结晶紫) / ultra violet (紫外光)；同族词：violets (复数)
violet.en: Commonly used in expressions like "crystal violet (结晶紫)" (n.).

gymnasium.tip: 高频搭配：gymnasium — 体育馆；同族词：gymnasiums (复数)
gymnasium.en: Commonly used in expressions like "gymnasium — 体育馆" (n.).

transformer.tip: 高频搭配：power transformer (电力变压器，电源变压器) / current transformer (n. 电流变换器)；同族词：transformers (复数)
transformer.en: Commonly used in expressions like "power transformer (电力变压器，电源变压器)" (n.).

popularize.tip: 英式也常写popularise；不只是“宣传”。
popularize.en: To make something widely known, liked, or used.

criminology.tip: 高频搭配：criminology — 犯罪学；同族词：criminologies (复数)
criminology.en: Commonly used in expressions like "criminology — 犯罪学" (n.).

condense.tip: 高频搭配：condense into (把…缩短)；同族词：condensed (过去分词)、condensing (现在分词)、condenses (复数)
condense.en: Commonly used in expressions like "condense into (把…缩短)" (v.).

eyesight.tip: eyesight是不可数名词，不说an eyesight。

worst.tip: worst是bad和badly的最高级；比较级是worse。
worst.en: Worse than all others in quality, condition, or effect.

considerate.en: Careful not to upset or inconvenience other people.

auxiliary.tip: 语法中 auxiliary verb 指助动词，如 be、have、do。
auxiliary.en: providing extra help or support when needed

manly.tip: 高频搭配：manly — 男子气概的；同族词：manliest (最高级)、manlier (比较级)
manly.en: Commonly used in expressions like "manly — 男子气概的" (adj.).

diligent.tip: 不仅指努力，也强调认真、细致和持续投入。
diligent.en: Working carefully and consistently with strong effort

dew.tip: dew通常不可数；一滴露水用a drop of dew。
dew.en: Small water drops forming on cool surfaces, especially overnight

cordial.tip: 形容友好态度较正式；名词在英国常指浓缩果饮。
cordial.en: Friendly and polite, often in a formal situation.

hateful.tip: 可形容充满仇恨的言行，也可指令人厌恶的事物。
hateful.en: expressing strong hatred or a wish to hurt others

deceit.tip: deceit通常不可数；一次欺骗可用an act of deceit。
deceit.en: Dishonest behaviour intended to make someone believe something false.

brood.tip: 作动词表忧思时常接over或on。
brood.en: A group of young birds born to the same mother.

newsstand.tip: 高频搭配：newsstand — 报摊；同族词：newsstands (复数)
newsstand.en: Commonly used in expressions like "newsstand — 报摊" (n.).

bough.tip: 读音与cow押韵；通常指大枝，小枝用twig。
bough.en: a large branch of a tree

invincible.tip: 高频搭配：remain invincible (立于不败之地) / invincible position (不败之地)；同族词：invincible (adj.)
invincible.en: Commonly used in expressions like "remain invincible (立于不败之地)" (adj.).

typist.tip: 指人；typing指打字活动，typewriter指打字机。
typist.en: A person who types, especially as a job.

circumference.tip: 高频搭配：waist circumference (腰围) / chest circumference (胸围)；同族词：circumferences (复数)
circumference.en: Commonly used in expressions like "waist circumference (腰围)" (n.).

mutton.tip: 高频搭配：stewed mutton (红烧羊肉)；同族词：muttons (复数)
mutton.en: Commonly used in expressions like "stewed mutton (红烧羊肉)" (n.).

sightseeing.tip: 不可数名词；说go sightseeing，不加a。
sightseeing.en: the activity of visiting interesting places as a tourist

plural.tip: 高频搭配：plural form (复数形式) / plural society (多元社会)；同族词：plurals (复数)
plural.en: Commonly used in expressions like "plural form (复数形式)" (adj./n.).

badminton.tip: 运动名通常不可数；“打羽毛球”用play badminton。
badminton.en: A sport involving hitting a shuttlecock over a net with rackets

negro.tip: 高频搭配：negro spiritual (n. 黑人灵歌)；同族词：negros (复数)
negro.en: Commonly used in expressions like "negro spiritual (n. 黑人灵歌)" (n.).

kilogram.tip: 高频搭配：kilogram — 千克；同族词：kilograms (复数)
kilogram.en: Commonly used in expressions like "kilogram — 千克" (n.).

aural.tip: aural指听觉的；oral指口头的或口腔的。
aural.en: Relating to hearing or the sense of hearing

dialog.tip: dialog是美式变体；英式通常用dialogue。
dialog.en: A conversation, especially between characters in a story or play.

gunpowder.tip: 不可数名词；一桶火药用a barrel of gunpowder。
gunpowder.en: An explosive powder historically used in guns and still in fireworks.

waken.tip: 比wake少见、较书面；过去式和过去分词均为wakened。
waken.en: to stop sleeping or cause someone to stop sleeping

heterogeneity.tip: 高频搭配：heterogeneity — 异种；同族词：heterogeneities (复数)
heterogeneity.en: Commonly used in expressions like "heterogeneity — 异种" (n.).

adverb.en: a word modifying a verb, adjective, adverb, or whole sentence

gaseous.tip: 高频搭配：gaseous phase ([化]气相) / gaseous state (气态)；同族词：gaseous (adj.)
gaseous.en: Commonly used in expressions like "gaseous phase ([化]气相)" (adj.).

remonstrate.tip: 高频搭配：remonstrate — 抗议；同族词：remonstrated (过去式)、remonstrating (现在分词)、remonstrates (第三人称单数)
remonstrate.en: Commonly used in expressions like "remonstrate — 抗议" (v.).

displease.tip: 高频搭配：displease — 使不愉快；同族词：displeasing (现在分词)、displeased (过去式)、displeases (第三人称单数)
displease.en: Commonly used in expressions like "displease — 使不愉快" (v.).

astrophysics.tip: 高频搭配：astrophysics — 天体物理学；同族词：astrophysic (词根/原形)
astrophysics.en: Commonly used in expressions like "astrophysics — 天体物理学" (n.).

punctual.tip: 表示准时参加会议，用be punctual for a meeting。
punctual.en: Arriving or happening at the agreed or expected time

dictation.tip: 高频搭配：dictation — 口授笔录；同族词：dictations (复数)
dictation.en: Commonly used in expressions like "dictation — 口授笔录" (n.).

fourfold.tip: 高频搭配：fourfold — 四倍；同族词：fourfold (adv./adj.)
fourfold.en: Commonly used in expressions like "fourfold — 四倍" (adv./adj.).

connexion.tip: 高频搭配：connexion — connection的英式拼法；同族词：connexions (复数)
connexion.en: Commonly used in expressions like "connexion — connection的英式拼法" (n.).

dishonour.en: Loss of respect caused by shameful or dishonest behaviour.

waggon.tip: 高频搭配：waggon — 四轮运货马车；同族词：waggons (复数)、waggoning (现在分词)、waggoned (过去式)
waggon.en: Commonly used in expressions like "waggon — 四轮运货马车" (n.).

congratulation.tip: 祝贺通常用复数congratulations，后接on加成就。
congratulation.en: An expression of pleasure at someone's success or good fortune.

industrialize.tip: 可及物也可不及物；英式也拼作industrialise。
industrialize.en: Develop industries and factories in a country or region

gramme.tip: gramme是英式变体；gram更常用，单位符号为g。
gramme.en: a unit of mass equal to one thousandth of a kilogram

preposition.tip: 介词后通常接名词、代词或动名词。
preposition.en: a word showing relationships, such as location, direction, or time

centigrade.tip: 通常说degrees centigrade；现代科学更常用Celsius。
centigrade.en: Using the temperature scale with water freezing at zero

civilize.tip: 谈论民族时易带优越或殖民色彩；英式也拼 civilise。
civilize.en: to make people behave more politely or develop organized societies

fahrenheit.tip: 指华氏温标，并非温度计；首字母始终大写。
fahrenheit.en: Using a temperature scale where water freezes at thirty-two degrees

ampere.tip: 符号为A；口语常缩为amp，复数加s。
ampere.en: a unit used to measure electric current

oceania.tip: 专有名词，首字母大写；前面通常不加the。
oceania.en: the region including Australia, New Zealand, and many Pacific islands

state.tip: state作动词较正式，可接that从句；名词可指状态或国家。
state.en: the condition of someone or something at a particular time

within.tip: within强调不超出某范围；within a week指一周内。
within.en: Inside a particular area, period, or limit.

war.tip: 表示处于交战状态用at war，不加冠词。
war.en: armed fighting between countries or groups

team.tip: 英式英语中team可接单数或复数谓语。
team.en: a group working together or playing a sport together

term.tip: in terms of意为就…而言；条款义常用复数terms。
term.en: A word or expression with a particular meaning.

towards.tip: towards与toward意思相同；前者英式更常用。
towards.en: In the direction of someone or something.

society.tip: 泛指社会常不加the；表示协会时是可数名词。
society.en: People living together in an organised community.

research.tip: 名词通常不可数；说a study，不说a research。
research.en: Careful study aimed at discovering facts or developing knowledge.

win.tip: 过去式和过去分词均为won；赢比赛用win，击败人用beat。
win.en: To succeed in a competition or receive a prize.

toward.tip: toward与towards同义；前者美式更常用。
toward.en: In the direction of someone or something

upon.en: on something, especially in formal or literary language

sense.tip: make sense指讲得通；make sense of指理解。
sense.en: An ability to perceive through sight, hearing, touch, taste, or smell.

special.en: Different from usual, often in an important or valued way.

role.tip: 表示“在……中起作用”用play a role in。
role.en: The function or responsibility someone or something has.

whole.tip: 注意语序：the whole day＝all the day。
whole.en: Complete, with no part missing or left out.

voice.tip: voice侧重人的嗓音；sound泛指声音。
voice.en: The sound someone makes when speaking or singing.

training.tip: 通常不可数；一次培训可说a training session。
training.en: Learning and practice that develop skills for a particular activity.

space.tip: 泛指空间、太空时不可数；具体车位等可数。
space.en: Room available for something, or a gap between things

university.tip: 用a university而非an，因开头发辅音/j/。
university.en: an institution offering degree courses and conducting advanced research

rule.tip: as a rule意为“通常”；rule out意为“排除”。
rule.en: an instruction stating what is allowed or required

test.tip: 参加测验用take a test；通过测验用pass a test。
test.en: a procedure that checks knowledge, ability, condition, or performance

step.tip: take steps to do sth表示“采取措施做某事”。
step.en: a foot movement when walking, or a stair surface

share.tip: 与某人分享用share something with someone。
share.en: To use, enjoy or take responsibility for something with others.

used.tip: 高频搭配：used — 使用过的；同族词：use (词根/原形)
used.en: Commonly used in expressions like "used — 使用过的" (adj.).

rise.tip: rise不及物，过去式rose，过去分词risen；raise及物。
rise.en: To move upwards or become greater in amount or level.

standard.tip: 达到标准用meet a standard；生活水平用standard of living。
standard.en: A required or achieved level of quality or performance.

top.tip: on top of指在上面；at the top of指在顶端。
top.en: the highest part or surface of something

success.tip: 泛指成功时不可数；a success指成功的人或事。
success.en: the achievement of an aim or a desired result

thought.tip: 表具体想法时可数；表思考过程时通常不可数。
thought.en: an idea or opinion formed in the mind

scene.tip: scene可数；scenery指整体风景，不可数。
scene.en: a view or situation that you see

serious.tip: serious about 后接名词或动名词，表示认真对待。
serious.en: causing harm or requiring careful attention

style.tip: style可指个人风格，不一定表示流行时尚。
style.en: A distinctive way of doing something or expressing ideas.

wonder.tip: wonder后接疑问词从句时，用陈述语序。
wonder.en: to think about something you do not know

skill.tip: 具体技能可数；泛指熟练程度时常不可数。
skill.en: an ability to do something well, developed through practice

user.en: A person who uses a product, service, or facility.

sex.tip: sex偏重生理性别；gender常侧重社会性别。
sex.en: Biological classification based on reproductive and other physical characteristics.

suddenly.tip: 可置于句首或动词前；强调变化突然、事先无预兆。
suddenly.en: Quickly and unexpectedly, with little or no warning.

rock.tip: rock 作岩石材料不可数；指一块石头时可数。
rock.en: The hard natural material forming much of Earth's surface.

stone.tip: 石料用不可数stone；一块石头用a stone。
