stone.en: Hard natural material from the ground, or a piece of it.

soviet.tip: Soviet通常大写；小写soviet可指苏维埃议会。
soviet.en: Relating to the former Soviet Union or its governing councils.

successful.tip: 常用be successful in doing；动词为succeed。
successful.en: Achieving the result that was wanted or intended.

traditional.tip: traditional强调传承已久，不一定表示落后。
traditional.en: Following customs or methods passed down over a long time.

shake.en: to move quickly back and forth, or cause this movement

shoulder.tip: 作动词常接responsibility或burden，表示承担。
shoulder.en: the body part where an arm joins the upper body

useful.tip: 首音是辅音/j/，所以说a useful tool，不用an。
useful.en: Helping you do something or achieve a purpose

speaker.tip: a native speaker of English指英语母语者。
speaker.en: a person who gives a talk or addresses others

skin.tip: 指人体皮肤通常不可数；一张兽皮可数。
skin.en: The natural outer covering of a person's or animal's body.

scientist.en: Someone who studies the natural world through research and experiments

safe.tip: safe是形容词，safety是名词；注意词性区别。
safe.en: Protected from danger or unlikely to cause harm.

speech.tip: 一次演讲用a speech；说话能力通常不可数。
speech.en: A formal talk given to an audience.

southern.en: Located in, coming from, or relating to the south.

safety.tip: 通常不可数；safe是形容词，safety是名词。
safety.en: the state of being protected from danger or harm

sale.tip: for sale指待售；销售额或销量通常用复数sales。
sale.en: the act of exchanging something for money

strike.tip: 过去式struck；过去分词通常也用struck。
strike.en: a refusal to work to demand better employment conditions

researcher.tip: researcher可数；research作名词通常不可数。
researcher.en: Someone who studies a subject carefully to discover new information.

spirit.tip: 表示“情绪”或泛指“烈酒”时，常用复数spirits。

strength.tip: 表示力气通常不可数；表示长处可数。
strength.en: Physical power to lift, move, or resist something.

shape.tip: in shape可指身体状态好，不只表示形状。

stick.tip: 动词过去式和过去分词均为stuck；stick to表示坚持。
stick.en: A long, thin piece of wood used for various purposes.

slowly.tip: slowly是副词，修饰动作；slow通常作形容词。
slowly.en: At a low speed or over a long time.

wood.tip: 木材义不可数；树林可说a wood或the woods。
wood.en: the hard material forming tree trunks and branches

truck.tip: truck常用于美式英语，英式英语常用lorry。
truck.en: A large road vehicle used for carrying goods.

relatively.tip: 表示比较后的程度，不等同于very。
relatively.en: To a certain degree compared with something else.

speed.tip: speed up表示加快；speed也可作动词指超速驾驶。
speed.en: How fast something moves, happens, or operates

tool.tip: tool是可数名词；equipment通常不可数。
tool.en: An object used to build, repair, or make things.

wild.tip: 表示“在野外”用in the wild，不能漏掉the。
wild.en: living or growing naturally, without human care

sight.tip: 视力通常不可数；表示名胜常用复数sights。

wine.tip: 泛指葡萄酒时不可数；多种葡萄酒可用wines。
wine.en: An alcoholic drink usually made from fermented grapes

visitor.en: Someone who goes to see a person or place.

soft.tip: soft是形容词；修饰说话等动作通常用softly。
soft.en: easy to press, bend, or change in shape

wonderful.tip: 表示极好或令人愉快，不等于奇怪的。

victory.tip: 高频搭配：victory — 胜利；同族词：victories (复数)
victory.en: Commonly used in expressions like "victory — 胜利" (n.).

theatre.tip: 英式拼写theatre，美式常写theater；英式电影院用cinema。
theatre.en: A building where people watch plays and other live performances.

usual.tip: as usual意为“照常”；than usual意为“比平时”。
usual.en: happening or done most often in a particular situation

unable.tip: 用 be unable to do，不用 unable doing。
unable.en: Not having the ability or opportunity to do something.

tape.tip: 胶带通常不可数；一卷胶带说a roll of tape。
tape.en: A narrow sticky strip used to attach or seal things.

search.tip: 高频搭配：search — 搜寻；同族词：searching (现在分词)、searched (过去式)、searches (复数)
search.en: Commonly used in expressions like "search — 搜寻" (n.).

tie.tip: tie的现在分词是tying；表示关系时通常用复数ties。
tie.en: to fasten something using string, rope, or a knot

warn.tip: warn后可接that从句；warn sb not to do表示告诫。
warn.en: tell someone about possible danger or an unpleasant consequence

surely.tip: 是副词；句首常表示期待对方赞同。
surely.en: Used when expecting others to agree that something is true

shut.tip: 过去式和过去分词均为shut；现在分词为shutting。
shut.en: to close something or stop being open for business

suitable.tip: 常用suitable for sb/sth或suitable to do sth。
suitable.en: right for a particular person, purpose, or situation

salt.tip: 食盐通常不可数；“一小撮盐”用a pinch of salt。
salt.en: a white substance used to flavour or preserve food

teaching.tip: 指教学时不可数；指教义或学说常用teachings。
teaching.en: The work of helping people learn knowledge or skills.

favorite.tip: favorite是美式拼写，英式为favourite；通常不用most修饰。
favorite.en: Liked or preferred more than others

soul.tip: not a soul意为一个人也没有，不是没有灵魂。
soul.en: The spiritual part of a person, separate from the body.

temperature.tip: have a temperature通常指发烧，不只是有体温。
temperature.en: A measure of how hot or cold something is.

waste.tip: 用waste time doing sth，通常不用to do。
waste.en: Use more of something than necessary or without useful results.

seriously.tip: 高频搭配：seriously — 严肃地；同族词：seriously (adv.)
seriously.en: Commonly used in expressions like "seriously — 严肃地" (adv.).

properly.tip: 修饰动作常用properly；修饰名词用proper。
properly.en: In the correct or suitable way.

sixty.tip: sixty重音在首音节；sixteen通常重读末音节。
sixty.en: the number equal to six times ten

storm.tip: storm out表示愤然离开，不是风暴向外移动。
storm.en: severe weather with strong winds and rain, snow, or thunder

expenditure.tip: 通常不可数；expenditure on后接花费对象。

shadow.tip: shadow指具体影子；shade多指遮阳的阴凉处。
shadow.en: A dark shape or area where something blocks light.

widely.tip: widely指范围广；wide还可表示充分张开。
widely.en: Across many places or among many people

root.tip: root本身不表示根除；root out才表示根除。
root.en: the part of a plant that absorbs water from soil

succeed.tip: 表示成功做成某事，用succeed in doing，不用to do。
succeed.en: To achieve what you are trying to do.

winner.tip: winner 指获胜者；winning 可作形容词修饰队伍。
winner.en: a person or team that wins a competition

valley.tip: valley是两侧山地之间的低地，不等同于盆地basin。
valley.en: Low land between hills or mountains, often containing a river.

tear.tip: 撕裂读/teə/，眼泪读/tɪə/；动词变化为 tore、torn。
tear.en: To pull something apart or make a hole by pulling.

secret.tip: 秘诀常用the secret to，to后接名词或动名词。
secret.en: Kept hidden from people who should not know.

servant.tip: 公务员用civil servant，不能只说servant。
servant.en: Someone employed to do household work in another person's home

roof.tip: 复数是roofs；roof指外部屋顶，ceiling指室内天花板。
roof.en: the top covering of a building or vehicle

diet.tip: diet不一定指节食，也可指日常饮食。
diet.en: The food and drink someone regularly consumes.

strongly.en: With great force, intensity, or conviction.

rapidly.tip: 表示速度快，不等于表示立刻的immediately。
rapidly.en: At a fast speed or within a short time.

weak.tip: weak与week同音；weakness可指弱点，也可指虚弱。

tenant.tip: tenant是租客，landlord是房东，二者是对应角色。
tenant.en: someone who pays rent to use property or land

sharp.tip: 形容变化时常指幅度大且突然，如a sharp rise。
sharp.en: Having an edge or point that cuts or pierces easily.

perfectly.tip: perfectly clear意为十分清楚，不译作完美地清楚。
perfectly.en: In a way that has no faults or mistakes.

licence.tip: 英式名词用licence，动词用license；美式都用license。
licence.en: an official document allowing someone to do something

self.tip: self是名词；表达“我自己”通常用myself。
self.en: The personality and qualities that make you who you are.

rose.tip: rose也可作rise的过去式；过去分词是risen。
rose.en: a flower with layered petals, often growing on thorny stems

spanish.tip: 首字母大写；一个西班牙人可说a Spanish person。
spanish.en: the language spoken in Spain and many Latin American countries

sand.tip: 表示沙子时不可数；一粒沙用a grain of sand。
sand.en: Tiny loose grains of rock found on beaches and in deserts.

valuable.tip: 贵重物品用复数valuables；invaluable意为极宝贵的。
valuable.en: Very useful or important for a particular purpose.

sudden.tip: sudden是形容词；修饰动作通常用suddenly。

seventy.tip: 高频搭配：seventy — 七十；同族词：seventy (num.)
seventy.en: Commonly used in expressions like "seventy — 七十" (num.).

whenever.tip: 引导将来时间从句时，通常用一般现在时，不用will。

toss.tip: toss常指轻抛；toss and turn指辗转反侧。
toss.en: To throw something lightly or without much care.

tomato.tip: 复数是tomatoes；英美发音的重读元音不同。
tomato.en: a soft, juicy fruit often eaten as a vegetable

surprising.tip: surprising形容事物；surprised形容人的感受。
surprising.en: unexpected and causing a feeling of surprise

toy.tip: 动词常用toy with；toy with an idea指并不认真地考虑。
toy.en: An object that children use for play.

successfully.tip: 高频搭配：successfully — 成功；同族词：successfully (adv.)
successfully.en: Commonly used in expressions like "successfully — 成功" (adv.).

stomach.tip: 表示“忍受”时，常用于 can't stomach 结构。
stomach.en: The organ that digests food, or the surrounding body area

weigh.tip: weigh是动词，weight是名词；表示重多少不用被动语态。
weigh.en: to measure how heavy someone or something is

stupid.tip: 直接说别人stupid带侮辱性，评价人时应避免。
stupid.en: Showing poor judgment or a lack of sensible thought.

sink.en: To move below a surface, or make something do this.

tail.tip: tail指尾巴；tale指故事，两词同音。
tail.en: the rear part of an animal or an aircraft

yell.tip: yell at常带怒气；yell to侧重喊给对方听。
yell.en: to shout loudly, often from excitement, anger, or fear

super.tip: 口语色彩强；正式写作宜用excellent或very。
super.en: Extremely good or enjoyable, used informally.

roughly.tip: 表示“大约”时常放在数量前；也可指动作粗暴。

satisfaction.tip: 通常不可数；满意某事常说satisfaction with。
satisfaction.en: Pleasure felt when needs, wishes, or expectations are fulfilled.

pant.tip: 高频搭配：pant — 喘息；同族词：panting (现在分词)、panted (过去式)、pants (第三人称单数)
pant.en: Commonly used in expressions like "pant — 喘息" (n.).

wipe.tip: wipe侧重擦拭；wipe out可表示彻底消除。
wipe.en: Rub a surface to remove dirt, liquid, or marks.

shopping.tip: shopping作名词不可数；“去购物”用go shopping。
shopping.en: The activity of looking for and buying things.

genetic.tip: genetic指基因或遗传的；genetics是遗传学。
genetic.en: relating to genes or characteristics passed from parents to offspring

translate.tip: 从某语言译成另一语言：translate from…into…。
translate.en: To express words or writing in another language

tight.tip: tight本身可作副词，如hold tight；tightly也表紧紧地。
tight.en: Fitting closely or held firmly, with little room to move.

satisfy.tip: 人感到满意用satisfied；事物令人满意用satisfying。
satisfy.en: to give someone what they want or need

economics.tip: 指学科时虽以s结尾，仍接单数谓语。
economics.en: The study of how societies produce, distribute, and use resources.

secondly.tip: 用于列举第二点，句首使用时后面通常加逗号。
secondly.en: Used to introduce the second point in a list or argument.

deliberately.tip: 高频搭配：deliberately — 故意地；同族词：deliberately (adv.)
deliberately.en: Commonly used in expressions like "deliberately — 故意地" (adv.).

automatically.tip: 高频搭配：automatically — 自动地；同族词：automatically (adv.)
automatically.en: Commonly used in expressions like "automatically — 自动地" (adv.).

singer.tip: sing 的过去式、过去分词分别是 sang、sung。
singer.en: A person who sings, especially as a job.

tongue.tip: tongue指语言多见于mother tongue等搭配。
tongue.en: the soft organ in your mouth used for tasting and speaking

purely.tip: 常放在for、by或形容词前，强调不含其他因素。
purely.en: Only for the stated reason or in the stated way.

tribe.tip: 指特定社群时，宜尊重其自称，避免泛称。
tribe.en: a social group sharing ancestry, traditions, and community ties

surprisingly.tip: 高频搭配：surprisingly — 使人惊奇；同族词：surprisingly (adv.)
surprisingly.en: Commonly used in expressions like "surprisingly — 使人惊奇" (adv.).

sufficiently.tip: 修饰形容词时放在其前；enough则放在其后。
sufficiently.en: to the degree needed for a particular purpose

trousers.tip: 用复数：trousers are；一条用a pair of trousers。
trousers.en: Clothing covering the waist and legs, with separate leg sections.

soup.tip: 通常不可数；点餐时two soups可指两份汤。
soup.en: A liquid food made by cooking ingredients in water or stock.

tobacco.tip: 通常为不可数名词；一片烟叶用a tobacco leaf。
tobacco.en: A plant whose dried leaves are used to make smoking products

punishment.tip: 高频搭配：punishment — 处罚；同族词：punishments (复数)
punishment.en: Commonly used in expressions like "punishment — 处罚" (n.).

ski.tip: 过去式skied，现在分词skiing；ski复数为skis。
ski.en: to move over snow wearing long narrow boards on your feet

porch.tip: 指入口外的有顶空间，不是室内走廊。
porch.en: A covered area immediately outside a building's entrance.

humor.tip: 高频搭配：humor — 幽默；同族词：humors (第三人称单数)、humoring (现在分词)、humored (过去式)
humor.en: Commonly used in expressions like "humor — 幽默" (n.).

sharply.tip: 高频搭配：sharply — 锐利地；同族词：sharply (adv.)
sharply.en: Commonly used in expressions like "sharply — 锐利地" (adv.).

upstairs.tip: 作副词时前面不加to：go upstairs。
upstairs.en: On or towards a higher floor of a building.

softly.tip: softly强调轻柔或低声；不等于缓慢地。
softly.en: in a quiet voice or with little noise

resignation.tip: 辞职用resignation；另一义是无奈接受，不是反抗。
resignation.en: The act or written notice of leaving a job voluntarily.

seller.tip: seller侧重交易中的卖方，不一定是店内售货员。
seller.en: a person or business that sells something

wherever.tip: 表示“无论哪里”时，相当于no matter where。
wherever.en: in or to any place, regardless of where

rubbish.tip: 通常不可数；英式常用词，美式常说garbage或trash。
rubbish.en: Things people throw away because they no longer need them.

turkey.tip: 鸟可数，肉不可数；表示失败之作时属非正式用法。
turkey.en: A large bird often raised for its meat

sacred.tip: sacred可指宗教上的神圣，也指极珍视、不可侵犯。
sacred.en: Connected with religion and deserving deep respect

soccer.tip: 英式英语通常称football，美式称soccer。
soccer.en: A game where two teams kick a ball into goals.

statute.tip: 高频搭配：statute — 法令；同族词：statutes (复数)
statute.en: Commonly used in expressions like "statute — 法令" (n.).

spell.tip: 过去式及过去分词英式可用spelt或spelled。
spell.en: To write or say the letters of a word in order.

surgeon.tip: surgeon指外科医生；surgery可指外科手术。
surgeon.en: a doctor trained to perform operations

snake.tip: 作动词表示蜿蜒，常搭配through或along。

specially.tip: specially侧重专门目的；especially侧重尤其。
specially.en: for a particular purpose or person

strictly.tip: strictly speaking是固定表达，意为“严格说来”。
strictly.en: with rules followed or enforced exactly

sandwich.tip: 动词常用被动结构be sandwiched between。
sandwich.en: Two slices of bread with a filling between them.

southwest.en: the direction between south and west, or an area's southwestern part

unfair.tip: 表示“对某人不公平”用unfair to someone。
unfair.en: not treating people equally or reasonably

unnecessary.tip: 表示“没必要做”可用 it is unnecessary to do。
unnecessary.en: Not needed or serving no useful purpose.

uncomfortable.tip: 既可指身体不适，也可指心理上的不自在。

sadly.tip: 句首Sadly常表示“遗憾的是”，修饰整句话。
sadly.en: in a way that expresses unhappiness

shame.tip: 羞愧义通常不可数；It's a shame表示真遗憾。
shame.en: A painful feeling caused by doing something wrong or embarrassing.

separation.tip: 高频搭配：separation — 分离；同族词：separations (复数)
separation.en: Commonly used in expressions like "separation — 分离" (n.).

sweat.tip: 汗水通常不可数；出一身汗可说a sweat。
sweat.en: Liquid produced by your skin when hot or nervous.

southeast.tip: 名词前常用the；副词不用：head southeast。
southeast.en: The direction between south and east, or an area's southeastern part.

whisky.tip: 苏格兰酒常拼whisky，爱尔兰和美国酒常拼whiskey。
whisky.en: A strong alcoholic drink made from grain and aged in barrels.

seventeen.tip: 注意与seventy（七十）区分，词尾读清。
seventeen.en: The number after sixteen and before eighteen.

shuttle.tip: 交通语境中强调两地间往返；航天飞机用space shuttle。
shuttle.en: a vehicle making frequent trips between two places

severely.tip: 既可指程度严重，也可指态度严厉，须看搭配。
severely.en: to a very serious or extreme degree

rider.tip: 高频搭配：rider — 骑手；同族词：riders (复数)
rider.en: Commonly used in expressions like "rider — 骑手" (n.).

pavement.tip: 英式指人行道；美式常指道路的硬质表面。
pavement.en: A path beside a road for people to walk on.

reign.en: the period when a king or queen rules

pursuit.tip: 表示追求或追赶通常不可数；消遣活动可数。
pursuit.en: The effort to achieve or obtain something

subsidy.tip: 可数名词，复数为subsidies；常与for搭配。
subsidy.en: Money provided to support activities or keep prices lower.

safely.tip: 高频搭配：safely — 安全地；同族词：safely (adv.)
safely.en: Commonly used in expressions like "safely — 安全地" (adv.).

peel.tip: peel作动词可指削皮，也可指油漆等剥落。
peel.en: To remove the outer skin of fruit or vegetables.

ton.tip: 高频搭配：ton — 吨；同族词：tons (复数)、toning (现在分词)、tonner (比较级)
ton.en: Commonly used in expressions like "ton — 吨" (n.).

thief.tip: 复数是thieves；robber通常涉及暴力或威胁抢劫。
thief.en: someone who steals another person's belongings

steadily.tip: 图表写作常用rise steadily，指平稳上升而非猛增。
steadily.en: At a regular rate, without sudden changes or interruptions.

stumble.tip: stumble不一定摔倒；stumble across指偶然发现。
stumble.en: To trip or briefly lose balance while walking or running

premier.tip: premier可指政府首脑；premiere指首映或首演。
premier.en: The head of a national or regional government.

unfortunate.tip: It is unfortunate that…可表示“令人遗憾的是……”。
unfortunate.en: Experiencing bad luck or caused by bad luck.

upwards.tip: 高频搭配：upwards — 以上；同族词：upwards (adv.)
upwards.en: Commonly used in expressions like "upwards — 以上" (adv.).

tuck.tip: 高频搭配：tuck — 缝褶；同族词：tucked (过去分词)、tucking (现在分词)、tucks (第三人称单数)
tuck.en: Commonly used in expressions like "tuck — 缝褶" (n.).

ruler.tip: a ruler可指一把尺子或一位统治者，需看语境。
ruler.en: A straight tool for measuring lengths or drawing straight lines.

undertaking.tip: 作“承诺”时常用give an undertaking to do。
undertaking.en: A task or project, especially one requiring considerable effort.

runner.en: a person who runs, especially for exercise or in races

terrific.tip: 常用于口语赞扬；别与terrible“糟糕的”混淆。

aluminum.tip: 美式拼写；英式通常写aluminium，读音也不同。
aluminum.en: A light, silvery metal used for cans, foil, and aircraft.

stitch.tip: get a stitch指运动时岔气，不是“缝一针”。
stitch.en: a loop of thread holding fabric or a wound together

sock.tip: 一双袜子说a pair of socks，sock为可数名词。
sock.en: a clothing item covering the foot and lower leg

soap.tip: 指清洁用品通常不可数；一块用a bar of soap。
soap.en: A substance used with water to clean skin or objects.

illusion.tip: 高频搭配：illusion — 幻影；同族词：illusions (复数)
illusion.en: Commonly used in expressions like "illusion — 幻影" (n.).

spoon.tip: 一勺的量通常用 a spoonful of 表达。
spoon.en: A utensil with a small bowl for eating or serving.

remains.tip: 作名词用复数谓语；也可为remain的单数动词形式。
remains.en: Parts left after something has been used, damaged, or destroyed.

partially.tip: partially表示不完全地；不要误解为偏心地。
partially.en: to some extent, but not completely

shy.tip: shy away from后接名词或动名词，表示回避。
shy.en: nervous or uncomfortable when meeting or speaking to people

proclaim.tip: 高频搭配：proclaim — 宣布；同族词：proclaimed (过去分词)、proclaiming (现在分词)、proclaims (第三人称单数)
proclaim.en: Commonly used in expressions like "proclaim — 宣布" (v.).

scent.tip: scent常指香味，也指动物追踪的气味；c不发音。
scent.en: A noticeable smell, especially a pleasant one.

textbook.tip: 作形容词时指典型或标准，如textbook example。
textbook.en: A book used to study a particular subject.

timetable.en: A schedule showing when lessons, journeys, or other events happen.

slavery.tip: slavery为不可数名词；abolish slavery指废除奴隶制。
slavery.en: a system where people are owned and forced to work

likelihood.tip: 常用likelihood of doing或likelihood that从句。
likelihood.en: the chance that something will happen

refuge.tip: take/seek refuge in表示“在……避难”；refuge通常作名词。
refuge.en: protection from danger, trouble, or bad weather

verb.tip: 高频搭配：verb — 动词；同族词：verbs (复数)
verb.en: Commonly used in expressions like "verb — 动词" (n.).

sprinkle.tip: 可说sprinkle A over B，也可说sprinkle B with A。
sprinkle.en: To scatter small drops or pieces over something.

useless.tip: useless at后接名词或动名词，表示不擅长。
useless.en: Not useful or unable to achieve the intended result

throne.tip: the throne可指王位，不一定指实体座椅。
throne.en: A special chair used by a king or queen.

poke.tip: poke fun at是“取笑”，不是“戳”。
poke.en: to push a finger or pointed object into something

unpleasant.tip: 形容事物表示令人不快；形容人常指态度不友善。

steward.tip: 不只指乘务员；a steward of也可指资源守护者。
steward.en: Someone who assists passengers or people attending an event.

tiger.tip: 可数名词；一只老虎用a tiger。
tiger.en: A large wild cat with dark stripes on orange fur

tablet.tip: tablet既指平板电脑，也指药片，需看语境。
tablet.en: a portable computer with a flat touchscreen

rubber.tip: 橡胶不可数；橡皮擦可数，美式英语通常用eraser。
rubber.en: an elastic material used to make tyres and other products

spy.tip: 监视某人用spy on；过去式和过去分词为spied。
spy.en: Someone who secretly gathers information about a country or organisation

permanently.tip: 高频搭配：permanently — 永久；同族词：permanently (adv.)
permanently.en: Commonly used in expressions like "permanently — 永久" (adv.).

pistol.en: A small gun designed to be held in one hand.

sickness.tip: 通常不可数；英式英语中也常指恶心、呕吐。

retrieve.tip: 高频搭配：retrieve — 取回；同族词：retrieved (过去分词)、retrieving (现在分词)、retrieves (第三人称单数)
retrieve.en: Commonly used in expressions like "retrieve — 取回" (v.).

telegraph.tip: telegraph 指通信系统或设备；telegram 指电报消息。
telegraph.en: A system or device sending messages electrically along wires.

spectacle.tip: 高频搭配：spectacle — 引人羡慕的东西；同族词：spectacles (复数)、spectacled (过去式)
spectacle.en: Commonly used in expressions like "spectacle — 引人羡慕的东西" (n.).

comparatively.tip: 常修饰形容词原级，如comparatively cheap。
comparatively.en: To a particular degree when compared with something else.

scar.tip: 高频搭配：scar — 疤痕；同族词：scars (复数)、scarred (过去分词)、scarring (现在分词)
scar.en: Commonly used in expressions like "scar — 疤痕" (n.).
