vaccination.en: Giving a vaccine to help protect someone against disease

self-defence.tip: 通常不可数；美式拼写为self-defense。
self-defence.en: protecting yourself from attack or physical harm

apiece.tip: 常放在价格或数量之后，不用于名词前作限定词。
apiece.en: For each person or thing separately.

considerably.tip: 常修饰比较级或变化动词，表示差异或变化很大。
considerably.en: by a large amount or to a large degree

note-taking.tip: 通常不可数；动词短语用take notes。
note-taking.en: the activity of writing down important information while listening or reading

herbal.tip: 英式发音读出h，美式通常不读h。
herbal.en: Relating to herbs or made from them.

expertise.tip: 不可数；某领域的专长用expertise in。
expertise.en: Specialist knowledge or skills gained through training and experience.

mid-term.tip: 也常写作midterm；作名词指期中考试，多见于美语。
mid-term.en: Happening halfway through an academic term or period in office.

terrify.tip: 及物动词；terrified形容人，terrifying形容吓人的事物。
terrify.en: To make someone feel extremely frightened.

prefix.tip: prefix放词首，suffix放词尾；两者统称affix。
prefix.en: A word part added at the beginning to change meaning.

slang.tip: 通常不可数；一个俚语表达用a slang term。
slang.en: very informal words used by particular groups of people

emission.tip: 指废气或排放量常用复数emissions；动词是emit。
emission.en: A substance released into the environment, especially a polluting gas.

poker.tip: poker是特定扑克游戏，不泛指所有纸牌。
poker.en: A card game involving bets on the strength of players' hands.

agreeable.tip: be agreeable to sth表示愿意接受某事，语气较正式。

encyclopaedia.tip: 英式拼写；美式通常写作encyclopedia。
encyclopaedia.en: A reference work containing information about many subjects or one field

paraphrase.tip: 改述须保留原意；summarize则侧重概括要点。
paraphrase.en: Express the same meaning using different words.

ecology.tip: ecology指生态学或生态关系，不等于environment。
ecology.en: The study of relationships between living things and their environment.

fin.tip: 指潜水脚蹼时常用复数fins。
fin.en: a flat body part or structure aiding movement or stability

postal.en: Relating to the system of collecting and delivering mail.

outdated.tip: 强调因时代变化而不再适用，不只是年代久远。
outdated.en: No longer useful or suitable because things have changed.

novelist.tip: novelist通常指长篇小说作家，novel是长篇小说。

fossil.tip: fossil fuels指煤、石油、天然气等化石燃料。
fossil.en: Ancient remains or traces of living things preserved in rock.

flaw.tip: 可数名词；某物的缺陷常用a flaw in sth。
flaw.en: a fault that makes something imperfect or less effective

flatten.tip: flatten out也可指价格、曲线等趋于平稳。
flatten.en: to make something flat or become flat

invoice.tip: invoice 通常用于要求付款；receipt 是已付款的收据。
invoice.en: a document listing goods or services and the payment required

fury.tip: 比anger语气强；in a fury表示“勃然大怒”。
fury.en: An extremely strong feeling of anger.

complication.tip: 可指数额外难题，也可指疾病或治疗引起的并发症。
complication.en: An extra problem that makes a situation harder to manage

detach.tip: 常用 detach A from B；detachable 指可拆卸的。
detach.en: to remove or separate something from what it is attached to

relay.tip: 动词也读/rɪˈleɪ/；relay a message指转达消息。
relay.en: a race in which teammates take turns completing sections

unreasonable.tip: 可形容人不讲理，也可形容要求或价格过分。
unreasonable.en: Not fair, sensible, or willing to accept good reasons.

overwhelming.tip: 强调程度极大；既可形容支持，也可形容压力。
overwhelming.en: So great or strong that little can oppose it

jellyfish.tip: 复数通常仍用 jellyfish；它不是鱼类。
jellyfish.en: a soft sea animal with hanging tentacles that can sting

criteria.en: Standards used to judge something or make a decision.

interact.tip: 不及物动词：与某人互动用interact with someone。
interact.en: To communicate or do things with other people.

superstitious.tip: 常用be superstitious about表示对某事迷信。
superstitious.en: believing certain actions or objects bring good or bad luck

carpentry.en: The work or skill of making and repairing wooden structures.

impractical.tip: 是形容词，不是动词；不实用不一定是不可能。
impractical.en: Unlikely to work well or be useful in practice

kidnap.tip: 不限于儿童；常用过去式kidnapped，分词kidnapping。
kidnap.en: To take someone away illegally and hold them captive

collide.tip: 通常是不及物动词；与某物相撞用with。
collide.en: to crash into something or each other

merchandise.tip: 名词不可数；动词词尾常读作/daɪz/。

edible.tip: edible表示能吃，不表示美味；勿凭外观判断野生植物。

disrupt.tip: 及物动词，直接接活动或系统；不是形容词。
disrupt.en: Prevent an activity or system from continuing normally.

threatened.tip: threatened指受到威胁；threatening指构成威胁。
threatened.en: At risk of harm, loss, or extinction.

howl.tip: 既用于动物长嚎，也用于风声或人的强烈反应。
howl.en: Make a long, loud cry or a similar rushing sound.

indirectly.tip: 是副词，不是形容词；修饰动词时用indirectly。
indirectly.en: Through another person, thing, or stage rather than directly

man-made.tip: 强调由人制造或造成；也可用human-made。
man-made.en: made or caused by people rather than occurring naturally

absurd.tip: 常用句式：It is absurd to do sth.。

migration.en: The movement of people to live in another place.

volcanic.tip: 通常作形容词；“火山岩”用volcanic rock。
volcanic.en: Related to volcanoes or produced by their activity.

obese.tip: 属医学用语，程度通常重于overweight；避免随意评价他人。
obese.en: having excessive body fat that may harm health

hedgehog.tip: hedgehog是刺猬；porcupine是豪猪，两者不是同一种动物。
hedgehog.en: A small mammal with spines that curls into a ball.

memo.tip: memo常指工作中的简短内部通知，复数为memos。
memo.en: A short written message, especially between people at work.

technological.tip: technological侧重科技发展，technical侧重具体技术。
technological.en: relating to technology and its practical development

compulsory.tip: compulsory强调规定必须做，与optional相对。
compulsory.en: required by a law or rule, rather than optional

mass media.tip: 泛指大众传媒常用the mass media，通常接复数谓语。
mass media.en: communication channels that deliver information to very large audiences

embarrassment.tip: 情绪义不可数；指令人尴尬的人或事时可数。
embarrassment.en: an uncomfortable feeling caused by awkwardness or fear of others' judgment

fatty.tip: 作名词称呼人有侮辱性，应避免使用。
fatty.en: Containing much fat, or consisting of fat.

challenging.tip: 形容任务有难度用challenging，不用challenged。
challenging.en: Difficult in a way that tests skills or determination.

beware.tip: 常用于警告：beware of＋名词；不用作普通过去式。
beware.en: to be careful about a possible danger or problem

venus.tip: 专有名词，首字母大写；金星通常不加冠词。
venus.en: The planet second closest to the Sun.

briefing.tip: 不只是书面简报，也常指口头说明或简报会。
briefing.en: a meeting or explanation giving essential information or instructions

odds.tip: odds用复数形式，常接of或that从句。
odds.en: The likelihood that something will happen.

cooperation.tip: 通常不可数；与……合作用in cooperation with。
cooperation.en: the act of working together towards a shared goal

completion.tip: 常用on completion of表示“在……完成时”。
completion.en: The act or state of finishing something.

notable.tip: notable for表示因……而出名或引人注意。
notable.en: important or unusual enough to deserve attention

deforestation.tip: 不可数名词；常用于栖息地丧失和气候变化话题。
deforestation.en: The clearing of forests by cutting down trees.

attendant.tip: attendant常指服务人员；参会者通常用attendee。
attendant.en: Someone employed to help people in a public place.

appreciation.tip: 通常不可数；an appreciation of可指对某事的理解。
appreciation.en: A feeling of gratitude for someone's help or kindness.

almond.tip: 通常指扁桃仁（巴旦木），并非杏核中的杏仁。
almond.en: an edible oval nut, or the tree that produces it

migrate.en: to move to another region, seasonally or to live there

lobster.tip: 指动物时可数；指作为食物的虾肉时不可数。
lobster.en: A large sea animal with a hard shell and claws.

burial.tip: burial重在入土安葬；funeral泛指葬礼仪式。
burial.en: the act or ceremony of placing a dead body underground

watt.tip: 瓦特衡量功率；千瓦时衡量用电量。
watt.en: a unit used to measure power

restricted.tip: restricted to表示“仅限于”；也是restrict过去分词。
restricted.en: limited in amount, range, or freedom

adjustment.tip: 表示改动或适应时，常用 adjustment to。
adjustment.en: A small change made to improve something.

reef.tip: reef指接近海面的礁体，不是海边的悬崖cliff。
reef.en: A ridge of rock or coral near the sea's surface.

giggle.tip: 强调轻轻咯咯笑，可因好玩或紧张；笑某事用at。
giggle.en: laugh in a light, often nervous or silly way

cleverness.tip: 不可数名词；既可指人的聪明，也可指设计巧妙。
cleverness.en: the ability to understand quickly or find effective, inventive solutions

tangle.tip: a tangle of既可指实物缠结，也可指复杂困局。
tangle.en: A twisted mass of threads, hair, or similar things

carbohydrate.tip: 泛指营养成分可不可数；谈种类或总称常用复数。
carbohydrate.en: A substance such as sugar or starch that provides energy.

yarn.tip: 作“纱线”通常不可数；作“故事”可数。
yarn.en: Thread used for knitting or weaving cloth.

applaud.tip: 可直接接人或事；applause是不可数名词。
applaud.en: Clap your hands to show enjoyment or approval.

hectic.tip: 现代常用义是忙乱的，不是兴奋的或发热的。
hectic.en: extremely busy and full of activity, often causing stress

longitude.tip: longitude是经度，分东西；latitude是纬度，分南北。
longitude.en: a place's angular distance east or west of the prime meridian

showroom.tip: 可数名词；showrooming指先在实体店看货再网购。
showroom.en: A room where goods are displayed for customers to examine.

landslide.tip: 政治语境中常指选举中的压倒性胜利。
landslide.en: a mass of earth and rocks sliding down a slope

hospitable.tip: 形容人时指好客；形容环境时指适宜生存。
hospitable.en: Friendly and generous towards guests or visitors.

uninterested.tip: 接in；勿与表示“公正无私”的disinterested混淆。
uninterested.en: not wanting to learn about or take part in something

wag.tip: 过去式wagged，现在分词wagging，均双写g。
wag.en: move repeatedly from side to side

stabilize.tip: 可及物也可不及物；英式英语也常拼作stabilise。
stabilize.en: make or become steady and less likely to change

flannel.tip: 布料义不可数；英式英语中a flannel指一块洗脸巾。
flannel.en: soft cotton or wool cloth used for warm clothing

strand.tip: 一缕头发用a strand of hair；滞留常用be stranded。
strand.en: A single thin length of hair, thread, or similar material.

attentively.tip: 最常见于listen attentively，重在专心而非关心。
attentively.en: with careful attention to what is happening

installment.tip: 美式拼写；英式为instalment，分期用in。
installment.en: One of several payments made over time for something.

crisp.tip: 薯片英式常用复数crisps，美式说potato chips。
crisp.en: firm or dry enough to break with a sharp sound

spoonful.tip: 是名词而非形容词；复数通常为spoonfuls。
spoonful.en: The amount that a spoon can hold

brightness.tip: 不可数；屏幕的“亮度”用brightness，不用lightness。
brightness.en: The amount of light something gives off or reflects.

remainder.tip: 常用the remainder of；谓语单复数取决于所指内容。
remainder.en: what is left after other parts are removed or used

appealing.tip: 表示“对某人有吸引力”用appealing to sb。
appealing.en: attractive or interesting enough to make people want it

courtesy.tip: courtesy of表示承蒙某方提供或允许使用。
courtesy.en: polite behaviour showing respect and consideration for others

parachute.tip: 作动词时，既可指人跳伞，也可指空投物资。
parachute.en: Equipment that slows a fall through the air

eyelid.en: a fold of skin that closes over the eye

oak.tip: 指树时可数，指木材时不可数；oak table中作定语。
oak.en: a large tree that produces acorns

fluffy.tip: 形容毛发时指毛茸茸；形容食物时指松软。
fluffy.en: covered with soft hair or having a soft, airy texture

tracking.tip: 作名词通常不可数；也是track的现在分词。
tracking.en: The process of following movements or monitoring changes over time.

hold-up.tip: 名词有连字符；动词短语写作hold up。
hold-up.en: A delay that prevents something from continuing as planned

bacterium.tip: 单数bacterium，复数bacteria；复数作主语用are。
bacterium.en: A microscopic single-celled organism, sometimes responsible for disease.

outbreak.tip: 名词outbreak写成一词；动词用break out。
outbreak.en: The sudden start of a disease or other harmful event.

subscription.en: An arrangement to receive a service or publication regularly.

goddess.tip: goddess指女神，对应男性神祇通常用god。
goddess.en: A female deity worshipped in a religion or described in mythology.

siren.tip: 可指发声的警报器，也可指其发出的警报声。
siren.en: a device producing a loud warning sound, or that sound

coursework.tip: 不可数，不说 a coursework；一份用 a piece of。
coursework.en: Work completed during a course, often contributing to final assessment.

demolish.tip: 及物动词，直接接宾语；也可指彻底驳倒论点。
demolish.en: To completely destroy a building or other structure.

pest.tip: pest不限于昆虫，也可指老鼠等有害动物。
pest.en: An insect or animal that damages crops, food, or property.

gadget.tip: 指有特定用途的小装置，不一定是电子产品。
gadget.en: A small device designed to perform a particular useful task

etiquette.tip: 通常不可数；表示礼仪规范，不指单个动作。
etiquette.en: Accepted rules of polite behaviour in particular social situations.

debit.tip: 借记卡用账户余额；信用卡使用授信额度。
debit.en: An amount recorded as money taken from a bank account.

patio.tip: 通常指房屋旁铺地的户外休憩区，不一定有围墙。
patio.en: a paved outdoor area beside a house for sitting or eating

bookkeeper.tip: 主要负责日常记账；accountant职责通常更广。
bookkeeper.en: Someone whose job is recording a business's financial transactions.

unlimited.tip: 表示没有限制；不等于 uncertain（不确定的）。
unlimited.en: not restricted in amount, number, or extent

bias.tip: bias against 指对……有偏见；in favour of 指偏袒。
bias.en: an unfair preference for or against a person or group

thigh.tip: 指髋部到膝盖之间；小腿通常用lower leg。
thigh.en: The upper part of the leg, above the knee.

corporate.en: Relating to a company or businesses in general.

supplier.tip: supplier of后接所供物品；supply为其动词形式。
supplier.en: a person or company that provides goods or services

speculation.tip: 猜测内容常接about或that从句；也可指金融投机。
speculation.en: Ideas about something without enough evidence to be certain.

asthma.tip: 不可数名词；th不发音，英美中间辅音不同。
asthma.en: A condition that can narrow airways and make breathing difficult

supposing.tip: 相当于if，可接that从句，常用来提出假设。
supposing.en: used to introduce an imagined situation or possibility

coincidence.tip: 碰巧用by coincidence；纯属巧合用pure coincidence。
coincidence.en: an unexpected connection between events that have no apparent cause

unfit.tip: 常用unfit for sth或unfit to do sth。
unfit.en: not suitable or good enough for a particular purpose

extract.en: to remove or obtain something from a larger source

feminine.tip: feminine强调气质或语法性；female强调性别。
feminine.en: Having qualities or styles traditionally associated with women.

diplomat.tip: diplomatic既可指外交的，也可指说话圆通的。
diplomat.en: An official who represents their country in relations with other countries.

caption.tip: caption配图片或视频；新闻报道标题通常用headline。
caption.en: Words accompanying an image or showing speech on a screen

archery.tip: archery 是不可数名词；射箭运动员叫 archer。
archery.en: the sport or skill of shooting arrows with a bow

archaeology.tip: 通常不可数；研究恐龙化石属于古生物学。
archaeology.en: The study of past societies through objects and remains.

destiny.tip: 常指注定的未来；shape your destiny强调主动掌握命运。
destiny.en: A future believed to be fixed by forces beyond personal control.

vacancy.tip: 职位、客房空缺均可数；复数为vacancies。
vacancy.en: A job or position available for someone to fill.

anthem.tip: national anthem指国歌；宗教语境中可指合唱赞美诗。
anthem.en: A song expressing loyalty to a country or group

appendix.tip: 附录复数可用appendices；阑尾常用appendixes。
appendix.en: An extra section containing supporting information at a book's end

counselor.tip: 美式拼写；英式通常写作 counsellor。
counselor.en: Someone trained to help people with personal or emotional problems.

cork.tip: 表示软木材料时不可数；表示软木塞时可数。
cork.en: a light material from tree bark, used for sealing bottles

time-consuming.tip: 强调花费大量时间，不一定表示浪费时间。
time-consuming.en: taking a lot of time to do or complete

predator.tip: predator是捕食者，prey是被捕食的猎物。
predator.en: An animal that hunts and eats other animals.

context.tip: out of context指脱离语境，常用于断章取义。
context.en: The circumstances surrounding an event that help explain it.

narrator.tip: 叙述者不一定是作者；小说中可由虚构人物担任。
narrator.en: The person or voice telling a story

suffix.en: A word part added at the end to change meaning or grammar.

united.tip: be united in后接共同立场；united front指一致阵线。
united.en: Working together or sharing the same aims and opinions.

linguistics.tip: 虽以s结尾，作为学科名通常接单数谓语。
linguistics.en: The scientific study of language and how it works.

workaholic.tip: 强调工作过度、难以停下，不等于单纯勤奋。
workaholic.en: Someone who works excessively and finds it hard to stop

best-seller.en: a book or product that sells in very large quantities

sleepiness.tip: 不可数名词，指想睡的感觉，不等于已经入睡。
sleepiness.en: The feeling of being tired and wanting to sleep.

blush.tip: 动词通常不及物；使某人脸红用make someone blush。
blush.en: To become red in the face from embarrassment or shyness.

contestant.tip: contestant指参赛者；participant也可指普通活动参与者。
contestant.en: A person who takes part in a competition.

decorator.tip: 英式英语常指刷墙、贴墙纸的工人，不仅是设计师。
decorator.en: Someone whose job is painting, wallpapering, or decorating rooms.

liking.tip: a liking for表示喜欢；to your liking表示合心意。
liking.en: a feeling of enjoying or being fond of something

homeless.tip: 不能说a homeless；应说a homeless person。
homeless.en: Without a permanent place to live.

repay.tip: 过去式和过去分词均为repaid；不表示报复。
repay.en: to pay back money that you owe

grief.tip: 表示悲痛时通常不可数，常与失去亲人有关。
grief.en: Deep sadness, especially after someone you love has died

literal.tip: literal指字面义；literary指文学的，注意区别。
literal.en: using the basic meaning of words, without metaphor

collaboration.tip: 普通语境指合作；通敌义须结合战争背景。
collaboration.en: Working together with others to achieve a shared goal

outsider.tip: 既可指圈外人，也可指不被看好的参赛者。
outsider.en: Someone who does not belong to a particular group.

distract.tip: 常用distract sb from sth或doing sth。
distract.en: To draw someone's attention away from what they are doing

kitesurfing.tip: 指由风筝牵引滑行，区别于帆板运动windsurfing。
kitesurfing.en: Riding a board across water while pulled by a kite.

serving.tip: 食物的serving是可数名词，常用a serving of。
serving.en: An amount of food or drink intended for one person.

in-store.tip: in-store指店内的；“有库存”通常说in stock。
in-store.en: happening or available inside a physical shop

citizenship.tip: 通常不可数；区别于residency（居留资格）。
citizenship.en: the legal status of belonging to a particular country

antibiotics.tip: 是antibiotic的复数；抗生素不能治疗病毒感染。
antibiotics.en: Medicines used to treat infections caused by bacteria.

erupt.tip: 通常作不及物动词；erupt into后可接掌声等。
erupt.en: To force out lava, ash, or gas from a volcano.

greed.tip: 不可数名词；greed for后接金钱、权力等渴求对象。
greed.en: a strong desire for more than one needs or deserves

brag.tip: 常接 about 或 that；过去式 bragged 双写 g。
brag.en: to talk too proudly about your achievements or possessions

financing.tip: 指提供或筹措资金；金融学通常用finance。
financing.en: the provision of money for a purchase, business, or project

heritage.tip: 多指文化与历史传承；个人继承财产常用inheritance。
heritage.en: Traditions, buildings, and values passed down from earlier generations.

laborer.tip: 美式拼写；英式为labourer，强调体力劳动。
laborer.en: Someone whose job involves hard physical work.

distinctly.tip: distinctly可修饰记忆、感知，也可强调程度。
distinctly.en: in a way that is easy to perceive or remember

gem.tip: hidden gem常指尚未广为人知的好地方或精品。
gem.en: a valuable stone, often cut and polished for jewellery

unpaid.tip: unpaid work指无偿工作；unpaid bills指未付账单。
unpaid.en: Done or working without receiving money.

hardness.tip: hardness 指硬度；hardship 才指困苦。
hardness.en: How strongly a material resists scratching, cutting, or denting.

expectancy.tip: life expectancy指预期寿命，不等于实际寿命。
expectancy.en: A feeling that something pleasant or exciting will happen.

editing.tip: 可作名词，也可作edit的现在分词。
editing.en: Preparing writing, images, or recordings by correcting and arranging them.

functional.tip: functional可指实用，也可指设备能正常工作。
functional.en: designed to be useful rather than decorative

plump.tip: 比fat语气温和，但描述他人体型仍需谨慎。
plump.en: pleasantly round and full in shape

disagreement.tip: 具体争执可数；泛指意见不合时通常不可数。
disagreement.en: A difference of opinion or an argument about it.

misery.tip: 通常不可数；a misery可指令人痛苦的处境。

fabulous.tip: 表“极好的”多用于非正式语境，语气较强。

warrior.tip: 常用于古代战士；现代军人通常用soldier。
warrior.en: A person experienced in fighting, especially in the past.

literally.tip: 口语可用于夸张；正式写作宜保留字面或确实义。
literally.en: According to the exact, ordinary meaning of the words.

shipment.tip: 指一批货物时可数；指装运过程时不可数。
shipment.en: A quantity of goods sent together to a destination.

foam.tip: foam作泡沫或泡沫材料时通常不可数。
foam.en: a mass of small bubbles on or in a liquid

enormously.tip: 常修饰形容词或动词，表示程度极高。
enormously.en: to a very great degree or extent

concise.tip: 不仅指短，还强调信息清楚且无赘述。
concise.en: Expressing information clearly in few words, without unnecessary detail.

attendance.en: The act of being present at an event or place.

importer.tip: 既可指进口商，也可指进口商品的国家。
importer.en: A person, company, or country buying goods from abroad.

riverside.tip: 常作名词定语，如 a riverside park（河滨公园）。
riverside.en: The area of land beside a river.

crumb.tip: 可数名词；表示面包屑时常用复数crumbs。
crumb.en: A tiny piece that breaks off bread, cake, or biscuits

deprive.tip: 固定结构deprive sb of sth，介词用of。
deprive.en: to prevent someone from having something they need or value

ward.tip: 作动词通常用ward off，表示抵挡、避开。
ward.en: a hospital room or section for patients receiving similar care

exceptional.tip: 常指特别优秀；exceptional circumstances指特殊情况。

icon.tip: 既可指屏幕图标，也可指有代表性的偶像或文化象征。
icon.en: a small screen image representing a program, file, or function

risky.tip: 常用It is risky to do sth表示做某事有风险。
risky.en: involving a chance of harm, failure, or loss

preservation.tip: 通常不可数；the preservation of后接保护对象。
preservation.en: The act of keeping something safe from damage or loss.

casualty.tip: 包括受伤者和死者，不等于仅指死亡的fatality。
casualty.en: Someone injured or killed in an accident, conflict, or disaster.

sibling.tip: 可数名词，单数指一个兄弟或姐妹，不区分性别。

alien.tip: 称外国人为alien有疏离感；通常用foreign national。
alien.en: Unfamiliar or very different from what someone knows or accepts

wasp.tip: wasp是黄蜂，bee是蜜蜂；两者不是同一种昆虫。
wasp.en: A narrow-waisted flying insect that can sting.

unwelcome.tip: 可形容人、消息或变化；feel unwelcome指感到不受欢迎。
unwelcome.en: not wanted or received with pleasure

oyster.tip: the world is your oyster指你有无限机会。
oyster.en: A shellfish with a rough shell, sometimes producing pearls.

pedestrian.tip: 作名词指行人；作形容词也可指作品平庸乏味。
pedestrian.en: a person walking rather than travelling in a vehicle

maximize.tip: 及物动词；英式也常拼作maximise。
maximize.en: to increase something as much as possible or use it fully

tile.tip: 可数名词；作动词时直接接要铺砖的表面。
tile.en: A shaped piece used to cover floors, walls, or roofs.

satisfactorily.tip: 表示达到要求，不一定是表现出色。
satisfactorily.en: in a way that meets expectations or requirements

catching.tip: 多作表语；形容曲调朗朗上口用catchy，而非catching。
catching.en: able to spread between people, like an illness or emotion

tanker.tip: tank可指储罐；tanker指运输液体等的船或车辆。
tanker.en: A ship designed to carry large quantities of liquid

cramp.tip: 表示空间狭窄用cramped，不用cramp作形容词。
cramp.en: Sudden pain caused by a muscle tightening involuntarily.

navigate.tip: 可直接接地点或网站，也可用 navigate through。
navigate.en: to find or direct the way to a destination

assessed.tip: 是assess的过去式和过去分词，词尾读/st/。
assessed.en: Evaluated the quality, value, extent, or importance of something.

module.tip: 课程中的module是独立单元，通常包含多节课。
module.en: a separate unit within a larger course of study

bilingual.tip: 表示精通哪两种语言，可用bilingual in A and B。
bilingual.en: Able to use two languages, or involving two languages.

typically.tip: 通常放在实义动词前、be动词后。
typically.en: In most cases or on most occasions.

generosity.tip: 通常不可数；一次慷慨之举用an act of generosity。
generosity.en: Willingness to give money, time, or help freely.

lily.en: A plant with large, often trumpet-shaped flowers.

muscular.tip: 既可指肌肉发达，也可仅表示与肌肉有关。

fascination.tip: 对某物着迷用 fascination with；看得入迷用 with fascination。
fascination.en: a very strong interest in someone or something

marvel.tip: 动词常接at；英式过去式marvelled，美式marveled。
marvel.en: Someone or something that causes great admiration or surprise

overview.tip: 通常作可数名词；搭配an overview of。
overview.en: A short account presenting the main features of a subject.

recruitment.tip: 通常不可数；招聘某类人员用recruitment of。
recruitment.en: the process of finding people to join an organisation

checklist.tip: 可数名词；强调逐项核对，不只是罗列物品。
checklist.en: A list of things to check or do

straightforward.tip: 既可形容事情简单，也可形容人坦率。
straightforward.en: easy to understand or do, without complications

cohesive.tip: cohesive强调紧密结合；coherent强调条理清楚。
cohesive.en: united or closely connected as a whole

hull.en: The main outer body of a ship or boat.

prospectus.tip: 教育语境常指招生简章，金融语境可指招股说明书。
prospectus.en: a document describing a school or university for potential students

sonnet.tip: sonnet固定为十四行，但押韵格式不只一种。
sonnet.en: A fourteen-line poem following a particular rhyme and rhythm pattern.

coeducation.tip: 不可数名词；形容词形式为coeducational。
coeducation.en: The education of boys and girls together in the same institution.

consul.tip: consul是领事；consulate是领事馆，勿混淆。
consul.en: An official abroad who assists citizens and represents national interests

manipulation.tip: 指操控人时常含贬义；指操作工具时可中性。
manipulation.en: Controlling people or situations unfairly for personal advantage.

concurrent.tip: 强调时间重叠；表示“与…同时”可用concurrent with。
concurrent.en: Happening or existing at the same time

flatter.tip: be flattered常指受宠若惊，不一定含贬义。
flatter.en: Praise someone, often insincerely, to gain their favour.

meddle.tip: 常接in表示干涉事务；接with表示擅自摆弄。
meddle.en: Interfere in other people's affairs without being invited.

contemplation.tip: 通常不可数；强调安静深思，不一定是痛苦思索。
contemplation.en: the act of thinking deeply and quietly about something

threshold.tip: on the threshold of表示即将进入某个新阶段。
threshold.en: the level at which something starts happening or changes

preoperative.tip: pre- 表示之前；postoperative 则表示手术后的。
preoperative.en: Happening or provided before a surgical operation.

inherent.tip: 常用inherent in；强调本身具有，而非后来获得。
inherent.en: Existing as a natural or essential part of something.

empirical.tip: 强调观察或实验依据，不等于个人经验之谈。
empirical.en: based on observation or experiments rather than theory alone

waterfront.tip: 指城镇临水地带，不一定是沙滩或海边。
waterfront.en: An area beside a sea, lake, or river, especially in towns.

redistribute.tip: 强调改变原有分配，不一定意味着平均分配。
redistribute.en: To share out or spread something again in a different way.

compliance.tip: 通常不可数；表示遵守某规定时用compliance with。
compliance.en: the act of following a rule, law, or request

phony.tip: 偏口语；英式英语也常拼作phoney。
phony.en: Not genuine, or intended to deceive people

meticulously.tip: 强调关注每个细节，不表示“胆小地”。
meticulously.en: with great care and attention to every detail

spherical.tip: spherical指立体球形；circular指平面圆形。

specification.tip: 谈产品各项参数常用复数specifications，可简称specs。
specification.en: A detailed description of how something must be designed or made.

ventilate.tip: 使通风是常用义；表示公开讨论时较正式。
ventilate.en: To allow fresh air to enter and circulate through somewhere.

microcosm.tip: 常用a microcosm of，指缩影，不只是微小事物。
microcosm.en: A small system showing the features of a larger one.

retrospect.tip: 通常用于固定短语in retrospect，表示事后回想。
retrospect.en: Consideration of past events, often with a changed understanding.

recur.tip: 不及物动词；过去式recurred，分词recurring。
recur.en: to happen again, especially repeatedly or after an interval

overthrow.en: to remove a ruler or government from power

incense.tip: 名词重音在前；同形动词重音在后，意为激怒。
incense.en: a substance burned to produce a pleasant smell

freak.tip: 形容词通常置于名词前；动词常用freak out。

forgery.tip: forgery是伪造或赝品；锻造作坊是forge。
forgery.en: Making illegal copies of documents or artworks; such a copy.

dispatch.tip: despatch也是正确拼写，但dispatch更常见。
dispatch.en: To send someone or something to a particular destination.

alignment.tip: in alignment with可指位置对齐或目标一致。
alignment.en: The arrangement of objects in a straight line or correct position.

democrat.tip: 泛指民主主义者用小写；美国民主党人写作Democrat。
democrat.en: Someone who supports government based on the people's choices

malice.tip: 通常不可数；with malice 表示“怀着恶意”。
malice.en: a desire to hurt someone or cause them trouble

certification.en: Official confirmation that someone or something meets required standards.

requisite.tip: 较正式；requisite 指必需，prerequisite 强调先决。

suspension.tip: 表示暂时中止；车辆语境中指悬架。
suspension.en: A temporary stop to an activity or someone's participation

overrun.tip: 变化为overran、overrun；名词重音在首音节。
overrun.en: To spread through or occupy a place in unwanted numbers.

instrumental.tip: 表示“起重要作用”时，用 be instrumental in doing。
instrumental.en: playing an important part in making something happen

exploitation.tip: 用于人常指剥削；用于资源指开发利用，需看语境。
exploitation.en: Unfair treatment of people to gain benefits from their work

tranquilizer.en: A drug used to calm people or animals and reduce anxiety.

prevailing.tip: 常置于名词前；prevailing wind指盛行风。
prevailing.en: Most common or influential at a particular time or place.

lull.tip: lull强调暂时平静，不表示彻底结束。
lull.en: A short period when activity or noise becomes less intense.

obnoxious.tip: 语气比annoying强，常形容无礼的人或行为。

droop.tip: 常形容花叶、眼皮或肩膀因缺水、疲倦而下垂。
droop.en: Hang or bend down, often from weakness or tiredness.

perspire.tip: 比sweat正式；通常作不及物动词。
perspire.en: to release sweat through your skin, especially when hot

irrigation.tip: 通常为不可数名词；动词形式是irrigate。
irrigation.en: The supply of water to land so crops can grow.

designate.tip: designate A as B表示指定或认定A为B。
designate.en: To officially choose someone or something for a particular purpose.

cosmos.tip: 表示宇宙时通常用the cosmos。
cosmos.en: The universe considered as a complete, ordered system.

lurk.tip: 通常作不及物动词；可用危险等抽象事物作主语。
lurk.en: stay hidden, often waiting to do something

implicit.en: Suggested or understood without being directly stated.

mediator.tip: 调解人促成双方协议，通常不直接作出裁决。
mediator.en: Someone who helps opposing sides reach an agreement

middleman.tip: 复数为 middlemen；中性表达可用 intermediary。
middleman.en: Someone arranging deals or buying goods to sell to others.

dagger.tip: look daggers at someone是习语，意为怒视某人。
dagger.en: A short pointed knife, usually with two sharp edges.

hydroelectric.en: Relating to electricity produced by the movement of water.

persistence.tip: 既可指人的毅力，也可指问题或现象持续存在。
persistence.en: continued effort despite difficulties or delays

ordinarily.tip: 表示“通常”，不表示推测性的“大概”。
ordinarily.en: Usually, or when conditions are normal.

instantaneous.tip: 强调几乎没有时间间隔，不等于同时发生。
instantaneous.en: Happening immediately, with no noticeable delay.

eclipse.tip: 日食用solar eclipse，月食用lunar eclipse。
eclipse.en: an event when one celestial body blocks another's light

reclaim.tip: reclaim强调收回或恢复利用，不只是收集。
reclaim.en: Get back something that belongs or previously belonged to you

pertinent.tip: 常用pertinent to表示与某事相关，语体较正式。
pertinent.en: directly related to the matter being discussed

snout.tip: 不只指猪嘴，也指其他动物突出的口鼻部。
snout.en: the projecting nose and mouth of an animal

gullible.tip: 带贬义，强调容易相信假话，不等于善良。
gullible.en: Too willing to believe what others say, even when untrue

scalpel.tip: 可数名词，指精细切割用的手术刀或解剖刀。
scalpel.en: A small, very sharp knife used in surgery or dissection.

sermon.tip: 本义为宗教讲道；比喻“说教”时常带不满。
sermon.en: a religious talk given during a service

whereby.tip: 正式关系副词，常接在system等词后，相当于by which。
whereby.en: By which a particular result is achieved.

curb.tip: 作动词指抑制；路缘石在英式英语中拼作kerb。
curb.en: to limit or control something unwanted

infinity.tip: 不是一般的“大量”；数学中常用趋于无穷大。
infinity.en: The state of having no end or limit.

elated.tip: 比happy语气更强，常用于成功或获悉好消息后。
elated.en: Extremely happy and excited, especially after success or good news.

solvency.tip: solvency指偿债能力，不等于盈利能力。
solvency.en: The ability to pay all the debts you owe.

alpine.tip: 泛指高山环境用小写；专指阿尔卑斯山常大写。
alpine.en: relating to high mountains, especially the Alps

consignment.tip: on consignment指寄售，卖出后再向供货方付款。
consignment.en: A batch of goods sent to a person or place.

primate.tip: 包括人、猿和猴；并非只指猴子。
primate.en: a mammal belonging to the group including humans, monkeys, and apes

reminiscent.tip: 固定搭配be reminiscent of，介词不用about。
reminiscent.en: Reminding you of something because of a similarity.

profound.en: Very great in effect, degree, or intensity.

delinquent.tip: 金融语境中指逾期未付；日常多指青少年违法。
delinquent.en: Behaving illegally or antisocially, especially while young.

stride.tip: 过去式strode，过去分词stridden；进展常用strides。

exclusivity.tip: 既可指商业独家权，也可指仅少数人享有的特性。
exclusivity.en: the right to provide or use something without competitors

zoology.tip: 通常为不可数名词；研究植物的学科是botany。

variant.tip: 名词常用a variant of；形容词可修饰spelling等。
variant.en: A form that differs slightly from other related forms.

commune.tip: 名词指共同生活群体；动词 commune with 指心灵交流。
commune.en: a group living together and sharing possessions and responsibilities

fume.tip: 表示烟气通常用复数fumes；动词常指十分恼怒。
fume.en: To feel or express strong anger.

henceforth.tip: 正式用语；日常交流多用 from now on。

laden.tip: 常用laden with；也可构成sugar-laden等复合形容词。
laden.en: Carrying or holding a large amount of something.

orientate.tip: 多用于英式英语；常用orientate oneself，不专指向东。
orientate.en: Find your position or become familiar with your surroundings.

craftsmanship.tip: 不可数名词，强调制作技艺或成品的工艺水平。
craftsmanship.en: Skill in making things, especially carefully by hand.

chisel.tip: 动词过去式英式常写chiselled，美式常写chiseled。
chisel.en: A tool with a sharp edge for cutting wood or stone.

slack.tip: slack指松弛或懈怠；slacks是宽松长裤。

occupant.tip: 强调实际居住或使用，不一定是owner（所有者）。
occupant.en: Someone who lives in or uses a room, building, or vehicle.

descendant.en: Someone related to a person who lived in an earlier generation.

contend.tip: contend that表主张；with接困难；for接争夺目标。
contend.en: To argue that something is true.

custodian.tip: custodian of后接所保管或守护的对象。
custodian.en: A person or organisation responsible for protecting or managing something.

subtle.tip: b不发音；常形容难以察觉的差别或影响。
subtle.en: Small or delicate enough to be difficult to notice

plummet.tip: 常作不及物动词；to接终值，by接降幅。
plummet.en: To decrease very quickly and sharply.

groove.tip: 具体指表面的长凹槽；音乐中可指鲜明的律动。
groove.en: A long, narrow cut or hollow in a surface.

plank.tip: a central plank of可比喻政策的核心内容。
plank.en: A long, flat, thick piece of wood.

commonwealth.tip: 指英联邦时首字母大写，通常与the连用。
commonwealth.en: A politically organised community, especially one governed for public benefit.

relish.tip: 动词后接名词或动名词，不接to do。
relish.en: To enjoy something greatly or eagerly anticipate doing it.

inhibit.tip: inhibit侧重抑制或阻碍；prohibit指明令禁止。
inhibit.en: To slow down or prevent a process or activity.

pawn.tip: 典当是以物换借款，可赎回，不等于直接出售。
pawn.en: A chess piece of the smallest size and lowest value.

imperialism.tip: 通常不可数；强调一国向外扩张统治或影响力。
imperialism.en: A policy of extending a country's power over other countries.

essayist.tip: 指以散文或随笔创作为业者，不泛指写作文的学生。
essayist.en: a writer of short pieces exploring particular subjects

dwarf.tip: 动词常表对比悬殊；名词指人可能冒犯，应谨慎。
dwarf.en: To make something seem small by comparison.

commissioner.tip: 通常指负有特定公共职责的官员，不泛指所有委员。
commissioner.en: an official responsible for a public service or commission

holocaust.tip: 特指纳粹大屠杀时用the Holocaust，首字母大写。
holocaust.en: Destruction or killing on a very large scale.

inauguration.tip: 既可指领导人就职，也可指设施正式启用。
inauguration.en: A ceremony formally marking someone's start in an important public office.

citrus.tip: citrus是总称，包括橙、柠檬、葡萄柚等。
citrus.en: Trees producing fruits such as oranges and lemons, or their fruits.

ovation.tip: 可数名词；standing ovation指观众起立鼓掌。
ovation.en: enthusiastic applause from an audience to show strong approval

vulnerability.tip: 泛指脆弱性时不可数；指具体漏洞时可数。
vulnerability.en: The state of being easily harmed, affected, or attacked.

instructive.tip: 强调让人学到东西，不等于“发出指令的”。
instructive.en: providing useful knowledge or helping someone understand something

asterisk.tip: 词尾是-risk，注意不要误读成-riks。
asterisk.en: A star-shaped symbol used to indicate a note or omission

merge.tip: merge with表示与……合并；merge into表示并入。
merge.en: Combine or join together to form a single whole.

notoriety.tip: 通常不可数，含贬义；中性的“名气”用fame。
notoriety.en: the state of being widely known for something bad

glimmer.tip: a glimmer of hope是“一线希望”的常见表达。
glimmer.en: A faint light, often shining unevenly

bureaucracy.tip: bureaucracy指体制或繁琐手续；官僚个人是bureaucrat。
bureaucracy.en: an administrative system run by officials following established rules

reconcile.tip: 协调两者用with；接受现实用reconcile oneself to。
reconcile.en: To make conflicting ideas, needs, or facts compatible

plasma.tip: 通常不可数；医学中指血浆，物理学中指等离子体。
plasma.en: The liquid part of blood in which blood cells float

skyrocket.tip: 通常作不及物动词，主语常为价格、成本或需求。
skyrocket.en: To increase extremely quickly to a very high level.

memorandum.en: A written message sharing information within an organisation

contractual.tip: 强调合同规定的权利或义务，常置于名词前。
contractual.en: Relating to or required by a legal agreement.

commend.tip: commend是称赞；command是命令，注意拼写。
commend.en: to praise someone or something, often publicly

indifference.tip: 通常不可数；对某事冷漠用 indifference to。
indifference.en: A lack of interest, concern, or emotional response.

contradict.tip: 及物动词，直接接人或说法；无需加with。
contradict.en: To be inconsistent with another statement, fact, or piece of evidence.

narrate.tip: 及物动词，直接接故事或事件，无需加about。
narrate.en: To tell a story or describe a series of events.

glassware.tip: 不可数名词；一件玻璃器皿用a piece of glassware。
glassware.en: objects made of glass, especially drinking vessels or laboratory equipment

provincial.tip: 指省级时中性；形容人的观念时可含贬义。
provincial.en: relating to a province or its administration

envisage.tip: 后接名词、动名词或that从句，不接to do。
envisage.en: To imagine a possible future situation or event.

esteem.tip: 常用hold someone in high esteem表示非常敬重某人。

judicial.en: relating to courts, judges, or the administration of justice

deficiency.tip: 缺某物用deficiency in；具体缺陷常用复数。
deficiency.en: A lack of enough of something necessary.

scorch.tip: 常指表面烧焦，不一定烧毁；太阳也能scorch植物。
scorch.en: To burn a surface slightly or damage it with heat

symmetry.tip: 通常为不可数名词；形容词是symmetrical。
symmetry.en: The matching arrangement of parts on opposite sides.

illiteracy.tip: illiteracy指不识字的状态；指人宜用描述性表达。
illiteracy.en: The inability to read and write.

calamity.tip: 比problem严重得多，常指造成重大损失的灾难。
calamity.en: An event causing severe damage, suffering, or distress.

diplomacy.tip: 既指国家间的外交，也指避免得罪人的处事技巧。
diplomacy.en: Managing relations between countries through discussion and negotiation.

transit.tip: in transit指运输途中；public transit多用于美式英语。
transit.en: the movement of people or goods between places

reimbursement.tip: 多指已付费用的报销，不泛指偿还贷款。
reimbursement.en: payment given back for money someone has spent

aristocracy.tip: 指贵族阶层整体时通常用the aristocracy。
aristocracy.en: the highest social class, traditionally holding inherited titles and privileges

array.tip: 常见a wide array of，强调数量多、种类丰富。
array.en: a large collection of different things

prelude.tip: 常用a prelude to，to后接名词或动名词。
prelude.en: Something that happens before and introduces a more important event.

perplex.tip: 及物动词；人感到困惑用perplexed，事物令人困惑用perplexing。
perplex.en: To confuse someone because something is difficult to understand.

tonnage.tip: 船舶总吨位衡量容积，不等于船的实际重量。
tonnage.en: The total weight of something expressed in tons.

hinder.tip: hinder是使事情更困难，不一定像prevent那样完全阻止。
hinder.en: To make progress or an activity more difficult.

quest.tip: 常用名词结构a quest for；动词用法较文学化。
quest.en: a long, determined search for something valuable or important

stagger.en: to walk unsteadily, as if about to fall

sheepish.tip: 通常因出错而难为情，不单指胆小或害羞。
sheepish.en: Embarrassed because you have done something silly or wrong

mythical.tip: mythical多形容神话中的事物，也可指根本不存在的。
mythical.en: existing in or relating to traditional myths

regularity.tip: with regularity表示有规律地，也可指经常发生。
regularity.en: The quality of happening at consistent intervals or following a pattern.

vow.tip: 动词常用vow to do或vow that从句。
vow.en: A serious promise to do or not do something

remnant.tip: 常用a remnant of；复数remnants强调残留的各部分。
remnant.en: a small part remaining after most has disappeared or been removed

eradication.tip: 强调彻底消除，常用eradication of。
eradication.en: the complete removal or destruction of something harmful

temperament.tip: temperament指惯常性情；temper常指脾气，尤指怒气。
temperament.en: a person's usual emotional nature and way of reacting

dub.tip: 过去式dubbed；dub A B表示“称A为B”。
dub.en: To replace a film's original speech with another language.

amends.tip: 名词通常用make amends；不说an amends。
amends.en: Something done to repair harm or show regret.

ignite.tip: 可及物也可不及物；还可比喻激起兴趣或争论。
ignite.en: To start burning or cause something to burn.

witty.tip: witty强调语言机智幽默，不泛指好笑。
witty.en: Using words in a clever and amusing way

veto.en: Official power to reject a decision, or its use.

wail.tip: 强调持续而尖厉的哭声，也可形容警报器长鸣。
wail.en: to cry loudly in pain, sadness, or distress

adverbial.tip: adverb是词类；adverbial可指单词、短语或从句的状语功能。
adverbial.en: functioning as an adverb or relating to adverbs

bust.tip: 指雕像时是可数名词，通常只有头、肩和胸部。
bust.en: a sculpture showing a person's head, shoulders, and upper chest

syndrome.tip: 指一组共同出现的症状，不等同于单一症状symptom。
syndrome.en: a group of symptoms that occur together in a condition

platypus.tip: 虽会产卵，鸭嘴兽仍属于哺乳动物。
platypus.en: An Australian egg-laying mammal with a flat bill and webbed feet.

converse.tip: 动词重音在后；名词“相反情况”重音在前。
converse.en: To talk with someone and exchange thoughts.

execution.tip: 既可指执行计划，也可指执行死刑，须看语境。
execution.en: the act of carrying out a plan, order, or task

alleviate.tip: 直接接痛苦或问题；表示减轻，不一定彻底消除。
alleviate.en: to make pain, suffering, or a problem less severe

textual.tip: textual指文本内容；textile指纺织品，勿混淆。
textual.en: relating to written words or the wording of a document

semblance.tip: 常用 a semblance of，表示表面上或些许的某种状态。
semblance.en: An outward appearance or slight degree of a particular quality

indicative.tip: 常用be indicative of，表示“是……的迹象”。
indicative.en: Showing that something exists or is likely to be true.

barometer.tip: 比喻某种状况的指标时，常用a barometer of。
barometer.en: an instrument that measures air pressure

authorize.tip: 常用authorize sb to do；英式也写authorise。
authorize.en: To give official permission for someone to do something.

prudent.tip: 强调考虑风险和后果，不只是胆小或节俭。
prudent.en: Careful and sensible about risks and future consequences.

treble.tip: treble表示变为原来的三倍，即增加两倍；英式英语常用。
treble.en: To become three times as much, or cause this increase.

inlet.tip: 地理中指小海湾；设备中指流体入口，与outlet相对。
inlet.en: A narrow stretch of water reaching into the land.

brink.tip: on the brink of后接名词或动名词，常指危机。
brink.en: A point just before something happens, especially something bad.

shun.tip: 及物动词，直接接宾语；过去式shunned。
shun.en: To deliberately avoid someone or something.

nomination.tip: 提名用nomination；最终任命通常用appointment。
nomination.en: The act of formally proposing someone for a position or award.

insofar.tip: 通常用于正式表达insofar as，后接从句。
insofar.en: To the extent that something is true or possible.

molest.tip: 现代英语多指性猥亵，勿用于普通的打扰。
molest.en: To subject someone to unwanted sexual touching or behaviour.

subdivide.tip: 常用subdivide A into B，表示把A细分为B。
subdivide.en: to divide something into smaller parts or groups

mutation.tip: 指遗传物质的改变，不一定有害。
mutation.en: A change in the genetic material of an organism.

disentangle.tip: 常用disentangle A from B，表示解开或分离。
disentangle.en: To separate things that have become twisted or caught together.

deficient.tip: 缺乏某物用be deficient in，常见于营养和能力描述。
deficient.en: not having enough of something necessary

finicky.tip: 偏口语，常带贬义；finicky about表示对……挑剔。
finicky.en: very particular about small details and difficult to please

flick.tip: flick through指快速翻阅，不表示仔细阅读。
flick.en: Move or remove something with a quick, light movement.

literate.tip: 常用作形容词；名词 literacy 表示读写能力。

watertight.tip: 既指不漏水，也可形容论证或协议严密。
watertight.en: Made so that water cannot enter or escape

embryo.en: An animal or plant at a very early developmental stage

misrepresent.tip: 及物动词，直接接事实、观点或人物作宾语。
misrepresent.en: Describe someone or something in a false or misleading way

miser.tip: 含贬义，指不舍得花钱的人，不等于节俭者。
miser.en: Someone who hoards money and strongly dislikes spending it.

oxidize.tip: 英式也拼作oxidise；氧化不一定涉及氧气。
oxidize.en: To react with oxygen, or lose electrons in a chemical reaction.

subsidize.tip: 英式也写作subsidise；补贴通常只承担部分费用。
subsidize.en: Pay part of the cost of an activity or service

obligate.tip: 形容词用于生物学，末尾读/ɡət/；有义务用obligated。
obligate.en: To require someone to do something legally or morally.

chronic.tip: 疾病语境中chronic指慢性，acute指急性。
chronic.en: Continuing for a long time, especially a medical condition

secluded.tip: 多形容地点僻静隐蔽，不等于人的性格内向。
secluded.en: private and quiet, away from people and busy places

deduction.tip: 推断对应动词deduce；扣除对应动词deduct。
deduction.en: A conclusion reached through reasoning, or the reasoning process itself.

equilibrium.tip: 通常不可数；常用于经济、生态或物理中的平衡。
equilibrium.en: A stable state in which opposing forces or influences balance.

monumental.tip: 常修饰task、effort，强调规模或难度极大。

ply.tip: ply someone with sth指不断向某人提供某物。
ply.en: To travel regularly along a route, especially by boat

fidelity.tip: 忠于某人或原则用fidelity to；通常不可数。
fidelity.en: continued loyalty to a person, belief, or duty

curt.tip: 不仅指简短，还带不礼貌之意；brief通常中性。
curt.en: Using very few words in a way that seems rude.

repertoire.tip: 不只指演出曲目，也可指某人掌握的全部技能。
repertoire.en: All the pieces a performer or group is prepared to perform.

deflection.tip: 强调受力后改变方向；工程中也指构件挠曲。
deflection.en: A change in direction caused by contact or another force

blunder.tip: 比mistake语气更重，强调因粗心或判断差犯错。
blunder.en: A serious mistake caused by carelessness or poor judgment.

devaluation.tip: 经济学中常指官方下调汇率；市场贬值多用depreciation。
devaluation.en: An official reduction in a currency's value relative to other currencies.

oscillate.tip: 表示在两者间摇摆，用oscillate between A and B。
oscillate.en: To move repeatedly backwards and forwards.

integral.tip: 常用an integral part of或be integral to。
integral.en: Necessary for something to be complete or work properly.

contemplate.tip: 后接名词或动名词，不接to do。
contemplate.en: to think carefully about something for a long time

baffle.tip: 比confuse更强调完全不理解；常用be baffled by。
baffle.en: To make someone unable to understand or explain something

longing.tip: 名词常接for；表示渴望做某事可接to do。
longing.en: A strong desire for someone or something

mobilize.tip: 英式也拼作mobilise；常接资源、支持者或军队。
mobilize.en: To organize people or resources for a particular purpose

snag.tip: hit a snag指遇到障碍；动词常接on表示被钩住。
snag.en: An unexpected difficulty that delays or prevents progress.

superiority.tip: 表示相对优势用superiority over，不用than。
superiority.en: The state of being better or stronger than something else.

oath.tip: under oath指已宣誓说真话，常用于法庭语境。
oath.en: A formal promise to tell the truth or fulfil a duty.

drop-off.tip: 名词带连字符；动词短语写作drop off。
drop-off.en: A decrease in an amount, level, or activity.

rosy.tip: paint a rosy picture 指描绘乐观景象，有时暗含过度美化。
rosy.en: pink or reddish, especially in a healthy-looking way

ridicule.tip: 作动词时及物，直接接宾语，不加at。
ridicule.en: Unkind laughter or comments that make someone seem foolish.

dimensional.tip: 常见于复合词three-dimensional，意为三维的。
dimensional.en: relating to measurements or dimensions of space

depreciation.tip: 资产折旧、货币贬值均可用；反义词为appreciation。
depreciation.en: A reduction in an asset's value over time.

climactic.en: Forming the most exciting or important part of something.

bona fide.tip: 较正式，常置于名词前，强调真实或善意。
bona fide.en: Real or genuine, rather than false or pretended.

assassination.tip: 通常指针对重要人物、带政治目的的谋杀。
assassination.en: the deliberate murder of an important person, often for political reasons

gloom.tip: 既可指光线昏暗，也可指心情或前景黯淡。
gloom.en: Darkness or weak light that makes things difficult to see

sewer.tip: sewer是管道，sewage是污水，sewerage指排污系统。
sewer.en: An underground pipe that carries away sewage and wastewater

displeasure.tip: 通常为不可数名词，较正式；常接at或with。
displeasure.en: a feeling of annoyance or dissatisfaction

financier.tip: 指提供或管理大笔资金的人，不等于普通银行职员。
financier.en: Someone who manages or provides large amounts of investment money

contaminate.tip: 常用be contaminated with表示被某物污染。
contaminate.en: make something dirty or unsafe by adding harmful substances

envision.tip: 后接名词或动名词，不接to do。
envision.en: to imagine a future situation or possibility

foretell.tip: 过去式和过去分词均为foretold；比predict更文学化。
foretell.en: to say or indicate what will happen in the future

testify.tip: testify that接从句；testify to接名词或动名词。
testify.en: To give evidence in court about what you know

proofreading.tip: 校对侧重拼写、标点等错误，不等于重写。
proofreading.en: checking written material for errors before its final version

communicative.tip: 形容人时指乐于交流；形容教学时指重视交际。
communicative.en: Willing to talk and share thoughts or information.

null.tip: 法律中常用null and void；编程空值不一定等于零。
null.en: Having no legal force or effect.

lawful.tip: lawful指法律允许；legal还可表示“与法律有关的”。

snobbish.tip: 重在因身份或品味而看低别人，不一定谄媚。
snobbish.en: Treating others as inferior because of status, wealth, or taste.

endeavor.tip: 美式拼写；英式为endeavour，动词常接to do。
endeavor.en: To try hard to achieve something

solitary.tip: solitary强调独自，不一定像lonely那样感到寂寞。
solitary.en: Alone, or preferring to live or spend time alone.

ample.tip: ample强调足够甚至有余，常修饰time、space、evidence。
ample.en: Enough or more than enough for a particular purpose

reiterate.tip: 是动词，不是形容词；可接名词或 that 从句。
reiterate.en: to say something again to make it clear or emphasise it

notwithstanding.tip: 正式用语；作介词可放名词前或后，如the rain notwithstanding。
notwithstanding.en: despite something that might prevent or contradict something else

dishonorable.tip: 美式拼写；英式通常写作dishonourable。
dishonorable.en: deserving disapproval because of dishonest or unfair behaviour

meticulous.tip: 通常是褒义，强调认真关注每个细节。
meticulous.en: Extremely careful and attentive to every small detail.

fluorescent.en: Emitting light through fluorescence, or using this effect for lighting.

tertiary.tip: tertiary education指中学之后的高等教育。
tertiary.en: Relating to education at college or university level.

concur.tip: 正式用词，常用concur with某人或concur that从句。
concur.en: to agree with someone or share the same opinion

protracted.tip: 比long更强调拖得过久，常含负面意味。
protracted.en: Lasting longer than expected or desired.

stagnation.tip: 通常为不可数名词，常用于经济或发展停滞。
stagnation.en: a state in which growth, activity, or development stops

afflict.tip: 常用被动be afflicted with，后接疾病或困境。
afflict.en: Cause someone or something serious suffering or difficulty

fulfillment.tip: 这是美式拼写；英式通常写作fulfilment。
fulfillment.en: A feeling of satisfaction from doing something meaningful

stationer.en: A person or business that sells writing and office supplies.

microbe.tip: 不只指细菌，也不一定有害；germ常指病菌。
microbe.en: A living organism too small to see without a microscope

twilight.tip: 多指日落后的暮光，也可指日出前的微光。
twilight.en: The soft light just after sunset or before sunrise

entrant.tip: 新加入某领域用entrant to；不等于入口entrance。
entrant.en: a person who takes part in a competition

cardinal.tip: cardinal number是基数，ordinal number是序数。
cardinal.en: Of central importance to a system, belief, or activity.

fallacy.tip: 不只是事实错误，也常指论证中的逻辑错误。
fallacy.en: A belief that is commonly accepted but actually false.

funnel.tip: 作动词常用funnel A into B，表示将A引入B。
funnel.en: A wide topped tool with a narrow tube for pouring

cutting.tip: 剪报在英式英语中叫cutting，美式常用clipping。
cutting.en: Intended to hurt someone through harsh criticism or unkind remarks.

procure.tip: 正式及物动词，直接接所获得的物品或资源。
procure.en: to obtain something, especially through effort or careful arrangements

posture.tip: 名词常指体态；动词常含“装样子”的贬义。
posture.en: the way you hold your body when sitting or standing

deadlock.tip: 常与reach或break搭配；强调分歧导致无法推进。
deadlock.en: A situation where disagreement prevents any further progress.

capillary.tip: 复数为capillaries；英美读音的重音位置不同。
capillary.en: a tiny blood vessel or an extremely narrow tube

maiden.tip: 形容词常指首次；名词指少女时带文学或古旧色彩。
maiden.en: being the first of its kind for someone or something

prosecution.tip: the prosecution指刑事案件控方，不是民事原告。
prosecution.en: The legal process of charging and trying someone for a crime.

conceive.tip: conceive an idea指构思；conceive of指设想。
conceive.en: to form an idea or imagine something

laborious.tip: 通常形容任务或过程；形容人勤劳用industrious。
laborious.en: requiring a lot of time and hard work

clarity.tip: 不可数名词；clarify是动词，意为澄清。
clarity.en: The quality of being clear and easy to understand.

indebted.tip: be indebted to sb for sth表示因某事感激某人。
indebted.en: Grateful to someone for help or support.

din.tip: 通常作单数名词，强调持续且令人不适的嘈杂声。
din.en: A loud, unpleasant mixture of continuing noises.

telecommunication.tip: 谈电信行业或技术时，通常用复数telecommunications。
telecommunication.en: Communication over a distance using electronic signals.

retention.tip: 通常不可数；动词形式为retain。
retention.en: the act of keeping something or preventing someone from leaving

drudgery.tip: 不可数名词，强调工作既繁重又单调，而不只是困难。
drudgery.en: Hard, boring work that must be repeated regularly.

prosecutor.tip: 代表控方提出指控；不负责作出判决。
prosecutor.en: A lawyer who presents a criminal case against an accused person.

regretful.tip: regretful指人感到遗憾；regrettable指事令人遗憾。
regretful.en: Feeling sorry about something that happened or something you did.

tenancy.tip: tenant指租客；tenancy指租赁关系、权利或租期。
tenancy.en: The legal right or arrangement to occupy rented property.

holding.tip: 资产常用复数holdings；holding company指控股公司。
holding.en: Property, shares, or other assets owned by someone.

drunkard.tip: 含贬义；中性表达可用person with alcohol dependence。
drunkard.en: An insulting term for someone who is frequently drunk.

hound.tip: 作动词强调反复纠缠，不只是普通的追赶。
hound.en: A dog bred to hunt using smell or sight.

formulation.tip: 常用the formulation of，表示计划等的制定。
formulation.en: The process of developing a plan, policy, or theory.

capitalism.tip: 不可数名词；capitalist可指资本家或作形容词。
capitalism.en: an economic system based on private ownership and profit

predominance.tip: 强调数量、力量或影响占优，不等于“杰出”。
predominance.en: The state of being most numerous, powerful, or influential.

thrift.tip: thrift 是名词；形容词“节俭的”是 thrifty。
thrift.en: careful use of money and resources to avoid waste

quiver.tip: 多指细微而快速的抖动；声音也可用quiver。
quiver.en: shake slightly with quick, small movements

perpetual.tip: 可指永不停止，也常夸张表示某事没完没了。
perpetual.en: continuing all the time or lasting forever

innumerable.tip: 后接可数名词复数，语气比many强，较正式。

divine.tip: 表示“极好的”时多用于非正式赞美。
divine.en: Connected with a god or coming from a god

permissive.en: Allowing considerable freedom rather than enforcing strict rules.

thesis.tip: 复数是theses；既可指学位论文，也可指核心论点。
thesis.en: A long research paper written for a university degree.

onset.tip: 常用the onset of，多指疾病或不利情况的开始。
onset.en: The beginning of something, especially something unpleasant.

fission.tip: 核物理中fission是裂变，fusion是聚变。
fission.en: The splitting of an atomic nucleus, usually releasing energy.

illuminate.tip: 既可指用光照亮，也可指用解释或证据阐明。
illuminate.en: To shine light on something so it becomes visible

relinquish.tip: 正式及物动词，直接接control、power、rights等。
relinquish.en: Give up control, possession or a right to something.

muster.tip: muster courage指鼓起勇气；pass muster指合格。
muster.en: Gather the courage, strength, or support needed to do something.

petty.tip: 形容人时常含贬义，指小心眼，不只是小气。
petty.en: Too small or unimportant to deserve much attention.

justification.tip: 常接for加名词或动名词，说明某事的合理依据。
justification.en: A good reason explaining why something is acceptable or necessary.

limestone.tip: limestone通常不可数；lime还可指石灰或青柠。
limestone.en: A rock mainly composed of calcium carbonate, often from marine remains.

hemisphere.tip: 地理中指地球的一半，也可指大脑半球。

pester.tip: 常用pester sb for sth或to do sth，强调反复纠缠。
pester.en: annoy someone by repeatedly asking for something or demanding attention

vulnerable.tip: 常用 vulnerable to，to 后接名词。
vulnerable.en: Easily harmed, attacked, or negatively affected.

hectare.tip: 公顷是面积单位；一公顷等于一万平方米。
hectare.en: a unit of land area equal to ten thousand square metres

cram.tip: 过去式crammed；复习考试用cram for。
cram.en: To force many things or people into a small space.

lofty.tip: 修饰理想时可表赞许，也可暗示目标过高、不切实际。
lofty.en: Aiming for morally admirable or very ambitious achievements.

ragged.tip: 形容词ragged读两个音节，结尾为/ɪd/。
ragged.en: torn and worn, or wearing clothes in this condition

notorious.tip: 通常含贬义；著名但非负面用famous，不宜用notorious。
notorious.en: widely known for something bad or undesirable

aimless.tip: aimless是形容词；修饰wander等动词用aimlessly。
aimless.en: having no clear purpose, plan, or direction

lethal.tip: 通常作形容词；lethal 强调具有致死能力。

counterpart.tip: 强调在另一地区或机构中角色相当，不是对手。
counterpart.en: Someone or something with a similar role in another setting.

impede.tip: 强调使进展困难或缓慢，不一定完全阻止。
impede.en: To make movement or progress slower or more difficult.

pompous.tip: 含贬义，重点是自命不凡，不只是外表华丽。
pompous.en: acting or speaking as though more important than others

proposition.tip: 作主张讲可接 that 从句；提议常用 proposal。
proposition.en: An idea or plan offered for consideration

quartz.tip: 通常不可数；一块石英用 a piece of quartz。
quartz.en: a hard mineral common in rocks and used in electronics

wharf.en: A structure beside water where boats load and unload.

uncalled-for.tip: 常形容批评或言论无理，不只是数量多余。
uncalled-for.en: Unfair, unnecessary, or inappropriate in a particular situation.

preoccupy.tip: 常用be preoccupied with，指心思被某事占据。
preoccupy.en: to fill someone's thoughts, leaving little attention for other things

vouch.tip: 通常用vouch for，不直接接担保的人或事物。
vouch.en: to confirm someone is reliable or something is true

jingle.tip: 既可指金属叮当声，也可指易记的广告短歌。
jingle.en: To make small metal objects produce light ringing sounds.

unify.tip: unify强调把分散部分合成整体，可用于制度或群体。
unify.en: To bring separate parts or groups together as one.

periodic.tip: periodic是形容词，不是名词；副词为periodically。
periodic.en: happening repeatedly, often at regular intervals

commonplace.tip: 多指常见到不足为奇，不一定含贬义。
commonplace.en: Happening or found often enough to seem ordinary.

advantageous.tip: 常用be advantageous to sb表示对某人有利。
advantageous.en: Giving benefits or improving the chances of success

merciful.tip: 对某人仁慈用be merciful to someone。
merciful.en: Showing kindness by choosing not to punish or hurt someone.

orthodox.tip: 大写常指宗教派别；小写orthodox可指正统的、传统的。
orthodox.en: relating to the Eastern Orthodox Christian churches

preacher.tip: preacher侧重讲道，missionary侧重传播宗教。
preacher.en: someone who gives public talks about religious beliefs

stationary.tip: stationary指静止的；stationery指文具，读音相同。

inclined.tip: be inclined to后接动词原形，表示倾向或意愿。
inclined.en: Likely or willing to think or act a certain way.

sovereignty.tip: 通常不可数；对某领土的主权用over连接。
sovereignty.en: A country's independent authority to govern itself.

simulate.tip: 模拟环境用simulate；刺激发展用stimulate。
simulate.en: To reproduce conditions or processes for testing, training, or study.

indent.tip: 指行首向内移动，不是把整行内容缩短。
indent.en: to start a line further inward than the surrounding lines

ideology.tip: 指成体系的社会或政治观念，不是单个想法。
ideology.en: a system of beliefs shaping political or social views

taboo.tip: 名词指禁忌；形容词可说a taboo subject。
taboo.en: a social rule against discussing or doing something

fortify.en: to strengthen a place or structure against attack or damage

trench.tip: 地面上的trench是沟或战壕，海底的则是海沟。
trench.en: A long, narrow ditch dug in the ground.

incinerator.tip: 通常指废物焚烧炉；火葬场用crematorium。
incinerator.en: A machine or structure that burns waste at high temperatures

boldness.tip: 可指行动大胆，也可指设计或色彩醒目。
boldness.en: confidence and willingness to take risks or challenge expectations

analytic.tip: 与analytical意思接近；日常描述分析能力更常用后者。
analytic.en: using careful examination of details to understand something

discrepancy.tip: 常指本应一致却不符，搭配 between 或 in。
discrepancy.en: A difference between things that should match.

amplification.tip: 常指声音、信号的增强，也可指影响被放大。
amplification.en: the process of making a sound or signal stronger

precedence.tip: 常用take precedence over，表示优先于。
precedence.en: Greater importance that gives someone or something priority over others.

resonance.tip: 情感义常用have resonance for；物理义指共振。
resonance.en: The power to evoke shared feelings, memories, or understanding.

apologetic.tip: 常接about或for说明歉意的缘由。
apologetic.en: Showing that you are sorry for something.

postmortem.tip: 英式也常写post-mortem；可比喻赛后或项目复盘。
postmortem.en: a medical examination of a body to determine death's cause

certify.tip: 强调正式或权威证明，常用certify that从句。
certify.en: to confirm officially that something is true or meets standards

heighten.tip: 多用于情绪、意识或效果增强，不常指身高增长。
heighten.en: to become stronger or make a feeling or effect stronger

tigress.tip: tigress专指雌虎；tiger可泛指老虎，不一定是雄虎。

aptitude.tip: 常用aptitude for，后接名词或动名词。
aptitude.en: A natural ability to learn or do something well

humiliate.tip: 比embarrass语气更重，强调受辱和尊严受损。
humiliate.en: to make someone feel deeply ashamed or foolish

scrutiny.tip: 不可数名词；under scrutiny表示受到严格审查。
scrutiny.en: Careful examination of something, especially to find faults or problems.

amphibian.tip: 动物名词用amphibian；两栖的常用amphibious。
amphibian.en: an animal, such as a frog, living in water and on land

reinforcement.tip: 表示援军、增援人员时通常用复数reinforcements。
reinforcement.en: The process of making something stronger or more effective.

fabricate.tip: 既可指捏造信息，也可指工业制造，须看宾语。
fabricate.en: To invent false information in order to deceive

sorrowful.tip: 比sad更正式，常用于表情、声音或告别。
sorrowful.en: Feeling, showing, or causing deep sadness.

overextend.tip: 常用 overextend oneself，指承担超出能力的任务或开支。
overextend.en: to commit more money or effort than can be managed

sportsmanship.tip: 不可数名词，强调公平与尊重，而非运动技术。
sportsmanship.en: Fair and respectful behaviour towards opponents in sport

deviation.tip: 常用 deviation from；standard deviation 是“标准差”。
deviation.en: a departure from an expected route, rule, or behaviour

snowbound.tip: 强调积雪阻碍出行，不只是“覆盖着雪”。
snowbound.en: Unable to travel or be reached because of heavy snow.

oversight.tip: 作“疏忽”通常可数；作“监督”通常不可数。
oversight.en: A mistake caused by failing to notice or consider something.

kerosene.tip: 不可数名词；英式日常用语也常称paraffin。
kerosene.en: An oil used as fuel for lamps, heaters, and aircraft.

temporal.tip: temporal指时间的；temporary才表示暂时的。
temporal.en: Relating to time or the order of events.

redundant.tip: 英式英语中be made redundant指岗位取消而被裁员。
redundant.en: unnecessary because it is no longer needed or repeats something

righteous.tip: 语气较庄重；self-righteous指自以为正直。
righteous.en: morally right or acting according to strong moral principles

lenient.tip: 对人宽容用lenient with；常涉及规则或处罚。
lenient.en: less strict or severe when enforcing rules or giving punishment

oblong.tip: 强调长宽不等的长方形；不指正方形。
oblong.en: having a rectangular shape with unequal adjacent sides

jeopardise.tip: 及物动词，直接接宾语；美式通常拼作jeopardize。
jeopardise.en: To put something at risk of harm, loss, or failure.

fluctuate.tip: 通常是不及物动词；在两值间波动用between。
fluctuate.en: Rise and fall irregularly in level, amount, or value.

observance.en: The practice of following a rule, law, or custom

ironical.tip: 与ironic基本同义，但ironic更常用；不一定含恶意。
ironical.en: expressing a meaning opposite to the words used

disperse.tip: 既可及物也可不及物：驱散人群或人群散去。
disperse.en: To spread out or make people or things spread out

fungus.tip: 复数常用fungi；真菌不属于植物。
fungus.en: an organism such as a mushroom, mould, or yeast

premise.tip: 表示房屋及场地时用复数premises。
premise.en: an idea accepted as the basis for reasoning or action

autonomy.tip: 通常不可数；既指地区自治，也指个人或机构自主。
autonomy.en: The freedom or right to make decisions independently.

know-how.tip: 不可数名词，强调实际操作能力，拼写保留连字符。
know-how.en: Practical knowledge and skills needed to do something successfully

polymer.tip: 聚合物不只包括塑料，也包括淀粉等天然物质。
polymer.en: A substance made of large molecules containing repeated smaller units.

idiomatic.tip: 地道不等于堆砌习语；自然搭配也体现idiomatic。
idiomatic.en: natural and typical of how fluent speakers use a language

supersede.tip: 注意拼写结尾是-sede，不是-cede；常用被动式。
supersede.en: To replace something older or no longer useful.

census.tip: census调查全部人口，sample survey只抽样。
census.en: an official count of people that collects information about them

nickel.tip: 指金属时不可数；指五分硬币时可数。
nickel.en: A hard, silvery metal used in alloys and batteries.

infringement.tip: 常接of；infringement of rights指侵犯权利。
infringement.en: An action that breaks a law or violates someone's rights.

enrich.en: To improve something by adding value, interest, or experience.

astronomical.tip: 谈费用时常表示高得惊人；也可表示天文学的。
astronomical.en: Extremely large, especially when describing prices, costs, or amounts.

disreputable.tip: 通常指名声或行为不佳，不只是外表破旧。
disreputable.en: Having a bad reputation and not deserving trust or respect.

vicious.tip: vicious circle指问题互相加剧的“恶性循环”。
vicious.en: likely to attack or cause serious harm

agonize.en: Worry intensely while trying to make a difficult decision

propulsion.tip: 通常为不可数名词，常用于船舶、飞机和航天器。
propulsion.en: The force or process that moves something forward

harmonious.tip: 既可形容人际关系融洽，也可形容色彩、声音协调。

mock.tip: mock作动词直接接宾语，不加at。
mock.en: To make someone seem foolish by laughing at or imitating them.

exertion.tip: 多指消耗体力或脑力，不等同于表示尽力的try hard。
exertion.en: Physical or mental effort, especially when it makes you tired.

genocide.tip: 不泛指大规模杀戮，核心是蓄意毁灭特定群体。
genocide.en: Acts intended to destroy a national, ethnic, racial, or religious group.

fallible.tip: 强调可能犯错，并非一定错误；反义词为infallible。
fallible.en: Capable of making mistakes or being wrong

transact.tip: 正式用语，常用transact business表示开展业务。
transact.en: to conduct business or carry out a business deal

consolidate.tip: 既可指巩固已有成果，也可指合并多个部分。
consolidate.en: To make an achievement, position, or skill stronger.

manure.tip: 名词通常不可数；fertilizer泛指肥料，范围更广。
manure.en: Animal waste used to improve soil and help plants grow.

verge.tip: on the verge of后接名词或动名词；动词常接on。
verge.en: The point just before something happens.

optimal.tip: 已含“最佳”之意，通常不再用 most 修饰。
optimal.en: Best or most effective for a particular purpose.

resolutely.tip: 这是副词；形容词形式为resolute。
resolutely.en: In a determined way, without giving up or changing course

upkeep.tip: 不可数名词，既指维护工作，也指维护费用。
upkeep.en: work or money needed to keep something in good condition

haunt.tip: 作动词直接接宾语；be haunted by表示受困扰。
haunt.en: to keep returning to someone's mind and causing distress

royalty.tip: 指王族时不可数；指版税收入时常用复数royalties。
royalty.en: people who belong to a royal family

perish.tip: 通常是不及物动词；英式英语也用于橡胶等老化。
perish.en: To die or be destroyed, especially in harsh conditions.

transferable.tip: transferable skills 指换岗位或行业仍适用的技能。
transferable.en: able to be moved or passed to another person or place

airway.tip: 常指呼吸道；航线义较专业，勿与airline混淆。
airway.en: a passage through which air reaches the lungs

displace.tip: displace常指被迫迁离；也可指新事物取代旧事物。
displace.en: Force people to leave their homes or usual surroundings.

lure.tip: 常用lure sb into doing，往往暗含诱骗意味。
lure.en: To attract someone by offering something appealing, sometimes deceptively.

cruiser.tip: 大型邮轮通常叫cruise ship，不叫cruiser。
cruiser.en: A powered leisure boat with space for sleeping.

accumulation.tip: 常接of，强调随时间逐渐增多。
accumulation.en: The gradual gathering of something, or the amount gathered.

prophecy.en: a statement about the future, often claiming supernatural knowledge

doctrine.tip: 不一定含贬义；可指宗教教义或政治、经济学说。
doctrine.en: A belief or set of principles taught by a group.

elevate.tip: 及物动词；elevate A to B可表示将A提升至B。
elevate.en: To move something to a higher physical position

tranquil.tip: 常描写环境或水面，比 quiet 更强调安宁感。
tranquil.en: calm and peaceful, without noise or disturbance

stimulus.tip: 复数是stimuli；stimulus to中的to是介词。
stimulus.en: Something that encourages activity, growth, or change.

deft.tip: 既可形容手部动作灵巧，也可指处理问题巧妙。
deft.en: Skilful, quick, and controlled in movement or action.

culminate.tip: 常用 culminate in＋结果，强调发展后的终点或高潮。
culminate.en: To reach a final result or highest point after gradual development

touchy.en: Easily upset or offended, especially by criticism.

workmanship.tip: 不可数名词，强调成品的做工，而非工作态度。
workmanship.en: The skill and quality shown in making something.

marshal.tip: 英式过去式marshalled，美式marshaled；勿混淆martial。
marshal.en: to gather and arrange people, resources, or ideas effectively

pharmaceutical.tip: 作名词常用复数 pharmaceuticals，泛指药品。
pharmaceutical.en: relating to medicines or their production

bleak.tip: 既可描述荒凉阴冷的环境，也可描述无望的前景。
bleak.en: offering little hope of improvement or success

mantle.tip: mantle也可指披风；壁炉架通常拼作mantel。
mantle.en: A layer that covers a surface or area

ceremonial.tip: ceremonial重在仪式用途；ceremonious指礼节隆重。
ceremonial.en: used in or connected with a formal public ceremony

administer.tip: 给某人用药可说administer medicine to someone。
administer.en: to manage an organization or put a system into operation

combustion.tip: 通常不可数，是burning的科技语体表达。
combustion.en: The chemical process of burning, which releases heat.

nameless.tip: remain nameless指不透露姓名，不一定真的没名字。
nameless.en: Having no name, or having a name that remains unknown

catastrophe.tip: 比一般problem严重，常指损失惨重的灾难。
catastrophe.en: an event causing extremely serious damage or suffering

legible.tip: legible强调字形可辨；readable也可指内容易读。
legible.en: Clear enough for written or printed words to be read.

arduous.en: requiring considerable effort and sustained hard work

expressly.tip: 勿与expressively混淆，后者指富有表现力地。
expressly.en: in a clear and direct way that leaves no doubt

supposition.tip: 可指一个假设，也可泛指推测；不等于已证实的事实。
supposition.en: an idea accepted as true without enough evidence

thermal.tip: thermal可指与热有关，也可指衣物保暖。

differentiate.tip: 常用differentiate between A and B。
differentiate.en: To recognize or explain the differences between things

sluggish.tip: 既形容人没精神，也形容经济或系统运转慢。
sluggish.en: moving or responding slowly, often from lack of energy

embroider.tip: embroider是在布上绣花，不是用毛线织物的knit。
embroider.en: To decorate cloth by sewing patterns with thread.

papercut.tip: 剪纸艺术常用papercutting；纸划伤通常写paper cut。
papercut.en: A decorative picture made by cutting shapes from paper

morality.tip: moral是形容词；morality是名词，常为不可数。
morality.en: Beliefs and principles about what is right and wrong

uncap.tip: 特指取下盖子；过去式uncapped，进行式uncapping。
uncap.en: To remove the cap from a container or pen.

consensus.tip: 常用reach a consensus on；共识未必全票一致。
consensus.en: General agreement among members of a group.

hideous.tip: 语气很强，常形容极丑的外观或可怕的事。

ammonia.tip: 不可数名词；既可指氨气，也可指氨水。
ammonia.en: A strong-smelling gas also dissolved in water for cleaning.

erection.tip: 建造义较正式，常接of；也有生理含义，须看语境。
erection.en: the act of building or putting a structure upright

allegiance.tip: 效忠对象用to引出：allegiance to a country。
allegiance.en: Loyalty and support given to a country, group, or leader.

outlandish.tip: 强调异乎寻常，常带惊讶或不赞同的语气。
outlandish.en: extremely unusual or strange, often seeming unreasonable

explanatory.en: Giving information that makes something easier to understand.

commence.tip: 比start正式；可接名词或动名词。
commence.en: to begin something or start happening

rhetoric.tip: 是名词；形容词为rhetorical，可含贬义。
rhetoric.en: Impressive language that may lack sincerity or practical substance.

pretext.tip: 强调掩盖真实目的的借口；常接for或of。
pretext.en: A stated reason that hides someone's real purpose.

pounce.tip: 常接on，既可指猛扑，也可指抓住机会或错误。
pounce.en: To jump suddenly towards something to catch or attack it.

pioneering.tip: 通常作形容词；指先驱人物用名词pioneer。
pioneering.en: Introducing important new ideas or methods before others.

neutralize.tip: 英式也拼neutralise；强调抵消作用，不一定移除物体。
neutralize.en: to stop something from having an effect

aspiration.tip: 抱负义常用复数；aspiration to do表示做某事的志向。
aspiration.en: A strong hope or ambition to achieve something.

conception.tip: conception of指对事物的理解；也可表示受孕。
conception.en: an idea or understanding of what something is like

conscientiously.tip: 强调责任心与认真态度，不只是动作小心。
conscientiously.en: With care and a strong sense of responsibility.

faction.tip: 常指大组织内意见对立的小集团，尤用于政治。
faction.en: A subgroup whose views conflict with others in a larger group.

aboriginal.tip: 指澳大利亚原住民时首字母大写；避免单独作名词称人。
aboriginal.en: Relating to the earliest known inhabitants of a region

offset.tip: 过去式和过去分词仍为offset；现在分词为offsetting。
offset.en: to balance or reduce the effect of something

arable.tip: 常修饰land；强调可种作物，不指单纯放牧用地。
arable.en: Suitable for or used for growing crops.

truce.tip: 通常指暂时停止冲突，不等于永久和平。
truce.en: An agreement to stop fighting or arguing for a time

exuberant.tip: 核心是活力或丰富程度高，不等于“华而不实”。
exuberant.en: full of energy, excitement, and happiness

oxide.tip: oxide为氧化物统称，dioxide指二氧化物。
oxide.en: A compound consisting of oxygen and another chemical element.

inscribe.tip: 常用inscribe A on B或inscribe B with A，非普通记笔记。
inscribe.en: write or carve words on an object, often permanently

handicap.tip: 指残疾或残疾人士时已过时，宜用disability。
handicap.en: A disadvantage that makes success or progress more difficult.

generalization.tip: 英式也写 generalisation；概括未必可靠。
generalization.en: A broad statement based on particular cases, sometimes without enough evidence.

uphold.tip: 过去式、过去分词均为upheld；常接权利或裁决。
uphold.en: To support and maintain a principle, right, or standard

expiration.tip: 表示到期时，美式常用expiration，英式常用expiry。
expiration.en: the end of the period when something remains valid

conformity.tip: in conformity with表示符合或遵照某规则。
conformity.en: Behaviour that follows accepted rules, standards, or group expectations.

formality.tip: 手续常用复数formalities；正式、拘谨为不可数义。
formality.en: A required procedure, often unlikely to change the outcome.

outlay.tip: 常指启动项目时的开支，常搭配initial或capital。
outlay.en: Money spent on a particular purpose, especially when starting something.

angular.tip: 形容外形棱角分明，也可形容人瘦削。
angular.en: Having sharp corners or clearly defined angles.

restock.tip: 常用restock A with B，表示用B补充A的存货。
restock.en: To replace goods that have been sold or used.

feud.tip: 强调持续很久的敌对或争执，而非一次口角。
feud.en: A bitter disagreement continuing for a long time.

potion.tip: 常见于奇幻故事；普通药物的一剂用dose。
potion.en: A drink believed to have magical or medicinal effects.

appraise.tip: appraise是评估；不要与apprise（告知）混淆。
appraise.en: to judge the quality, condition, or performance of something

tariff.tip: 关税用tariff on goods；复数tariffs常指多项关税。
tariff.en: a tax charged on goods entering or leaving a country

sarcastic.tip: 常用反话挖苦人；ironic不一定含攻击或嘲弄。
sarcastic.en: using mocking words, often meaning the opposite, to criticize

devastating.tip: 事物令人悲痛用devastating；人感到悲痛用devastated。
devastating.en: Causing extremely serious damage or destruction.

simultaneous.tip: 强调时间重合；副词simultaneously表示同时地。
simultaneous.en: happening or existing at exactly the same time

desolate.tip: 形容地方指荒凉，形容人则指孤独凄凉。
desolate.en: Empty of people and lacking signs of life

rodent.tip: 老鼠、松鼠和河狸都属啮齿动物。
rodent.en: a mammal with strong front teeth that grow continuously

normalization.tip: 英式也拼normalisation；数据语境常指归一化。
normalization.en: The process of making conditions normal or usual.

consulate.tip: consulate是领事馆；embassy是大使馆，职能不同。
consulate.en: an office representing a country and helping its citizens abroad

vainly.tip: vainly侧重努力无果，常可换成in vain。
vainly.en: Without achieving the desired result despite effort

amputate.tip: 主要用于手术切除肢体，不能泛指切除所有器官。
amputate.en: To surgically remove all or part of a limb.

rig.tip: rig作动词既可指装配，也可指作弊操纵；注意语境。
rig.en: a large structure or machine used for drilling

erosion.tip: 通常不可数；也可比喻信任、权利等逐渐受损。
erosion.en: The gradual removal of soil or rock by natural forces.

scornful.tip: 常用 scornful of，表示对某人或某事不屑。
scornful.en: showing that you think someone or something deserves no respect

disadvantageous.tip: 常用disadvantageous to sb表示对某人不利。
disadvantageous.en: Making success harder or putting someone in a worse position.

flaunt.tip: flaunt指炫耀；flout指公然无视规则，勿混。
flaunt.en: To show something proudly to attract attention or admiration.

robust.tip: 既形容身体或物品结实，也形容证据、系统可靠。
robust.en: strong, healthy, and unlikely to break or become weak

tacit.tip: tacit指未明说但已理解，并非明确表达的同意。
tacit.en: Understood or accepted without being directly stated.

solidify.tip: 既可指液体凝固，也可指关系或地位得到巩固。
solidify.en: To become solid, or make something become solid.

crave.tip: 直接接宾语：crave something，不加 for。

ultraviolet.tip: 常缩写为UV；紫外线本身肉眼不可见。
ultraviolet.en: Describing invisible radiation with wavelengths shorter than visible violet light.

everlasting.tip: 语气比long-lasting更强，常用于爱、友谊等抽象事物。
everlasting.en: Lasting forever or seeming never to end.

asylum.tip: 表示庇护时不可数；指精神病院是过时用法。
asylum.en: Protection a country gives people escaping danger in another country.

parasite.tip: 指人时有强烈贬义；生物学中的宿主叫host。
parasite.en: an organism living on or inside another and taking nutrients

decompose.tip: 既可不及物，也可及物；分解成某物用into。
decompose.en: to decay naturally into simpler substances

colonialism.tip: 通常不可数；colony指殖民地，非殖民主义。
colonialism.en: Control of another territory and its people by a country

meteorologist.tip: 研究天气与大气，不是研究流星的天文学家。
meteorologist.en: A scientist who studies weather and atmospheric conditions.

theatrical.tip: 既指戏剧相关，也可形容言行夸张做作。
theatrical.en: relating to theatre or the performance of plays

agitation.tip: 通常不可数；既可指情绪不安，也可指搅动。
agitation.en: A state of worry or excitement that prevents calm behaviour.

accrued.tip: 也是accrue的过去分词；应计不等于已收付。
accrued.en: built up over time, especially financially, but not necessarily paid

vocal.tip: be vocal about表示公开且强烈地表达对某事的看法。
vocal.en: Expressing opinions or complaints openly and strongly.

elapse.tip: 不及物动词，以时间作主语，不能直接接宾语。
elapse.en: for a period of time to pass

ominous.tip: 强调预示坏事将发生，而非坏事已经发生。
ominous.en: suggesting that something bad or unpleasant may happen

overlap.tip: 动词重音在后，名词在前；过去式overlapped。
overlap.en: to partly cover something or share features with it

volatile.tip: 既可描述市场波动，也可指情绪易变或物质易挥发。
volatile.en: Likely to change suddenly and unpredictably.

pertain.tip: 正式用语，通常接to；常见结构为pertaining to。
pertain.en: To relate to or apply to a particular subject.

filament.tip: 既指一般细丝，也指灯泡中通电发光的灯丝。
filament.en: A very thin thread or thread-like structure.

impart.tip: 常用impart sth to sb，意为把某事传授给某人。
impart.en: To communicate knowledge, information, or skills to someone

depreciate.tip: 常指货币或资产贬值；反义词appreciate可指升值。
depreciate.en: To lose value, or reduce an asset's recorded value.

hereby.tip: 用于正式声明，常置于主语后、主要动词前。
hereby.en: By means of this statement or official action.

scarlet.tip: turn scarlet常形容因尴尬或生气而脸红。

gramophone.tip: 指老式唱片播放机；美式英语常称phonograph。
gramophone.en: an old machine that plays sound from flat records

strive.tip: 常用strive to do或strive for；过去式常为strove。
strive.en: To try very hard to achieve something.

yearn.tip: 用yearn for sth或yearn to do，表达强烈渴望。
yearn.en: To want something deeply, especially something difficult to obtain

coherence.tip: 侧重逻辑连贯；cohesion侧重语言或结构衔接。
coherence.en: The quality of ideas fitting together clearly and logically.

monarch.tip: 可指国王或女王，不限性别；制度称monarchy。
monarch.en: A king or queen who serves as head of state

bypass.tip: 作动词直接接宾语：bypass the town。
bypass.en: To go around something or avoid a usual step

multitude.tip: a multitude of后接复数名词，表示大量。
multitude.en: A very large number of people or things

deceased.tip: 正式用语；the deceased可指一位或多位死者。
deceased.en: No longer alive, especially in formal or legal contexts.

resentful.tip: 强调因自觉受到不公平对待而不满，不只是生气。
resentful.en: angry because you believe you have been treated unfairly

diversion.tip: 英式英语中可指道路改道；美式常用detour。
diversion.en: A change in the route or use of something.

tack.tip: 方法用tack；步入正轨用on track，勿混。
tack.en: A short nail with a broad, flat head.

reappraisal.tip: 常用a reappraisal of，表示对某事重新评价。
reappraisal.en: A fresh assessment of something, often leading to changed views.

toad.en: A frog-like animal with rough skin that usually lives on land.

inflict.tip: 搭配为inflict伤害on对象，不能说inflict sb。
inflict.en: to cause someone or something to suffer harm

duplicate.tip: 名词、形容词结尾读/kət/；动词读/keɪt/。

methodology.tip: method是具体方法；methodology侧重整套方法及原理。
methodology.en: a system of methods and principles used in research

farmhand.tip: hand可指干体力活的人；farmhand是雇工而非农场主。
farmhand.en: A person employed to do practical work on a farm

portfolio.tip: 求职时常指作品集；金融语境指投资组合。
portfolio.en: a collection of work showing someone's skills and experience

enlighten.tip: 常用enlighten sb about/on sth，语气较正式。
enlighten.en: to give someone information that helps them understand something

pore.tip: 动词常用pore over，勿与pour over混淆。
pore.en: a tiny opening in skin or another surface

magnitude.tip: 谈规模常用the magnitude of；震级也用此词。
magnitude.en: The size, extent, or importance of something.

irony.tip: irony不只是巧合，常指结果与预期形成讽刺性反差。
irony.en: A situation that is strikingly opposite to what is expected.

advent.tip: 常用the advent of，指重要新事物的出现。
advent.en: The arrival of an important new invention, event, or period

mediate.tip: mediate侧重促成协议；arbitrate可指作出仲裁。
mediate.en: To help opposing sides reach an agreement.

latitude.en: Distance north or south of the equator, measured in degrees.

relentless.tip: 不限于“无情的”，也常形容雨、压力等持续不减。
relentless.en: continuing strongly without stopping or becoming less intense

analogous.tip: 常用be analogous to，强调某方面可作比较。
analogous.en: Similar in a way that allows a useful comparison.

depict.tip: depict A as B：把A描绘成B。
depict.en: to show or describe something in art, images, or words

pasture.tip: pasture强调供牲畜吃草的土地，不是普通草坪。
pasture.en: Land covered with grass where farm animals feed.

biographer.en: Someone who writes an account of another person's life.

assertion.tip: 常用the assertion that…；断言不代表已有证据。
assertion.en: a confident statement that something is true

standstill.tip: 常用come to a standstill，注意冠词a。
standstill.en: A state in which all movement or activity has stopped.

fodder.tip: 通常不可数；fodder for也可比喻供利用的素材。
fodder.en: Food such as hay or straw given to farm animals.

globalize.en: to make something operate or spread across the world

spatial.tip: spatial指空间关系；spacious指地方宽敞。
spatial.en: relating to space and the positions of objects within it

narcotic.tip: 医学常指麻醉性镇痛药；法律语境可泛指毒品。
narcotic.en: a sleep-inducing painkiller; also an illegal drug
